hero.sub: Discovery & verification controller ma Vortex atipɛnfo-ne-atipɛnfo ntam nkitahodi. Bue. Wɔayɛ no encrypted. Nea wontumi nsiw ano.

network.label: NETWORK .
network.body: Atipɛnfo biara kura krataa a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase. Clients di ho adanse ansa na wɔabɔ mu, nodes di adanse sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wura bere a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din no. Tumi titiriw biara nni hɔ a obetumi ayɛ nea cryptography asi so dua dedaw no atoro.
network.dual_body: Wɔakyerɛw wɔn din wɔ controller AND a wɔasɔ no ano wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so denam Solana so. Adansefo baanu a wɔde wɔn ho si code hash ne pubkey so dua. Ahobammɔ wom ma nhyiam ahorow a ɛyɛ nkate.
network.ctrl_body: Signature di adanse sɛ node no wɔ ne private key, nanso code integrity no nnyɛ anchored on-chain. Fine ma nhyiam dodow no ara; asiane = ahotoso wɔ controller operator no so.
network.unverif_body: Wonim fi config anaa nsɛmmɔnedi mu. Cryptographic adanse biara nni hɔ de besi nnɛ. Fa di dwuma nkutoo de bootstrap atipɛnfo list — da sɛ handoff botae ma live sessions.

security.label: SECURITY .
security.heading_line1: Zero-a wɔde wɔn ho to so
security.body: Ed25519 keypairs anan a ɛde ne ho, a emu biara wɔ adwuma teateaa biako. Safoa biako biara a wɔsɛe no no nsɛe afoforo no.
security.release_verified: Clients — pinned wɔ bere a wɔasi
security.controller_signs: /v1/* mmuae biara a mfaso wɔ so
security.controller_verified: Clients — fi SNS anaasɛ si pin
security.user_signs: Session tokens, nkrasɛm nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm
security.step1_t: SNS hwehwɛ a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu
security.step1_d: Kenkan vortexx.sol wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so. Kyerɛwtohɔ a Solana sika kotoku de ne nsa ahyɛ ase — ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye sɛ DNS-hijack.
security.step2_d: Client frɛ /v1/integrity. Pow mmuae biara gye status: verified fi pinned release key no mu.
security.step3_t: Mmuae ahorow a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase
security.step3_d: API frɛ biara san ba {payload, sig, signed_by}. Client di Ed25519 nsaano nkyerɛwee no ho adanse ansa na wanya ahotoso.
security.step4_d: Sealed nodes: client kenkan code_hash fi Solana registry mu. Divergence fi controller = daa blacklisted.
security.cta_full: Ahobammɔ ho nhwɛso a edi mũ →
security.check_auth: Mmuae nokwaredi — ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye sɛ wobɛfa /v1/nodes a controller no kokoam safoa nni hɔ.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — controller fael ahorow a wɔayɛ no hashed na wɔayɛ no cross-checked wɔ startup biara mu. Tampering san 503 ansa na wɔasom kar biara.
security.check_identity: Node identity — ɛsɛ sɛ node ahorow no de wɔn ankasa safoa hyɛ ase sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw wɔn din. ɔtowhyɛfo ntumi nkyerɛw ne din wɔ node foforo pubkey ananmu.
security.check_dns: DNS hijack ahobammɔ — .sol kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow no te ase wɔ Solana so. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtamfo de sika kotoku no to asiane mu, ɛnyɛ DNS ɔkyerɛwfo bi kɛkɛ.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — session transfers kura Ed25519-signed tokens a anti-replay, a ɛyɛ adwuma simma 5 pɛ. Target pow fibea ahorow a wonnim.
security.check_transport: Transport kokoamsɛm — nkitahodi URL a wotumi hu ma wo ISP / Cloudflare. Fa Tor ahwehwɛ no di dwuma sɛ metadata ho hia a.
security.check_content: Nkrasɛm mu nsɛm — NOT a controller no de ne nsa ka. End-to-end encrypted wɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ntam. Controller ntumi nkenkan biribiara mpo sɛ wɔagyae mu koraa a.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — sɛ VPS no yɛ ntini a, wobetumi awia safe. Fa hardware-backed signing di dwuma ma paranoid deployments.

access.label: ACCESS .
access.body: Nneɛma pii a wɔde hyɛn mu kyerɛ sɛ adwumakuw biako biara nni hɔ a ebetumi asiw wo kwan a wobɛfa so akɔ hɔ no kwan. Mirror sites som nneɛma koro no ara a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase fi independent infrastructure mu.
access.tunnel_title: Cloudflare ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma
access.tunnel_body: *.trycloudflare.com address a wontua hwee. Akontaabu biara ho nhia. URL sesa bere a tuntum no san fi ase — fa no sɛ bere tiaa mu de.
access.tor_body: .onion address, a wobetumi afa Tor nkutoo so akɔ hɔ. Censor-proof ne metadata-private, nanso ɛyɛ brɛoo. Ɛhia Tor afɛfoɔ.
access.ipfs_body: Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu-addressed copy a ɛwɔ static frontend no. IPFS apon biara betumi asom no — server biako biara nni hɔ a wobesiw ano.
access.direct_body: Domain a wɔyɛ no daa + TLS. Ɔkwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm sen biara. Blockable wɔ DNS/IP level — hwe ase san kɔ afoforo so sɛ censored a.
access.mirrors_body: Host foforo a ɛsom nneɛma a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase koro no ara pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛ saa controller yi. Wɔhwehwɛ ahwehwɛ biara mu bere ne bere mu — nsensanee a ɛyɛ ahabammono kyerɛ sɛ wobetumi adu ho wɔ simma 5 a etwa to no mu. Tor .onion ahwehwɛ no ntumi nhwɛ akwahosan a ɛnyɛ mpɔtam hɔ Tor proxy.
access.cta_entries: URL ahorow a wɔde hyɛ mu →

start.label: GET STARTED .
start.step1: Fa Vortex si wo mfiri so — mobile anaa desktop so.
start.step2: Paw Global ntwamutam tebea wɔ nhyehyɛe wizard no mu.
start.step3: Fa controller URL (auto-resolved via SNS) anaa entry biara URL fi Entries krataafa no so.
start.step4: Hwɛ sɛ pubkey a ɛwɔ wo app mu no ne controller nsateaa nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no hyia. Nea ɛne ne ho nhyia kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛsakra nneɛma.
start.step5: Wo ne wo abɔ mu. Wɔdi node list, signatures, ne routing ho dwuma automatically.
start.fingerprint_note: Pin saa safoa yi wɔ wo client no mu ansa na woagye mmuae biara adi.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_title: On- nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛda adi pefee
treasury.transparency_body: Protocol fees nyinaa — node register fees ne 20% a wɔatwa premium subscriptions — sen kɔ sikakorabea sika kotoku a ɛwɔ Solana so. Aguadi biara yɛ nea obiara betumi adi ho adanse wɔ baguam.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% wɔ premium sub biara mu kɔ akatua pool, kyekyɛ pro-rata ma active node operators. 20% de sika ma core nkɔso. 10% hyew anaasɛ ɛtra ase sɛ insurance.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Kasa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Scripting kasa a ɛyɛ adwuma yiye a wɔde kyekye bots. 96 afã horow. Rust akyi asɛm.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix yɛ kasa a ɛfa domain pɔtee bi (DSL) a wɔayɛ fi mfiase sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛw Vortex bots. Baabi a kasa afoforo hwehwɛ nhomakorabea, callbacks, ne boilerplate no, Gravitix ma wo event handlers a edi kan, nkɔmmɔbɔ flows, ne built-in state — ne nyinaa wɔ syntax a ɛho tew, a wotumi kenkan a Rust na ɛkanyan no mu.
gravitixDocs.designGoals: Botae ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ nhyehyɛe
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Readable — code kenkan te sɛ adwene, ɛnyɛ mfiri
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe — static types kyere mfomso ansa na runtime aba
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Expressive — flows, guards, ne pattern matching yɛ nea wɔasisi wɔ mu
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — adesua biara nni hɔ, agyapade biara nni hɔ, nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosua
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix yɛ ma obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Vortex bot ntɛmntɛm — sɛ ebia wo nkyerɛw code da, anaasɛ woyɛ seasoned developer a woabrɛ Python boilerplate. Saa nsɛm a wɔde gyina so yi kyerɛkyerɛ Gravitix fi nnyinasosɛm ahorow a edi kan mu: osuahu biara a edi kan ho nhia.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Ɔfã biara gyina nea atwam no so. Sɛ woyɛ foforo wɔ nhyehyɛe mu a, kenkan fi soro kosi ase. Sɛ wunim kasa foforo dedaw a, fa emu nsɛm no huruw kɔ nea w’ani gye ho no so tẽẽ.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Ɔkwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm sen biara a efi zero so kɔ bot a ɛretu mmirika so.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — kyerɛkyerɛ handler a ɛyɛ adwuma bere a ɔdefo bi soma /start. emit "..." — de nkra san kɔma nea ɔde di dwuma no. {ctx.first_name} — de ɔdefoɔ no din a ɛdi kan no hyɛ ahama no mu.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Wɔ Gravitix IDE no mu no, klik Run button a ɛwɔ soro bar no so. Hyehyɛ wo Vortex Bot Token bere a wɔabisa no. Bot no fi ase ntɛm ara — no build step needed.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Wɔde adansiɛ mfitiaseɛ mmiɛnsa na ɛkyekyere Gravitix dwumadie biara: handlers, emit statements, ne logic.
gravitixDocs.anatomyOfHandler: Anatomy a ɛfa obi a ɔde ne nsa di dwuma ho
gravitixDocs.multipleHandlers: Handlers pii ma trigger koro no ara
gravitixDocs.declaringVariables: Nsakrae ahorow a wɔpae mu ka
gravitixDocs.declaringDesc: Fa asɛmfua titiriw let no di dwuma.
gravitixDocs.explicitTypes: Type nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛda adi pefee
gravitixDocs.updatingVariables: Nsakrae ahorow a wɔreyɛ no foforo
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Botae biara a ɛwɔ Gravitix mu no wɔ type bi. Type system no yɛ static: wɔhwɛ types wɔ compile bere mu, ansa na wo bot no ayɛ adwuma.

gravitixDocs.multilineStrings: Nhama a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde pii mu
gravitixDocs.ifElifElse: sɛ / elif / a ɛnte saa a
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Pattern-match botae bi atia pattern ahorow pii. Fa no sɛ ɛyɛ switch asɛm a tumi wom.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Dwumadi ahorow yɛ koodu block ahorow a wotumi san de di dwuma. Wɔboa wo ma wokwati sɛ wobɛsan atĩ mu na wɔma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛte mmara ase.

gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Awɛmfo ma wode tebea bi ka handler bi ho. Sɛ ɔwɛmfo no susuw ho sɛ ɛyɛ nokware nkutoo a, nea ɔhwɛ so no tu mmirika.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: ctx adeɛ no wɔ hɔ ankasa wɔ handler biara mu. Ɛwɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren ne nea ɔde kɔmaa no ho.

gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Flows ma wo kyerɛw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛwɔ anammɔn pii wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ linear, a wotumi kenkan so. Flow bi betumi agyina kakra na atwɛn nea ɔde di dwuma no nkrasɛm a edi hɔ.

intro.li2: Safe — static types catch mfomsoɔ ansa na wɔayɛ
intro.li3: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu — flows, guards, ne nhwɛso matching yɛ nea wɔasisi mu
intro.li4: Minimal — adesua biara nni hɔ, agyapade biara nni hɔ, nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosua
intro.p1: Gravitix yɛ kasa a ɛfa domain pɔtee bi ho (DSL) a wɔayɛ no fi fam sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛw Vortex bots. Baabi a kasa afoforo hwehwɛ nhomakorabea, callbacks, ne boilerplate no, Gravitix ma wo event handlers a edi kan, nkɔmmɔbɔ flows, ne state a wɔasisi mu — ne nyinaa wɔ syntax a ɛho tew, a wotumi kenkan a Rust na ɛkanyan no mu.
intro.p2: Gravitix yɛ ma obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Vortex bot ntɛmntɛm — sɛ ebia woankyerɛw code da, anaasɛ woyɛ seasoned developer a woabrɛ wɔ Python boilerplate ho. Saa nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi kyerɛkyerɛ Gravitix fi nnyinasosɛm ahorow a edi kan mu: osuahu biara a wɔadi kan ahwehwɛ.

math_special.p1: Gamma dwumadie Γ(n) yɛ factorial no generalization a ɛkɔ so: Γ(n) = (n−1)! ma akontaahyɛde mũ a ɛyɛ papa. Ɛtrɛw factorial mu kɔ akontaabu ankasa ne nea ɛyɛ den so.
math_special.p2: Mfomsoɔ dwumadie erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt yɛ Gaussian no integral. Ɛne CDF a ɛyɛ daa no wɔ abusuabɔ tẽẽ na ɛda adi wɔ ɔhyew nsɛso ne nea ebetumi aba ho nsusuwii mu.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ ma n=1,2,3,... (bere a Re(s)>1). Ɛnam Euler ade no so di nkitaho kɔ prime distribution so. Riemann Hypothesis (a wonnyaa ano aduru!) no fa ζ zero a ɛwɔ plane a ɛyɛ den no mu ho.
math_special.p4: Bessel dwumadie Jₙ(x) ne Yₙ(x) yɛ Bessel nsonsonoeɛ nsɛsoɔ no ano aduru: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Ɛda adi wɔ asorɔkye a ɛtrɛ, ɔhyeɛ a ɛkɔ cylinders mu, ne quantum mechanics mu.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) ne Bi(x) yɛ ano aduru a ɛma y'' = xy. Wɔpue wɔ quantum tunneling (WKB bɛyɛ) ne optics (diffraction) mu.
math_special.p6: Saa polynomial mmusua yi sɔre sɛ eigenfunctions a ɛwɔ operators a ɛho hia mu na wɔde di dwuma wɔ spectral akwan, quadrature, ne quantum mechanics mu.
math_special.p7: K(k) ne E(k) yɛ elliptic integrals a edi mũ a ɛyɛ nea edi kan ne nea ɛto so abien. Wɔbu bere a pendulum a ɛnyɛ linear ne ellipse atwa ho ahyia no ho akontaa.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫₀^∞ tˣ⁻1e⁻dt. Lanczos bɛyɛ sɛ. Γ(n+1)=n na ɛyɛ!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids boroflow ma x kɛse.
math_special.td5: P3(x): ɛyɛ orthogonal wɔ [−1,1] so. Hydrogen asorɔkye dwumadi ahorow no fã a ɛyɛ ahinanan.
math_special.td6: H3(x): w.r.t a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. e^(−x2) na ɛwɔ hɔ. Quantum harmonic oscillator a ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa.
math_special.td7: T3 (x) = cos (n·acos (x)): polynomial bɛyɛ a eye sen biara.
math_special.td8: L3(x): ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x) na ɛyɛ. Hydrogen radial asorɔkye dwumadi ahorow.

architexDocs.title: Architex Kasa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu
architexDocs.subtitle: Kasa a wɔde mpaemuka UI ma Vortex Mini Apps. Reactive tebea, composable nhyehyɛe, zero ɔda anammɔn.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex yɛ mpaemuka ketewa DSL a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde UI bɛkɔ Vortex ɔbɔfo no mu. Wokyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ screen no yɛ mu; runtime no ma piksel ahorow no yɛ sync ne tebea no ara kwa. Virtual DOM biara nni hɔ, bundler biara nni hɔ, JSX biara nni hɔ — `.arx` fael no ne app no.
architexDocs.designGoals: Botae ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ nhyehyɛe
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Declarative — wo kyerɛw UI a wopɛ, ɛnyɛ anammɔn a wobɛfa so asi no
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~count += 1` na label biara a ɛkenkan no updates wɔ beaeɛ
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — `.arx` koro no ara na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb, iOS, ne Android runtimes a enni nsakrae
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer hyɛn wɔ ase 30 KB, enti Mini Apps bue ntɛm ara
architexDocs.goalReadable: Akenkan — indentation yɛ nhyehyɛe; wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abɔ nsakraefo a wɔde `::`; tow biara nni hɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ nkyerɛwde nkyerɛwde ho
architexDocs.whoDesc: Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde nkitahodi screen bi mena wɔ Vortex — adetɔfo nkrataa, dashboards, abatow nkratafa, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Sɛ woakyerɛw HTML+CSS+JS pɛn a, Architex bɛte nka sɛ wunim nanso ɛyɛ ntɛm sɛ wobɛkyerɛw. Sɛ woannyɛ saa a, Architex nso yɛ nnianim asɛm a ɛyɛ brɛoo a ɛfa reactive programming ho efisɛ kasa no ma nan ase nkyerɛwee no yɛ ketewaa.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Ɔfã biara gyina nea edii kan bae no so. Fi ase wɔ Quick Start, afei kenkan Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, ne ɔfã a ɛkɔ akyiri no nea etwa to. Jump around via the table of contents sɛ wunim React anaa Svelte dedaw a — nsusuwii ahorow no map a ɛho tew.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Ɔkwan tiawa a efi fael a ɛda hɔ kwa so kɔ Mini App a ɛretu mmirika so.
architexDocs.yourFirstScreen: Wo screen a edi kan no
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Yɛkyea wo

  ~din = "wiase".

  col :: pad(24) gap(12) mfinimfini

    asɛmti "Hello, {~din}!" :: bold kɛse(28) .

    input ~ din :: pad (8) radius (6) hye (# ccc) .

    text "Twerɛ din bi wɔ atifi hɔ — saa nkyerɛwee yi yɛ foforo bere a worekyerɛw no."
      :: kɛse(12) kɔla (# 888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` de ntini no to gua. `~name = "wiase"` yɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛyɛ reactive. `col`, `header`, `input`, `text` yɛ nneɛma a wɔasisi wɔ mu. `::` de nsakraeɛ (padding, kɔla, kɛseɛ) bata ho. Sɛ ɔdefoɔ no kyerɛw kɔ input no mu a, `{~name}` interpolation biara yɛ foforɔ — wiring biara nni hɔ, subscriptions biara nni hɔ, renders biara nni hɔ a wɔde nsa yɛ.
architexDocs.runningIt: Screen no a wɔde tu mmirika
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Bue Architex tab no wɔ Vortex bot studio no mu, fa code no hyɛ mu, mia Run. Runtime no kyerɛ kɔ preview pane no mu na hot-reloads wɔ save so. Sɛ wo tintim a, wo dwumadiefoɔ no bue app no ​​firi nkɔmmɔbɔ biara mu — no installs.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Architex dwumadie biara yɛ nneɛma anan: mpaemuka a ɛfiri aseɛ wɔ `@`, reactive variables a wɔde `~` ahyɛ anim, components a wɔakyerɛw sɛ bare identifiers, ne modifiers a wɔde abata `::` akyi.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, ne `@for item in ~list` nyinaa fi ase wɔ column 0. Biribiara a wɔakyerɛw wɔ wɔn ase no yɛ saa block no dea.
architexDocs.anatomyComp: Anatomy a ɛfa ade bi ho
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Nneɛma a ɛka bom no te wɔn ankasa nkyerɛwde so: `nkyerɛwee`, `bɔn`, `mfonini`, `ati`, `ahyɛnsode`, `badge`, `kyekyɛmu`, `col`, `row`. Wɔn gyinabea ho akyinnyegye no ba edin no akyi pɛɛ: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifier: Anatomy a ɛwɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛsakra nneɛma mu
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: `::` akyi no wobɛtumi abɔ modifiers dodoɔ biara a wopɛ. Obiara fa zero anaa nea ɛboro saa akyinnyegye wɔ nkahyemde mu: `:: pad(24) gap(16) mfinimfini bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Modifiers yɛ positional, ɛnyɛ keyword — nhyehyɛe nnyɛ hwee gye last-writer-wins wɔn te sɛ `color`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` wɔ bɔtn bi so (anaasɛ nkitahodi fã biara) de dwumadi anaa dwumadie frɛ a ɛdi akyire no di dwuma. Multiple `=>` nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn afã-ne-afã: `button "Submit" => ~busy = nokware => soma (adeyɛ: "kora", data: ~ form)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVars: Nneɛma a ɛsakra a ɛma wɔyɛ ade
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Edin biara a wɔde `~` ahyɛ anim no yɛ reactive cell. Kyerɛw `~count = 0` de pae mu ka, `~count = 5` sɛ wobɛsan de ama, `~count += 1` de ayɛ foforo. UI node biara a ɛkenkan cell no — tẽẽ anaasɛ ɛnam interpolation so — san yɛ adwuma bere a cell no sesa.
architexDocs.computedVars: Nneɛma a ɛsakra a wɔabɔ ho akontaa
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Fa `:=` mmom sen `=` de bɔ akontabuo asɛmfua: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Nifa so no san susuw ho bere biara a biribiara a ɛde ne ho bɛsesa no. Manual subscription biara nni hɔ na stale-value bug biara nni hɔ — sɛ wokenkan `~a` wɔ baabi wɔ asɛmfua no mu a, wo ara wode wo ho to so.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yɛ nea wopɛ nanso ɛboa wɔ autocomplete ne mfomso nkrasɛm mu: `~count: nɔma = 0`, `~din: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = atoro`, `~nneɛma: array = []`, `~ɔdefo: ade = {}`. Sɛ wo skip wɔn a type no yɛ inferred fi initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `nɔmba`, `ahama`, `boolean`, `nhyehyɛe`, `ade`, `null`. Wɔde date ne blobs fa mu sɛ nhama ne nneɛma. Runtime no de JavaScript nhyɛsoɔ mmara di dwuma wɔ hood no ase, enti `~count + 1` yɛ adwuma sɛ mpo `~count` hyɛɛ asetena ase sɛ ahama a.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Ahama biara betumi de nsɛmfua a ɛwɔ `{...}` ahyɛ mu: `"Hello, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Interpolation yɛ nea ɛyɛ ade bere nyinaa.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex wɔ nkuku abien a wotumi hyehyɛ ne nhaban afã horow dumien. Nest wɔn ne indentation — no closing tags.
architexDocs.containers: Nneɛma a wɔde gu mu: col ne row
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` stacks mmofra gyina hɔ, `row` gyina hɔ. Wɔn baanu nyinaa gye `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `mfinimfini`, `nyin`, ne ntrɛwmu/ɔsorokɔ nsakraefo tom. Indent mmofra level biako mu dɔ ma wɔnyɛ berebuw.
architexDocs.containerExample:
row :: gap(8) pad(16) mfinimfini
  mfonini "/avatar.png" :: w (40) h (40) radius (20) .
  col :: nyin gap(2) .
    nkyerɛwee ~din :: nkyerɛwde tuntum
    nkyerɛwee ~ bio :: kɛse (12) kɔla (# 888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — nipadua biara a wɔde yɛ mfonini. `header` — semantically a ɛyɛ asɛmti. `label` — nsɛm nketewa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm. `button` — tap-a wotumi di so. `input` — nkyerɛwee afuw a wɔakyekyere no reactive var. `mfonini` — mfonini a efi URL bi mu. `badge` — tag a ɛte sɛ pill. `divider` — a ɛyɛ teateaa a ɛpaapae mu. `toast` — bere tiaa mu aduan a wɔde ma. `tabs` / `tab` — tab nsakraefoɔ.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` kyerɛ ahama a ɛyɛ static. `text ~message` kyerɛ nea ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ adwuma. Fa nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu ka bom: `text "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Nsɛm a ɛwɔ asɛmti mu. Defaults to kɛse, bolder sen `text`. Gyinabea ho akyinnyegye koro no ara: `atiri "Nsiesiei"`. Size nsenia ne screen — override ne `size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Tap-able element a wotumi de tap. Gyinabea ahama no ne label no; `=>` adeyɛ no tu mmirika wɔ tap so. `button "Sie" => ~draft = null`. `=>` ogya pii wɔ nnidiso nnidiso.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ akwan abien so. Reactive variable a ɛwɔ din no akyi no kura mprempren botae: `input ~email`. Nsakraeɛ: `beaeɛ("...")`, `debounce(300)` ma throttled updates.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Adesoa fi HTTPS URL anaa `/uploads/...` kwan so. Nsakraefo `w (px)`, `h (px)`, `radius (px)` twitwa adaka no mu. Ɛhwe ase san kɔ beaeɛ silhouette sɛ URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline separator, 1px, hyɛ mprempren asɛmti kɔla no anuonyam. Akyinnyegye biara nni hɔ.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Pill a ɛyɛ ne mu nsɛm atuu: `badge ~count`, `badge "new"`. Fa di dwuma ma counters a wɔankenkan ne tag chips.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/aboafoɔ nkyerɛwee — a wɔde aniwa brɛ ase. Good ma fom afuo din.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Amanneɛbɔ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔasiw ano. `toast ~visible "Wɔakora so!" :: duration(2000)` kyerɛ s 2 bere biara a `~visible` yɛ nokware, afei auto-dismisses. Modal stacking biara nni hɔ, z-index akodi biara nni hɔ.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab container a wɔakyekyere no akɔ reactive string so: `tabs ~activeTab`. Wɔ mu no, `tab "Label" "key"` biara bɔ tab biako ho dawuru; wɔkyerɛ nipadua a wɔde ahyɛ ase no bere a safe no hyia no.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ayɛ component bi style. Fa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn hyehyɛ wɔn wɔ `::` akyi. Wɔyɛ mmusua anum: ntam kwan, ne kɛse, kɔla, nkyerɛwee, ne nneyɛe.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — padding wɔ afã nyinaa. `pad(x, y)` — a ɛda fam + gyina hɔ. `pad(atifi, nifa, ase, benkum)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — ahunmu a ɛda mmofra a wɔwɔ `col` / `row` ntam. `margin(n)` — akyi kwan a ɛda anuanom ntam.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — ntrɛwmu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. `h(px)` — ɔsorokɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. `grow` — hyɛ baabi a aka ma wɔ row/col. `mfinimfini` — mfinimfini wɔ mmeamudua no so; wɔ `col` mu no ɛwɔ mfinimfini tẽẽ, wɔ `row` mu no ɛwɔ mfinimfini tẽẽ.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `kɔla(#rrggbb)` — anim. `bg (#rrggbb)` — akyi. Wɔn baanu nyinaa gye asɛmti token tom: `color(~primary)` kenkan fi mprempren `@theme` block no mu. Opacity fa 8-digit hex mu: `#00000080` yɛ 50 %% tuntum.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — nkyerɛwde kɛse. `bold` / `italic` — mu duru ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ. `align(benkum|mfinimfini|nifa)` — nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — yi node no fi mu bere a frankaa no yɛ nokware. `a wotumi hu (~ frankaa)` — inverse. Nodes a wɔanhyɛ no hwie wɔn DOM gu, enti conditional UI yɛ nea ne bo yɛ mmerɛw.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce (ms)` wɔ `input` so throttles nsɛm foforo. `placeholder("...")` kyerɛ hint ahama. `format(kind, arg)` wɔ `text` so no hyehyɛ nɔma: `format("sika", "USD")`, `format("ɔha biara mu nkyem")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` yɛ ntwea so kurukuruwa. `border(#rrggbb)` twetwe 1 px nkyerɛwde. `border(px, #rrggbb)` de ne kɛse nso si hɔ.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Nneyɛe sesa tebea anaasɛ kasa kyerɛ abɔnten wiase. Wɔtu mmirika synchronously wɔ tap/keypress handler no mu.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~kan = 0`, `=> ~adagyew = nokware`, `=> ~list = []`. Reactive variable biara yɛ nea wotumi kyerɛw.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~count += 1` yɛ kasakoa ma akontabuo.
architexDocs.actionMultiple: Nneyɛe a wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn gu mu
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: `=>` pii a ɛwɔ line koro no ara so to gya soro-kɔ-ase wɔ tick koro no ara mu, enti UI no yɛ foforo pɛnkoro wɔ awiei: `button "Tɔ" => ~busy = nokware => send(action: "tɔ") => ~busy = false`. Sɛ wopɛ async adwuma a, pɛ kɔmputa so `@reaction`.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` yɛ bridge a ɛsan kɔ bot no so. Host (Vortex runtime) no gye no sɛ JSON RPC nkra na obetumi afrɛ wo bot no code. Fa di dwuma ma login, API fetches, payments — biribiara a DSL no ankasa ntumi nkyerɛ.
architexDocs.actionNavigate: Navigation a wɔde fa kwan so
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto ("ScreenName", arg: botae, ...)` pia `@screen` foforo kɔ stack no so; `akyi ()` pops. Runtime no yɛ nkwa denam default so.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("hann" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — `it` nkyerɛwde tiawa no yɛ sanba bo a ɛwɔ asɛmfua a edi kan no mu.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Fa palette bi to gua pɛnkoro, san fa di dwuma wɔ baabiara. Tokens bɛyɛ daa reactive variables enti wo app no ​​betumi de dark-mode toggle akɔma wɔ lines abiɛsa mu.
architexDocs.themeExample:
@asɛmti no
  ~mfitiase = #4f8ef7
  ~asiane = #e53935 na ɛwɔ hɔ
  ~bg = #ffffff
  ~nkyerɛwee = #212121
  ~radius = 12 na ɛyɛ
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` twe `@component` ne `@screen` biara fi saa fael no mu kɔ mprempren scope no mu. Akwan no fa fael a wɔde ba no ho; wɔhunu circular imports na wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ wɔ parse berɛ mu.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Kyerɛkyerɛ mu pɛnkoro, fa di dwuma mpɛn pii: `@component Avatar url kɛse\n mfonini url :: w(kɛse) h(kɛse) radius(kɛse / 2)`. Wɔ component body no mu no parameters a wɔato din no wɔ scope mu sɛ plain identifiers (a `~` nni mu).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item wɔ ~list` kyerɛ row biako wɔ element biara mu. `@for item, idx wɔ ~list` nso kyekyere index a egyina zero so no. Runtime no di identity akyi denam element no ankasa so, enti sɛ wode nneɛma ka ho wɔ 10 000-row list atifi a, ɛbɔ O(1) DOM adwuma.
architexDocs.forExample:
@ma ade, idx wɔ ~nneɛma mu
  row :: nsonsonoe(8) pad(4) .
    badge ~idx
    text ~item :: nyin
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` yɛ adwuma wɔ baabiara a wogye asɛmfua bi tom. Nest ma enums: `~gyinabea >= 10 ? "ɔkorɔn" : ~gyinabea >= 5 ? "mid" : "a ɛba fam"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Wɔ component declaration mu no, `slot` hyɛ baabi a ɔfrɛfo no nipadua plug in. Fa no sɛ ɛyɛ React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: `~var` biara yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne. Sɛ wokenkan no wɔ kɔmputa, modifier argument, anaa interpolation mu a, runtime no hyɛ akenkan no nsow wɔ mprempren dependency graph no mu. Sɛ worekyerɛw a, node biara a ɛkenkan no nya re-evaluated — pɛnkoro, wɔ mprempren microtask no awiei.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Wɔayɛ writes pii wɔ handler koro no ara mu batched. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` kanyan render pass biako pɛpɛɛpɛ.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Sɛnea wɔahyɛ no, runtime no de pɛyɛ a ɛyɛ katee (`===`) di dwuma. Sɛ wokyerɛw botae koro no ara a, ɛsan tu mmirika biara. Fa ade/array foforo kɔ mu de hyɛ update; wɔhyɛ nsakrae a ɛnsakra ho nkuran nanso ɛnhwehwɛ.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Canonical apps anan, a emu biara wɔ ne ho na ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde 40 ase. Kɔpi wɔn mu biara kɔ Architex tab no mu na mia Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter — reactive tebea, kɔmputa, button handlers, nsɛm a wɔkyekyere.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — list rendering, ka ho / yi fi hɔ, inline editing.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile — mfonini, badge, tebea mu visibility, akwantuo.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Killer features — asɛmti, imports, tabs, toasts, nɔma a wɔahyehyɛ, ternaries, typed vars.
architexDocs.errors: Mfomso a ɛtaa ba ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `unknown name ~foo` — wode reactive variable dii dwuma ansa na worebɔ ho dawuru. Fa `~foo = ...` ka ho wɔ `@screen` a ɛka ho no atifi.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — ɛsɛ sɛ mmofra yɛ level biako a emu dɔ sen wɔn ɔwofo. Architex de ahunmu abien pɛpɛɛpɛ di dwuma wɔ ɔfã biara mu; wɔpow tabs sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛkwati invisible-whitespace mfomso ahorow.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — wokyerɛw `:: shadow` nanso runtime no ntumi mmoa. Hwɛ modifier list a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no; Architex yɛ katee wɔ din a wonnim ho de bɔ forward compatability ho ban.
architexDocs.errType: `type mismatch` — s.e. wotwaam ahama bi a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ nɔma bi bɛba. Annotate reactive variable (`~count: number`) na parser no bɛkyerɛ wo baabi a bad value no fi ase.
architexDocs.errDebug: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ debug wɔ runtime mu a, kyekyere suspect expression no wɔ `debug(...)` mu — runtime no kyerɛw evaluation biara kɔ console no so a ennya botae no so nkɛntɛnso.
architexDocs.compatibility: Runtime a ɛne ne ho hyia
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — kyerɛ ase kɔ vanilla DOM a CSS nsakrae ma asɛmti tokens. No React / Vue / Svelte a ɛde ne ho to so.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — `.arx` koro no ara na wɔakyekyɛ mu na wɔakyerɛ ase akɔ SwiftUI hwɛ mu denam Vortex iOS host no so. Modifier biara map kɔ SwiftUI kwan so.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — host no kyerɛ ase kɔ Jetpack Compose. Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nsakraeɛ (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) kyerɛ aseɛ kɔ Compose equivalents.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Version policy — Architex hyɛ bɔ sɛ ɛbɛkɔ akyi ama `.arx` fael ahorow wɔ nkyerɛase nketewa nyinaa mu. `.arx` fael a wɔakyerɛw atia 0.1 da so ara yɛ adwuma wɔ 0.9 so.
architexDocs.nextSteps: Anamɔn a edi hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Kenkan aduannoa nwoma no ma nhwɛsoɔ (nkyerɛwde a enni ano, nkrataa, sikatua), nnwinnadeɛ akwankyerɛ ma CLI ne VS Code plugin, ne ntoboa akwankyerɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode ade bi a wɔasisi ka ho a. Fibea no nyinaa wɔ github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Nkyerɛkyerɛmu
meta.subtitle: Subsystem biara a ɛwɔ Vortex wɔ beaeɛ baako.
meta.intro: Saa nsɛm a wɔatwe adwene asi so yi yɛ nea edi mũ sɛnea wɔayɛ no. Fi ase wɔ baabiara — ti biara yɛ nea ɛfa ne ho. Asɛm biara san kɔ fibea akwan so bere a ɛfata. Wɔfrɛ biribiara a ɛnsakra pefee.
meta.howToUse: Nsɛm a ɛwɔ benkum so no yɛ ti ahorow a ɛwɔ ha no ahwehwɛ. Klik ti bi so na huruw kɔ so; ti biara wɔ nsɛmti nketewa ne nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ a wubetumi ahwehwɛ mu wɔ sikɔne 30 mu ansa na woakɔ mu.
meta.updatedBy: Wɔayɛ no afi `scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py` mu. San fa `python3 scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py` san kyekye.

architecture.title: Architecture ho nsɛm a wɔaka abom
architecture.subtitle: Nneɛma abiɛsa — client, node, controller — ne protocol biako a ɛkyekyere wɔn.
architecture.intro: Vortex yɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu. Sɛ anka ɛbɛyɛ akyi-akyi baako a ɛyɛ adwumakuo baako dea no, ɛka **nodes** a ɛde ne ho a ɛbue mu, a **controller** a ɛyɛ ketewa a ɛtintim mmara a wadi ho adanseɛ no manifest a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ ahunu na ɛhyɛ ho adanseɛ no bom. **Adetɔfoɔ** kura kokoam safoa nyinaa na wɔkyerɛ UI. Ti yi fã a aka no nantew akwan abiɛsa no, wɔn ahye, ne data a ɛsen fa wɔn ntam no so.
architecture.h1: Dɛn nti na wɔde decentralize bɛma
architecture.h1p1: Abɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mfinimfini no yɛ ade biako pɛ a wɔhyɛ. Asɛnnibea ahyɛde, cloud-provider outage, anaasɛ atamfo adetɔ nyinaa kyerɛ ase sɛ "wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no hwere kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ". Vortex sidesteps saa denam ma obiara a ɔbɛma no ayɛ node na wama clients akɔ node ntam a wɔrensan nkyerɛw wɔn din bio no so.
architecture.h1p2: Ɛsɛ sɛ decentralization kora kokoamsɛm ne nokwaredi so. Seva ahorow a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto so federation yɛ adwuma sɛ server ahorow no ntumi nkenkan nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no pefee na wontumi nyɛ nkrasɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware nkutoo a. Vortex hyɛ abien no nyinaa mu den denam end-to-end encryption ne Ed25519 adansedi so wɔ cross-node nkra biara so.
architecture.h1p3: Controller no yɛ centralised-ish afã biako, nanso ɛyɛ ketewaa bi. Ɛtintim `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ne nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu a wogye di nkutoo. Obiara betumi ayɛ ne ho agye ahwehwɛ, enti mpo controller no nyɛ ade biako pɛ a edi nkogu — nokware fibea biako pɛ ma "a pubkey signs official releases".
architecture.h1l1: No vendor lock-in: clients betumi atu wɔn identity akɔ nodes ntam bere biara denam X25519 pubkey a wɔbɛsan de wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase denam JWT foforo so.
architecture.h1l2: No outage correlation: sɛ node biako kɔ fam a, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node afoforo so no nhyɛ no nsow.
architecture.h1l3: Tumi biako biara nni hɔ: adwumayɛfo paw wɔn fie a mmara ma ho kwan, na wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no paw wɔn adwumayɛfo.
architecture.h1l4: No single UI: iOS, Android, wɛb yɛ atipɛnfo a wodi kan — platform biara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ tratraa wrapper wɔ foforo so.
architecture.h2p1: Client no yɛ adwuma wɔ user bi device so. Ɛno nkutoo ne beae a nkrasɛm a wɔakyerɛw no pefee, kokoam safe, ne fael-a-wɔ-mu-da hɔ no te. Node no nhu wɔn da.
architecture.h2p2: Platform biara a wɔboa no de waya protocol koro no ara di dwuma (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split feature modules (`api/` protocols, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) ma apam no yɛ den na platform-specific code no yɛ localised.
architecture.h2p3: Nneɛma a wɔkora so wɔ afiri no so: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly cookie ma tokens; SQLite (GRDB wɔ iOS, Room wɔ Android, IndexedDB wrapper wɔ wɛb) ma cached ciphertext + FTS index no.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Package a ɛwɔ 30+ afã module ahorow. Min deployment botae iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Nhyehyɛe + Hilt. minSdk 26, botaeSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanilla JS PWA, ɔsom adwumayɛfo, ɔdansi anammɔn biara nni hɔ a ɛboro ES module bundling so.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop — Tauri wrapper a ɛtwa wɛb akraman no ho hyia; bundle koro no ara, native Chrome renderer.
architecture.h3p1: Node yɛ Python dwumadie (`python -m app.main`, anaasɛ bundled `run.py`) a ɛtie wɔ 9000 default so. Ɛkɔ so tra ciphertext, fans fi WebSocket nsɛm a esisi, kura TURN credentials, na brokers federation ne nodes afoforo.
architecture.h3p2: Wɔhyɛ da na node layer no yɛ teateaa. Ɛda akwan bɛyɛ 120 adi wɔ `/api/*` dua no so a wɔde `/ws` ka ho ma bere ankasa mu fan-out. Wɔde ade a emu yɛ duru a wɔma so (crypto, baabi a wowɔ, nhyehyɛe) no to `app/security/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/` mu.
architecture.h3p3: Node biako a ɛwɔ default SQLite mode no mu di ~50 a wɔde di dwuma bere koro mu ho dwuma yiye wɔ M1 so. Sɛ Postgres ne Redis yɛ adwuma a, code koro no ara scales horizontally — node biara bɛyɛ stateless atwam DB ne fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛn mu: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrity` ne `/akwahosan` ma nkwa.
architecture.h3l2: Nneɛma a egyina so: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust ntrɛwmu `vortex_chat` ma ɔkwan a ɛyɛ hyew so crypto.
architecture.h3l3: Nea wopɛ: Redis (a ɛwɔ hɔ fan-out wɔ node ahorow pii so), Postgres (ayɛyɛ DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log po so hyɛn).
architecture.h3l4: Binary kɛse: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust ntrɛwmu. Docker mfonini bɛyɛ 400 MB ansa na squash.
architecture.h4p1: Controller no yɛ Python dwumadie a ɛyɛ soronko (`vortex_controller`) a ɛwɔ atirimpɔw teateaa: tintim na hwɛ `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, pa entry URLs, na di federated peers akwahosan akyi.
architecture.h4p2: Wɔ startup mu no controller no nantew source dua no, hashes fael biara, na ɔde toto manifest no ho. Sɛ hash biara nhyia a controller no pow sɛ ebefi ase. Wei kyerɛ sɛ fael a ɛwɔ disk so a wɔayɛ no foforo ntumi nsom `status:"verified"`.
architecture.h4p3: Clients bɔ `/v1/integrity` ansa na wɔagye node bi adi. Sɛ wohu `status != "verified"` a wɔpow sɛ wɔde credentials bɛma, bere. Ɛno ne ahotoso anchor no.
architecture.h4l1: Wɔde `nsafe/release.key` (Ed25519) ahyɛ aseɛ. Ɔmanfo fã a wɔatow akɔ client releases mu.
architecture.h4l2: Manifest entries: `{path, sha256, size}` ma fael biara a wɔanhwɛ so.
architecture.h4l3: San si: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_adwinnade`. Ɛde `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ba wɔ repo ntini no mu.
architecture.h4l4: Nkyinkyin: adwumayɛfo forking Vortex sesa `release.key`. Clients configured ne wɔn pubkey afei ahotoso saa fork.
architecture.h5p1: Nantew nea ɛba bere a Alice de "hi" kɔma Bob no mu:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Adetɔfo hwehwɛ dan no ntini safe wɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ sotɔɔ mu. Sɛ enni hɔ a, ɛgye envelope foforɔ firi `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` ma n'ankasa pubkey. DMfo a wodi kan tu mmirika Diffie-Hellman a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa biako wɔ prekeys so.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Client frame payload no sɛ CBOR `{v:1, text:"hi", reply_to:null, sent_at:...}`, yɛ random 96-bit nonce, seals ne AES-256-GCM, na POSTs `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` ne `{ciphertext: hex, nonce: hex, sender_pseudo: hex}`.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node sie row no na fans fi `{type:"m", dan:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` kɔ WebSocket biara a ɔwɔ nkitahodi a wɔakyerɛw ne din wɔ dan no mu.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob client no gye frame no, ɔde root key koro no ara decrypt, hwɛ sɛ sender pseudo ne membership a wɔhwɛ kwan no hyia, na ɔkyerɛ bubble no.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob afɛfo no de `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` a akenkan nkrasɛm id a etwa to no to gua. Ɛno kanyan `{type:"r"}` broadcast enti Alice bubble no kyerɛ tick.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) yɛ katee, ɛyɛ abien, na ɛyɛ ntɛm sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw. Sɛ wɔde toto JSON ho a, ɛtew payload kɛse so ~30 % wɔ chat ciphertext a wɔtaa yɛ so na eyi whitespace ambiguity fi hɔ.
architecture.h6p2: Sɛ wode toto Protobuf ho a ɛnhia schema generator na ɛnnyɛ freeze field numbers. Ɛno ho hia efisɛ Vortex dannan — yɛde `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` aka ho wɔ releases so a yɛrenbubu clients dedaw.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR nso ne nea Signal, Matrix, ne NIP-29 de di dwuma esiane nneɛma a ɛte saa ara nti. Matching wɔn paw kyerɛ sɛ yɛn protocol no yɛ mmerɛw sɛ ahobammɔ nhwehwɛmufo a wonim encoding dedaw no audit.
architecture.h7: Protocol nkyerɛase a wɔde yɛ adwuma
architecture.h7p1: Frame biara kura `v:<int>`. Mprempren nkyerɛase no yɛ 1. Wɔtow frame a ɛwɔ nkyerɛase a wonnim no gu; clients log kɔkɔbɔ na wɔtoa so ne frame a edi hɔ no.
architecture.h7p2: Backwards compatibility yɛ guaranteed ma frame biara a ɛda so ara kura `v:1`. Forward compatibility yɛ best-effort: wɔde fields foforo ka ho wɔ dict no awiei, clients dedaw bu wɔn ani gu so.
architecture.h7p3: Wɔde hard breakage asie ama nsakraeɛ a ɛho hia wɔ ahobanbɔ mu (e.g. swapping HKDF context strings). Wɔ saa nsɛm no mu no version no bumps to 2 na wotintim migration window.
architecture.h1_a: Vortex ntam nkitahodi no mu paapae yɛ nneɛma abiɛsa. Wɔn mu biara tu mmirika, na ɛnam wire protocol ahorow a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu yiye so ne afoforo no kasa, na wobetumi de wɔn ho asi ananmu. Monolith biara nni hɔ — feature biara plugs kɔ dwumadi abiɛsa no mu biako mu.
architecture.h1_b: Client bi kura keys na ɔkyerɛ UI. Node bi kɔ so yɛ ciphertext, fans out nsɛm a esisi wɔ WebSocket, na brokers WebRTC signalling. Controller bi tintim manifest ne entry URL ahorow a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase no. Wɔnam HTTPS + WebSocket so di nkitaho denam CBOR-encoded payloads a ɛwɔ AES-GCM envelopes mu so.
architecture.h1_c: Wɔde mpaapaemu no bae wɔ v0.0.3 mu bere a monolith nkyerɛase a edi kan no tuu mmirika kɔɔ ɔhaw abien mu akyi: na wɔakyekyere adansedi a wɔayi no adi no wɔ node a ɛretu mmirika no ho (enti node a wɔagyae no betumi adi atoro wɔ n’ankasa mmara ho), na na federation ntumi nyɛ yiye efisɛ na node tebea ne ahotoso tebea no te pon koro no ara mu. Splitting attestation out into its own process maa operator biara pubkey biako a ɔde pin na ma yɛmfa scale federation to arbitrary N.
architecture.h1_f:
akraman --HTTPS/WSS--> node
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +------/v1/integrity-- controller (wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase manifest) .
architecture.h2_a: Node/controller mpaapaemu no tew artifact a ɛyɛ ahobammɔ-a ɛyɛ den sen biara (manifest a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase) fi ntua a ɛso sen biara (API server) no ho.
architecture.h2_b: Controller sie SQLite DB ketewaa bi: pubkeys a wogye di, ahwehwɛ URLs, ne akwahosan nkontabuo. Ɛpow sɛ ebefi ase sɛ INTEGRITY.sig.json ne on-disk dua no nhyia a — fael a wɔasakra no ntumi nsom `status:"verified"` da. Node no tu mmirika wɔ n’ankasa Postgres/SQLite so na enkura release key no da.
architecture.h2_c: Nhwɛsoɔ no firi Chrome root-store split (certs te ase wɔ browser no release track so, ɛnyɛ wɛb mfitiaseɛ) ne Debian Release.gpg (manifest signed, packages unsigned). Wogye toom efisɛ adwini abien no nyinaa traa ase mfe du du pii a wɔde akasakasa asan ahwɛ mu.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 wɔ hop biara so, end-to-end encrypted payloads wɔ mu. TLS di akwantuo ho dwuma; AES-GCM di emu nsɛm ho dwuma.
architecture.h3_b: Wɔ akraman ne node ntam: HTTPS (`/api/*`) ne WSS (`/ws`). Ntam node ahorow: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). Wɔ node ne controller ntam: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Wɔn nyinaa de TLS 1.3 a Chrome 120 nsateaa nkyerɛwee di dwuma de ko tia DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Mfiase Vortex de raw TCP a amanne dede-protocol nsa a wɔde di dwuma. Wɔdan kɔɔ TLS 1.3 wɔ v0.0.4 mu bere a wohui sɛ amanne kwan so protocol ahorow kyerɛ "anigye" ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ ade a wɔnyɛ hwee no akyi. TLS 1.3 yɛ mfonoe, ɛwɔ baabiara, na ECH-ayɛ krado — agyapade abiɛsa a yɛpɛe.
architecture.h3_f:
akwantuo fã: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + a wopɛ ECH (RFC 9460) .
content layer: AES-256-GCM wɔatoto mu CBOR .
architecture.h4_a: Nkrasɛm biako a ɛkɔ abɔnten fa anammɔn anan mu: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Client bu dan safoa (X25519 + HKDF), frame nkrasɛm no sɛ CBOR, seals ne AES-256-GCM denam random 96-bit nonce, POSTs kɔ `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node sie ciphertext row no na fans kɔ WebSocket biara a ɛka ho a wɔakyerɛw ne din wɔ dan no mu. Recipient no client no de safoa koro no ara decrypt. Akwantuo a ɛkɔ ne baabi a ɛkyɛ wɔ 50 ms ase wɔ mpɔtam hɔ LAN, ~120 ms a ɛtaa ba WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Nsuo afiri a ɛwɔ anammɔn anan no yɛ deɛ Signal de dii dwuma wɔ afe 2014 mu no ara; yɛsesaa akwantuo no nko ara (WebSocket mmom sen Signal TCP) ne encoding (CBOR mmom sen protobuf). Adwini a wɔada no adi a wɔde bɛyɛ pɛ no boro foforo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so.
architecture.h5_a: Yɛpaw CBOR sen JSON ne Protobuf bere a yɛde payload kɛse, evolvability, ne debug ergonomics totoo ho wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ adwuma ankasa so akyi.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR ma ~30% payloads nketewa sen JSON wɔ unicode-heavy nkrasɛm so, enni whitespace ambiguity, na ɛboa field addition a enni schema generators. Proto behia .proto fael wɔ release biara mu na ɛbɛma afuw nɔma ayɛ freeze.
architecture.h5_c: Signal danee fii protobuf kɔɔ CBOR-te sɛ framing wɔ afe 2017 mu esiane nneɛma koro no ara nti. Matrix de CBOR di dwuma wɔ ne tebea-nsusuwii layer no mu. CBOR yɛ IETF gyinapɛn (RFC 8949) na kasa biara a yɛde yɛn ani asi so no wɔ nhomakorabea a ɛho akokwaw.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR kɛse: ~0.7 × JSON wɔ utf-8 a wɔadi afra so
          ~1.05 × protobuf wɔ schema koro no ara so
Field a wode bɛka ho = append wɔ awiei. Adetɔfo dedaw bu wɔn ani gu wɔn so.
architecture.h6_a: Adɛn nti na CBOR — ɛyɛ adansi ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
architecture.h6_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Dɛn nti na CBOR". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
architecture.h6_c: "Dɛn nti na CBOR" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — ɛyɛ architecture ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
architecture.h7_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Protocol versioning". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
architecture.h7_c: "Protocol versioning" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.

crypto.title: Cryptographic mfitiaseɛ nsɛm
crypto.subtitle: Algorithm biara a ɛwɔ stack no mu, n’atirimpɔw, ne parameters, ne RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex de primitives a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu nkutoo na edi dwuma. Amanneɛbɔ block ciphers biara nni hɔ, KDF ahorow a wodua wɔ fie biara nni hɔ, nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe foforo biara nni hɔ. Saa ti yi kyerɛw primitive biara a yɛde di dwuma, parameters pɔtee, ne ntease a ɛwɔ paw biara akyi.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) wɔ ne Montgomery kwan so, a wɔde di dwuma ma Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. 32-byte kokoam safe, 32-byte ɔmanfo safe, 32-byte kyɛ kokoam nsɛm a wɔde fi adi.
crypto.h1p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: static device identity, ephemeral session keys, sealed push envelopes, dan safe a wɔde kyekyere, federation envelopes.
crypto.h1p3: iOS dwumadie: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` a ɛfiri CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` denam JNI so. Node: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` wɔ OpenSSL so.
crypto.h1p4: Wɔn baasa no nyinaa di nkitaho bit-for-bit. Wɔsɔɔ akwantuo a ɛkɔ baabiara hwɛeɛ tiaa RFC 7748 Alice/Bob sɔhwɛ vectors wɔ ɔdan biara so.
crypto.h1p5: Adwumayɛ: ~100 μs wɔ Diffie-Hellman biara so wɔ 2020 iPhone so, ~30 μs wɔ 2020 Mac so. A round of room-key wrapping ma kuw a emufo yɛ 200 gye bɛyɛ 10 ms ɔfasu-dɔn.
crypto.h1p6: Daa-bere: yiw, wɔ curve akontabuo ne raw-byte decoding kwan no nyinaa mu.
crypto.h1p7: Side-channel gyinabea: Montgomery antweri no ntumi ntua bere ntua kuw a ɛbɔ Weierstrass curves no; OpenSSL ne Swift CryptoKit nyinaa de di dwuma.
crypto.h1p8: Key serialisation: 32-byte ketewa-endian. Wɔakyekye ɔmanfo safe wɔ import so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a inputs a ɛnnyɛ yiye no mma low-order-point leaks mma.
crypto.h1l1: Dɛn nti na X25519 na ɛnyɛ P-256: ntɛmntɛm, nketewa, NIST-curve dadwen biara nni hɔ.
crypto.h1l2: Nea enti a 32-byte output na ɛnyɛ 64: ɛne HKDF-SHA256 input tenten hyia pɛpɛɛpɛ.
crypto.h1l3: Nea enti a Montgomery na ɛnyɛ Edwards: DH nkutoo na yehia, ɛnyɛ nsaano nkyerɛwee, wɔ saa nneɛma atitiriw yi so. Edwards behia nsakrae anammɔn bere biara.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) wɔ edwards25519 so. 32-byte ɔmanfo safoa, 64-byte nsaano nkyerɛwee.
crypto.h2p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: node adansedi wɔ federation nkrasɛm so, release-key signatures wɔ integrity manifest no so, bot deploy signing, device bere tenten identity ma Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: RFC 8032 variant a yɛde di dwuma no ma nsaano nkyerɛwee koro no ara mprenu ma nkra + safoa koro no ara. Apple's CryptoKit wɔ iOS 17+ de RFC 8032bis randomized variant di dwuma — abien no nyinaa yɛ nokware na abien no nyinaa de nokwaredi biara a ɛne no hyia di ho adanse.
crypto.h2p4: Verification ka: ~200 μs wɔ nnɛyi CPU so. Batch verify (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) yɛ ~ 10× ntɛmntɛm wɔ nsaano nkyerɛwee biara mu.
crypto.h2p5: Nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe: `R || S`, 32 bytes biara, kakraa bi-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Ɔmanfoɔ safoa gyinabea: 32-byte compressed point. Bere nyinaa ɛyɛ nokware — "point at infinity" asɛm biara nni hɔ.
crypto.h2l2: Private key gyinabea: 32-byte aba. Wɔnya scalar a wɔatrɛw mu no wɔ nwansena so denam SHA-512 so.
crypto.h2l3: Dɛn nti na wonnyɛ ECDSA: ECDSA hia RNG a ɛkorɔn ma nsaano nkyerɛwee biara; a biased RNG leaks kokoam safoa no. Ed25519 yɛ deterministic, RNG biara nhia wɔ sɛnkyerɛnne bere mu.
crypto.h3p1: AES wɔ Galois/Akontaabuo Mode (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-bit safoa, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit nokwaredi tags.
crypto.h3p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: nkrasɛm ciphertext envelope, fael chunk envelopes, encrypted backup payloads, sealed push payloads.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce adansi: nkra biara ma 96-bit random nonce foforo ba. Node no di akyi 10 ^ 6 nonces a etwa to wɔ dan biara mu na ɛtow duplicates defensively — ɛnsɛ sɛ client no generate duplicates wɔ nea edi kan no mu, nanso fa no sɛ-biribiara nni hɔ a ne bo yɛ mmerɛw.
crypto.h3p4: Nea enti a 96-bit nonces na ɛnyɛ 128-bit: 96 bits yɛ GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce tenten, na ɛma yɛn 2^32 random nonces ansa na awoda mu nhyiam abɛyɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene. Wɔdannan dan safe biako bere tenten ansa na ɛno aba, enti ahobammɔ nnim.
crypto.h3p5: Tag kɛse: ne nyinaa yɛ 128 bits. Yɛnnyɛ truncate — storage savings yɛ anibiannaso na truncation ma forgery probability kɔ soro.
crypto.h3l1: Hardware ahoɔhare: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto ntrɛwmu, crypto blocks a wɔahyira so wɔ Apple Silicon so. Encryption kwan a wɔfa so yɛ ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Wɔ ARM mfiri dedaw a enni crypto ntrɛwmu so: ~300 MB/s denam softwea so. Ɛda so ara yɛ ntɛmntɛm sen disk IO.
crypto.h3l3: Data a ɛbata ho: wɔde frame ti (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) no twam sɛ AAD enti atiri a wɔayɛ no atoro rentumi nkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
crypto.h4: HKDF-SHA256 safoa a wonya fi mu
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) ne SHA-256. Nya 32-byte sub-keys pii fi 32-byte input biako mu.
crypto.h4p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: X25519 output no a wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu ayɛ no encryption key + MAC key + header key; ntini ratchet safe a wonya fi Diffie-Hellman kurukuruwa bi mu; fa fael safoa biara a wɔbɛkyekyere afi fael ntini no mu.
crypto.h4p3: Info nhama yɛ deterministic bere nyinaa ASCII: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:ti"`, `"v1:backup"`. Versioning ma yɛdannan key hierarchy no nyinaa denam info-string nsakrae so.
crypto.h4p4: Nkyene yɛ nea obi betumi apaw. Wɔ Vortex mu no yɛde room id no di dwuma sɛ nkyene ma room-key derivation enti room ahodoɔ ntumi nsan mfa derived keys nni dwuma wɔ akwanhyia mu mpo sɛ X25519 output korɔ no ara pue a.
crypto.h4l1: Dɛn nti na SHA-256 na ɛnyɛ SHA-512: platform nyinaa wɔ hardware SHA-256 ahoɔhare; SHA-512 yɛ ntɛmntɛm kakra wɔ 64-bit CPUs so nanso ɛnyɛ fon so.
crypto.h4l2: Dɛn nti na ɛnyɛ KMAC-gyina KDF: KMAC yɛ niche. HKDF wɔ crypto nhomakorabea biara a yɛde di dwuma mu.
crypto.h5: Argon2id asɛmfua a wɔde hyɛ mu
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ: m = 64 MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: server-side password hash (`users.password_hash`), local-backup wrapping safoa, aba-kasasin a wɔde fi amannɔne ba.
crypto.h5p3: Nea enti a saa parameters yi: OWASP 2023 nyansahyɛ ahorow. 64 MiB + 3 iterations gye ~0.5 s wɔ iPhone X — yɛn mfiri a wɔboa brɛoo sen biara. ASIC attacker a ɔwɔ 100× memory bandwidth a ɛwɔ fon bi mu no da so ara hia ~5 ms wɔ mmɔden biara mu. Passwords atenten (entropy > 40 bits) bɛyɛ nea kɔmputa so ntumi nyɛ yiye sɛ wɔbɛpaapae wɔ nsenia so.
crypto.h5p4: Storage format: `argon2:<encoded>` baabi a encoded no yɛ RFC-format string a nkyene, memory, iterations, ne hash ka ho.
crypto.h5l1: Nea enti a Argon2id na ɛnyɛ Argon2i anaa Argon2d: 2id ne hybrid — nea edi kan a ɛtwam no ko tia side-channels (i-mode), twam a edi hɔ no ko tia GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Signal de saa ara na edi dwuma.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash ntotoho: mpo bere a ɔdefo no nni hɔ no, yɛda so ara yɛ atoro Argon2 verify a hash a ɛkɔ so daa wom. Wei ma login bere yɛ pɛ enti attackers ntumi nkan usernames denam mmuae bere so.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash wɔ login so: sɛ server admin bumps memory cost a, wɔsan hashes dedaw wɔ login a edi hɔ a edi mu. Transparent ma nea ɔde di dwuma no.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768 na ɛyɛ. 1184-byte ɔmanfo safoa, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte a wɔakyekyɛ ahintasɛm.
crypto.h6p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: hybrid post-quantum session keys. Sɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmienu no nyinaa bɔ Kyber mmoa ho dawuru a, nhyiamu safoa no ne `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Dɛn nti na hybrid: sɛ akyiri yi Kyber bubu (sɛ wɔde toto ho a, ɛyɛ ketewa) mpo a, X25519 fã no da so ara bɔ yɛn ho ban. Sɛ wɔka bom a, ɛma wonya nea eye sen biara wɔ abien no nyinaa mu.
crypto.h6p4: Nea enti a Kyber na ɛnyɛ NIST candidates afoforo no: na ɛyɛ nea wɔpaw no maa standardisation. Kood a ɛwɔ hɔ no trɛw (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Adwumayɛ: awo ntoatoaso titiriw ~ 100 μs, encapsulation ~ 30 μs, decapsulation ~ 50 μs. Sɛ wɔde toto akwantu a wɔde kɔ baabiara a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no ho a, ɛnyɛ hwee.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth ka: 1088 bytes wɔ session ciphertext biara mu, 1184 bytes ma ɔmanfo safoa no. Wɔtua nhyiamu no ho ka wɔ bere a edi kan a wo ne wɔn di nkitaho no; ɛno akyi no ɛyɛ zero.
crypto.h6l3: Server fã: `pqcrypto` Python paket a ɛwɔ `kem.ml_kem_768`. Client afã: liboqs denam platform bindings so.
crypto.h7p1: Signal's Double Ratchet (sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wɔ 2016 ɔmanfo spec mu). Ɔde Diffie-Hellman ratchet ne symmetric-key chain bom.
crypto.h7p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: nkrasɛm a ɛkɔ mfiri abien ntam tẽẽ. Kuw dan ahorow de "sender key" nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde keyed off the room root di dwuma.
crypto.h7p3: Properties: forward secrecy (sɛ wosɛe afiri bi a, ɛda nkrasɛm a wanya dedaw nkutoo adi, ɛnyɛ daakye de), post-compromise security (re-ratcheting heals after a key compromise), out-of-order delivery (ɛkɔsi 1000 messages of skip).
crypto.h7p4: Yɛn dwumadie no wɔ `app/security/double_ratchet.py` ne `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt` mu.
crypto.h7l1: Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn tenten cap: 1000 nkrasɛm wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biara ansa na wɔahyɛ no re-ratchet. Tow ɔsɛe a efi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn safe a wowia mu ba no ano hye.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache: safoa a ɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ soro kodu 1000 a wɔde sie wɔ memory mu wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biara mu. Nea ɛboro saa no, wɔpow nkrasɛm no sɛ ɛyɛ dedaw.
crypto.h7l3: Ti encryption: wɔ so default so. Ti no kura ratchet metadata na wɔde atiri safoa a wɔatu ho ama a wonya fi ntini no mu denam HKDF so na ɛyɛ encrypted.
crypto.h8p1: Fael a ɛnyɛ cryptographic no identity ne integrity de BLAKE3 di dwuma efisɛ ɛyɛ 10× ntɛmntɛm sen SHA-256 wɔ blobs akɛse so.
crypto.h8p2: Wɔde di dwuma ma: fael `sha256` kɔla wɔ DB (abakɔsɛm din; nokwarem no BLAKE3 ase hood fi v0.1.2), attachment dedup, fael-upload nokwaredi nhwehwɛmu.
crypto.h8p3: Ahobammɔ gyinabea: BLAKE3 yɛ cryptographically den (256-bit); yɛfrɛ kɔla no `sha256` ma atutra a ɛne ne ho hyia nkutoo.
crypto.h9p1: Wɔnam OS RNG so na ɛyɛ nonces, prekeys, asɛnnennen botaeɛ nyinaa: `SecRandom` wɔ iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` wɔ Android, `secrets.token_bytes` wɔ Python (wɔkyekyere `/dev/urandom` anaa nea ɛne no sɛ).
crypto.h9p2: Ɛnyɛ `random.random ()` da, `Math.random ()` da, `rand ()` da. Lint mmara bara wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ crypto module ahorow no mu.
crypto.h10: Oprehyɛn a wɔyɛ no bere nyinaa
crypto.h10p1: HMAC ntotoho, nsaano nkyerɛwee nokwaredi, password hash nokwaredi — ne nyinaa de bere nyinaa primitives di dwuma de siw bere afã-kwan ahorow ano.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.fa toto_digest ho`. Swift: `Bere a Wɔde Toto Ho Daa` boafo. Kotlin: `NkrasɛmDigest.yɛ Pɛ`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 yɛ elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman wɔ Curve25519 so wɔ ne Montgomery kwan so. 32-byte keys, 32-byte a wɔkyɛ ahintasɛm. Private key / static device identity / session key biara a ɛwɔ Vortex mu no de di dwuma.
crypto.h1_b: Alice ne Bob biara wɔ kokoam nsafe a, b ne ɔmanfo nsafe A = a·G, B = b·G a G yɛ curve base point. Wɔbu akontaa sɛ s = a·B = b·A. Saa 32-byte ahintasɛm a wɔakyɛ yi kɔ HKDF-SHA256 mu kɔ nya symmetric AES-GCM keys. Wɔde Montgomery antweri no yɛ curve akontaabu no wɔ bere a ɛkɔ so daa mu; nkorabata biara nni kokoam data so.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 no Daniel J. Bernstein na ɔtintimii wɔ afe 2005 mu na IETF na ɔpaw no wɔ RFC 7748 (2016). Wɔde Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard na ɛgye toom. Vortex de di dwuma efisɛ ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm sen P-256, ɛwɔ 32-byte key size a ɛyɛ den, ɛkwati NIST curve dadwen, na platform biara de hardened implementation mena.
crypto.h1_f:
Kokoam safoa: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian) .
Ɔmanfo safoa: A = a · G (32-byte a wɔahyɛ no den) .
Ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ: s = a · B = b · A (baiti 32, →HKDF nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu) .
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 yɛ X25519 nua a ɔde ne nsa hyɛ ase, de curve koro no ara di dwuma wɔ ne twisted-Edwards kwan so. 32-byte ɔmanfo safe, 64-byte nsaano nkyerɛwee, deterministic default.
crypto.h2_b: Sɛ wode kokoam safoa d bɛhyɛ nkra m ase a: bu akontaa r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Nsaano nkyerɛwee ne (R, S). Nhwehwɛmu: hwɛ R + c·A = S·G. Deterministic signing kwati asiane a wɔmfa nni dwuma bio koraa — signatures abien a ɛwɔ nkrasɛm koro no ara a ɛwɔ key koro no ara yɛ bit-identical.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) firii Bernstein 2011 krataa a ɔne Duif, Lange, Schwabe, ne Yang yɛeɛ no mu. Wɔgye toom kɛseɛ wɔ afe 2013 akyi.Apple's CryptoKit, Google's Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH nyinaa de di dwuma. Vortex de Ed25519 de ne nsa hyɛ federation envelope biara ase ne node adansedi biara ase.
crypto.h2_f:
Nsɛnkyerɛnne (d, m): r = SHA-512 (d∥m);  R = r·G na ɛwɔ hɔ
              c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  S = r + c·a na ɛyɛ adwuma
              sanba (R, S) .

Hwɛ sɛ: c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G na ɛwɔ hɔ
crypto.h3_a: AES wɔ Galois/Akontaabu Mode mu. 256-bit safoa, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit nokwaredi tags. Blob biara a wɔabɔ no encrypt wɔ Vortex mu no de GCM di dwuma.
crypto.h3_b: GCM tu mmirika AES wɔ CTR mode mu na ɛbu GHASH wɔ ciphertext + AAD so denam safoa soronko a wonya fi encryption safoa no mu so. Tag = GHASH(AAD, nsɛm a wɔde sie) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Decryption san bu akontaa GHASH na ɛde toto ho — bit-flip biako biara di nkogu wɔ nokwaredi mu. Hardware-a ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm wɔ nnɛyi CPU biara so denam AES-NI anaa ARMv8-A crypto ntrɛwmu so.
crypto.h3_c: AES dii nkonim wɔ NIST AES akansi no mu wɔ afe 2001. Wɔde GCM yɛɛ gyinapɛn wɔ NIST SP 800-38D wɔ afe 2007 mu na ɛyɛ default AEAD wɔ TLS 1.3. Vortex paw 256-bit safoa ɛwom mpo sɛ 128-bit bɛdɔɔso atia classical atamfo — ahuruhuruw kɔ 256-bit ma yɛn bɛyɛ 128 bits post-quantum ahobammɔ wɔ Grover algorithm ase.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR (k, n, pt) .
                          tag = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES (k, n∥1) .
                          san kɔ ct∥tag so
Nonce reuse ⇒ kokoamsɛm + nokware a wɔabubu.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-gyina KDF, RFC 5869) dane safoa baako ma ɛbɛyɛ pii. Fa entropy a ɛkorɔn input ne context label; ɛde baiti 32 ma wɔ label biara mu.
crypto.h4_b: Anamɔn abien: Yi fi mu na Trɛw mu. Nkyem = HMAC-SHA256(nkyene, IKM) → PRK. Trɛw = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) a wɔde abɔ mu ama len baiti. Yɛde eyi di dwuma de kyekyɛ X25519 output mu ma ɛyɛ encryption key, MAC key, ne header key a info strings "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF Hugo Krawczyk na ɔtintimii wɔ EUROCRYPT 2010 na wɔde yɛɛ no ​​gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 5869 wɔ afe 2010. TLS 1.3 de dii dwuma maa ne nhyehyɛe, Signal for Double Ratchet, WireGuard de yɛɛ session keys. Versioning a ɛwɔ info strings mu no ma yɛdannan key hierarchy no nyinaa denam "v1" → "v2" a yɛbɛbɔ so.
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(nkyene, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ nsɛm ∥ i) .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... wɔatwitwa mu ayɛ no len bytes
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id yɛ memory-hard password hash a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛko atia GPU ne ASIC ntuafoɔ. Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id fra Argon2i (ɛko tia side-channels denam branching a ɛnnyɛ wɔ password-a wonya fi data so) ne Argon2d (ɛhyɛ memory ma a wontumi nhu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a parallel hardware ntumi ntwa ntwea so). Nea edi kan fã-twam yɛ data-a ɛnyɛ nea ɛde ne ho (i-mode); nkaeɛ no gyina data so (d-mode). 0.5 sikani a wɔde kɔmputa yɛ wɔ iPhone X so wɔ yɛn parameters, bɛyɛ 5 ms wɔ ASIC — ~100× ahoɔhare no yɛ ketewaa bi sɛ wɔde toto SHA-256-gyina hashes a ASICs di nkonim 1 000 000× ho a.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 dii nkonim wɔ afe 2015 Password Hashing Akansie a Dmitry Khovratovich ne Alex Biryukov hyehyɛeɛ no mu. Wɔahyɛ no gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 9106 wɔ afe 2021. Wɔde 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass na ɛde dii dwuma. Vortex no parameters fi OWASP 2023 nyansahyɛ ahorow mu, a wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛyɛ login wɔ yɛn mfiri a wɔboa brɛoo sen biara (iPhone X) so wɔ sekan 1 ase.
crypto.h5_f:
ɛka (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ≈ 0.5 s wɔ iPhone X so
ɔtowhyɛfo ka: m × t × (p / ntua_parallelism) .
Wɔ 1010 guess/s a 40-bit password entropy ka ho:
  1012 sikani = mfeɛ 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) yɛ NIST-standardised post-quantum safoa encapsulation afiri. Ma quantum-safe session keys a wɔaka abom ne X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice na ɔwo (pk, sk). Bob frɛ Encapsulate (pk) → (c, ss); soma c kɔma Alice. Alice frɛ Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Mprempren afanu no nyinaa kyɛ ss, ahintasɛm a ɛyɛ baiti 32. Ahobammɔ so tew kɔ Module-LWE haw no so, a wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ quantum-hard. Yɛka bom ne X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_afiri ∥ kyber_afiri). Sɛ fã biara tra ase a, nhyiam no nya nkwa.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber na NIST na ɔpaw no wɔ July 2022 mu wɔ mfeɛ 6 akansi akyi. Standardized as FIPS 203 wɔ August 2024. Vortex de Kyber mena sɛ nea wopɛ efisɛ ɛde ~2 KB ka ho wɔ nhyiam biara nsa a wɔde bɔ mu; wɔahyɛ no den default ama tiers a wotua ho ka, opt-in wɔ baabi foforo. Hybrid kwan no na Signal kamfoo kyerɛe wɔ afe 2023 mu na Chrome nso gye toom wɔ afe 2024 mu.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio
Decaps (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so
hybrid nhyiam = HKDF (x25519_afiri ∥ kyber_afiri, info="nhyia-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal's Double Ratchet ma anim kokoamsɛm ne post-compromise ahobammɔ ma 1:1 nkɔmmɔbɔ.
crypto.h7_b: Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abien: nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wɔde soma ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wɔde gye. Nkra biara de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no kɔ anim denam HKDF so. Mpɛn pii no, Diffie-Hellman ratchet ma ntini no kɔ anim, na ɛsan de nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abien no nyinaa safe. Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn safoa bi a wɔsɛe no no da nkrasɛm a ɛde encrypt tẽẽ no nkutoo adi. DH ratchet akyi no, daakye nkrasɛm yɛ ahobammɔ sɛ mpo ɔtowhyɛfo bi wiaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn safe a.
crypto.h7_c: Trevor Perrin ne Moxie Marlinspike na wɔyɛɛ no ​​wɔ afe 2013 mu, wɔde dii dwuma wɔ Signal 2014 mu, WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations gye toom. Public spec in 2016. Vortex no dwumadie yɛ hyɛn gyinabea tẽẽ; interop ne Signal-protocol clients afoforo wɔ v0.4 kwankyerɛ no so.
crypto.h7_f:
soma: CK = HKDF (CK, "anammɔn");  MK = HKDF(CK, "nkrasɛm") .
gye: CK' = HKDF(CK', "anammɔn"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "nkrasɛm") .
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(yɛn_eph, wɔn_eph), RK_kan)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing ma fael — crypto ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
crypto.h8_b: Nnwuma ho nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma ma "BLAKE3 hashing for files". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
crypto.h8_c: "BLAKE3 hashing for files" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.
crypto.h9_a: Random nɔma awo ntoatoaso — crypto ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
crypto.h9_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Random nɔma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
crypto.h9_c: "Random number generation" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.

crypto.h10_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Daa-bere dwumadie". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
