cryptoWire.title: Crypto waya nhyehyɛe ahorow
cryptoWire.subtitle: Byte nhyehyeɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ma blob biara a wɔabɔ no encrypted.
cryptoWire.intro: Saa ti yi kyerɛkyerɛ baiti ahorow a ɛwɔ waya no so no mu. Obiara a ɔde client foforo anaa forensics adwinnade redi dwuma no betumi akenkan akɔ.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Nhyehyɛe: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<hex a ɛsakra>, ɔdemafo_pseudo:<32-hex>, wɔsomaa_wɔ:<unix_ms>}`. Wɔde kɔmaa wɔ HTTPS (POST) ne WebSocket (frame type `m`) so.
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` nsɛm a ɛwɔ AES-GCM decryption akyi: CBOR `{v:1, nkyerɛwee?:<string>, attachments?:[<fael_id>, ...], mmuae_to?:<msg_id>, nsakrae?:[<ansa na_nkyerɛwee>, ...], ka?:[<ɔdefo_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag no di akyi: `ciphertext` baiti ahama no yɛ (encrypted payload || 16-byte tag). Client no mu paapae wɔ ne tenten so.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: wɔde nkyerɛwde nketewa hex dan id no kɔ sɛ data a ɛbata ho. Binding the room id siw cross-room replay kwan.
cryptoWire.h2: Fael chunk envelope a wɔde ahyɛ mu
cryptoWire.h2p1: Fael ntini safoa yɛ random 32 bytes. Per-chunk safoa: `HKDF(ntini, info: "fael:chunk:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk ciphertext: AES-GCM a ɛwɔ chunk biara safoa, random 96-bit nonce, AAD: `<fael_id> || <offset>`. Max chunk kɛse yɛ 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Fael mũ no nyinaa mudi mu kura: akraman no bu BLAKE3 wɔ nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den so na ɛde kɔma sɛ `plain_blake3` kɔma nea ogye no denam dan mu nkrasɛm no so. Nea ogye no san bu akontaa bere a wɔatwe awie no na ɔhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
cryptoWire.h3: Envelope a wɔatoto mu a wɔde piapia
cryptoWire.h3p1: Client de `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) kɔ node no so.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Sɛ push bi due a, node ma ephemeral X25519 key, yɛ DH ne `p256dh_pub`, nya AES-GCM key via HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Blob a wɔatoto ano: `{endpoint, p256dh: akraman no pub, auth: baiti 16, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM hwɛ `data` nkutoo.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Client decrypts on receive denam ne private key ne `p256dh` (a nokwarem no ɛyɛ node no ephemeral pub wɔ envelope no mu) so.
cryptoWire.h4p1: Password nya backup safoa denam Argon2id (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, nkyene = <random 16B>, hashLen = 32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{nkyene, nonce, nsɛm a wɔde sie}`. Ciphertext yɛ CBOR a ɛyɛ `{v:1, adan:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, nkitahodi:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Wɔde asie wɔ mpɔtam hɔ (iCloud / Google Drive) anaasɛ wɔ node bi so wɔ ɔdefo no kokoam dan mu.
cryptoWire.h5: Federation krataa a wɔde kyerɛw krataa
cryptoWire.h5p1: Cross-node nkrasɛm: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, mu: {... te sɛ dan mu envelope ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` kata CBOR-serialized `{fibea_node, botae_ɔdefo, mu}` so. Target di adanseɛ tia `source_node` pubkey a ɛfiri `trusted_nodes`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Pia nkrasɛm baako a ɛwɔ waya no so yɛ CBOR dict a ɛwɔ encrypted payload, nonce, sender pseudonym, ne timestamp. Envelope no yɛ pɛ sɛ ɛtena HTTPS (POST) anaa WebSocket (frame type `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Client no serialise nkra nipadua `{v:1, nkyerɛwee, mmuae_to, sent_at}` sɛ CBOR → `pt`. Ɛyɛ random 12-byte nonce a ɛyɛ random. Bu akontaa `aad = hex (dan_id)`. Frɛ `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (dan_safoa, nonce, pt, aad)`. Wɔkyekyere no `{v:1, ciphertext: hex (ct), nonce: hex (nonce), sender_pseudo: hex (pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` na ɛde kɔ. Receiver di GCM tag no ho adanse bere a decrypt no, afei CBOR-parses plaintext no.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Wire shape no yɛ version-tagged fi v0.0.4 akyi abortive v0.0.3 release a na enni `v` field — na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbɔ format no nyinaa bere a yɛde `thread_id` kaa ho efisɛ dedaw clients crash wɔ unknown key. Asuadeɛ a yɛanya: daakye waya nsusuiɛ biara kura `v:N` wɔ ne afuo a ɛdi kan enti anim a ɛne ne ho hyia no da adi pefee.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Wɔakyekyɛ fael ahorow mu ayɛ no asinasin a ne kɛse yɛ pintinn, na emu biara wɔ n’ankasa safoa a wonya fi fael ntini ne chunk offset no mu. Per-chunk encryption ma nea ɔde kɔma no no gyina/san fi ase wɔ chunk hye biara so.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Fael ntini safoa yɛ random 32 bytes. Per-chunk safoa ne `HKDF (ntini, info = "fael:chunk:" + str (offset), len = 32)`. Chunk biara yɛ AES-GCM encrypted ne n'ankasa safoa, random 96-bit nonce, ne `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks default yɛ 512 KiB; 4 MiB kyɛw. Wɔde fael a edi mũ BLAKE3 kɔ sɛ `plain_blake3` wɔ dan nkrasɛm a ɛkyerɛ fael no mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wogye no betumi ahwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware wɔ decrypt akyi.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption a ɛwɔ per-chunk keys no, Mega.nz na ɛyɛɛ akwampaefoɔ wɔ afe 2013 mu na Signal kɛseɛ-fael mmoa na ɛyɛɛ no ​​yie wɔ afe 2019. Vortex's 512 KiB default yɛ kɛseɛ a TCP flow control ma pipe no yɛ ma a enni dua atenten wɔ mobile 4G so. Yɛsɔɔ 256/512/1024/4096 KiB hwɛe na 512 na ɛyɛ dɛ wɔ yɛn susuw mu.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Push envelope a wɔatoto mu no de amanneɛbɔ payload sie fi Apple / Google / Mozilla denam encrypting a wɔde device-specific X25519 key so.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Client kyerɛw `p256dh_pub` ne `auth` wɔ node no so. Sɛ push bi due a, node tu mmirika ephemeral-ECDH ne p256dh_pub, nya key + nonce via HKDF a auth ahintasɛm no yɛ nkyene. Encrypts `{asɛmti, nipadua, dan_id, nkra_id}` ne AES-GCM. Ɔsoma kyerɛwtohɔ no sɛ opaque `data` field kɔ push provider no. Device ntrɛwmu san nya, decrypt, kyerɛ.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Nsɔano a wɔde piapia ne Wɛb Push Nkrasɛm Encryption spec (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple gyee no toom wɔ iOS 16 no Notification Service Extensions mu. Ansa na sealed push rebɛyɛ nea wɔboa kɛse no, Signal ne WhatsApp de komm "biribi duu hɔ" pings a enni mu kɔmaa na wɔmaa app no ​​faa nkrasɛm no wɔ wake-up — a na ɛyɛ brɛoo. Sealed push ma yɛn end-to-end kokoamsɛm plus instant render.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob ma obi a ɔde di dwuma no san de dan mu safe + profile + di nnafua 90 wɔ afiri foforo so fi password nkutoo so.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Backup key fi password no mu denam Argon2id a ɛwɔ random 16-byte nkyene so. Payload yɛ CBOR: `{v:1, adan: [{id, safoa, msg_ref_ids}], profile, nkitahodi ahorow}`. Encrypted ne AES-GCM wɔ derived key no ase. Wɔde asie wɔ mpɔtam hɔ (iCloud / Google Drive) anaasɛ sɛ fael wɔ ɔdefo no kokoam mununkum dan mu. San fa: hyɛ password → Argon2id → decrypt → san fa safe ne nsɛm a wɔde gyina so ba.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Wɔde 1Password OPVault (2013) ne Bitwarden encrypted export (2017) na ɛyɛɛ format no nhwɛsoɔ. Wɔn baanu nyinaa de KDF-afei-AEAD di dwuma a nkyene a wɔaboaboa ano metadata ka ho. Vortex de nnafua 90 trimming no kaa ho efisɛ abakɔsɛm a edi mũ backups yɛ 100 MB+ wɔ sɔhwɛ mu; restores dodow no ara hia nkrasɛm a ɛbaa nnansa yi nkutoo, na nneɛma dedaw no da so ara tumi fa server ciphertext so du hɔ bere a nea ɔde di dwuma no wɔ nkitahodi no.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Cross-node federation nkrasɛm kyekyere emu envelope a wɔabɔ no kokoam dedaw no wɔ akyi envelope a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase a ɛkyerɛ sɛ source node no yɛ nokware.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A serializes `{fibea_node, botae_ɔdefo, emu_ct, mu_nonce, sent_at}` sɛ CBOR. Nsɛnkyerɛnne ne ne Ed25519 kokoam yiyi safoa → `sig`. POSTs `{envelope, sig}` kɔ node B no `/federation/deliver` so. B di `sig` ho adanseɛ tia pubkey ma `source_node` wɔ `federations` mu, hwɛ timestamp wɔ simma 5 skew window mu, afei ɔkyerɛw emu ciphertext no kɔ n'ankasa `messages` pon so ma botaeɛ dwumadiefoɔ.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Wɔfɛm abɔnten envelopes a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ no firi Matrix's federation spec (2015) ne ActivityPub's HTTP Signatures (2018). Simma 5 mfɛnsere no ne SMTP RFC 5321 nyansahyɛ no hyia na esiw ntua a wɔsan bɔ a ɔtowhyɛfo bi kyere federation biako POST na ɔsan bɔ no nnɔnhwerew bi akyi no ano. Vortex paw Ed25519 sen RSA-PSS efisɛ Ed25519 nsaano nkyerɛwee yɛ baiti 64 vs RSA-PSS-2048 baiti 256 — ɛho hia bere a federation yɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ.
cryptoWire.h1_f:
pt = CBOR{v:1, nkyerɛwee, mmuae_ma?, thread_id?, ka ho asɛm?, wɔde amena_wɔ}
ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (dan_safo, nonce, pt, aad = hex (dan_id)) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio.
waya = CBOR{ .
  v: 1, 2 .
  ciphertext: hex (ct), // nsakrae tenten
  nonce: hex(12 B), .
  ɔdemafo_atoro: hex (16 B), .
  wɔde amena_wɔ: unix_ms
} .
cryptoWire.h2_f:
fael_ntini = rand (32) .
chunk_key (o) = HKDF (fael_ntini, "fael:chunk:" + o, 32) .
chunk_ct (o) = AES-GCM (chunk_key (o), rand (12), nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den, aad = fael_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(plaintext_bytes_of_full_fael) // wɔde kɔmaa sɛ plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
bere tiaa mu de = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH (bere tiaa mu.priv, p256dh_pub) .
prk = HMAC-SHA256(ɔkyerɛwfo, ikm) .
safoa = HKDF-Trɛw (prk, "Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu-Nkyerɛwde: aes128gcm \ 0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Trɛw (prk, "Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu-Encoding: nonce \ 0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(safoa, nonce, CBOR{asɛmti, nipadua, dan_id, nkrasɛm_id})
waya = nkyene (16) ∥ rs (4) ∥ idlen (1) ∥ bere tiaa mu.pub (32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
nkyene = rand(16) .
safoa = Argon2id (asɛmfua, nkyene, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32)
nonce = rand(12) a ɛnyɛ hwee.
ct = AES-GCM(safoa, nonce, CBOR{dan, profile, nkitahodi}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
fael = {v:1, nkyene, nonce, ct}.
cryptoWire.h5_f:
akyi = CBOR{ .
  fibea_node: hex32, .
  botae_a ɔde di dwuma: int64, .
  inner_ciphertext: baiti, .
  inner_nonce: baiti, .
  wɔde amena_wɔ: unix_ms
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign (fibea_priv, abɔnten)
POST /federation/deliver { krataa a wɔde kyerɛw krataa: akyi, sig: hex64 }

auth.title: Nokwaredi a wɔde ma
auth.subtitle: Kyerɛw wo din, kɔ mu, yɛ foforo, twa mu. JWT + X25519 + passkey a wopɛ / aba / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex de JWTs a enni bere tiaa bi (15 min access, 30 days refresh) a ɔdefo no X25519 public key bound in. Endpoint biara a ɛho hia no hwɛ JWT + hwɛ sɛ wɔantwa safoa no mu. Saa ti yi ka nsu a ɛsen biara ho asɛm fi awiei kosi awiei.
auth.h1p1: Client no fi ase denam 32-byte X25519 kokoam safoa foforo a ɔde OS RNG no yɛ so. Ɛnya public key no, encodes sɛ 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Client no de `POST /api/authentication/register` a `{ɔdefoɔ din, asɛmfua, x25519_public_key, display_din, telefon, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}` to gua.
auth.h1p3: Node di mu: ɔdefoɔ din ne `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (nkyerɛwde nketewa de kwati homograph squats); password twam zxcvbn-style ahoɔden (min nkontabuo 2); telefon a ɛne E.164 hyia sɛ wɔde ma a; email hyia RFC 5322 mfitiase regex sɛ wɔde ma a.
auth.h1p4: Node hwɛ `x25519_public_key` soronkoyɛ — pubkey biara betumi akyerɛw akontaabu biako pɛpɛɛpɛ. Eyi ma bulk registration ntua a ɛsan de pubkey koro no ara di dwuma no gyae.
auth.h1p5: Node de Argon2id di dwuma wɔ asɛmfua no so (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) na ɛkora `argon2: $...$` wɔ `users.password_hash` mu.
auth.h1p6: Node mints JWT abien: kwan a wɔfa so kɔ (simma 15, `jti:<device_id>`) ne refresh (30 d). Nsɛm a wɔka: `{sub: ɔdefo_id, jti: mfiri_id, typ: kwan|san yɛ foforo, exp: ...}`. Wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ HS256 wɔ 64-byte server secret a wɔde afiri `.env` ahyɛ mu.
auth.h1p7: Node yɛ `ɔdefoɔ_mfiri` row: `{ɔdefoɔ_id, mfiri_id, ɔdefoɔ_ananmusifoɔ, wɔabɔ_wɔ}`. Wɔakyekyere refresh biara wɔ ne device_id so; afiri bi a wobɛpopa no kunkum saa asuten no nkutoo.
auth.h1p8: Mmuae: `{ok, ɔdefo_id, ɔdefo din, kwan_ahyɛnsode, refresh_token, x25519_ɔmanfo_safoa, kyber_ɔmanfo_safoa, ɔyɛkyerɛ_din, avatar_url, telefon, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Adetɔfoɔ de token sie wɔ Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Kuki a ɛyɛ katee (wɛb).
auth.h1l1: Rate anohyeto: 5 a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din wɔ sikani 60 biara mu wɔ IP biara mu. TESTING=nokware ma eyi yɛ adwuma.
auth.h1l2: To nsa frɛ mode: sɛ `REGISTRATION_MODE=to nsa frɛ` a, ɛsɛ sɛ nipadua no de `invite_code` a ɛfata ka ho. Wɔnam admin API so na ɛyɛ codes.
auth.h1l3: Ɔkwan a wɔato mu: `REGISTRATION_MODE=wɔato mu`. Aba admin no nko ara na obetumi akyerɛw ne din. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma akyiri yi no nam nsato a wɔde to nsa frɛ nkurɔfo so ba adan pɔtee bi mu.
auth.h2p1: Client de `POST /api/authentication/login` a `{ɔdefoɔ din, asɛmfua}` to gua.
auth.h2p2: Node bisa `users` denam nkyerɛwde nketewa a wɔde di dwuma so. Sɛ wɔanhu a, ɛda so ara yɛ dummy Argon2 verify tia hash a ɛkɔ so daa de ma bere yɛ pɛ (~0.5 s ɔkwan biara so).
auth.h2p3: Sɛ Argon2 verify di nkonim na akontaabu no nnyɛ adwuma a, node san de envelope koro no ara ba sɛ register. Wɔayɛ `user_devices` row foforo; wɔagyaw row a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no nkutoo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nea ɔde di dwuma no betumi akɔ mu wɔ mfiri pii so.
auth.h2p4: Sɛ verify di nkogu a, node san de 401 ba a `{error:"invalid credentials"}`. Nsonsonoe biara nni "ɔdefo din a ɛnteɛ" ne "asɛmfua a ɛnteɛ" ntam wɔ mmuae no mu.
auth.h2l1: Rate anohyeto: Mmɔden 10 a entumi nyɛ yiye wɔ sikani 60 biara mu wɔ IP biara mu. Sɛ ɛboro so a, ɛsan de 429 ba a `Retry-After` ti.
auth.h2l2: Akontaabu lockout: 20 mmɔdenbɔ a entumi nyɛ yiye wɔ 24 h mu frankaa akontaabu no ma admin nhwehwɛmu. Legit dwumadiefoɔ kɛkɛ password-reset wɔn kwan kɔ mu.
auth.h2l3: Nhyiamu akyidie: `/api/authentication/devices` kyerɛw nhyiamu a ɛyɛ adwuma nyinaa; ɔdefo betumi atwa biara mu.
auth.h3p1: Sɛ access token no rebɛn sɛ ɛbɛtwa mu (afɛfoɔ di `exp` akyi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ) anaasɛ sɛ abisadeɛ bi san de 401 a `token expired` ka ho a, akraman no de `POST /api/authentication/refresh` a `{refresh_token}` bɛto hɔ.
auth.h3p2: Node decodes refresh no, hwɛ sɛ `jti` da so ara wɔ `user_devices` (wɔntwa mu), hwɛ `exp`, na mints access token foforo.
auth.h3p3: Refresh rotation no yɛ off default so. Ma ne `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` nyɛ adwuma na fa refresh foforo nso ma.
auth.h3p4: Sɛ refresh no twam, wɔatwa mu, anaasɛ wɔayɛ no atoro a, node no san de 401. Client no fi mu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na ɔka sɛ wɔnsan nkɔ mu bio.
auth.h4p1: Wɛb afɛfoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛw platform authenticator (Ka ID, Anim ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Server sie `{agyede_id, ɔmanfo_safoa, akontaabu}`.
auth.h4p2: Login: `POST /api/nokwadi/passkey/fi ase` → server san de asɛnnennen ba; client signs ne passkey private (wɔkura mu wɔ Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → server no di ho adanse na ɛde JWT ma.
auth.h4p3: Counter monotonicity check: ɛsɛ sɛ verification biara ma counter no kɔ soro. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, wɔfa passkey no sɛ cloned na wɔapow.
auth.h5p1: Sɛ́ atoyerɛnkyɛm-san a wɔsan nya kwan no, nea ɔde di dwuma no betumi de aba a ɛwɔ nsɛmfua 24 BIP-39 akɔ amannɔne. Sɛ wode ba mfiri biara so a, ɛsan yɛ X25519 identity (aba → HKDF → static key) na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wowɔ denam asɛnnennen a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase so.
auth.h5p2: Aba mfi afiri no mu da. Node no hu X25519 ɔmanfo safoa a wonya fi mu ne nsaano nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ server asɛnnennen bi so nkutoo.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bits (baiti 32) na ɛwɔ hɔ. BIP-39 checksum yɛ standard, enti wɔkyere typos ansa na adu server no so.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) a ɛwɔ 30-s anammɔn ne 6-digit koodu. Optional obiara a ɔde di dwuma.
auth.h6p2: Wɔn a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` san de kokoam + otpauth URI + QR ba. Ɔdefoɔ de Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password scan. Ɔdefo no de nhwɛsode 6-digit code bi kɔ akyi de kyerɛ sɛ app no ​​reyɛ adwuma.
auth.h6p3: Fa 2FA kɔ mu: sɛ asɛmfua no twam akyi a, node san de `{needs_2fa: nokware}` ba. Client bisa sɛ ɔmfa koodu bi mma na ɔde kɔ `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Rate anohyeto: 5 TOTP mmɔdenbɔ wɔ simma 5 biara mu wɔ obiara a ɔde di dwuma biara mu. Sɛ ɛboro so a, ɛkanyan sikɔne 60 cooldown ne email kɔkɔbɔ.
auth.h6p5: Backup codes: 12 × 10-digit codes a wɔda no adi pɛnkoro bere a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din no. Wobetumi de mmara biara adi dwuma pɛnkoro pɛpɛɛpɛ.
auth.h7: QR login (akonta koro no ara a wɔde bom) .
auth.h7p1: Telefon a woakɔ mu no betumi akɔhyɛ tablɛt foforo a ɛwɔ QR koodu mu. Device A de `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` to hɔ → server san de nonce ne TTL ba.
auth.h7p2: Mfiri A kyerɛ QR a `nonce + user_id + server_url` wom. Mfiri B scan na ɛde `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` to hɔ ne nonce.
auth.h7p3: Server di adanse sɛ nonce da so ara te ase (TTL 60 s, one-shot), ɛkyekyere device B X25519 pubkey foforo no kɔ ɔdefo A akontaabu so (`user_devices` row foforo), na ɛsan JWT kɔ device B so.
auth.h7p4: Device A nsa ka WebSocket amanneɛbɔ `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdefo no betumi asi so dua / atwa mu wɔ bere ankasa mu.
auth.h8p1: Yɛhyɛ da san de mfomso koro no ara ba ma "unknown username" ne "wrong password". Signup rate anohyeto ahorow no de edin a wɔde di dwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ no sie.
auth.h8p2: Profile awiei (`/api/users/{username}`) hwehwɛ auth. Attacker ntumi nkan usernames a enni token a ɛfata.
auth.h8p3: Rate anohyeto wɔ `/api/authentication/login` so ma brute force kɔ so yɛ crawl.
auth.h1_a: Registration ma wonya identity foforo: X25519 keypair wɔ device no so, Argon2id password hash wɔ server no so, JWT pair a wɔde ma wɔ nkonimdi so.
auth.h1_b: Anamɔn 1: client no tu mmirika `crypto.randomBytes(32)` ma X25519 kokoam safoa no, nya ɔmanfo safoa (~100 μs wɔ fon so). Anamɔn 2: POST /api/authentication/register ne `{ɔdefo din, asɛmfua, x25519_public_key, display_din, telefon, email, avatar_emoji}`. Anamɔn 3: node di mu denam Pydantic so (ɔdefo din regex, asɛmfua ≥ ​​8 chars, telefon E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Anamɔn 4: node tu mmirika Argon2id (asɛmfua) → `argon2:...`, sie wɔ `users.password_hash`. Anamɔn 5: node nsɛm a ɛfa kwan a wɔfa so nya JWT (simma 15) + refresh JWT (nnafua 30), kɔ so yɛ `user_devices` row.
auth.h1_c: Nsuo no yɛ nnɛyi adannandi a ɛwɔ PHP mysql_real_escape_string bere no mu. Nnɛyi auth stack biara — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — yɛ bɛyɛ saa nsusuwii yi. Twist pɔtee a ɛwɔ Vortex mu ne sɛ ɛresoma X25519 pubkey no wɔ register call no mu: ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔakyekyere akontaabu no wɔ bere tenten E2E identity a efi frame biako mu, a wɔmfa nka ho akyiri yi. Wɔde Signal 2013 protocol nhyehyɛe no na ɛkanyan no.
auth.h2_a: Login di password no ho adanseɛ wɔ Argon2 hash a wɔde asie no ho na ɛde JWT pair foforɔ ma sɛ ɛne no hyia a.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login ne `{ɔdefoɔ din, asɛmfua}`. Node bisa `users` denam nkyerɛwde nketewa a wɔde di dwuma so. Sɛ wohu a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ Argon2id yɛ nokware wɔ bere a ɛkɔ so daa mu tia `users.password_hash`. Sɛ wɔanhu a, ɛda so ara tu mmirika dummy Argon2 verify tia constant string to equalize timing. Odi nkonim → foforo JWT baanu + foforo `user_devices` row (baako wɔ mfiri biara a woakɔ mu). Failure → 401 a ɛwɔ generic "invalid credentials" — nsonsonoe biara nni edin bɔne ne asɛmfua bɔne ntam, sɛ ɛbɛko atia enumeration.
auth.h2_c: Daa-bere nokwaredi ne dummy hashing ma wɔn a wonni hɔ no ne nhwɛso Signal gye toom wɔ afe 2014 mu bere a nhwehwɛmufo kyerɛɛ bere anomeration wɔ wɔn login endpoint. Efi saa bere no wɔagye atom kɛse — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak nyinaa de di dwuma. Adeyɛ no de ~0.5 s ka mmɔdenbɔ biara a entumi nkɔ mu ho, a ɛyɛ papa; yɛ rate-limit login wɔ 10/min/IP ɔkwan biara so.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__bere_equaliser__", nkyene = wɔasiesie, ...)

login (u, p): .
  row = dwumadiefoɔ.hwehwɛ (ɔdefoɔ din = u.ase ())
  sɛ row yɛ Obiara nni hɔ a:
      Argon2Verify (dummy_hash, p) // ma bere yɛ pɛ
      ma 401 so
  sɛ ɛnyɛ Argon2Verify (row.asɛmfua_hash, p):
      ma 401 so
  san kɔ asɛm_jwt (row) .
auth.h3_a: Access token ahorow no twam wɔ simma 15 akyi. Refresh sesa refresh token a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ de nya access token foforo a ɛnsan mmisa nea ɔde di dwuma no ne password.
auth.h3_b: Client di `exp` akyi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Sɛ `now + 30s > exp`, anaa sɛ abisadeɛ bi san de 401 a `token_expired` ka ho a, akraman no POST refresh token no kɔ `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node decodes, hwɛ sɛ `jti` wɔ `user_devices` mu na ɛnyɛ `revoked_at`, hwɛ `exp`, na mints simma 15 access token foforo. Refresh rotation yɛ opt-in via `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — off default ɛfiri sɛ retating refresh tokens wɔ access refresh biara mu no ma mmirikatuo ba bere a clients mmienu refresh bere koro mu.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) na ɛde kwan a wɔfa so kɔ + refresh mpaepaemu bae. Simma 15 nkwa nna a wɔde kɔ hɔ no yɛ mfinimfini wɔ adwumayɛkuw no nyinaa mu — Google de dɔnhwerew 1 di dwuma, Auth0 defaults yɛ nnɔnhwerew 24, Okta de dɔnhwerew 1. Yɛpaw 15 min sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yɛbɛtew mfɛnsere a bere mu no, mfaso wɔ token a wowiae so no so. Nnafua 30 a wɔde yɛ foforo no ne nea mobile app dodow no ara hia na ama wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no akɔ so akɔ mu wɔ ɔsram biako a wɔanyɛ adwuma no mu no hyia.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / passkey login de platform authenticator (Ka ID, Anim ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) di dwuma sen sɛ wode password bedi dwuma.
auth.h4_b: Enrolment: server de asɛnnennen bi to gua; client no authenticator no yɛ keypair foforo wɔ ne secure enclave no mu na ɛsan de public key + attestation no kɔ. Server sie `{agyede_id, ɔmanfo_safoa, akontaabu}`. Login: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → server san de asɛnnennen bi ba; client de authenticator no kokoam safoa (a wɔkura mu wɔ Secure Enclave mu, ennyaw chip no da); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → server di nsaano nkyerɛwee no ho adanseɛ wɔ ɔmanfoɔ safoa a wɔde asie no ho. Monotonic counter hu authenticators a wɔayɛ no cloned.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn no, W3C na ɛde gyinapɛn sii hɔ wɔ afe 2019 mu wɔ mfeɛ pii adwuma a FIDO Apam no yɛeɛ akyi. Apple de platform-authenticator mmoa kaa ho wɔ iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Asɛmfua a wɔde hyɛ mu no dii akyi. Vortex gyee WebAuthn wɔ v0.0.8 mu. Ɛyɛ nea wopɛ nanso wɔkamfo kyerɛ denneennen — passkey dwumadiefoɔ nhunu phishing-based account takeover da ɛfiri sɛ private key no ntwa device hyeɛ da.
auth.h4_f:
register_begin (): asɛnnennen = rand (32) .
                    options = { rp.id, ɔdefo.id, pubKeyCredParams, asɛnnennen } .
                    sankɔhwɛ ahorow a wubetumi apaw

register_finish (adansedi): .
  hwɛ adansedi krataa a ɛne TPM / Secure Enclave ntini CA .
  store { adansedi_id, ɔmanfo_safoa, akontaabu: 0 } .
auth.h5_a: Aba-kasamu a wɔsan nya no san kyekye X25519 nipasu no wɔ afiri foforo so fi nsɛmfua 24 BIP-39 nkae mu. Ɛnhwehwɛ da sɛ server no kura decryption material biara.
auth.h5_b: Ɔdefo kyerɛw mnemonic no wɔ bere a edi kan a wɔde fi ase (optional, prɛko pɛ prompt). Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛsan anya: wɔ mfiri foforo so no, nea ɔde di dwuma no hyɛn mnemonic no mu; akraman tu mmirika PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(nkaeɛ, "nkaeɛ", 2048 rounds) → 64 bytes aba. Aba no baiti 32 a edi kan no bɛyɛ X25519 kokoam safoa; public key no na wonya fi mu. Wɔka kyerɛ server sɛ ɔmanfo safoa foforo no nkutoo; ɛde Ed25519 challenge-response (a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase nonce) hwɛ sɛ obi wɔ, afei ɛde JWT ahorow ma.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) yɛ canonical kwan a wɔfa so de encode cryptographic ahintasɛm sɛ nsɛmfua lists a wɔbɛkae. 2048-word Engiresi nsɛm asekyerɛ nhoma a 4-byte checksum wɔ awiei. Vortex de nsɛmfua 24 di dwuma efisɛ nnwuma gyinapɛn a ɛfa sika kotoku a ahobammɔ kɛse wom (Trezor, Ledger) yɛ 24. Nsɛmfua 12 bɛdɔɔso ama 128-bit ahobammɔ nanso ɛnte sɛ nea ɛho hia sɛnea ɛsɛ ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma dodow no ara.
auth.h5_f:
nsɛmfua = BIP39_Encode (entropy = 256_bits + 8_bit_checksum) .
aba = PBKDF2-SHA512(nsɛmfua, "nkae", kurukuruwa=2048, len=64)
sk = aba [0:32] // X25519 kokoam
pk = sk · G // X25519 ɔmanfoɔ
auth.h6_a: Nneɛma abien ahotoso de bere a egyina bere so asɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro (TOTP) anammɔn ka ho wɔ asɛmfua a wɔagye atom akyi.
auth.h6_b: Enrolment: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → server no yɛ 160-bit random secret, san de ba sɛ base32 string + otpauth:// URI ma QR scanning. Ɔdefoɔ de Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password scan; posts back a sample 6-digit code de kyerɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe no yɛɛ adwuma. Login: sɛ password twam akyi a, server san de `{needs_2fa: true}` ba mmom sen JWTs. Client bisa 6-digit code ne POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Server di HOTP(ahintasɛm, T=now_unix / 30) ho adanseɛ tia koodu no.
auth.h6_c: TOTP na wɔde gyinapɛn sii hɔ sɛ RFC 6238 wɔ afe 2011 mu denam Mark Pei so. Ansa na ɛno reba no, RSA SecurID de algorithm a ɛyɛ ne de di dwuma; akyi no, 2FA app biara sii TOTP so. Vortex anammɔn 30-second ne 6-digit tenten yɛ RFC defaults. Wɔfɛm backup codes (12 × 10-digit, wɔakyerɛ pɛnkoro) firi GitHub nhyehyɛɛ a ɛfiri afe 2012 mu.
auth.h6_f:
kokoam = rand (20 bytes) // 160 bits wɔ RFC 6238 biara mu
TOTP(ahintasɛm, t) = HOTP(ahintasɛm, ⌊t / 30⌋) .
HOTP(k, c) = twa ( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

mfɛnsere: ±1 anammɔn a wɔma ho kwan ma dɔn skew
auth.h7_a: QR login de mfiri foforo bom kɔ akontaabu a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw mu a ɛnsan nkyerɛw password no bio. Fone a woakɔ mu dedaw no de ne nsa hyɛ nonce ase a mfiri foforo no de di dwuma de kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
auth.h7_b: Mfiri A de `/api/nokwaredi/qr/fi ase` to gua. Server yɛ 128-bit nonce a ɛwɔ TTL 60s, kyekyere no wɔ A user_id so, san de ba. A kyerɛ nonce a wɔahyɛ no sɛ QR (ɛka `nonce + user_id + server_url` ho). Device B scan, de `/api/authentication/qr/verify` a nonce no to gua. Server: nonce valid na ɛyɛ pɛnkoro? Fa B X25519 pubkey foforo no bata user_id (`user_devices` row foforo), mint JWTs ma B. Device A nsa ka WebSocket amanneɛbɔ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdefo no betumi ahu na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔpopa.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing na WhatsApp Web dii kan maa agye din wɔ afe 2015. Telegram dii akyire; Signal yɛɛ no kɔpi maa wɔn multi-device mmoa wɔ afe 2021. Vortex's twist: pairing event biara pue wɔ mfitiaseɛ device no so a "confirm" button, enti attacker a ɔgye QR no firi screenshot mu no ntumi nwie pairing a user interaction nni device A so.
auth.h7_f:
POST /api/nokwaredi/qr/fi ase
  → { nonce: 128-bit hex, ttl: 60 } Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio.
QR payload = { nonce, ɔdefo_id, ɔsomfo: "https://node.nhwɛso" }

POST /api/nokwaredi/qr/hwɛ sɛ { nonce } .
  → mfiri foforo a wɔakyerɛw din; JWTfo san bae.
auth.h8_a: Akontaabu enumeration resistance — auth ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
auth.h8_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Akontaabuo enumeration resistance". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
auth.h8_c: "Account enumeration resistance" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.

rooms.title: Pia ne nkrasɛm a wɔde mena
rooms.subtitle: Pia ahorow anan no, asɔremma, safoa a wɔkyinkyini, nkrasɛm.
rooms.intro: Pia ahorow anan no nyinaa — DM, kokoam kuw, ɔmanfo kuw, ɔkwan — kyɛ `dan` pon biako a ɛhyɛ ase. Suban no yɛ gated denam boolean frankaa so.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: asɔremma mmienu pɛpɛɛpɛ, `yɛ_dm=nokware`, `yɛ_kokoam=nokware`. Edin auto-set to ɔmannifo foforo no nsa.
rooms.h1p2: **Kokoam kuw**: nsato-nko, `yɛ_kokoam=nokware`, `yɛ_kwan=atoro`. Max 5000 asɔremma wɔ default so.
rooms.h1p3: **Ɔmanfoɔ kuw**: `yɛ_kokoam=atoro`. Obiara a ɔwɔ invite link betumi akɔka ho; wɔakyerɛw wɔ baguam kyerɛwtohɔ no mu sɛ owura no paw sɛ ɔbɛkɔ mu a.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: broadcast-nko, `yɛ_channel=nokware`. owners/admins nko ara na wobetumi de post; asɔremma a wɔyɛ daa kenkan.
rooms.h2p1: Dwumadi ahorow: `owura`, `admin`, `ɔmanni`. Owura biako pɛ na ɛwɔ dan biara mu (wobetumi de ama).
rooms.h2p2: Admins betumi ato nsa afrɛ, abɔ, abɔ mu, na wɔasesa dan nhyehyɛe. Asɔremma betumi de nkra amena, ayɛ wɔn ade, asiesie wɔn ankasa, apopa wɔn ankasa.
rooms.h2p3: Permissions cascade: wuranom wɔ admin tumi biara. Admins ntumi nto owura no ase.
rooms.h2p4: Dwumadi mu nsakrae ma nhyehyɛe nkrasɛm (`kind: "role_changed"`) a ɔmannifo biara hu.
rooms.h3p1: Pia biara wɔ 32-byte **root key** a wɔayɛ wɔ adebɔ mu denam `secrets.token_bytes(32)` so wɔ ɔbɔadeɛ no mfiri so.
rooms.h3p2: Ɔmannifoɔ biara nya envelope `{member_id, envelope: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` a wɔde asie wɔ `room_keys` mu.
rooms.h3p3: Sɛ asɔremma bi kɔka ho a, asɔremma biara a ɔwɔ hɔ dedaw no afɛfo na ɔyɛ envelope foforo ma wɔn. Envelope minting yɛ O(1) wɔ join biara mu.
rooms.h3p4: Sɛ asɔremma bi kɔ a, dan no dannan: ɔbɔadeɛ (anaasɛ admin a odi kan a ɔyɛ adwuma) nya ntini foforo, san de envelopes kɔ asɔremma a wɔaka so, de `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` to WebSocket so. Ciphertext dedaw no tra hɔ a wotumi kenkan denam safoa dedaw a akraman da so ara de asie no so.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: wɔ ɔmanfo adan a > 1000 asɔremma, envelopes gyae scaling. Mmom, owura no de ne nsa hyɛ ase na ɔtintim mprempren ntini safoa no wɔ `room_public_keys` pon no mu. Clients di nsaano nkyerɛwee ho adanse wɔ dan no wura pubkey so. Enti rotation wɔ member leave yɛ no-op ma Variant-B adan.
rooms.h3l2: Per-room pseudo: dan biara nso wɔ `room_pseudo_salt`. Asɔremma din a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ nkrasɛm mu no yɛ `HMAC-SHA256(nkyene, ɔdefo_id)` a wɔatwa no mu ayɛ no hex chars 16. Node ntumi nkyerɛ ɔdefo ko a ɔde nkra ko kɔe a enni client-side mapping.
rooms.h4p1: Nkrasɛm wɔ ID ahorow a ɛyɛ monotonic wɔ dan biara mu (64-bit auto-increment, `bigserial` wɔ Postgres mu, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` wɔ SQLite mu).
rooms.h4p2: Ordering yɛ server-a wɔde ama. Wɔn a wɔkra nneɛma no nko wɔ bere nsɔano ho; wɔkyerɛ ase wɔ ID nhyehyɛe mu na wɔkyerɛ nea ɔde kɔmaa no ɔfasu-dɔn bere sɛ UI metadata nkutoo.
rooms.h4p3: Nsakraeɛ: ciphertext foforɔ si dedaw a ɛwɔ beaeɛ, `edited_at` updates ananmu. Clients kyerɛ `(edited)` agyiraehyɛde.
rooms.h4p4: Popa: hyehyɛ `deleted_at`, null fi ciphertext. `{type:"m", wɔapopa:true}` amanneɛbɔ.
rooms.h4p5: Mmuae: `reply_to` = nkrasɛm id a wɔatwe adwene asi so. Clients kyerɛ quote header ketewa bi.
rooms.h5p1: Nneyɛe yɛ rows wɔ `nneyɛe (nkrasɛm_id, ɔdefo_id, emoji, abɔ_wɔ)`. Client POSTs `/api/nkrasɛm/{id}/nneɛma/{emoji}`. DELETE ma un-reacts.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans out `{type:"m", reactions:[...]}` ma obiara a ɔkra. Clients no bom yɛ adwuma.
rooms.h5p3: Anohyeto biara nni emoji — Unicode biara. Clients de-dupe na wɔkyerɛ akontaabu.
rooms.h6p1: Asaawa yɛ atoro dan a egyina nkrasɛm bi so. `POST /api/nkrasɛm/{id}/thread` bɔ `{id: <dan_id_foforo>, ɔwofo_nkrasɛm_id: <msg_id>, ɔwofo_dan_id: <mfitiase>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Thread rooms nya asɔremmayɛ fi ɔwofo no hɔ. Ɔwofo-dan mu muni biara betumi de ahyɛ thread biara mu.
rooms.h6p3: Safoa a wonya fi mu: asaawa ntini safoa = `HKDF(ɔwofo_ntini, info: "asaawa:" + <ɔwofo_nkrasɛm_id>, len: 32)`. Compromise a ɛwɔ thread key no mu no nnyɛ leak ɔwofo.
rooms.h7: Nkrasɛm a wɔde pin ahyɛ mu
rooms.h7p1: Admins tumi pin nkrasɛm 10 wɔ dan biara mu. `POST /api/dan/{id}/pin` a ɛwɔ `{nkrasɛm_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned set yɛ loaded wɔ dan a wɔabue mu; clients kyerɛ pinned header wɔ soro.
rooms.h8p1: Pia biara mu nsusuiɛ kɔ so wɔ node no so: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` a `{text}` ka ho. `GET` san de mprempren ba. `DELETE` no mu tew.
rooms.h8p2: Clients sync drafts wɔ devices nyinaa so enti sɛ wokyerɛw wɔ fon no so a, ɛba awiei wɔ desktop no so. Drafts nyɛ end-to-end encrypted — ɛyɛ server-visible plaintext. Ɛno yɛ aguadi a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ma cross-device UX. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔkasa tia no betumi asiw sync per-room ano.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` ne `{dan_id, ciphertext, soma_wɔ}`. Node sie wɔ `scheduled_messages` mu; cron adwumayɛfo bi hyɛ bɔ wɔ bere ano.
rooms.h9p2: Editable na cancellable kosi sɛ send_at tick no bɛhyew. Sɛ wɔde mena wie a, nkra no bɛyɛ row a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa wɔ `nkrasɛm` mu.
rooms.h1_a: Pia ahorow anan no nyinaa (DM, kokoam kuw, ɔmanfo kuw, ɔkwan) kyɛ `dan` pon biako. Nsonsonoe wɔ boolean frankaa abiɛsa mu.
rooms.h1_b: Flags: `yɛ_dm`, `yɛ_kokoam`, `yɛ_kwan`. DM: is_dm=nokware, is_private=nokware, asɔremma 2 pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ankorankoro kuw: is_private=nokware, is_channel=atoro, ɛkɔsi asɔremma 5000. Ɔmanfoɔ kuo: is_private=atoro, wɔakyerɛw wɔ daerekta mu sɛ owura no paw mu Channel: is_channel=nokware, owura/admins nko ara na wɔde bɛto gua. Wɔn nyinaa kyɛ key management, fan-out, reactions, nhama.
rooms.h1_c: Single-table polymorphism yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfiri Martin Fowler *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002) mu. Telegram de dan ahorow abiɛsa a ɛsono emu biara di dwuma wɔ mu; Slack de channels + DMs + multi-party DMs di dwuma sɛ ahorow anan; Discord de "channels" di dwuma ma biribiara. Yɛpaw one-table akyi profiling kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛka titiriw ne fan-out (a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ types nyinaa mu) na akyi v0.0.3 refactor kaa tables abiɛsa a ɛte saa ara boom yɛɛ no ​​biako.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE adan (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  type VARCHAR(16), -- agyapadeɛ, a ɛho nhia a frankaa ka ho
  din VARCHAR(256), .
  yɛ_kokoam BOOLEAN, .
  ne_kwan BOOLEAN, .
  ne_dm BOOLEAN, .
  asɔremma_kan INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512), 1999. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
  wɔbɔɔ_wɔ TIMESTAMP, .
  abɔ_wɔ BIGINT REFERENCES dwumadiefoɔ(id) .
);
rooms.h2_a: Dwumadi ahorow no yɛ abiɛsa: owura, admin, ɔmannifo. Owura biako pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ dan biara mu, anyɛ yiye koraa no admin biako, asɔremma pii a wɔpɛ.
rooms.h2_b: `dan_mufoɔ (dan_id, ɔdefoɔ_id, dwumadie, wɔaka ho_wɔ, muted_kosi)`. Roles cascade: wuranom wɔ admin tumi biara. Admins tumi to nsa frɛ, kick, mute, na edit room settings nanso wontumi nto owura no ase. Asɔremma betumi de nkra amena, ayɛ wɔn ade, asiesie wɔn ankasa, apopa wɔn ankasa. Owura a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo denam `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` a `new_owner_id` ka ho — owura dedaw no to fam kɔ ​​admin so.
rooms.h2_c: Owura/admin/member yɛ afã abiɛsa IRC op/voice/user model a efi 1988, akyiri yi Slack, Discord, Telegram gye toom. Paw pɔtee a wɔpaw sɛ wobenya owura biako pɛpɛɛpɛ (ɛnyɛ dodow) no fi mmara mu nsusuwii mu: wɔ tumidi ahorow a kuw-asɛyɛde ho mmara wom mu no, owura biako a ɛda adi pefee a wobenya no ma DMCA ne abisade a ɛte saa ara yɛ mmerɛw.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE dan mufo (
  dan_id BIGINT, .
  ɔdefo_id BIGINT, .
  dwumadie VARCHAR(16) CHECK(dwumadi IN ('owura','admin','asɔremma')), .
  ɔde ne ho bɔɔ_wɔ TIMESTAMP, .
  muted_kosi TIMESTAMP, .
  PRIMARY KEY (dan_id, ɔdefo_id) .
);
rooms.h3_a: Pia biara wɔ 32-byte symmetric root key. Asɔremma kura mfonini ahorow a wɔde abɔ wɔn X25519 pubkey ase.
rooms.h3_b: Wɔ adebɔ so no, akraman no yɛ `root_key = secrets.token_bytes (32)`. Wɔ asɔremma biara fam no, akraman de encrypt `root_key` wɔ `X25519(asɔremma_pubkey)` → envelope ase. Envelopes te `room_keys(dan_id, ɔdefo_id, envelope)` mu. Sɛ obi a ɔde di dwuma de ne ho hyɛ mu a, ɔmannifo biara a ɔwɔ hɔ dedaw no afɛfo no mint envelope foforo ma wɔn. Sɛ ɔdefoɔ bi kɔ a, owura anaa admin a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ adwuma no di akɔneaba — ɔyɛ root_key foforɔ, ɛsan de envelopes ma asɔremma a wɔaka, bɔ `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` wɔ WebSocket so.
rooms.h3_c: Per-member wrapping yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a Signal yɛɛ akwampaefoɔ wɔ afe 2014 mu maa ne akuo-v2. Matrix's Megolm de "sender keys" kwan a ɛte saa ara di dwuma. Vortex kɔe ne per-member envelopes efisɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobesusuw ho: no forward secrecy drift between senders. Aguadi-off ne O(N) envelope minting wɔ asɔremma nsakrae so, a ɛyɛ papa kosi ~5000 asɔremma; public-channel Variant-B twa anohyeto no ho.
rooms.h3_f:
on abɔ:
  ntini_safoa = rand (32) .
  ma m wɔ asɔremma mu:
    envelope [m] = X25519_Encrypt (m.pubkey, ntini_safoa) .

wɔ akwamma mu:
  ntini_foforo = rand (32) .
  rebroadcast(envelopes foforo ma asɔremma a wɔaka)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish de safoa biako a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase, a wɔde ato pon a ɔmanfo akenkan so si envelopes a ɔmannifo biara wɔ ananmu. Scales to 100k+ asɔremma.
rooms.h4_b: Sɛ anka O(N) envelope minting no, owura no de ne nsa hyɛ root_key no ase na ɔde kɔ `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)`. Clients fa, di ho adanseɛ tia owura no Ed25519 pubkey, na wɔde di dwuma. Rotation yɛ no-op ma membership nsakrae — obiara a na ɔwɔ safe no da so ara wɔ bi mpo sɛ wɔabɔ no akuturuku a. Ɛno yɛ nea wogye tom ma baguam announce-channels a "deep history" nyɛ ahunahuna nhwɛso nanso reach ne scale yɛ.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B yɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ Matrix "wiase akenkan" abakɔsɛm visibility a wɔaka abom ne signed key rotation. Wɔde kaa Vortex ho wɔ v0.0.8 mu bere a beta no wɔ 50k-member public channel a ne bere ne bere mu re-envelope bursts saturated node no akyi. Ɔkwan a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase na wɔatintim no scales linearly ne key rotations (a ɛntaa nsi) sen sɛ ɛne asɔremma nsakrae (a ɛyɛ daa).
rooms.h4_f:
Nsonsonoe-B:
  owura nsɛnkyerɛnne: sig = Ed25519Sign (owura_priv, dan_id ∥ ntini_safoa ∥ nkyerɛase)
  publish: dan_ɔmanfo_safe += {dan_id, ntini_safoa, nkyerɛase, sig}
  client: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → hwɛ sɛ sig tia owura_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: To nsa frɛ koodu ahorow no yɛ hex chars 32. Optional max_uses, expires_at, fa_dwumadi, nea wotumi san.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-only) yɛ row wɔ `invites(code, room_id, abɔ_de, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` ne koodu no hwɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ nokware (wɔntwa mu, ɛnyɛ nea atwam, used_count < max_uses), ɛma `used_count` kɔ soro, ɛyɛ `room_members` row, san de dan metadata ba. Revoke via `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — akyiri yi nkabom no di nkogu.
rooms.h5_c: To nsa frɛ koodu sɛ primitive no akyɛ te sɛ IRC `+i` mode (1988). Telegram's public invite links with expiry and use limits were introduced in 2017. Vortex's variant de `assign_role` ka ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wuranom betumi akyekyɛ admin-granting codes dwoodwoo wɔ one-shot format mu — mfaso wɔ so ma onboarding moderator foforo a enhia sɛ wohu wɔn user id pɔtee no ansa.
rooms.h5_f:
to nsa frɛ row:
  koodu : VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex nkyerɛwde
  dan_id : BIGINT .
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = anohyeto nni mu
  akontabuo_a wɔde adi dwuma : INT .
  expires_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = da biara
  fa dwumadie_ma : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = ɔmannifoɔ
  revoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = wɔte ase
rooms.h6_a: Nkra row bi sie ciphertext + metadata; wɔmfa sender nsie wɔ plaintext mu da.
rooms.h6_b: `nkrasɛm (id, dan_id, ɔdemafo_id, ciphertext, nonce, ɔdemafo_pseudo, asoma_wɔ, wɔasiesie_wɔ?, wɔapopa_wɔ?, mmuae_wɔ?, thread_id?, ɔkwan)`. `sender_id` wɔ hɔ ma kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ na wɔayɛ no index. `sender_pseudo` yɛ dan biara deterministic hash a sender_id enti fan-out nhia sɛ ɛka dwumadiefoɔ pon no. `kind` yɛ biako a: nkyerɛwee, mfonini, fael, nne, frɛ, nhyehyɛe. `ciphertext` yɛ opaque AES-GCM afiri; dan mufo a wɔwɔ safe no nkutoo na wobetumi decrypt.
rooms.h6_c: Sender_pseudo adwene no firi Signal sealed-sender (2018) mu. Signal de di dwuma de anifura server no ani ma onhu sender identity; yɛde di dwuma ma atirimpɔw a ɛte saa ara nanso yɛkora `sender_id` cleartext ma ACL ne rate anohyeto. Split no ma yɛhyɛ "asɔremma nkutoo na wobetumi de post" a server no nsua nea ɔkaa nea ɔkae wɔ full DB dump so.
rooms.h7_a: Nsakraeɛ kyerɛw `ciphertext` so wɔ beaeɛ na ɛbɔ `edited_at`. Popa null out ciphertext na hyehyɛ `deleted_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Sesa: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` a ɛwɔ `{ciphertext, nonce}` foforo. Nea ɔde kɔmaa no nkutoo na obetumi asiesie n’ankasa nkrasɛm. Row no ciphertext/nonce asi ananmu, `edited_at = seesei`, `kind` a ɛnsakra. Fan-out `{type:"m", id, ct, nonce, wɔasiesie_wɔ}`. Popa: `DELETE /api/nkrasɛm/{id}`. Sender anaa admin betumi apopa. `wɔapopa_wɔ = seesei`, `ciphertext = NULL`. Row tra hɔ enti mmuae da so ara yɛ nea ntease wom. Fan-out `{type:"m", wɔapopa:nokware, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place yɛ Telegram/Slack nhwɛsoɔ; Discord de edit history a edi mũ siee mfiase no na afei wɔtow gui sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ kokoamsɛm. Vortex sie nea aba foforo nkutoo — edit abakɔsɛm yɛ fibea a PR nsɛm a esisi bere a deleted-edit no yɛ nea wobetumi asan anya. Soft-delete a null ciphertext ka ho no fi Telegram playbook koro no ara mu na ɛkora mmuae nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so a enkora emu nsɛm so.

files.title: Fael ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho
files.subtitle: Single-shot ma nketewa, resumable ma akɛse, client-side encryption ma abien no nyinaa.
files.intro: Fael biara a wɔde bɛto so no fa encryption pipeline koro no ara mu. Nsonsonoe a ɛda akwan ntam no fa network resilience ho ara kwa: resumable tolerates flaky links.
files.h1: Single-shot upload kwan a wɔfa so de nneɛma gu so
files.h1p1: Nkyɛmu: 5 MB. Wɔde yɛ mfonini, nne nsɛm, nsɛm ntiantiaa.
files.h1p2: Client de AES-GCM, random 96-bit nonce, safoa = `fael_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)` de encrypt fael no nyinaa.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` kɔ `/api/fael` a ɛwɔ mfuw `fael` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (integrity claim), `mime_type` (hint; server san hwɛ ne `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Node sie `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` ase na ɛsan de `{file_id, url}` ba.
files.h1p5: Afei Client de dan nkrasɛm a ɛkyerɛ file_id no to hɔ na ɛde file_root no kɔ ne ciphertext mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a dan mufo betumi decrypt.
files.h2: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so de nneɛma gu so a wotumi san de gu so
files.h2p2: Stage 1: `POST /api/fael/resumable/init` a `{fael din, kɛse, chunk_size_hint}` ka ho. Node kyekyɛ upload id, paw chunk kɛseɛ (default 512 KiB, capped wɔ 4 MiB), san de `{upload_id, chunk_size}` ba.
files.h2p3: Stage 2: wɔ chunk biara ho no, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` a ɛwɔ raw ciphertext nipadua. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde offsets no hyia `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Ɔfa 3: `POST /api/fael/wɔbɛtumi asan ahyɛ aseɛ/{upload_id}/finalise` ne `{plain_blake3}`. Node san boaboa ano, hwɛ kɛse, sie, san de `{file_id, url}` ba.
files.h2p5: Failure handling: uploads a wɔatwa mu no betumi asan afi ase denam offsets a ayera nkutoo a wɔbɛsan de ahyɛ mu no so. Node tracks offsets a ɛbaa Redis (anaasɛ in-memory ma SQLite mode).
files.h2p6: TTL: wɔpopa uploads a wonwiei wɔ 24 h akyi.
files.h3p1: Mfonini a wɔde gu so (MIME `mfonini/*`) kanyan Pillow-based thumbnail generator wɔ 256×256 JPEG q=80. Wɔakora so wɔ `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg` ase.
files.h3p2: Thumbnails nso yɛ client-side encrypted — nea ogye no hia file_root no na ama watumi akyerɛ ase. Sie bandwidth ma list previews.
files.h3p3: Video a wɔde gu so (MIME `video/*`) kanyan ffmpeg-based poster extraction wɔ 10 % wɔ clip no bere tenten mu, a wɔkora so saa ara.
files.h4: MIME ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde hyɛ mu
files.h4p1: `mime_type` a adetɔfoɔ de akɔma no yɛ hint. Server no tu mmirika `python-magic` tia 1 KB a edi kan no na ɛpow sɛ sniffed type no wɔ deny list no mu a: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Eyi mma wɔn a wonni adwene no ntumi mfa messenger no so nkyekyɛ malware wɔ akwanhyia mu. Motivated attackers da so ara tumi bypass ne correctly-labelled containers — defense no yɛ client-side unwrap pow, ɛnyɛ server-side sniff.
files.h5p1: Default: mpɔtam hɔ fael nhyehyɛe. Good ma node biako a wɔde di dwuma.
files.h5p2: S3: hyehyɛ `AKYI_AKYI=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Wɔde fael ahorow no kɔ S3 tẽẽ a wɔmfa wɔn nsa nka node no disk no. Wɔde URL ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ahyɛ ase no di dwuma de twe nneɛma.
files.h5p3: IPFS: sɔhwɛ. Uploads de CIDs to gua denam DHT so; downloads fa pinning node biara ba.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload yɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm ma biribiara a ennu 5 MB — mfonini, nne nsɛm, nsɛm ntiantiaa. HTTPS POST baako, blob baako a wɔabɔ no encrypt, row baako wɔ `fael` mu.
files.h1_b: Client de AES-GCM de fael baiti ahorow no sie fi awiei kosi awiei wɔ random 32-byte `fael_root` ase. POSTs `multipart/form-data` kɔ `/api/fael` a mfuw `fael` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (nokwaredi ho asɛm), `mime_type` (hint). Node hyɛ 5 MB cap no den wɔ receive buffer level no so, ɛyɛ `python-magic` ma type detection, ɛpo sɛ MIME wɔ deny list no mu, sie wɔ `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin` ase, ɛsan de `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}` ba. Afei client de dan nkrasɛm a ɛkyerɛ `file_id` na ɛkura `file_root` wɔ ne ciphertext mu to gua.
files.h1_c: 5 MB cap no yɛ nɔma koro no ara a Slack ne Telegram de di dwuma ma wɔn "inline" upload kwan no. Fael akɛse kɔ ɔkwan a wɔsan de di dwuma no so. Mfiase no na Vortex wɔ 100 MB a wɔde tow tuo biako; yɛkɔɔ fam kɔɔ 5 MB akyi profiling kyerɛe sɛ single-shot uploads a ɛboro 5 MB no wɔ 40 % drop rate wɔ mobile networks so. Ɔkwan a wɔsan de di dwuma no ye katee ma fael akɛse ɛwom mpo sɛ ɛyɛ akwantu a ɛkɔ akyi kɛse wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ anigye so de.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload yɛ ɔkwan a fael akɛseɛ fa so. Client uploads fixed-size chunks, betumi agyina, obetumi asan afi ase wɔ chunk hye biara so, obetumi asan afi network blips mu.
files.h2_b: Protocol a ɛwɔ afã abiɛsa. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ne `{fael din, kɛse, chunk_size_hint}` → node kyekyɛ `upload_id` + si chunk kɛse so dua. Chunks: wɔ offset biara ho no, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` a ɛwɔ raw ciphertext nipadua. Ɛsɛ sɛ offsets yɛ chunk_size dodow. Fa wie: `POST /api/fael/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` ne `{plain_blake3}` — node san boaboa ano, hwɛ kɛse + tag, sie, san de `{fael_id, url}` ba.
files.h2_c: Protocol a ɛwɔ akwan mmiɛnsa no yɛ nsɛsoɔ korɔ no ara sɛ tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 multipart uploads, ne Google Drive resumable uploads. Vortex faa tus.io nsusuwii no efisɛ na ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara a ɛne FastAPI + streaming hyia. 24 h TTL wɔ uploads a wonwiei so no ne S3 default no hyia na balances san fi ase flexibility tia server disk dwumadie.
files.h3_a: Wɔyɛ mfonini nketewa wɔ server-side bere a wɔde rekɔ so nanso ɛtra encrypted wɔ fael ntini koro no ara ase, enti dan mufo nkutoo na wobetumi akyerɛ ase.
files.h3_b: Wɔ `mfonini/*` MIME ho no, Pillow yɛ 256×256 JPEG q=80 fi preview a wɔabɔ no mu. Twɛn — dabi, server no nni plaintext da. Nsuo a ɛteɛ: akraman no yɛ nsateaa no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ, ɔde file_root + nonce foforɔ korɔ no, ɛde kɔ sɛ onua blob, na ɛkyerɛ `thumb_id` wɔ dan no nkrasɛm mu. Server no de ciphertext no sie. `video/*` deɛ, akraman no yɛ saa ara wɔ ffmpeg-a ɛfiri keyframe mu.
files.h3_c: Mfiase Vortex na server-side thumbnail awo ntoatoaso fi plaintext — yɛyii saa tumi no wɔ v0.0.4 akyi ahobammɔ nhwehwɛmu kyerɛe sɛ ɛto E2E guarantee. Client-side thumbs ne nhwɛsoɔ a Signal de adi dwuma firi afe 2018 ne WhatsApp firi afe 2020. Bandwidth ka yɛ ketewa — a 256×256 JPEG wɔ ase 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Server no hyɛ MIME deny list wɔ sniff layer no mu ma ɛgyae executables a wɔakyekyɛ wɔ akwanhyia mu.
files.h4_b: Afei upload a edi mũ (single-shot) anaasɛ finalize (resumable), server no tu mmirika `python-magic` wɔ 1 KB a edi kan wɔ ciphertext no host container no so de hu nokware type. Sɛ sniff no bɔ amanneɛ sɛ `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), anaa `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O) a, wɔde 415 Unsupported Media Type pow upload no. Eyi yɛ server nhyehyɛe, ɛnyɛ ahobammɔ hye — client no dan mufo da so ara betumi ahyɛ wrapper format a ɛtwa sniff no ho hyia.
files.h4_c: MIME sniffing sɛ pow nhyehyɛe yɛ IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X fi 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram nyinaa yɛ. Anohyeto (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) no yɛ nea wonim fi 2016 — yɛn defense no yɛ layered: ne user-side kɔkɔbɔ wɔ fael biara a ɛwɔ executable ntrɛwmu so.
files.h5_a: Storage backends — fael ahorow ti no fã. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
files.h5_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Storage backends". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
files.h5_c: "Storage backends" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.

presence.title: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ hɔ ne nea ɔde ma
presence.subtitle: Typing indicators, akenkan receipts, nea etwa to a wohuu — ne nyinaa yɛ bere tiaa mu de.
presence.intro: Saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi yɛ dede. Vortex ma wɔyɛ off-persistence default: typing lives wɔ Redis (anaasɛ in-memory), akenkan receipts nkutoo ne sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛtra ase wɔ restart.
presence.h1p1: Client soma `{type:"t", room:..., state:"start"|"gyae"}` wɔ keystroke so. Debounced to at most adeyɛ biako wɔ 3 s biara mu.
presence.h1p2: Node bɔ `{type:"t", dan:..., ɔdefo:..., ɔman:...}` ma WebSocketfo a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din nyinaa.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `fi ase` a enni `gyina` bere a edi so akyi wɔ s 10 akyi wɔ akraman afã.
presence.h2: Kenkan nkrataa a wɔde gye sika
presence.h2p2: Node kɔ so wɔ `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` na ɛbɔ `{type:"r", dan:..., ɔdefo:..., message_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Clients kyerɛ "seen by N" wɔ outbound nkrasɛm ase.
presence.h2p4: Privacy: ɔdefo betumi asiw "seen" ano koraa; afei node no nkura receipts mma wɔn. Trade-off: wɔn nso wɔnhunu nnipa foforɔ receipts (symmetry).
presence.h3: Nea etwa to a wohuu no
presence.h3p1: Node di `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) akyi wɔ ɔdefo biara mu. Wɔayɛ no foforo wɔ WebSocket frame biara so.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (nea ɔde di dwuma no betumi apaw): pɛpɛɛpɛ, wɔayɛ no kurukuruwa kosi simma 5 a ɛbɛn, wɔayɛ no kurukuruwa kosi dɔnhwerew a ɛbɛn, "nnansa yi ara", anaasɛ wɔadum.
presence.h3p3: Wɔnam `GET /api/users/{id}/baabi` so na wobisae. Wɔakyerɛw wɔn din denam `{type:"sub_presence", ɔdefo:...}` so.
presence.h4p1: Ɔdefoɔ bi wɔ "online" sɛ anyɛ yie koraa no ɔwɔ WebSocket baako a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn mfiri biara so a.
presence.h4p2: Visible to contacts only — wɔn a wɔnyɛ nkitahodifo hu nea etwa to a wɔahu nanso ɛnyɛ live dot.
presence.h1_a: Typing indicator no nam WebSocket frame `{type:"t", dan, state: "start"|"stop"}` so mena na wɔde node no bɔ amanneɛ kɔma obiara a ɔkra wɔ dan no mu.
presence.h1_b: Client debounces wɔ 3 s — keystroke a edi kan soma `fi ase`, akyiri yi wɔ 3 s mu nyɛ hwee. 10 s akyi keystroke a etwa to no, client soma `stop`. Node bɔ frame no ho dawuru asɛmfua biara, a wɔde `user_id` ahyɛ anim. No persistence — typing tebea te ase wɔ in-memory per-room dicts (anaasɛ Redis pub / sub ma multi-node). Auto-expire 10 s wɔ receiver afã: sɛ update biara mma a, clients fa no sɛ wɔagyae.
presence.h1_c: Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm no san kɔ AIM / ICQ (1997). Nnɛyi debounced designs trace to Skype 2006 ne iMessage 2011. 3 s / 10 s nɔma no fi iMessage suban a wɔahyɛ no nsow — yɛn A/B sɔɔ hwɛe 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 ne 3/10 nyaa subjective "matches human rhythm" feedback a eye sen biara.
presence.h2_a: Akenkan krataa a wɔde gye no kɔ so: client POSTs last-read message id; node sie wɔ `read_receipts` ne broadcasts mu.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/dan/{id}/kenkan` ne `{akenkan_a etwa to_nkrasɛm_id}`. Node de UPSERT nkyerɛaseɛ yɛ `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` foforɔ. Broadcasts `{type:"r", dan, ɔdefo, nkra_id, akenkan_wɔ}`. Clients kyerɛ "seen by N" wɔ outbound nkrasɛm ase. Kokoamsɛm: nea ɔde di dwuma no betumi asiw nkrataa a wɔde gye sika no ano koraa; afei node no ntra hɔ mma wɔn AND wɔnhu afoforo receipts (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Read receipts became ubiquitous after iMessage 2011 and WhatsApp 2014. Symmetry mmara (sɛ wode wo deɛ sie a, wunhu afoforɔ deɛ) firi Telegram 2014 na ɛno nko ara ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so akwati ɔkwan baako a wɔfa so hwɛ nneɛma so. Vortex hyɛ symmetry wɔ server no so — ɛnyɛ client no nko ara — enti clients a wodi atoro fa frankaa no ho da so ara nnya visibility.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen yɛ bere nsɔano biako a ɔde di dwuma biara, a wɔayɛ no foforo wɔ WebSocket frame biara so na ayɛ dedaw bere a frame biara mma.
presence.h3_b: Node di `presence.last_seen_at` akyi sɛ unix ms. Wɔayɛ no foforo wɔ WebSocket frame biara a wɔagye atom a efi saa ɔdefo no hɔ. Kenkan denam `GET /api/adwumayɛfo/{id}/baabi` so. Subscribe via `{type:"sub_presence", user}` na woanya live push wɔ nsakrae ho. Granularity yɛ user-configurable: bere stamp pɛpɛɛpɛ, kurukuruwa kɔ 5 min, kurukuruwa kɔ 1 h, "nnansa yi ara", anaasɛ off.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers trace to WhatsApp 2012 privacy update akyi anwiinwii wɔ stalking a etwa to a wohuu ho. Telegram wɔ afe 2013 mu de "nnansa yi ara / dapɛn biako mu / ɔsram biako mu" bokiti no kaa ho. Vortex's 5 min / 1 h / "nnansa yi ara" no yɛ Telegram. "off" option no symmetrically de ɔdefo no sie sɛ onhu afoforo nea etwa to a wɔahu esiane ntease koro no ara nti sɛnea wɔkenkan nkrataa a wɔde gye sika no.
presence.h4_a: Online indicator: obi a ɔde di dwuma no yɛ "online" sɛ anyɛ yiye koraa no ɔwɔ live WebSocket biako wɔ wɔn mfiri biara so a.
presence.h4_b: Node sie `active_ws_count(user_id)` wɔ nkaeɛ mu. Nkɔanim wɔ WS upgrade, decrements wɔ close. `online = active_ws_count (ɔdefo_id) > 0`. Visible to contacts only — non-contacts hu last-seen (ɛhyɛ granularity ase) nanso da te ase green dot. Sesa nsɛm a esisi gya bere a akontaabu no twa zero wɔ ɔkwan biara so.
presence.h4_c: Contacts-only visibility yɛ model a ɔbɔfoɔ biara a ɔyɛ anibereɛ atena so wɔ stalking nsɛm pii akyi (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Mfiase Vortex maa obiara hui wɔ intanɛt so; yɛdannan default no bere a beta nhwehwɛmufo bi kyerɛe sɛ ɔmanfo adan mu bɛma ahɔho mpempem pii a wɔwɔ hɔ akɔma ahɔho afoforo mpempem pii akyi.
presence.h2_f:
POST /api/dan/{id}/kenkan { akenkan_a etwa to_nkrasɛm_id }

calls.title: WebRTC frɛ
calls.subtitle: Ɛnne + video, 1:1 ne kuw, a wɔde sɛnkyerɛnne kyerɛ wɔ WebSocket so, a wɔde fa coturn so de ma.
calls.intro: Vortex de stock WebRTC stack no di dwuma. Node yɛ signalling-nko. Sɛ atipɛnfoɔ ka wɔn ICE akansifoɔ no bom pɛ a, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ sen tẽẽ (atipɛnfoɔ-ne-atipɛnfoɔ) anaa ɛfa TURN relay no so wɔ bad NAT so.
calls.h1p1: Ɔfrɛfo: `POST /api/frɛ/{dan_id}/fi ase` ne `{video: bool, ɔdio: bool}`. Node kyekyɛ call_id, bɔ `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` kɔ dan mu.
calls.h1p2: Ɔfrɛ no gye tom: `POST /api/frɛ/{frɛ_id}/gye` → `{type:"c", ɔkwan:"wɔagye atom"}`.
calls.h1p3: Ɔde ma/mmuae nsakrae: `{su:"ma", sdp:...}` → `{su:"mmuae", sdp:...}` → `{su:"ɔkannifo", ice:...}` × N kosi sɛ ɛbɛka ho.
calls.h1p4: Frɛ no ba awiei: `POST /api/frɛ/{frɛ_id}/awie`. Ɔfã biara betumi de telefon no ato hɔ. Node kyerɛwtohɔ `frɛ_kyerɛwtohɔ (frɛ_id, bere tenten_s, video, ɔdio, apontow ahorow)`.
calls.h2p1: Server Nkitahodi Nkitahodi a Wɔde Sisi Hɔ. Atipɛnfo sesa wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn (host, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: wɔde coturn abɔ mu. Stun-only mode a wɔde di dwuma ma symmetric-NAT detection.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn ne HMAC-a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase bere tiaa mu adansedi nkrataa. Ɔfrɛ biara nya fresh creds a ɛyɛ adwuma 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Adansedie: `{ɔdefoɔ din: <bere nsɔano>:<ɔdefoɔ_id>, asɛmfua: base64(HMAC-SHA1(ahintasɛm, ɔdefoɔ din))}`. Standard RFC 5389 nhyehyɛe.
calls.h3p1: Ɔdio: Opus 48 kHz a ɛsakra bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX on ma kommyɛ a wɔde siw ano.
calls.h3p2: Video: VP9 (wɔpɛ) / H.264 / AV1 (paw sɛ wobɛkɔ). Simulcast ma kuw frɛ: ɔfrɛfo no de encode resolutions abiɛsa bere koro mu.
calls.h3p3: FEC: bere nyinaa wɔ so ma ɔdio; ma video sɛ bitrate headroom ma kwan a.
calls.h4p1: Wɔ > 2 a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no, Vortex spawns SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) wɔ node no so. Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no de upload pɛnkoro, SFU fans out.
calls.h4p2: Mprempren wɔde ɔdio nkutoo na ɛyɛ nnipa 100 a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu; video akuw a wɔde 8 ahyɛ mu wɔ v0.1 mu (video SFU a ɛyɛ den wɔ v0.3 kwankyerɛ mu).
calls.h4p3: SFU de coturn relay koro no ara di dwuma ma traversal; nnwuma foforo biara ho nhia.
calls.h5p1: Ɛnam `getDisplayMedia` so. Client de track foforo ka PeerConnection a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ho; renegotiates offer/mmuae a wɔde ma.
calls.h5p2: Wɔn a wogye no kyerɛ screen a wɔakyekyɛ no sɛ video track a ɛyɛ soronko. Wɔ mobile so no, screen sharing hwehwɛ OS-level kwan — iOS hwehwɛ, Android kyerɛ nhyehyɛe nkɔmmɔbɔ.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC NetEQ a wɔde ahyɛ mu no di adehwere ne jitter ho dwuma. Wɔ degradation kɛse mu no client no gyae resolution anaasɛ disable video koraa bere a ɔma audio tra ase.
calls.h6p2: 500 ms freeze kanyan mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsan abɔ mu bio (ICE san fi ase). Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no hu "Reconnecting..." overlay.
calls.h1_a: Call signaling tra WebSocket koro no ara a wɔde di dwuma ma nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Node yɛ signalling-only — ɛyɛ brokers SDP ne ICE wɔ atipɛnfo ntam nanso ɛnka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo da.
calls.h1_b: Ɔfrɛfo POSTs `/api/frɛ/{room_id}/fi ase` ne `{video, ɔdio}`. Node kyekyɛ `frɛ_id`, bɔ `{type:"c", kind:"to nsa frɛ", frɛ_id, video, ɔdio}` kɔ dan no mu. Callee posts `/api/frɛ/{frɛ_id}/gye` → `{type:"c", ɔkwan:"gye tom"}`. SDP ayɛyɛde/mmuae nsakrae: `{ɔkwan:"adeyɛ", sdp}` → `{su:"mmuae", sdp}`. ICE abatoɔfoɔ: `{kind:"candidate", ice}` × N kɔsi sɛ PeerConnection bɛbɔ amanneɛ sɛ `wɔabɔ`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE sɛnkyerɛnne yɛ gyinapɛn WebRTC nhyehyɛe a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ RFC 8839 ne 8841. Vortex nnyɛ biribiara wɔ ha; ɛyɛ flow koro no ara Chrome, Firefox, ne WebRTC nhomakorabea dwumadie biara. Node-as-signalling-only choice no fi nimdeɛ a yɛwɔ sɛ SFU-style media forwarding kyekyere bandwidth na ɛhwehwɛ hardware a yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛde bɛmena wɔ base install no mu.
calls.h2_a: ICE hwehwɛ ɔkwan bi a ɛnam NATs so de host + server-reflexive + relay candidates di dwuma. coturn nsa STUN ne TURN wɔ Vortex fã.
calls.h2_b: Atipɛnfo biara kan wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn: host (mpɔtam hɔ IP ahorow), srflx (server-reflexive via STUN), relay (TURN-allocated). Atipɛnfo sesa wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no nyinaa; baanu biara yɛ "pair", nkitahodi nhwehwɛmu de STUN binding request kɔ UDP so. Awarefo a wodi kan a wodi yiye bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔapaw. Wɔ symmetric NAT akyi no, relay abien nkutoo na ɛyɛ adwuma — ɛno ne bere a TURN relay no relay media ankasa.
calls.h2_c: Wɔde ICE yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 5245 wɔ afe 2010 mu na wɔsan yɛɛ no ​​foforo sɛ RFC 8445 wɔ afe 2018. Wɔ carrier-grade-NAT akyi no, STUN di nkogu bɛyɛ 15 % wɔ bere no mu na TURN yɛ nea wontumi nkwati. coturn yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ open-source TURN server; yɛde mena efisɛ ɔkwan foforo (aguadi Twilio/Vonage TURN) no gye simma biara a wɔde relayed audio.
calls.h3_a: TURN credentials yɛ bere tiaa mu HMAC-signed username/password pairs a wɔde ma wɔ frɛ biara mu, ɛnyɛ ahintasɛm a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ.
calls.h3_b: Wɔ frɛ mfiase no, node no yɛ `ɔdefo din = "<expiry_unix>:<ɔdefo_id>"` ne `asɛmfua = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, ɔdefo din))`. Wɔn baanu nyinaa wɔ TTL 24 h. Client de di dwuma wɔ ne RTCPeerConnection nhyehyeɛ mu. coturn di HMAC no ho adanse wɔ nhyiam nhyehyɛe mu. Creds a ne bere atwam no di nkogu wɔ HMAC check no mu — wogyae adwumayɛ ankasa a enni revocation database.
calls.h3_c: HMAC creds a ɛnkyɛ firi RFC 5389 (STUN) na ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ a production WebRTC deployment biara de di dwuma. Twilio, Google, Xirsys nyinaa yɛ. Ɔkwan foforo — static TURN creds — leaks sɛ client biara yɛ compromised. Creds a ɛtra hɔ bere tiaa bi no to ɔsɛe mfɛnsere no ano hye ma ɛyɛ 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Audio yɛ Opus wɔ 48 kHz a DTX; video no yɛ VP9 titiriw / H.264 fallback / AV1 paw-in.
calls.h4_b: Nsɛm a Wɔte: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Discotinuous Transmission) gyae soma bere a wɔayɛ komm, ɛsan fi ase wɔ nne so. FEC so bere nyinaa. Video: VP9 wɔ mfiase; H.264 a wɔbɔɔ ho dawuru maa mfiri a enni hardware VP9 decode (iOS ansa na A10 Bionic reba); AV1 a wɔde ma sɛ opt-in ma premium wɔ nnɛyi hardware so. Simulcast ma kuw frɛ: ɔfrɛfo encode resolutions abiɛsa bere koro mu, SFU fans fi nea ɛfata ma obiara a ɔhwɛ.
calls.h4_c: Opus yɛ IETF ɔdio codec a wontua hwee (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 yɛ Google a wɔabue H.265-a ɛne no sɛ. H.264 yɛ fallback ɛfiri sɛ Apple kuraa VP9 mmoa so kɔsii afe 2021. AV1 bɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ fon so wɔ iPhone 15 Pro (2023) ne Pixel 8 (2023) de hardware decode kaa ho akyi. Vortex no codec mix no yɛ nea Google Meet de di dwuma no ara.
calls.h5_a: Kuw frɛ de SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) di dwuma wɔ node no so. Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no de to so pɛnkoro; SFU de kɔma obiara.
calls.h5_b: Wɔ > 2 atipɛnfo deɛ ɔfrɛfoɔ no de `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start` to hɔ. Node spins up SFU instance a wɔakyekyere no akɔ frɛ no so. Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no bue PeerConnection ma SFU no sen sɛ ɔbɛbue ama atipɛnfoɔ foforɔ biara. Uplink: emu biara de asuten 1 kɔ. Downlink: SFU kɔ anim N-1 nsuten. Simulcast layers kyerɛ sɛ SFU paw resolution a ɛfata hwɛfo biara bandwidth a ɛwɔ hɔ.
calls.h5_c: SFU adansiɛ no firi Jitsi Videobridge (2013) mu. Ansa na SFU reba no, na WebRTC kuw frɛ no yɛ full-mesh — atipɛnfo biara encoded N-1 nsuten, a ɛyɛ quadratically. Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi, Signal kuw frɛ nyinaa de di dwuma SFU. Vortex kuw frɛ a wɔde ɔdio nkutoo na wɔde mena wɔ v0.0.8 mu; video kuw frɛ wɔ v0.3 kwankyerɛ no so.
calls.h6_a: Screen sharing yɛ media track foforɔ wɔ PeerConnection a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no so, a wɔsan di nkitaho denam offer/answer so.
calls.h6_b: Ɔdefoɔ pia Kyɛ Screen → brawsa / iOS / Android frɛ `getDisplayMedia()`. MediaStream a wɔasan de aba no yɛ addTrack-ed wɔ PeerConnection no mu. Renegotiation fires: foforo a wɔde ma/mmuae a wɔde track a wɔde aka ho no ka ho. Wɔn a wogye no kyerɛ screen a wɔakyekyɛ no sɛ video element a ɛyɛ soronko. Wɔ iOS so no, screen sharing hia Broadcast Upload Extension; wɔ Android so no, ɛyɛ anim som + MediaProjection kwan.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia yɛɛ standardized wɔ afe 2017 mu na ɛwɔ browser biara mu firi afe 2019. iOS Broadcast Upload Extension baa iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection ayɛ nea ɛyɛ den fi bere a Lollipop (2015) dii dwuma. Vortex screen kyɛfa a wɔde mena wɔ v0.0.8 mu.

wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ dibea:
  host : rtp:addr (ɛhɔnom IP) .
  srflx : STUN ahunu baguam kasa
  relay : TURN-a wɔde ama relay address

pair check: STUN abisade a ɛkyekyere wɔ UDP .
pair a wɔapaw: nea edi kan a edi nkonim

edin a ɔde di dwuma = "{expiry_unix}:{ɔdefo_id}".
password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_ahintasɛm, ɔdefo din))
TTL = 24 h
coturn: ɛma HMAC yɛ nokware wɔ AUTH abisade so; pow bere a ne bere atwam akyi
calls.h4_f:
ɔdio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR, DTX so, FEC so
video: VP9 (mfitiase) .
         ↓ asɛm a wɔsan kɔ akyi
        H.264 mfitiaseɛ (a wɔahyɛ no den) .

full mesh (N peers): emu biara de N-1 nsuten → O(N2) uplink kɔ
SFU (N atipɛnfo): obiara de asuten 1 → O(N) uplink kɔ atipɛnfo biara

getDisplayMedia ({video: {cursor: "bere nyinaa"}, ɔdio: atoro})
