federation.title: Federation a ɛwɔ hɔ
federation.subtitle: Pubkeys a wogye wɔn di, nsɛmmɔnedi a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase, cross-node DMs.
federation.intro: Federation ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node A nkrasɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node B. Ɛyɛ opt-in per operator. Node pubkeys yɛ nea wogye di pefee; ɛnyɛ automatic "node biara betumi ayɛ federate ne me de" mode.
federation.h1: Fa wo ho to anchors so
federation.h1p1: Node biara hwɛ `federations(pubkey, endpoint, akwahosan_nkontabuo, added_at, added_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Peer a wode bɛka ho no hwehwɛ sɛ operator-signed admin action. Admin UI no kyerɛ remote no nsateaa nkyerɛwee sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ sɛ out-of-band no yɛ nokware.
federation.h1p3: Atipɛnfo a wɔayi wɔn no da so ara wɔ DB a wɔahyɛ no agyirae sɛ `revoked_at` ma akontaabu. Wɔpow federation abisade foforo a efi pubkey koro no ara mu kosi sɛ admin bi beyi afi mu.
federation.h2: Cross-node nkrasɛm a wɔde fa kwan so
federation.h2p1: Outbound fi A kɔ user@B: node A kyekyere nkra envelope no wɔ blob a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase mu na POSTs `/federation/deliver` wɔ node B so.
federation.h2p2: Envelope: `{fibea_node, botae_ɔdefo, mu_ciphertext, mu_nonce, sent_at, sig}`. Sig kata biribiara so gye sig ankasa.
federation.h2p3: Node B di nsaano nkyerɛwee ho adanseɛ tia `source_node` pubkey fi ne `federations` pon so. Sign → 401 + akontabuo adeyɛ a ɛntene.
federation.h3p1: Sɛ B yɛ nea wontumi nkɔ hɔ a, A to ntonto wɔ `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, mmɔdenbɔ, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Nkɛntɛnso a ɛkɔ akyiri: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, wɔatoto so wɔ 6h. Di nkogu a ɛtra hɔ daa wɔ nnafua 14 akyi.
federation.h3p3: Operator kɔkɔbɔ gya bere a outbox bun > 1000 nkra — kyerɛ sɛ federation link a akɔ so.
federation.h4p1: S 60 biara node biara ping `GET /v1/health` wɔ atipɛnfo biara so. Mmuae bere + tebea a wɔadi akyi.
federation.h4p2: Akwahosan nkontabuo: mfitiaseɛ 100. Bere biara a wɔde twam no yi 1; nkonimdi biara de 1 ka ho (cap 100). Score 0 → federation no gyinaa kakra maa saa atipɛnfo no.
federation.h4p3: Wɔnam `GET /v1/peers` so tintimii maa adwumayɛfo dashboard ahorow.
federation.h1_a: Federation wɔ Vortex mu yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔn ho wɔn ho mu ahotoso a ɛda node adwumayɛfo baanu ntam. Node biara tintim 32-byte Ed25519 ɔmanfo safoa; node foforo no de ka `trusted_nodes` pon a ɛka n'awiei ne akwahosan nkontabuo ho.
federation.h1_b: Sɛ wode pubkey a wogye di bɛka ho a, ɛhwehwɛ sɛ adwumayɛfo no de node no ankasa release key no de ne nsa hyɛ admin abisade ase. UI no kyerɛ remote no nsateaa nkyerɛwee wɔ 64-hex-char kwan so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a admins betumi ahwɛ sɛ out of band. Sɛ wɔde ka ho wie a, wɔgye federation envelope biara a ɛba no di ho adanseɛ wɔ saa pubkey no Ed25519 nsaano nkyerɛwee no ho — wɔhunu atoro ntɛm ara na wɔkyerɛw. Revocation yɛ mmerɛw: row no tra hɔ a wɔahyɛ no agyirae `revoked_at` ma audit, nanso envelope nsaano nkyerɛwee no mprempren di nkogu.
federation.h1_c: Wɔnya nhwɛsoɔ no firi Matrix federation (baabi a server biara bɔ signing key ho dawuru na wɔde ne nsa hyɛ event biara ase) ne email DKIM (baabi a DNS tintim signing pubkey). Matrix daa no adi sɛ model no yɛ adwuma wɔ scale — wɔn network no wɔ bɛboro 100k federated servers. Vortex no variant no yɛ soronko denam hwehwɛ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ obiara paw nea ɛda adi pefee sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ Matrix "server biara betumi ayɛ federate by default" mmara; yɛde nneɛma a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sesaa ahobammɔ a emu yɛ den a yɛde bɛko atia fekuw a wɔyɛ asisifo.
federation.h1_f:
ahotoso_nodes row:
  pubkey : 32 baiti Ed25519. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so
  awiei : https://...
  akwahosan_nkontaabu : int [0, 100].
  wɔde aka ho_wɔ : unix_ms
  added_by : admin_ɔdefoɔ_id
  wɔatwa_wɔ : unix_ms | NULL .
federation.h2_a: Nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ cross-node no te E2E envelope koro no ara so sɛnea local de no, a wɔakyekyere no wɔ envelope a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase a ɛkyerɛ sɛ node a wɔde mena no yɛ nokware ma node a ogye no.
federation.h2_b: Node A pɛ sɛ ɔde kɔma user@B. Anamɔn 1: A serialises `{fibea_node, botae_ɔdefo, emu_ciphertext, emu_nonce, sent_at}`. Anamɔn 2: A de ne Ed25519 kokoam safoa → `sig` de ne nsa hyɛ serialized bytes ase. Anamɔn 3: A POSTs tuple no kɔ `POST /federation/deliver` wɔ node B. Anamɔn 4: B hwehwɛ `source_node` wɔ ne `trusted_nodes` mu, hwɛ `sig`, hwɛ `sent_at` wɔ replay-window, na ɔtra mu envelope no wɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ `messages` pon no so. Nea ogye no hu no te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ nkrasɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ — federation layer no ntumi nhu mma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma awiei.
federation.h2_c: Wɔfɛm envelope a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase wɔ akyi no fi Matrix `m.room.message` federation events mu. Wɔfɛm mfɛnsere a wɔsan bɔ (simma 5) ne ahwehwɛde a ɛne sɛ bere nsɔano a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase wɔ fibea no ne ɔfasu dɔn no hyia no fi DKIM. Mfiase Vortex (v0.0.2) sɔɔ federation a wɔmfa wɔn nsa nhyɛ ase a ɛwɔ TLS client certs hwɛe; yɛsesaa kɔɔ payload signatures wɔ v0.0.5 akyi a yɛhunuu sɛ client certs nnya nkwa wɔ load balancers na wɔde nokwaredi ankasa sie fi application layer no mu.
federation.h2_f:
envelope = { .
  fibea_node : hex32, .
  botae_a ɔde di dwuma : int64, .
  inner_ciphertext: baiti, .
  inner_nonce : baiti, .
  wɔde amena_wɔ : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign (fibea_priv, CBOR (envelope))
POST /federation/deliver { krataa a wɔde kyerɛw krataa, sig } .
federation.h3_a: Sɛ akyirikyiri node no ntumi nkɔ hɔ a, node a ɛresoma no de envelope no to ntonto mu wɔ ne `federation_outbox` mu na ɛsan bɔ mmɔden de exponential backoff.
federation.h3_b: Backoff nhyehyɛe: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped wɔ 6h. Wɔ mmɔdenbɔ biara a entumi nyɛ yiye so no, wɔde row no `mmɔdenbɔ` kɔla no kɔ soro na wɔde `next_retry_at` asi hɔ sɛ seesei + mprempren-anamɔn. Akyi adwumayɛfoɔ (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) nyane s 5 biara na ɔfa rows a `next_retry_at <= now()`. Odi nkonim popa row no; Nnafua 14 a entumi nyɛ adwuma no hyɛ no agyirae daa na fa admin alert mena.
federation.h3_c: Exponential backoff a ɛwɔ ceiling yɛ nhwɛsoɔ korɔ no ara a Kafka de di dwuma ma producer retries ne SMTP de di dwuma ma bounced mail. Nnafua 14 cap no ne SMTP RFC 5321 nyansahyɛ no hyia. Nkyerɛase ahorow a edi kan no de sikani 60 a wɔasan abɔ mmɔden a wɔasiesie a ɛde aprannaa-nguankuw spikes bae bere a atipɛnfo bi san baa intanɛt so bere a wɔagyae adwumayɛ akyi no dii dwuma; exponential spread siesiee sɛ wɔ v0.0.7 mu.
federation.h3_f:
akyɛde (n) = min (6h, 1s · 20) ma n = 0, 1, 2, ...

nhyehyɛe a wɔsan sɔ hwɛ: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
kɔkɔbɔ: outbox_depth > 1000 ma > simma 5
federation.h4_a: Sikɔne 60 biara node biara ping atipɛnfo biara `/v1/akwahosan` awiei. Score drifts kɔ soro wɔ nkonimdi mu, ɛba fam wɔ huammɔdi so, anohyeto wɔ [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Score fi ase wɔ 100 wɔ add so. Nkonimdi biara de +1 ka ho (a wɔakata so wɔ 100), bere biara a wɔde twam no twetwe -1 (wɔabɔ no fam wɔ 0). Score 0 pauses federation to that peer — new messages queue in outbox, no new outbound delivery attempts until score climbs back above 20. Wɔda nkontabuo no adi denam `GET /v1/peers` so ma operator dashboards ne denam `/metrics` so ma Prometheus. Nkonimdi a ɛkɔ fam mpofirim wɔ atipɛnfo pii so wɔ mfɛnsere tiawa bi mu no kanyan "network partition suspected" kɔkɔbɔ.
federation.h4_c: AIMD-style score no fi TCP congestion window ne Akamai akwahosan-hwɛ damper. Asymmetric ±1 anammɔn (sen sɛ TCP fã) ma ahotɔ yɛ brɛoo sen huammɔdi, a ɛma nhyehyɛe no yɛ animhwɛ kɔ ahwɛyiye so — yɛbɛpɛ sɛ yɛma federation no gyae bere a yentumi nsi pi sen sɛ yɛde nkrasɛm a ɛyɛ abien bɛmena denam flapping link so. Wɔde kaa ho wɔ v0.0.6 mu bere a atipɛnfo bi a ɔnyɛ abrabɔ bɔne de mmɔdenbɔ a wɔsan yiri faa mfɛfo pa baanu so akyi.
federation.h4_f:
wɔ nkonimdi so: nkontabuo = min(100, nkontabuo + 1) .
wɔ bere a wɔde twaa mu: nkontabuo = max (0, nkontabuo - 1) .
sɛ nkontabuo == 0: pause_federation (atipɛnfoɔ) .
sɛ nkontabuo >= 20: san fi ase_federation (atipɛnfoɔ) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gossip ne atipɛnfo a wohu
gossip.subtitle: Sɛnea nodes hwehwɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho a wonni central registry.
gossip.intro: Wɔ controller no attested list akyi no, Vortex nodes no bɔ atipɛnfo nsɛmmɔne wɔ wɔn mu. Eyi hu node foforo bere a adwumayɛfo no twitwiw wɔn so no, sɛ mpo controller no nnya nnii ho adanse de besi nnɛ a.
gossip.h1p1: S 60 biara no, node paw atipɛnfo a wɔanhyɛ da na ɛde 256-bit Bloom filter a ɛyɛ atipɛnfo a wonim no kɔ. Atipɛnfo bua ne atipɛnfo NOT wɔ filter no mu, ne n’ankasa filter no. Bandwidth yɛ `O(atipɛnfo foforo × 32 bytes)`, mpɛn pii no ɛba fam sen 1 KiB wɔ round biara mu.
gossip.h1p2: Atipɛnfo biara a wɔabɔ ho dawuru no, aguade ho dawurubɔ node no de ne nsa hyɛ ase. Clients verify signatures on first contact — ɔtowhyɛfo ntumi nhyɛ atipɛnfo bi nkɔ nsɛmmɔnedi no mu.
gossip.h1p3: Kurukuruwa no yɛ rate-limited: nsakrae biako wɔ atipɛnfo biara mu wɔ s 30 biara mu (sliding window).
gossip.h2p1: Nodes foforo fi ase wɔ 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers. Nsɛmmɔnedi a edi kan no hu atipɛnfo du du pii; network no hyia wɔ ~ simma 1 mu.
gossip.h2p2: Bootstrap list no yɛ nea wotumi sesa denam `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde adwumayɛfoɔ no Ed25519 release key de ne nsa hyɛ atipɛnfoɔ biara a wɔabɔ no dawuru ase. Atipɛnfo dawurubɔ a ɛyɛ atoro hwehwɛ sɛ wowia safe a ɛfata.
gossip.h3p2: Adanse-a-adwuma (adjustable, default 2^18 leading zeros) wɔ atipɛnfo dinkyerɛw foforo so ma Sybil-bot asorɔkye a ɛdɔɔso no kɔ so nyɛ nea mfaso wɔ so.
gossip.h3p3: Din nhyehyɛe: atipɛnfo a wɔnyɛ wɔn ade bɔne (nsaano nkyerɛwee bɔne, nsɛm a wɔde to gua a ɛnyɛ nokware, bere a wɔde twam mpɛn pii) no din pa sɛe. Zero din → blacklist.
gossip.h1_a: S 60 biara node biara paw atipɛnfo a wɔanhyɛ da na ɛde 256-bit Bloom filter a ɛbɔ atipɛnfo a wonim no mua no kɔ. Atipɛnfo de atipɛnfo foforo bua + n’ankasa filter. Bandwidth yɛ `O (atipɛnfo_foforo × 32 baiti)`.
gossip.h1_b: Nhwiren yiyi k=5 hashes, m=256 bits. Node A de ne peer_ids a wonim no nyinaa hyɛ mu. Send to peer B. B ne n’atipɛnfo no mu biara bisa filter no; biribiara a ɛyera no, B de kɔma A (ne n’ankasa filter ka ho). A yɛ nhwehwɛmu koro no ara wɔ akyi. Wɔ nsakrae no akyi no, bɛyɛ sɛ node abien no nyinaa kyɛ nimdeɛ koro. Nsesa a wɔtaa yɛ: 200-800 bytes. Updates converge wɔ network no nyinaa mu wɔ ~5 rounds (simma 5) aseda wɔ gossip agyapade no.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter nsɛmmɔnedi fi ase wɔ Cornell 1998 bimodal multicast krataa. Apache Cassandra de di dwuma de yɛ asɔremma; Bitcoin ma nkitahodi relay; IPFS ma DHT nsiesie. O(log N) convergence property no ne nea ɛma ɛyɛ nea ɛfata yiye ma yɛn dwumadie — yenhia wiase nyinaa adwene, awieeɛ koraa no-atipɛnfoɔ nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ so daa kɛkɛ. Filter size (256 bits) yɛ tuned enti atoro-positive rate yɛ < 1 % wɔ 100 atipɛnfo.
gossip.h2_a: Nodes foforo fi ase wɔ 8 hardcoded bootstrap controllers. First gossip round hu pii; converges wɔ ~simma 1 mu.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` de `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@awiei1,pubkey2@awiei2,...` mena. Sɛ wofi ase a, node sɔ emu biara hwɛ nnidiso nnidiso. Nea edi kan a wobua no de atipɛnfo din a edi kan ma (ɛnam `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` so). Node de wɔn no hyɛ ne mpɔtam hɔ atipɛnfo pon mu, hyɛ wɔn agyirae sɛ bootstrapped, na efi ase 60 s gossip loop no. Akwantu a edi hɔ no hu atipɛnfo.
gossip.h2_c: Hardcoded bootstraps yɛ nhwɛso koro no ara a Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS de di dwuma. Ɔkwan foforo — DHT-gyina hwehwɛ — hwehwɛ sɛ wodi kan hyɛn mu ɔkwan biara so. Wɔpaw Vortex's 8 bootstrap count efisɛ sɛ wowɔ > 4 a ɛma ahoɔden a ɛko tia 2-3 bere koro mu downtime events, na < 16 ma `.env` fael no kɔ so kenkan. Sesa per-deployment denam `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS` a wobɛsesa so.
gossip.h3_a: Ɛsɛ sɛ atipɛnfo biara a wɔabɔ ho dawuru no de ne mfiase adwumayɛfo Ed25519 a wɔayi no adi safe no de ne nsa hyɛ ase. ɔtowhyɛfo ntumi nsusuw atipɛnfo nkɔ network no mu.
gossip.h3_b: Sɛ node A bɔ peer P ho dawuru wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi mu kɔ node B a, A de `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, ne bere nsɔano ka ho, ne nyinaa de P ankasa release key ahyɛ ne nsa. B verifies the signature before trusting P. Sɛ akyiri yi B ne P ne P di nkitaho TLS cert + koma bɔ a edi kan no ne pubkey a wɔabɔ ho dawuru no nhyia a, wɔhyɛ dawurubɔ no agyirae sɛ awuduru wom na wɔtrɛw kɔ fam.
gossip.h3_c: Atipɛnfoɔ dawurubɔ a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ yɛ standard anti-Sybil primitive a ɛfiri Chord (2001) ne Kademlia (2002). Bitcoin addr nkrasɛm no de nhwɛsoɔ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw di dwuma (wɔn nsaano nkyerɛwee biara, ɛde ne ho to nkitahodi ho ka so sɛ Sybil deterrent); Ethereum no discv5 nsɛnkyerɛnne. Vortex gyee dawurubɔ a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase wɔ v0.0.6 mu bere a testnet ntuafo bi bɔɔ atipɛnfo atoro 1000 ho dawuru denam node biako a ɛfata so akyi.
gossip.h1_f:
afiri a wɔde yiyi mu: k=5, m=256 bits
insert (x) = ma i wɔ 0..k: filter [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
asɛmmisa (x) = ma i wɔ 0..k: hwɛ filter [hash_i (x) mod m].
atoro-a ɛyɛ papa wɔ atipɛnfo 100, bits 256, k=5: ~0.4 % .
gossip.h2_f:
.env: 1 .
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.nhwɛso,efgh...@https://b.nhwɛso

mfiase:
  ma atipɛnfo wɔ BOOTSTRAP_PEERS mu:
    bɔ mmɔden: atipɛnfo ← atipɛnfo.get ('/ v1/ ahotoso_nodes'); break
    gyese: toa so
  fi ase yɛ nsɛmmɔnedi loop
gossip.h3_f:
dawurubɔ = {pubkey, awiei, dawurubɔ_wɔ}
sig = Ed25519-Sign (pubkey_priv, CBOR (dawurubɔ))
nsɛmmɔnedi a mfaso wɔ so: [..., {ad, sig}, ...].

agyefo: hwɛ sɛ sig tia ad.pubkey → store iff ok
foforo: PoW a ɛyɛ 2^18 a edi kan zero wɔ {pubkey, endpoint} so.

stealth.title: Stealth ntam nkitahodi
stealth.subtitle: Nneɛma anum, mfiri 28. Biribiara fi TLS padding so kosi Tor onion services so.
stealth.intro: Vortex fa no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔman-man-grade ɔtamfo. Wɔde stealth stack no ayɛ layered enti sɛ mpo wɔatwa akyi layers no ho ahyia no, emu de no da so ara de degraded-but-working service ma.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — nsateaa nkyerɛwee normalisation. Gyina passive classifiers mu.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — nsusuwii / kɛse morphing. Gyina kar akwan-nhwehwɛmu classifiers.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — protocol a wɔde kata wɔn ho. Gyae active DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — nneɛma a wɔde fa nneɛma a wotumi de hyɛ mu. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ network ahorow a esiw yɛn primary no kwan mu.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — nea etwa to-resort fallback. Ayɛyɛdeɛ, BMP, multi-hop relay. Ɛyɛ adwuma bere a biribi foforo biara nyɛ adwuma.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello ne Chrome a ɛwɔ Windows 11 so no hyia baiti-ne-baiti. JA3/JA4 hash ne Chrome 120 hyia — nsateaa nkyerɛwee pɔtee biara nni hɔ.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: TLS kyerɛwtohɔ nyinaa a wɔde ahyɛ 16 KB. Packet akɛse ne browser traffic pii hyia.
stealth.h2p3: Constant-rate send: queue yi frame biako N ms biara a application dwumadi mfa ho. Idle periods ma dummy frames a wɔahyɛ no agyirae wɔ envelope a ɛwɔ mu no mu ma enti wɔn a wogye no tow gu.
stealth.h2p4: Bere jitter: 0-50 ms random delay wɔ egress so nkonimdi latency-gyina DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: packet-size nkyekyɛmu, burst cadence, ne kommyɛ gaps hyia YouTube live stream. Classifiers a wɔrehwehwɛ abɔfo koma bɔ no ntumi nhyia.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: nsuo koro no ara a ɛpaapae wɔ Wi-Fi, nkwammoaa, ne VPN biara a ɛyɛ adwuma so bere koro mu. San boaboa ano wɔ receiver no so. Di ɔkwan biako so nsusuwii so nkonim.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data channel tunnel: sɛ wɔasiw TLS nanso WebRTC yɛ adwuma a, Vortex fa DTLS-SRTP channel so kɔ atipɛnfo bi a wonim no nkyɛn.
stealth.h3p4: Decoy nkitahodi: 3 a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ TLS nhyiamu a ɛnyɛ hwee kɔ Google, YouTube, ne Cloudflare. Observer hu browser no suban a ɛfata.
stealth.h4: Level 3 — Protocol a wɔde kata wɔn ho
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS nyinaa a wɔasiesie denam DoH so akɔ Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP hu HTTPS nkutoo ma saa resolvers no, ɛnyɛ domain list ankasa.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI wɔde safoa a wɔatintim wɔ DNS HTTPS kyerɛwtohɔ no mu abɔ encrypt. Passive observers ntumi nhu destination hostname no.
stealth.h4p3: Probe detection: node di abisade ahorow a enni auth session akyi. Nhwehwɛmu abiɛsa a adi nkogu a efi IP mu wɔ simma 5 mu no kanyan "decoy site" mode — sɛ IP mprempren hu HTML landing page a ɛyɛ petee a 200 OK wom.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): deterministic domain generator a wɔde nnɛ date ahyɛ mu. Sɛ wɔsiw primary endpoint ano a, clients bu candidate a odi hɔ no ho akontaa na wɔbɔ mmɔden.
stealth.h5: Level 4 — Nneɛma a wɔde fa nsu mu a wotumi de plug
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: V2Ray-kwan so akwantuo a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn a ɛwɔ JSON config a wotumi de hyɛ mu.
stealth.h5p2: Nokwasɛm: TLS-wɔ-TLS tuntum mu. Abɔnten nsa a wɔde kyekyere wɔn ho no de wɔn ani si www.microsoft.com; nsa a wɔde bɔ mu no yɛ Vortex. Probes a ɛtia akyi no nya forwarded to Microsoft enti active probing da biribiara adi.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: atuhoamafo browser ahorow de Vortex kar akwan kɔ WebRTC so. Wɔn a wɔde Snowflake ntrɛwmu no ahyɛ mu no de kataso ma.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: sesa HTTPS probes ma ɛne Chromium ankasa suban nfra kosi microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Onion services: node biara nso da ne ho adi sɛ `.onion`. Clients a wɔwɔ Tor mmoa no hwe ase wɔ eyi mu bere a biribiara a aka no di nkogu.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): a wonnim din a wɔde sie-na-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔ-kɔma nkrasɛm. Hwɛ BMP ti.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: nkrasɛm tumi bounce fa mfinimfini nodes a ɛkɔ 5 mu, na emu biara de envelope bi ka ho. Te sɛ Tor nanso wɔ yɛn ankasa mesh mu.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): HTTP a wɔn ani da hɔ denam relay so. Ɔfã biako biara nni hɔ a ehu adesrɛ ne mmuae nyinaa.
stealth.h1_a: Wɔahyehyɛ sum ase sɛ layers anum a ɛde ne ho. Layer biara di ɔtamfo kuw soronko bi so nkonim. Failure of one layer degrades to the next — ɛnyɛ cascade.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 normalises yɛn TLS nsateaa nkyerɛwee enti passive DPI ntumi nkyekyɛ. Layer 2 morphs traffic shape ma ɛyɛ te sɛ streaming. Layer 3 camouflages protocol no denam ECH / DoH / probe-mmuae akwan horow so. Layer 4 dan kɔ pluggable transports (vmess, nokwasɛm, Snowflake) bere a wɔabara primary no denneennen. Layer 5 yɛ nea etwa to: Tor onion, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Layered model no firi Tor pluggable-transports architecture (2013) mu. Vortex de layers anum kaa ho sen Tor deɛ mmiɛnsa ɛfiri sɛ ɛduruu afe 2025 no, na adversarial landscape no ka DPI a ɛgye Tor transports ankasa tom (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Wɔde Vortex layer biara bae wɔ afuw mu asɛm bi akyi: L1 wɔ Kazakhstan siw akyi (2019-a ɛne no sɛ), L2 wɔ Iran 2022 nhyɛso akyi, L3 wɔ China 2020 DoH detection akyi, L4 wɔ Turkey siw 2023 akyi, L5 wɔ ahosiesie mu.
stealth.h1_f:
Ɔtamfo kuw | Wodii nkogu denam
------------------ | -----------
a ɛnyɛ adwuma DPI | L1 (nsateaa nkyerɛwee) .
kar akwan ho nhwehwɛmu | L2 (nsusuwii) .
active DPI | L3 (ade a wɔde kata ade so) .
a wɔde siw kwan denam IP | L4 (akwantuo) .
biribiara a aka | L5 (ayɛyɛde / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 ma Vortex traffic yɛ nea wontumi nhu nsonsonoe a ɛda Chrome ntam wɔ Windows 11 so wɔ TLS layer no so.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello nhyehyɛe, ntrɛwmu list, cipher suite list, ALPN values ​​— ne nyinaa ayɛ tuned sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛne Chrome 120 baiti pɛpɛɛpɛ hyia. JA3/JA4 hash no ne Chrome a wɔayi no adi mprempren no hyia. TLS kyerɛwtohɔ padding kɔ 16 KB. Constant-rate sender yi frame biako N ms biara a dummy fillers ka ho bere a idle. Bere jitter 0-50 ms de di latency nhwehwɛmu so nkonim. Decoy nkitahodi a ɛkɔ Google, YouTube, Cloudflare no tu mmirika wɔ akyi wɔ s 45 ntam.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 nsateaa nkyerɛwee no, Salesforce mfiridwumayɛfoɔ na wɔtintimii wɔ afe 2017. Ɛduruu afe 2019 no na ɛyɛ gyinapɛn wɔ adwumayɛ mu DPI. Vortex nsateaa nkyerɛwee normalization no yɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ uTLS, Go nwomakorabea a Snowflake de di dwuma ma atirimpɔw korɔ no ara. Wɔn a wɔde nneɛma mena bere nyinaa no yɛ WireGuard "cover traffic" nyansahyɛ no hyɛn gyinabea tẽẽ.
stealth.h2_f:
ClientHello bytes = chrome_120_nsusuwii a ɛne { .
  random = yɛn random, .
  server_name = yɛn hostname (anaasɛ ECH-a wɔabɔ no), .
  session_id = yɛn nhyiamu id, .
} .
JA4 = t13d_xxxx_xxxx_xxxx (ɛne mprempren Chrome a ɛyɛ den no hyia)
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 morphs traffic ma ɛyɛ te sɛ bulk streaming media sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ interactive chat.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: packet-size nkyekyɛmu ne 720p YouTube live stream (empirical table), burst cadence nhyiamu, kommyɛ gaps hyia. Multipath: asuten koro no ara a ntease wom a ɛpaapae wɔ Wi-Fi, cellular, ne VPN biara a ɛyɛ adwuma so bere koro mu; receiver san boaboa ano wɔ nnidiso nnidiso nɔma nhyehyɛe mu. WebRTC data channel fallback: sɛ wɔasiw TLS nanso WebRTC fa mu a, fa Vortex fa DTLS-SRTP data kwan so kɔ atipɛnfo bi a wonim no nkyɛn.
stealth.h3_c: Traffic morphing nhwehwɛmu no san kɔ Wright ne afoforo so. 2009. Obfs4 de dii dwuma sɛ ne "morph" sub-mode wɔ afe 2014. Meek+domain-fronting kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ nsusuwii no ho hia te sɛ encryption no. Wɔpaw YouTube-titiriw efisɛ ɛyɛ sait biako a ɛso sen biara a wɔansiw ano wɔ anohyeto ntam nkitahodi dodow no ara mu — sɛ wode wo ho sie wɔ YouTube-shaped traffic mu a, ɛyɛ "hitae wɔ nnipadɔm no mu".
stealth.h3_f:
packet_kɛse [me] ~ P (kɛse | YT-720p) .
send_delay [me] ~ P (akyɛde | YT-720p)
dummy_frames a wɔde ahyɛ mu bere a idle de akura envelope nsusuwii mu
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 camouflages protocol identity no ankasa — SNI, DNS, mmuae koodu ahorow.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS nyinaa fa DNS-so-HTTPS kɔ Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP hu HTTPS nkutoo ma saa asiesiefo no. ECH (RFC 9460): Wɔde safoa a wɔatintim wɔ DNS HTTPS kyerɛwtohɔ no mu na ɛbɔ SNI. Wɔn a wɔhwɛ ade a wɔnyɛ hwee no hu anim-awiei IP nkutoo. Probe detection: nodes track unauth'd IPs a ɛbɔ `/api/*`; huammɔdi abiɛsa wɔ simma 5 mu dannan IP no kɔ "decoy mode" — sɛ IP mprempren hu static HTML landing page a 200 OK. DGA: deterministic domain generator seeded ne nnɛ date sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a clients hwehwɛ fallback bere a wɔasiw primary no.
stealth.h4_c: DoH fii ase wɔ Firefox 2018 na ɛbɛyɛɛ default ma Chrome wɔ 2019. ECH faa anum drafts ansa na standardization wɔ 2024 — Vortex shipped mmoa wɔ draft-13 na seesei ɛboa spec a etwa to. Wɔfɛm probe-response decoys fi meek 2014 nhyehyɛe mu na wɔyɛɛ no ​​yiye wɔ 2023 mu bere a Iran probers a wɔyɛ nnam no huu meek denam ne mmuae bere so.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 de pluggable transports di dwuma — third-party tunnels a ɛte sɛ biribi foforo koraa.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: V2Ray-kwan so akwantuo a ɛkɔ soro a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn; nhyehyeɛ JSON. Nokwasɛm: TLS-mu-TLS tunnel a abɔnten nsa a wɔde bɔ no de wɔn ani si www.microsoft.com; nsa a wɔde bɔ mu no yɛ Vortex. Wɔde nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ nnam a ɛkɔ akyi no kɔ Microsoft, enti nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no nkyerɛ hwee. Sukyerɛmma: browser ahorow a wotu wɔn ho ma de Vortex kɔ WebRTC so; infra biara nni yɛn afã. NaiveProxy: sesa HTTPS probes ma ɛne Chromium suban pɔtee no bɛfra.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray VMess no, Chinafoɔ a wɔsɔre tia censorship na wɔde baeɛ wɔ afe 2015 mu. Trojan launched in 2019. Nokwasɛm no firi afe 2022 — mmuaeɛ a wɔde ma Great Firewall no TLS nsateaa nkyerɛwee a wɔhunu. Snowflake yɛ Tor Project 2020 a wɔde besi obfs4 ananmu; Vortex de mmoa kaa ho wɔ v0.0.9 mu wɔ Iran 2023 full-scale block of Tor entry points akyi.
stealth.h5_f:
nokwasɛm a ɛkɔ mu nhwɛso:
  ɔsomfoɔEdin: www.microsoft.com
  dest: www.microsoft.com: 443 na ɛwɔ hɔ
  Ids tiawa: ["<random>"]
client connects to yɛn IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, yɛ proxy ankasa Microsoft mmuae
sɛ ɔkwan no ne shortId+auth ⇒ kwan a ɛkɔ Vortex no hyia a.
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 ne bag a etwa to a wɔde di dwuma: onion service, BMP store-and-forward, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node biara tintim `.onion` address. Clients a wɔwɔ Tor-capable host no hwe ase bere a TLS + L1-L4 nyinaa di nkogu. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): ɔdemafo no tow blob a wɔabɔ no kokoam gu node biara a wɔde `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")` ahyɛ mu no so; nsɛmmɔnedi trɛw; nea ogye no twe fi wɔn fie node. Multi-hop: nkrasɛm bounce fa kɔ 5 mfinimfini nodes, biara de layer of envelope ka ho — te sɛ Tor nanso yɛn ankasa mesh mu. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP nam relay so enti ɔfã biako biara nhu adesrɛ ne mmuae nyinaa.
stealth.h6_c: Onion som no fi ase wɔ afe 2004 mu wɔ Tor. BMP yɛ yɛn ankasa adeyɛ, a wɔayɛ no sɛnea Tor som nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ahintaw nsɛmmɔnedi no ayɛ nhwɛso. Multi-hop relay ahwehwɛ Signal no sealed-sender ne onion routing. OHTTP yɛ deɛ ɛfiri afe 2024, Cloudflare ne Apple na wɔyɛɛ no ​​maa telemetry a ɛkora kokoamsɛm so; yɛfaa no wɔ v0.0.9 mu sɛ fallback a etwa to.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP nkrataa adaka_id = HKDF(nea ogye_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Sika a wɔde asie: POST /bmp/deposit { mailbox_id, blob } .
Pickup: GET /bmp/nkrasɛm (wɔagye atom)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max wɔ node biara mu: 500 MB .

bmp.title: Anifuraefo Nkrataa Adaka Protocol
bmp.subtitle: Anonymous store-and-forward ma nkrasɛm denam nsɛmmɔnedi afiri no so.
bmp.intro: BMP ma obi a ɔde nkra kɔma no de nkra bi sie node biara a ɔnna ne nipasu adi. Nkrasɛm no bɔ nkɔmmɔ kosi sɛ ebedu nea ogye no fie node no so, baabi a ɛdecrypt sɛnea ɛtaa ba no.
bmp.h1p1: Ɔsomafoɔ no nya `mailbox_id = HKDF(ɔgyefoɔ_pubkey, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Ɔsomafo (a onim recipient_pubkey) nkutoo na obetumi abu ho akontaa; nea ogye no nso nim.
bmp.h1p2: Ɔsomafoɔ de `POST /bmp/deposit` ne `{mailbox_id, blob}` kɔ nsɛmmɔnedifoɔ node biara so.
bmp.h1p3: Node sie pair ma ɛkɔ 7200 s. Node nso de mailbox_id no ka ho wɔ next gossip round no Bloom filter no mu.
bmp.h1p4: Node afoforo twetwe blobs ma mailbox_ids a wodwen ho wɔ mpɔtam hɔ (wɔn a wogye wɔ wɔn node so).
bmp.h1p5: Recipient no client polls `GET /bmp/messages` na ɔde ne key material a ɛtaa ba no decrypt blobs foforo biara.
bmp.h2p1: Node biara ntumi de blob bi bata nea ɔde kɔma no ho — nea ɔde kɔma no TLS nkitahodi no kyerɛ fibea IP, nanso onion hops nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn bi a ɛda nea ɔde kɔma ne BMP node a edi kan ntam no yi ɛno nso fi hɔ.
bmp.h2p2: Recipient-hiding: blob yɛ encrypted ne recipient no pubkey. Mfinimfini nodes hu opaque byte string ne random mailbox_id nkutoo.
bmp.h2p3: No delivery confirmation biara mma nea ɔde kɔmaa no. At-most-once nkyerɛaseɛ.
bmp.h3p1: Max blob kɛse: 1 MB. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyekyɛ payloads akɛse fa fael flow a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no mu.
bmp.h3p2: Max storage wɔ node biara mu: 500 MB a wɔde asie nyinaa. LRU a wɔpam obi fi hɔ wɔ cap. Operators betumi ayɛ tune.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP sika a wɔde asie no bo a wɔahyɛ no anohyeto ma 10 / min. Mailbox IDs a wɔahu bɛboro mpɛn 3 / dɔnhwerew wɔ node biako so no yɛ rate-limited sɛ nsuyiri a wosusuw sɛ ɛreba.
bmp.h4: Fa nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma
bmp.h4p1: High-censorship recipients: enhia sɛ ɔdemafo no hu nea ogye no fie node.
bmp.h4p2: Nkitahodi a ɛba bere ne bere mu: blobs twɛn kosi sɛ nea ogye no bɛsan abɔ mu na watow aba.
bmp.h4p3: Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = metadata biara nni hɔ a ɛfa nea ɔde nea ɔde too hɔ ho.
bmp.h1_a: BMP yɛ adekora-ne-anim layer a wɔmmɔ din. Sender tow blob gu node biara a nsɛmmɔnedi tumi yɛ adwuma so; blob no twɛn wɔ mailbox a wɔde keyed ahyɛ nea ogye no ɔmanfo safe nkutoo mu.
bmp.h1_b: Ɔsomafoɔ no bu akontaa `mailbox_id = HKDF(ɔgyefoɔ_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Obi a onim `recipient_pubkey` nkutoo na obetumi abu ho akontaa — nea ogye no nim, nea ɔde kɔmaa no nim, obi a ɔto so abiɛsa nnim. Ɔsomafo no POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` kɔ node biara a ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔnedifo. Node sie baanu no kosi 7200 s (2 h), na ɛde mailbox_id no to gua wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi nsakrae Bloom filter a edi hɔ no mu. Nodes afoforo a wohu sɛ mailbox_id a ɛne ɔdefo bi mailbox a wɔakora so no hyia wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no twe blob no na ɛde kɔ saa ɔdefo no akraman no nkyɛn.
bmp.h1_c: BMP no, Vortex kuw no na wɔyɛɛ no ​​fi mfiase. Yɛkyekyeree no ɛfiri sɛ na ɔbɔfoɔ titire biara nni ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛsɛe nneɛma a ɛhia de asie metadata awieeɛ kɔsi awieeɛ — adeɛ biara a ɛyɛ anibereɛ de content encryption mena nanso ɛgyaa delivery layer no bue, enti na server bi da so ara nim onii a ɔne onii ne berɛ a ɔne no kasa. Wɔ kuw no mu no yɛkɔɔ so kae sɛ "ɔbɔfo a ɔwɔ ahobammɔ a ɔtwetwe social graph no yɛ ahobammɔ fã pɛ." BMP ne yɛn mmuaeɛ: nea ɔde kɔma, nea ogye, ne emu nsɛm nyinaa bɛyɛ nea wontumi nhu; node biako biara nni mesh no mu a ɛkura asinasin a ɛdɔɔso a ɛbɛma wɔasan ayɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ bi. Ɛtu mmirika wɔ Vortex ankasa nsɛmmɔnedi ntama so sen sɛ wɔde bolted-on infrastructure, a ɛno ne nea ɛmaa aguadi ho ka yɛɛ nea ɛfata na wotumi yɛɛ adwini no ho akontaabu wɔ fie.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (ogyefo_pubkey, nsɛm = "bmp-v1", len = 32)

Sika a wɔde asie: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Fa to gua: nsɛmmɔnedi Bloom filter += mailbox_id
Pickup: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs ma ɔdefo no mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  node biara akorae cap: 500 MB |  sika a wɔde sie: 10/simma/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP ma kokoam nsɛm abiɛsa a ɛde ne ho: nea ɔde kɔma no a ɔde sie, nea ogye no a ɔde sie, emu nsɛm a ɔde sie.
bmp.h2_b: Sender-hiding: TLS nkitahodi a ɛkɔ depositing node no da fibea IP adi; sɛ wode Tor hop anaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a onion-routed bɛka BMP node a edi kan no ho a, eyi saa. Recipient-hiding: mailbox_id yɛ ɔkwan baako hash a ɛyɛ recipient_pubkey a wɔde BMP version string ahyɛ mu nkyene — mfinimfini node bi hu opaque 32-byte identifier. Content-hiding: blob yɛ E2E-encrypted dedaw ama nea ogye no de Vortex room / DM safoa a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa di dwuma, enti mfinimfini node no hu ciphertext nkutoo.
bmp.h2_c: Agyapadeɛ mmiɛnsa nhyehyeɛ no ne sɛdeɛ Pond kyerɛkyerɛɛ ne botaeɛ mu wɔ afe 2014. Vortex siesiee no denam mailbox_id a ɔmaa ɛyɛɛ collision-resistant (256-bit hash) so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa mmienu a wɔnni abusuabɔ ntumi nkyɛ mailbox wɔ akwanhyia mu. 7200-second TTL no fi hwɛ a wɔhwɛɛ sɛ 95 % a wɔgyee wɔ yɛn beta mu no twee wɔ 2 h mu; a tenten TTL inflated per-node storage a enni delivery mfaso a ɛda adi.
bmp.h2_f:
Ɔtamfo a ohu node tebea:
  - nim sɛ mailbox_id wɔ hɔ wɔ bere T mu
  - so NOT nim sender (na TLS/Tor hop away) .
  - so NOT nim ogyefo (mailbox_id ye kwan baako hash) .
  - so NOT nim emu nsɛm (blob yɛ E2E-encrypted) .
bmp.h3_a: Anohyeto a emu yɛ den wɔ blob kɛse, per-node storage, ne deposit rate ho no mma BMP nnyɛ dead-drop mma data a wɔpɛ.
bmp.h3_b: Max blob kɛse: 1 MB. Ɛsɛ sɛ payloads akɛse chunk fa fael nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no mu, a ɛwɔ n’ankasa storage kwan no. Max per-node storage: 500 MB ne nyinaa yɛ BMP sika a wɔde asie. Sɛ wɔduru cap no so a, oldest-first eviction tow blobs ansa na wɔn TTL — adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi asiesie wɔn ho denam `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Deposit rate per IP: 10 simma biara, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛko atia nsuyiri a efi ɔtowhyɛfo biako hɔ. Mailbox IDs a wɔahu bɛboro mpɛn 3/dɔnhwerew wɔ network no nyinaa so no yɛ rate-limited sɛ "sususpected flood target".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap no ne IRC DCC-send nhyiamu ne Signal sealed-sender cap hyia — kɛseɛ ma nkra ntiantiaa ne mfonini nketewa, ketewa araa ma ɔtowhfoɔ ntumi mfa BMP nni dwuma mma fael hosting. 500 MB biara-node yɛ OSS-default ntease; adwumayɛfo akɛse ma no so de `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Rate anohyeto bae wɔ v0.0.8 beta akyi a tester’s test script hyɛɛ nodes 50 ma de deposits wɔ simma 20 mu.
bmp.h3_f:
anohyeto ahorow:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # simma biara wɔ IP biara mu.
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # mailbox_id koro no ara dɔnhwerew biara
bmp.h4_a: BMP hyerɛn wɔ tebea abiɛsa mu: wɔn a wogye wɔn a wɔhwɛ so kɛse, nkitahodi a ɛba bere ne bere mu, amanneɛbɔ a wɔmmɔ wɔn din.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: sender nnim recipient no fie node (na ebia ontumi nkɔ hɔ ɔkwan biara so). Drop at any peer, ma nsɛmmɔnedi kwan. Nkitahodi a ɛba bere ne bere mu: nea ogye no nni intanɛt so nnɔnhwerew pii; blob twɛn, ɛho nhia sɛ wɔsan bɔ mmɔden bio. Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = metadata biara nni hɔ a ɛfa nea ɔde nea ɔde too hɔ ho. Sɛ wɔde dan safe a nnipa a wogye wɔn di nkutoo nim ka ho a, emu nsɛm no nso yɛ nea wontumi nhu mma obiara a ogye nsɛm no.
bmp.h4_c: Nsɛm mmiɛnsa a wɔde di dwuma no di abakɔsɛm mu nkannyan a ɛde owuo a ɛtɔ wɔ honam fam akwansrafoɔ mu (Soviet-era), ma `alt.anonymous.messages` wɔ Usenet (1990s), ne SecureDrop (2013 rekɔ) akyi. BMP ne mmɔden a yɛbɔ sɛ yɛde saa abakɔsɛm no bɛba nnɛyi ɔbɔfo mu a enhia adwinnade a ɛyɛ soronko.

push.title: Push amanneɛbɔ ahorow
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — ne nyinaa wɔ envelopes a wɔatoto mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔde ma no ntumi nkenkan.
push.intro: Standard push services (APNs, FCM, Web Push) hu payload biara. Vortex kyekyere amanneɛbɔ biara wɔ E2E layer a ɛyɛ soronko mu ma enti ɔdemafoɔ no hunu opaque blob a enni dan id, sender, anaa text nko ara.
push.h1p1: Client nya platform token (APNs device token, FCM registration id, anaa Web Push nkrataahyɛ JWT).
push.h1p2: Client no yɛ 32-byte X25519 key `p256dh_pub` foforo ne 16-byte `auth` ahintasɛm. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ne `{awiei, p256dh, auth, platform}`.
push.h1p3: Node kɔ so tra hɔ `push_subscriptions (ɔdefo_id, awiei, p256dh, auth, platform, abɔ_wɔ)`.
push.h2p1: Sɛ amanneɛbɔ bi du (nkra foforo wɔ dan a wɔayɛ no mum mu a wɔahyɛ sɛ ɛbɛbɔ amanneɛ, aka ho asɛm, frɛ nsato), node de AES-GCM de safoa a wonya fi `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` via HKDF de sie payload no.
push.h2p2: Node packages `{endpoint, TTL, ntɛmpɛ, asɛmti: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` na ɛde kɔ APNs / FCM / Web Push server.
push.h2p3: Ɔdemafo no hu `data` (ciphertext) + `asɛmti` nkutoo. Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no pefee biara nni hɔ a ɛretu.
push.h3p1: Pia biara asɛmti titiriw: `dan:<id>`. Nkrasɛm pii a ɛwɔ dan koro mu no hwe ase kɔ amanneɛbɔ biako mu wɔ OS gyinabea.
push.h3p2: Ɔfrɛ biara asɛmti: `frɛ:<id>`. Mmuae anaa pow a wɔpow no twe frankaa no; ɔfrɛ foforo a wɔto nsa frɛ nkurɔfo kɔ dan koro no ara mu si dedaw no ananmu.
push.h4: Decryption wɔ gye a wogye so
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension decrypts wɔ NSE nhyehyɛe no mu (ɛtew ne ho fi app titiriw no ho). Ɔde CryptoKit primitives koro no ara di dwuma.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService decrypt wɔ akyi dwumadie bi mu. JobScheduler yɛ nhyehyɛe ankasa UI update bere a app no ​​wɔ foregrounded.
push.h4p3: Wɛb: Ɔsom Adwumayɛfoɔ decrypt wɔ SW nsɛm mu, de mpɔtam hɔ amanneɛbɔ bi fa Wɛb Amanneɛbɔ API so to gua.
push.h5: Quirks a ɛfa ɔdemafo pɔtee bi ho
push.h5p1: APNs: hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ provider token no foforo simma 60 biara. Token refresh no nam Apple `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 key fael so na ɛyɛ adwuma.
push.h5p2: FCM: agyapade HTTP awiei a wɔapow; yɛde HTTP v1 awiei a ɛwɔ OAuth2 ɔsom akontaabu adansedi nkrataa di dwuma. Nkyinkyin 1 h biara.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID safoa (safoa biako wɔ node biara mu). TTL capped wɔ nnafua 28 denam browser dodow no ara so.
push.h1_a: Client kyerɛw device token (APNs/FCM/Web Push) bom ne X25519 ɔmanfo safoa foforo ne 16-byte auth ahintasɛm.
push.h1_b: Client no yɛ `p256dh_priv = rand (32)` ne `auth = rand (16)`. Ɛnya `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ne `{awiei, p256dh, auth, platform, ɔdefo_ananmusifo}`. Node kɔ so tra hɔ `push_subscriptions (ɔdefo_id, awiei, p256dh, auth, platform, abɔ_wɔ, nea etwa to_refreshed_at)`. Rotation: client no san kyerɛw ne din wɔ app biara a wɔde fi ase no so, a ɛma `last_refreshed_at` yɛ foforo. Wɔpopa nkrataa a wɔkra a adi boro nnafua 30 no.
push.h1_c: p256dh + auth fields no firi Web Push RFC 8291 (2017) no mu. Yɛsan de dii dwuma maa APNs ne FCM ɛwom mpo sɛ saa dwumadie no nhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde sealed format no — saa a yɛyɛ no ma code kwan baako kɔ so wɔ mmiɛnsa no nyinaa so. Ansa na v0.0.5 Vortex resoma plaintext payloads denam push services no so; akyi Apple 2022 push privacy update ne asɛm a ɛyɛ soronko a FCM adwuma bi a wɔanhyehyɛ no yiye no leaked notifications, yɛde biribiara kɔɔ envelopes a wɔatoto mu.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32) na ɛyɛ adwuma.
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 .
auth = rand (16) a ɛyɛ nokware.

POST /api/pia/kyerɛw wo din
  { awiei, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), asɛnka agua }
push.h2_a: Sɛ amanneɛbɔ bi du a, node no de encrypt payload no ma enti nea ogye no mfiri nkutoo na ebetumi akenkan. Push service (Apple / Google / Mozilla) no hu blob a ɛnyɛ hann nkutoo.
push.h2_b: Node paw bere tiaa mu X25519 keypair. Nya `ikm = ECDH(bere tiaa mu_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Mmirikatu HKDF(nkyene=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → safoa. Encrypts `{asɛmti, nipadua, dan_id, nkra_id}` sɛ CBOR → AES-GCM ne safoa a wonya fii mu + random 96-bit nonce. Ɔsoma `{awiei, TTL, ntɛmpɛ, asɛmti: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {nkyene, pub_ephemeral}}` kɔ APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Device gye, ntrɛwmu / ɔsom adwumayɛfo runs saa key derivation koro no ara wɔ reverse, decrypts, kyerɛ amanneɛbɔ.
push.h2_c: Sealed push yɛ tẽẽ Web Push Message Encryption spec a efi 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple 2022 iOS 16 update no de mmoa a edi kan kaa ho ma amanneɛbɔ som ntrɛwmu a ɛyɛ decryption no; Android nam FCM data nkra so aboa no mfeɛ pii. Vortex yɛ abɔfoɔ kakraa bi a wɔde nsuo a ɛsen no nyinaa di dwuma wɔ koodu mmiɛnsa no nyinaa so no mu baako — iOS de `NotificationServiceExtension` di dwuma, Android de `FirebaseMessagingService` di dwuma, Wɛb de ɔsom adwumayɛfoɔ no di dwuma.
push.h2_f:
bere tiaa mu_priv = rand (32);  bere tiaa mu_pub = bere tiaa mu_priv · G
ikm = ECDH (bere tiaa mu_priv, p256dh_pub) .
prk = HMAC-SHA256(ɔkyerɛwfo, ikm) .
key = HKDF-Trɛw (prk, "Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu-nkode: aes128gcm \ x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Trɛw (prk, "Nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu-Encoding: nonce \ x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (safoa, nonce, adesoa a mfaso wɔ so)
send { endpoint, data: nkyene∥kyerɛwtohɔ_kɛse∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Collapse keys siw notifications pii a efi chat koro no ara mu no kwan sɛ ɛbɛhyehyɛ sɛnea banners ankorankoro — OS no ka bom yɛ biako.
push.h3_b: Pia biara mu a ɛhwe ase: asɛmti = `dan:<id>`. APNs `apns-collapse-id` ne FCM `collapse_key` ka kyerɛ OS sɛ wɔmfa asɛmti koro no ara nsi amanneɛbɔ a wɔadi kan de ama no ananmu. Ɔdefo no hu frankaa biako wɔ dan biara mu ɛmfa ho sɛ nkrasɛm dodow ahe na ɛbɛba. Per-frɛ a ɛhwe ase: asɛmti = `frɛ:<id>`; ɔfrɛ foforo a wɔto nsa frɛ nkurɔfo kɔ dan koro no ara mu no si nea atwam no ananmu. Per-mention: topic = `ka:<ɔdefo>:<dan>`; biako ka banner biara user-room pair.
push.h3_c: Wɔde collapse keys kaa APNs ho wɔ iOS 10 (2016) ne FCM wɔ 2014. Ansa na ɛno reba no, multi-message bursts maa multi-banner stacks a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tan no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Telegram na ɔyɛɛ akwampaefoɔ wɔ dan biara a ɛbubuu UX wɔ afe 2015 mu; ɔbɔfo titiriw biara dii n’akyi. Vortex's mpaapaemu wɔ dan / frɛ / mention collapse fi user feedback wɔ v0.0.6 beta sɛ "frɛ to nsa frɛ sesa chat banner" tee nka sɛ ɛnteɛ — nsɛmti ahorow siesiee no.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = dan:42 → ɛsesa frankaa a atwam
FCM: collapse_key = frɛ:17 → ɛsesa frankaa a atwam
Wɛb: asɛmti = mention:u12:r5 → ɛsesa frankaa a atwam
push.h4_a: Asɛnka agua biara wɔ n’ankasa gotchas. iOS hia Notification Service Ntrɛwmu no; Android hia FCM data nkrasɛm; Web hia ɔsom adwumayɛfo + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: app bundle no de `NotificationServiceExtension` botaeɛ mena. System de encrypted payload no kɔ NSE no so; NSE wɔ s 30 CPU + 25 MB memory a ɛbɛtumi decrypt na ayɛ mutate amanneɛbɔ no ansa na wɔakyerɛ. FCM: yɛde `data` nkrasɛm mena (ɛnyɛ `notification`) enti app no ​​FirebaseMessagingService no yɛ adwuma bere a yɛadu hɔ — ɛno ma yɛn tumi wɔ sɛ yɛbɛkyerɛ banner anaa. Web Push: ɔsom adwumayɛfo twa `push` nsɛm a esisi, decrypt, kyerɛ denam `self.registration.showNotification` so.
push.h4_c: NSE nhyehyeɛ no, Apple na ɔde baeɛ wɔ iOS 10 (2016) mu titire maa nkra-decryption dwumadie nsɛm. Ansa na ɛno reba no, na ɛsɛ sɛ abɔfo a wɔabɔ wɔn kokoam fi awiei kosi awiei no paw plaintext push payloads (privacy-hostile) ne badge-only pushes (UX-hostile). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram nyinaa huruw kɔɔ NSEs wɔ afe biako mu. Vortex di nhyehyeɛ korɔ no ara akyi.
push.h5_a: Provider-specific quirks — fã bi a ɛwɔ push ti no mu. Eyi yɛ akwan titiriw a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ Vortex nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nyinaa mu no mu biako. Kenkan ti a atwa ho ahyia no ma nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛtrɛw; ɔfa yi ma suban pɔtee no yɛ kɛse.
push.h5_b: Dwumadie ho nsusuiɛ ma "Provider-specific quirks". Wɔde adwinnade no di dwuma wɔ module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, anaa `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/` ase. Module README no frɛ fael akwan pɔtee.
push.h5_c: "Provider-specific quirks" adwinnade no danee wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi no nyinaa mu. Nsusuwii no fi nhwehwɛmu a wɔatintim ne nneyɛe a abɔfo a wɔadi kan ayɛ no so. Version abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ `CHANGELOG.md` mu no kyerɛw bere a afã biara sii fam ne nea ɛkanyan no.

controller.title: Controller som adwuma
controller.subtitle: Nokwaredi adanse, hyɛn a wohu, akwahosan sohwɛ.
controller.intro: Controller no yɛ Python adeyɛ a ɛyɛ soronko. Ne ntua no ani yɛ ketewaa bi (bɛyɛ akwan dumien) na wɔde ne ahotoso no abɔ Ed25519 ɔmanfo safe biako a wɔatow akɔ atɔfo mu.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — adansedie aba. Schema: `{gyinabea, signed_by, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, a ɛne no hyia, enhyia, ɛyera, ɛka ho, nkra}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/akwahosan` — nkwagye. Schema: `{gyinabea: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{intanɛt so, wɔapene so, ne nyinaa}}`.
controller.h1p3: `GET /v1/entries` — nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu URL ahorow. Nhyehyɛe: `[{protocol: "wss"|"https", url}...]`.
controller.h1p5: `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` — atipɛnfo a wonim wɔn a wɔaka abom.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/koma bɔ/{pubkey}` — node nkwagye nhwehwɛmu. Wɔde di dwuma denam federated nodes so de ma wɔn dinkyerɛw kɔ so yɛ foforo.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node foforo bi di dwuma ma ahotoso. Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ admin pene gye sɛ `AUTO_APPROVE=nokware`.
controller.h2p1: Fael a ɛda adi: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Ɛwɔ fael biara BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 nsaano nkyerɛwee.
controller.h2p2: Awo ntoatoaso: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_adwinnade`. Kenkan release key no fi `keys/release.key`, nantew dua, kyerɛw manifest.
controller.h2p3: Verification: controller kenkan manifest no wɔ startup na ɛde toto disk ho. Startup di nkogu denneennen wɔ mismatch so.
controller.h3p1: Mirrors de controller code koro no ara di dwuma a release key koro no ara a wɔayɛ no kɔpi wɔ so. Clients hu `signed_by` a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ ahwehwɛ ahorow so — ɔkwan biako a wobɛfa so ahu ahwehwɛ a ɛnyɛ nokware ne sɛ wode pubkeys bɛtoto ho.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS tintim nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ ahwehwɛ pii no mu biako. Clients bɔ mmɔden wɔ priority order mu ne timeouts.
controller.h3p3: `vortex.sol-mirror/` kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛwɔ saa repo yi mu no yɛ trycloudflare ahwehwɛ a wɔasiesie ama nkɔso.
controller.h1_a: Controller's public API surface yɛ bɛyɛ akwan dumien. Ne nyinaa nketewa, ne nyinaa twe adwene si adansedi ne entry-URL discovery so.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — adansedie a ɛda adi a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ. `/v1/akwahosan` — nkwa + pubkey + akontaabu. `/v1/entries` — URL ahorow a wɔde hyɛ mu ma nkitahodi. `/v1/mirrors` — ahwehwɛ sohwɛfo. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — fekuw no atipɛnfo. `/v1/koma bɔ/{pubkey}` — node nkwagye nhwehwɛmu. `/v1/register` — node foforo di dwuma ma ahotoso (admin pene gye sɛ `AUTO_APPROVE=nokware`). Ɛno ne no — wɔahyɛ da ayɛ teateaa na ama ntua no ani ayɛ ketewaa bi.
controller.h1_c: Wɔnam hwɛ a wɔahu sɛ adansedi nhyehyɛe no bɛyɛ botae a ɛsom bo sen biara bere a afɛfo de wɔn adwene asi so no so na ɛma wohu sɛnea wɔayɛ no teateaa no. Kood nketewa = ɔfasu ketewaa bi. Fa toto node a ɛwɔ akwan 120+ no ho; controller no wɔ 12. Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛte saa ara: Debian apt-get de ne ho to `Release.gpg` dwumadie ketewa bi a ɛsono ne ho wɔ package hosting no ho.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` nantew fibea dua no, hash fael biara, de ne nsa hyɛ ase denam release safoa no so, kyerɛw `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Adwinnade kenkan `safoa/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 kokoam safoa). Nantew `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (ɛnyɛ fael ahorow a wɔabu ani agu so). Fael biara ho: `blake3(nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu) → hash`. Builds manifest `{version, built_at, fael ahorow: [{ɔkwan, sha256, kɛse}]}`. Bu akontaa `canonical_bytes = CBOR(ada adi)`. Nsɛnkyerɛnne: `sig = Ed25519-Sign (yi_safoa, canonical_bytes)`. Ɔkyerɛw `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {ada no adi, wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Manifests a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ no san kɔ Debian's Release.gpg (1997) ne PGP-a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ Linux kernel tarballs. Sigstore (2021) siesiee nhwɛsoɔ no maa supply-chain adansedie. Vortex no version no yɛ hare kɛse efisɛ ɛdi deployment biako ho adanse, ɛnyɛ multi-party release chain. Ebia yɛbɛfa Sigstore wɔ v0.4 mu ama baguam a wɔayi no adi.
controller.h3_a: Mirrors de controller code koro no ara a release key koro no ara na ɛyɛ adwuma. DNS / SNS / IPFS nsɛm pii a wɔakyerɛw no twe adwene si ahwehwɛ pii no mu biako so.
controller.h3_b: Adwumayɛfo hyehyɛ ahwehwɛ N (mpɛn pii no 3-5). Wɔn mu biara de `vortex_controller` koodu koro no ara a `keys/release.key` koro no ara na ɛyɛ adwuma. Clients hu `signed_by` a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ ahwehwɛ so — sanity check pa. DNS/SNS/IPFS kyerɛwtohɔ kyerɛw ahwehwɛ a nneɛma a ɛho hia titiriw wom. Atɔfoɔ bɔ mmɔden wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde di kan, a sikani 7 na ɛtwa mu wɔ mmɔden biara mu. `vortex.sol-mirror/` daerekta a ɛwɔ saa repo yi mu no yɛ trycloudflare ahwehwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a wɔadi kan ahyɛ mu.
controller.h3_c: Ahwehwɛ pii a ɛwɔ priority lookup yɛ nhwɛsoɔ korɔ no ara a SMTP de di dwuma ma MX kyerɛwtohɔ ne HTTPS de di dwuma ma SRV kyerɛwtohɔ. Tor's directory atumfoɔ yɛ model a ɛfa ho — 9 hardcoded DAs + votes. Vortex paw "paw ahwehwɛ a ɛyɛ adwuma" sen "quorum vote" efisɛ abatow so nhyehyɛe ahorow no tumi gyina ano nanso ɛyɛ brɛoo kɛse sɛ wɔbɛbɔ bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/integrity : GET → adansedie aba
/v1/akwahosan : GET → {gyinabea, nkyerɛase, pubkey, akontaabu}
/v1/nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/ahwehwɛ : GET → [ahyɛfo_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{pubkey, awiei, akwahosan}, ...]
/v1/koma bɔ/{pk} : POST (efi node ahorow a wɔakyerɛw din nkutoo mu)
/v1/register : POST (ma node foforo) .
controller.h2_f:
adwinnade = sɛnkyerɛnne_adwinnade
input = fibea dua, nsafe/release.key
manifest = { .
  nkyerɛase: "0.1.0",
  wɔasi_wɔ: unix_ms, .
  fael ahorow: [{ɔkwan, sha256, kɛse}, ...]
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign (yi_priv, CBOR (ada no adi))
output = INTEGRITY.sig.json = {ada no adi, wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase: pub_hex, sig: sig_hex}

DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: nkitahodi =/ipfs/<CID>

storage.title: Nneɛma a wɔkora so layer
storage.subtitle: SQLite ma dev, Postgres ma prod, Alembic ma atutra, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB wɔ akraman so.
storage.intro: Vortex node akoraeɛ no yɛ SQL. SQLite (dev) ne Postgres (prod) ntam nsakraeɛ yɛ DATABASE_URL nsakraeɛ — koodu fork biara nni hɔ.

storage.h2: Nnipa a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo
storage.h2p1: Alembic wɔ `alembic/nkyerɛase ahorow/` mu. Linear abakɔsɛm, nsakraeɛ baako wɔ release biara mu (ɛtɔ da bi a kakraa bi wɔ release biara mu).
storage.h2p2: Dev mode: `bɔ_ne nyinaa + ALTER TABLE fallback` ma iteration ntɛmntɛm.
storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `alembic upgrade ti` ansa na woafi ase. Docker mfonini no de di dwuma wɔ entrypoint no mu.
storage.h3: Index ahorow a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — mfitiaseɛ index ma nkratafa a wɔde bɛfa.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — ma bere a egyina nhyehyɛe so wɔ nsakrae so.
storage.h3p3: `reactions(message_id)` — ma aggregation wɔ dan a wɔabue so.
storage.h3p5: `user_devices(user_id)` — de kyerɛ mfiri a ɛyɛ adwuma.
storage.h3p6: FTS virtual tables (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) ma nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw nyinaa hwehwɛ.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` ma bere a wɔakyerɛw so akorae. Encrypted wɔ ahomegye mu ne operator safoa.
storage.h4p2: Nneɛma a wɔde sie: da biara da nnafua 14, dapɛn biara adapɛn 4, ɔsram biara asram 12.
storage.h4p3: Sanba: `yɛ db-san FILE=<ɔkwan>`. Otu mmirika wɔ staging DB so kan; operator verifies afei swaps.
storage.h1_a: Node akoraeɛ yɛ SQL. SQLite ma dev ne nketewa ankasa-hosted; PostgreSQL ma federated anaa multi-node adwumayɛ. SQLAlchemy 2.x async koodu koro no ara na ɛma abien no nyinaa kɔ.
storage.h1_b: Hyehyɛ denam `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` anaa `postgresql+asyncpg://ɔdefo:pw@host/db` so. Single config, code fork biara nni hɔ. SQLite no tu mmirika wɔ nhyehyɛe mu; Postgres tu mmirika wɔ ɔkwan soronko so. Adwumayɛ: SQLite di ~50 a wɔde di dwuma bere koro mu ho dwuma yiye wɔ M1 so; Postgres nsenia kɔ mpempem pii. Migration Postgres → SQLite yɛ ɔkwan biako so denam `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite import; ɔkwan foforo no nso yɛ saa ara.
storage.h1_c: "Baako ORM, abien akyi akyi" nhyehyɛe no yɛ mfe du SQLAlchemy adeyɛ. Vortex de async 2.x API di dwuma enti asɛmmisa biara twɛn. Yɛpaw SQLAlchemy Core sen Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` maa atutra ho asɛm a ɛyɛ adefo ne nea ɛne FastAPI async kasakoa no hyia.
storage.h2_a: 18 core tables: users, user_devices, dan, room_members, nkrasɛm, nneyɛe, fael, akenkan_gye, baabi a wɔwɔ, federations, federation_outbox, scheduled_messages, nkitahodi, saved_gifs, folda, bot_installations, nhyiam, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Users table ne identity root no. room_members kura (dan, ɔdefo, dwumadie, joined_at, muted_until). nkrasɛm no kura ciphertext + metadata; indexed wɔ (room_id, id) ma paginated fetch. reactions yɛ compound-primary-key pon. Biribiara a aka no yɛ tẽẽ. Storage nyin linearly ne nkra dodow — bɛyɛ 1 KB nkra biara wɔ disk so wɔ index overhead akyi.
storage.h2_c: Na schema no gyina hɔ pintinn wɔ v0.0.4 akyi. Kan no na yɛwɔ `dm_messages` ne `group_messages` pon ahorow a ɛsono emu biara; wɔaka abom wɔ v0.0.3 mu bere a fanout koodu no ayɛ abien wɔ abien no nyinaa so akyi. Tables 18 no yɛ nea esua koraa ma feature-complete messenger; deployments akɛseɛ de analytics tables ka ho nanso ɛnonom ho nhia mma adwumayɛ.
storage.h3_a: Alembic na ɔhwɛ atutra ahorow so. Linear revision abakɔsɛm, nsakrae biako wɔ nea wɔayi no adi biara mu. Nsakraeɛ biara wɔ `upgrade()` ne `downgrade()` dwumadie nyinaa.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` kura nsakraeɛ. Biara yɛ Python fael a ɛwɔ upgrade/downgrade. CI tu mmirika `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` de hwɛ sɛ akwantuo a ɛkɔ ne baabiara no yɛ nokware. Production: `ma db-migrate` yɛ adwuma wɔ Docker entrypoint no mu ansa na app afi ase. Dev mode de `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` di dwuma enti iteration yɛ ntɛmntɛm a enhia sɛ wotu kɔ baabi foforo wɔ rebase biara so.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) yɛ canonical SQLAlchemy atutena adwinnadeɛ. Linear abakɔsɛm (ɛnyɛ branching) yɛ paw — ɛkwati "developers baanu bɔ revision number koro" haw no. Django atutra ahorow no de ɔkwan koro no ara na edi dwuma. Rails fii linear kɔɔ timestamped wɔ afe 2014 mu nanso wɔsan gyee linear-with-merge wɔ afe 2020 mu.
storage.h4_a: Wɔde ahwɛyiye paw key indexes enti hot reads (nkrasɛm, reactions, akenkan receipts) ntaa nkɔ disk so.
storage.h4_b: `nkrasɛm (dan_id, id DESC)` — nkratafa nkyerɛwde titiriw. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — bere a wɔahyehyɛ no fallback ma nsakrae. `reactions(message_id)` — aboaboa ano wɔ dan a wɔabue so. `read_receipts (room_id, message_id)` — "wɔahu wɔ N" kan. `ɔdefoɔ_mfiri (ɔdefoɔ_id)` — mfiri din. FTS virtual tables a wɔde hwehwɛ (FTS5 wɔ SQLite so, tsvector wɔ Postgres so).
storage.h4_c: Index a wɔpaw no fi explain-plan-profiling mu wɔ v0.0.4 adesoa sɔhwɛ mu. Yɛde naive indexes na efii ase na yɛde kaa ho/yi fii hɔ a egyina asɛmmisa nhyehyɛe a yɛahu so. `messages(room_id, id DESC)` no yɛ index biako a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara — bɛyɛ 80 % akenkan no bɔ no. Sɛ woma ɛyɛ teateaa (no include columns) a, ɛma ɛfata wɔ memory mu.

bots.title: Bot nhyehyɛe
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + gua so + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dan mu a wodi kan. Wɔde bot bi Ed25519 safoa na ɛhyɛ nkra ase enti wotumi hu atoro.
bots.h1p1: Nneɛma mmienu a wobɛtumi apaw: Python SDK anaa Gravitix DSL. Python yɛ adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den; Gravitix ma event-driven chat bots a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde mena ntɛmntɛm.
bots.h1p2:
Python nhwɛsoɔ: `efi vortex_bot mu ba Bot
bot = Bot (token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo (msg): twɛn bot.send (msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run ()`. SDK no di WebSocket, reconnection, encryption key exchange ho dwuma.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix nhwɛso: `on /start { emit "Hello, {ctx.din_a edi kan}!" }` na ɛyɛ. Ɛboaboa ano kɔ bytecode mu na ɛkɔ so wɔ sandboxed interpreter mu.
bots.h1p4: Bot token no yɛ nea wɔde ma wɔ bot adebɔ mu. Token a ayera? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` de foforo ma.
bots.h2p1: Deployment models mmienu: in-process (coroutine wɔ node no mu) ne abɔnten (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: In-process: zero network hop, ntɛmntɛm sen biara, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ operator gye bot code di. Good ma ankasa bots.
bots.h2p3: Abɔnten so: webhook anaasɛ long-poll. Node-level ahotoso biara ho nhia. Good ma bots a ɛto so abiɛsa ne gua so.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots bere nyinaa tu mmirika in-process wɔ sandbox — wonni faelsystem anaa network kwan biara gye API a ɛda adi pefee.
bots.h3p1: Ɔmanfo bot ahorow betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ gua so. Reviewers verify code no nnyɛ phish, ɛnyɛ spam, ɛnyɛ leak user data.
bots.h3p2: Categories: aba, agodie, amanneɛbɔ, mfasoɔ, ai, nkyerɛaseɛ.
bots.h3p3: Install: klike biako. Node subscribes user to bot no username enti DMs kwan yie.
bots.h3p4: Sika a wonya: kwa, adetɔ pɛnkoro, nkrataahyɛ. Platform fee 10 %% wɔ sika nyinaa mu.
bots.h4: Antispam bot a wɔde di dwuma
bots.h4p1: Wɔde antispam bot a aniwa nhu na ɛhwɛ dan biara so. Nhwehwɛmu: link density > 3 simma biara, nkyerɛwde akɛse ratio > 70 %% ma 10+ chars, nkrasɛm a wɔsan de kɔ, mpofirim a ɛpae a ɛyɛ foforo-account joiners.
bots.h4p2: Nneyɛe: kɔkɔbɔ → bere a wɔde twam (simma 5) → bɔ akuturuku → bara. Appeals kɔ room admin nkyɛn.
bots.h4p3: Tuneable wɔ dan biara mu denam bot config so.
bots.h1_a: Bots yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ dan mu a wodi kan. Wɔn mu biara wɔ Ed25519 safe ne token; wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ nkra biara a wɔde bɛmena ase, enti wotumi hu atoro.
bots.h1_b: Bɔ: owura POSTs `/api/bots` ne `{ɔdefo din, ɔyɛkyerɛ_din, koodu}`. Node yɛ `users` row a `is_bot=true`, yɛ Ed25519 keypair, san de private-key bot token no kɔma owura no (wɔakyerɛ pɛnkoro). Run: bot te ase wɔ-adwuma mu sɛ coroutine anaasɛ abɔnten polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates` ne ne token. Nkrasɛm a efi bots mu no kura `from_bot: true` frankaa na wɔde bot no kokoam safoa na ɛhyɛ ase.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs no, Slack (2014) na ɔyɛɛ akwampaefoɔ na Telegram (2015) na ɔyɛɛ no ​​yie. Vortex's twist: bot signatures kyekyere nkrasɛm kɔ bot identity no so, enti node a wɔagyae mu no antumi anhyehyɛ "@bot said X". Matrix bot mmoa de saa agyapadeɛ yi kaa ho wɔ afe 2021 mu denam federated signatures so; Vortex wɔ no fi v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix yɛ domain-specific kasa a wɔde kyerɛw event-driven bots. Nketewa, ɛda nsɛm adi, a wɔaboaboa ano akɔ sandboxed bytecode mu.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `on /start { emit "Hello, {ctx.edin_a edi kan}!" }` na ɛyɛ. Handlers kyekyere triggers (ahyɛde, regex, adeyɛ). Nipadua yɛ `emit`, `let`, `sɛ`, `nhyehyɛe`, ne nea ɛkeka ho a ɛtoatoa so Compiler emits bytecode; runtime kyerɛ ase wɔ sandbox a enni filesystem, enni network a wɔpɛ, Vortex's API nkutoo. Nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ wɔ Gravitix docs ti no mu.
bots.h2_c: Wɔyɛɛ Gravitix wɔ v0.0.6 bere mu akyi a wɔhwɛɛ sɛ bot code dodow no ara yɛ 80 % boilerplate de wire Vortex SDK no, a kernel a ɛyɛ nokware ntease wɔ mfinimfini. A DSL ma nteaseɛ no hyerɛn na esiw shoveling arbitrary Python kɔ bot-dev tebea a ɛda adi sɛ sandbox guankɔbea.
bots.h3_a: Pia biara wɔ antispam bot a aniwa nhu a ɛhwɛ nsuyiri, link spam, nkrasɛm a wɔsan de ba, ne account foforo join bursts.
bots.h3_b: Mmara: link density > 3 simma biara fi obiako a ɔde di dwuma, ALL-CAPS ratio > 70 % wɔ nkrasɛm ≥ 10 chars, nkra a wɔsan yɛ > mpɛn 3 wɔ s 30 mu, burst of joiners a akontaabu mfe < 24 h > 20 wɔ 60 s mu. Nneyɛe no mu yɛ den: kɔkɔbɔ → simma 5 bere a wɔde twam → dɔnhwerew 1 a wɔbɔ → bara (admin pene sɛ wɔbara). Tuneable wɔ dan biara mu denam `/antispam config` so.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics fi IRC-era bot mmara (Eggdrop, BitchX) ne nnɛyi nhyehyɛe te sɛ Discord AutoMod a wɔaka abom. Wɔde thresholds pɔtee a ɛwɔ Vortex no yɛɛ tuned tiaa asram 6 beta corpus a nkrasɛm 200k wom; atoro-a ɛyɛ papa dodow yɛ ~0.3 % wɔ ban-asɛm a wɔde kɔdan asɛnnibea dodow a wɔahu no mu.
bots.h4_a: Ɔmanfo bot ahorow de wɔn ho hyɛ gua so. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ di adanseɛ sɛ phishing biara nni hɔ / spam biara nni hɔ / data biara nni hɔ a ɛretu. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no hwehwɛ nneɛma mu sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ no na wɔde klike biako na wɔde hyɛ mu.
bots.h4_b: Submission: owura no de bot fibea + nkyerɛkyerɛmu to gua. Reviewer de koodu no di dwuma wɔ sandbox mu, kenkan no ma anti-patterns a wonim, hwɛ network frɛ biara a ɛfa API ahorow a wɔama ho kwan so, hwɛ sɛ kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe yɛ nokware. Listing: ɔfa, bo, rating, install dodow. Install: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node yɛ obiara a ɔde di dwuma no nkrataahyɛ. Sika a wonya: kwa / pɛnkoro / nkrataahyɛ; platform gye 10 %.
bots.h4_c: App gua ahorow san kɔ 2008 App Store. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex 10 % a wɔatwa no sua sen Apple 30 % na ɛba fam kakra sen Shopify 20 %, a wɔpaw sɛ ɛbɛkanyan wɔn a wɔyɛ no ma wɔatintim. Wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no nhwɛso wɔ GitLab "nhwehwɛmu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, yi list wɔ anwiinwii so".

ops.title: Adwumayɛ ahorow
ops.subtitle: Deploy, hwɛ, rollback kɔ akyi.
ops.intro: Dwumadie adwuma biara wɔ `make` botaeɛ anaa CLI ahyɛdeɛ. Ops nkratafa no te `deploy/` mu.
ops.h1p1: `docker hyehyɛ kɔ soro` de node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy ba.
ops.h1p2: Volumes: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/ade a wɔde gu so`, `/data/logs`. Mount to host ma nsiyɛ.
ops.h1p3: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia: `.env` wɔ repo ntini mu. Mfa wo ho nhyɛ wo ho da. `.env.example` ne nsusuwso no.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-fa Let's Encrypt adansedi nkrataa. Let's Encrypt rate anohyeto ahorow di dwuma — fa staging di dwuma ma sɔhwɛ ahorow.
ops.h2p1: `yɛ instɔl` — instɔl Python deps + dev nnwinnade.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn a ɛwɔ reload wɔ hyɛn gyinabea 9000 so.
ops.h2p4: `yɛ lint` — ruff + mypy. CI siw ano wɔ huammɔdi ahorow so.
ops.h2p5: `yɛ docker-build` — si mfonini a wɔakyerɛw so sɛ `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `ma ci` — tu mmirika CI nsuo afiri no nyinaa wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` yɛ PyInstaller bundle a ɛwɔ pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Flow a edi kan: paw node din → yɛ release keys → hyehyɛ TLS (Let's Encrypt / fa-wo-ankasa / wo ankasa de wo nsa hyɛ ase) → paw entry URLs → ma stealth nyɛ adwuma → bue firewall ports.
ops.h3p3: Sɛ wosiesie wie a, wizard tra hɔ sɛ admin console: start/stop node, hwɛ logs, dannan keys, fa federated peers ka ho.
ops.h4p1: Biribiara a wɔayi no adi a wɔde tagged wɔ git mu. Tag nso signed ne release key enti tag no ankasa yɛ verifiable.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && yɛ docker-kyekye && docker hyehyɛ kɔ soro -d`. Running nodes drain na ɛsan fi ase.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` a wɔboa ma nkyerɛase ketewa biako akyi. Sɛ yɛbɛkɔ akyi a, ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nsa de wɔn ho gye mu.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` de Vortex stack a edi mũ no ba: node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` wɔ repo ntini so. Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` a wɔde ahyɛ host so ma enti data kɔ so wɔ restarts nyinaa so. Healthchecks: node healthy iff `/akwahosan/asiesie` san ba 200; controller iff `/v1/integrity` san ba a wɔagye atom. Caddy auto-fa Let's Encrypt adansedi nkrataa. `.env` de ahintasɛm ma (nnyɛ wo ho da). `.env.example` ne nsusuwso no.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose yɛ de-facto nhwɛsoɔ ma multi-container self-hosted services. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux nyinaa de di dwuma. Wɔsan yɛɛ Vortex no compose fael no bio fi v0.0.2 rekɔ; mprempren nsusuwii no gyinaa pintinn wɔ v0.0.5 mu. Wogyaw akwan foforo (k8s, nomad) sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ma adwumayɛfo akɛse.
ops.h2_a: Makefile yɛ central entrypoint ma dev ne ops adeyɛ biara. `yɛ mmoa` kyerɛw botae ahorow.
ops.h2_b: `yɛ instɔl` → `pip instɔl -r ahwehwɛde.txt`. `yɛ dev` → uvicorn a ɛwɔ reload. `yɛ sɔhwɛ` → pytest + katasoɔ, outputs `katasoɔ.xml`. `yɛ lint` → ruff + mypy. `yɛ docker-kyekye` → `docker si -t vortex:$VERSION`. `yɛ db-migrate` → `alembic nkɔso ti`. `yɛ db-backup` / `yɛ db-san FILE=...`. `yɛ ci` → CI nsuo afiri a ɛyɛ ma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
ops.h2_c: Makefile bi sɛ canonical entrypoint yɛ Unix adeyɛ a adi mfe du du pii, a Python adwuma titiriw biara (pytest, django, flask, fastapi) agye atom. Nnwinnade foforo (Anwensɛm, Hatch, uv) yɛ afe no mu dɛ; Make yɛ mfonoe na ɛyɛ amansan nyinaa de.
ops.h3_a: Nsiesiei wizard no yɛ PyInstaller bundle (`Vortex Wizard.app`) a ɛwɔ pywebview GUI a ɛnantew adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔdi kan fa dwumadie mu.
ops.h3_b: Flow a edi kan: paw node din → yɛ release keys (Ed25519 keypair a wɔakora so wɔ `keys/release.key`) → hyehyɛ TLS (Let's Encrypt / fa-wo-ankasa / wo ankasa de wo nsa hyɛ ase) → paw entry URLs (vortexx.sol / custom domain / .onion) → ma stealth level → bue firewall ports (iptables/ufw/pf) a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm. Afei mmirikatu a edi kan no, wizard tra hɔ sɛ admin console: start/stop node, hwɛ logs, dannan keys, fa federated peers ka ho.
ops.h3_c: Nsiesiei wizards yɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn ani si wɔn a wɔnyɛ sysadmin dwumadiefoɔ so: Ghost onboarding (2015), Standard Notes server nhyehyeɛ, Mastodon instɔlehyɛn nsɛmmisa. PyInstaller ma yɛde binary biako a wotumi klik mprenu mena; pywebview kyerɛ mpɔtam hɔ HTML krataafa a FastAPI admin API a wɔaboaboa ano som wɔ 127.0.0.1 — browser UX a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobɛkyekyere kurom hɔ GUI.
ops.h4_a: Wɔde git ahyɛ biribiara a wɔayi no adi no agyirae. Rollback yɛ `git checkout <tag> && yɛ docker-kyekye && docker hyehyɛ kɔ soro -d`. Migrations wɔ `downgrade()` dwumadie.
ops.h4_b: Wɔde release key no ahyɛ tags ase enti tag no ankasa yɛ nea wotumi di ho adanse. Rollback nhyehyɛe: checkout dedaw tag, san kyekye mfonini, san yɛ nsukorade — mmirikatu nkitahodi drain wɔ SIGTERM (default 15 s adom). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` san de nsakraeɛ baako ba. Data a wɔkwati: yɛmfa nkyerɛwde nhyɛ da wɔ a wɔayi no adi biako mu; drops si N+1 akyi code agyae akenkan wɔn.
ops.h4_c: "code-then-code" atutra nhyehyɛe (expand-migrate-contract) yɛ gyinapɛn ma zero-downtime deployments. Stripe’s migration guide (2019) kyerɛkyerɛ mu yie. Vortex gyee no toom wɔ asɛm bi a esii wɔ v0.0.3 mu a adum bi a ɛtɔe hyɛɛ no ​​ma wɔde simma 30 siesie mfɛnsere no akyi.

mobile.title: Mobile so afɛfo
mobile.subtitle: iOS ne Android — kurom hɔ UI, protocol koro no ara.
mobile.intro: Mobile clients baanu no nyinaa yɛ atipɛnfo a wɔyɛ pɛ, ɛnyɛ wrappers a wɔyɛ tratraa. Native hwɛ, native adwumayɛ, native nkabom (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets).
mobile.h1p1: Swift Package wɔ `ios/Modules/` mu. 30+ feature modules, emu biara SOLID-apaapae `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: App botaeɛ wɔ `ios/VortexApp/` mu. XcodeGen spec a ɛwɔ `ios/project.yml` no san yɛ xcodeproj no.
mobile.h1p3: Nsɛm a Wɔde Sie: Nsɛm a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Mutations nyinaa fa `db.write` so.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNs via `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadi Ntrɛwmu ma decryption.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle adwuma wɔ `android/` mu. 22 feature modules a Hilt DI, saa ara `api / impl / di / ui` mpaapaemu.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Pia a FTS4 nneɛma a ɛkanyan wom.
mobile.h2p6: Pia: FCM + FirebaseMessagingService a wɔde yiyi nsɛm mu.
mobile.h3p1: Saa ara na 146-locale bundle a ɛwɔ din ankasa (`Русский ru`, `English en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Saa ara na 1500-emoji katalog a 9 categories + skin-tones + MRU + hwehwɛ.
mobile.h3p3: Saa ara na akontaabu pii X25519 asɛnnennen-mmuae ma nsakrae.
mobile.h3p4: Nkɔmmɔbɔ folda koro no ara (Ne nyinaa / Archived / amanne) a twetwe-na-tow a wɔsan hyehyɛ.
mobile.h3p5: Saved-GIFs list koro no ara (Tenor biara nni hɔ — ankorankoro nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano nkutoo).
mobile.h3p6: Saa ara na nhyehyɛe-nkrasɛm UI, nkitahodi screen, premium tebea krataafa.
mobile.h1_a: iOS client yɛ Swift Package a ɛwɔ 30+ feature modules. HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocol koro no ara te sɛ client foforo biara.
mobile.h1_b: Modules a wɔahyehyɛ no sɛnea feature: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Frɛ`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folda`, `Akontaabu`, `SavedGifs`, `Nkitahodi`, `Wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe`, `Premium`, `Nneyɛe`, .... Wɔn mu biara akyekyɛ mu ayɛ no `api/` (protocols), `impl/` (concrete classes), `ui/` (SwiftUI views). Nsɛm a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm: CryptoKit ma X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift ma Argon2id. DB: GRDB ne FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFnsusuwii nhyehyɛe. Push: APN ahorow a ɛwɔ Notification Service Extension ma sealed-push decryption.
mobile.h1_c: Modular packages yɛ Swift adeyɛ a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn firi Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Yɛn mpaapaemu wɔ api / impl / ui yɛ SOLID-ish: dependency inversion (modules gyina api / nkutoo), mpaapaemu a ɛhaw adwene, testability (swap impl ma sɔhwɛ). 30+ module count no yɛ paw ma build parallelism — module biara boaboa ano wɔ isolation.
mobile.h2_a: Android afɛfoɔ ahwehwɛ iOS: Kotlin + Hyehyɛ + Hilt DI. 22 feature modules, saa ara `api / impl / di` mpaapaemu.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), botaeSdk 34 (Android 14) na wɔde asi wɔn ani so. Crypto: AndroidX ahobammɔ + Tink ma AES-GCM; argon2-jvm ma Argon2id. DB: Pia a FTS4 a ɛkanyan nneɛma wom. WebRTC: Fa WebRTC Android. Pia: FCM denam FirebaseMessagingService + envelope a wɔatoto mu decryption so. Gradle multi-module, Hilt ka feature modules a enni dependencies tẽẽ.
mobile.h2_c: Compose yɛ Google's declarative UI toolkit, stable fi 2021. Hilt (2020) yɛ Google-endorsed DI framework a ɛwɔ Dagger 2. Wɔbom yɛ pɛ SwiftUI + agyapade wrappers wɔ iOS ma ɛkame ayɛ sɛ architectural atenka. Vortex faa Compose/Hilt fi v0.0.4 rekɔ; kan no na Android yɛ View-based.
mobile.h3_a: iOS ne Android nyinaa bundle 146-locale JSON set koro no ara a native din ne 1500-emoji catalog — ɔdefo bi a ɔkyerɛw 🥹 wɔ iOS 17 renders 🥹 wɔ Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Fibea/I18N/Nneɛma/mpɔtam/*.json` ahwehwɛ `android/app/src/titiriw/agyapade/mpɔtam/*.json`. Apps abien no nyinaa load locale a ɛfata wɔ kan launch (kasa picker screen) na ɛkɔ so paw. Emoji katalog no yɛ 9-category JSON a wɔde mena wɔ bundles abien no nyinaa mu; ɛyɛ sidesteps OS-level emoji-set divergence a sɛ ɛnte saa a ɛde `?` glyphs a wɔankyerɛ ase wɔ OS dedaw so.
mobile.h3_c: W'ankasa emoji katalog a wode bɛmena ne nhwɛso a Telegram de di dwuma (wɔn Twemoji fork) ne WhatsApp a wɔde di dwuma kosi 2022. Aguadi-off: ~300 KB extra per app bundle for emoji + ~1.2 MB for locales. Ɛfata sɛ ɛyɛ cross-platform consistency.

emoji: 1 JSON a ɛwɔ safoa 9 (akuw) × 1500 a wɔakyerɛw

webclient.title: Wɛbsaet akraman
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, offline mode, ɔsom adwumayɛfo.
webclient.intro: Wɛb akraman yɛ vanilla-JS PWA. No React, bundler biara nni hɔ a ɛboro ESM so. ~400 KB gzipped nyinaa, a locales 146 ka ho.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw. Feature modules lazy-load wɔ nea edi kan a wɔde di dwuma.
webclient.h1p2: Tebea: dan biara ring buffers wɔ IndexedDB, in-memory decrypted cache. Ɔsom Adwumayɛfo yɛ ntamgyinafo fetch.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Nsuo Glass nsunsuansoɔ denam CSS akyi-filter so. Nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ; event delegation + idempotent render aboafoɔ.
webclient.h2p1: Akyerɛw biara a wɔayɛ bere a wonni intanɛt so no ntonto kɔ IndexedDB. SW flushes bere a nkitahodi asan aba.
webclient.h2p2: Idempotency key wɔ POST biara so ma duplicate retries di nkonim dwoodwoo.
webclient.h2p3: Akenkan yɛ adwuma koraa offline — synced ciphertext nyinaa te IndexedDB mu.
webclient.h3p1: 146 mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ `static/locales/*.json` mu. Akwaaba screen (`lang-picker.js`) kyinhyia fa native-din hints.
webclient.h3p2: Runtime locale switch: `document.documentElement.lang = koodu` + san kyerɛ nkyerɛwde ahorow denam `data-i18n` su ahorow so.
webclient.h1_a: Wɛb akraman yɛ vanilla-JS PWA. No React, no build anammɔn a ɛboro ESM bundling so. JS a wɔde mena nyinaa: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` yɛ Jinja2-a wɔakyerɛ ase shell no. `static/js/main.js` yɛ ES-module a wɔde hyɛ mu. Feature modules wɔ `static/js/<feature>/` lazy-load wɔ dwumadie a ɛdi kan. CSS wɔ `static/css/` mu a 1-fael-biara-afã apam. Ɔsom Adwumayɛfo di cache ho dwuma; adesoa a edi kan no fi network so, nea edi hɔ no fi cache mu; update checks wɔ akwantuo mu.
webclient.h1_c: Na tra off frameworks yɛ v0.0.1 gyinaesi a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ bere a wɔde React ne Vue PWAs a ɛwɔ ~1.5 MB gzipped a ɛwɔ features a ɛte saa ara ayɛ benchmarking akyi. Vanilla JS + ES module ahorow no ma yɛn ~400 KB. Aguadi-off no yɛ DOM-manipulation boilerplate kɛse, a yɛde aboafo nketewa brɛ ase wɔ `static/js/lib/dom.js` mu.
webclient.h2_a: Offline mode: outgoing kyerɛw queue kɔ IndexedDB; Service Worker flushes bere a nkitahodi no asan aba.
webclient.h2_b: POST / PATCH biara a ɔdefoɔ no yɛ offline no nya idempotency key na ɛkɔ fam wɔ `outbox` (IndexedDB) mu. Service Worker tie `online` event na ɔsan de idempotency safoa no to gua sɛ header. Server hu duplicates denam idempotency key so na ɛsan de mmuae a edi kan no ba. Akenkan yɛ adwuma koraa offline — synced ciphertext nyinaa te IndexedDB mu na ɛde in-memory keys no decrypt locally.
webclient.h2_c: Idempotency keys for retryable POSTs yɛ Stripe 2017 nhyiamu, a nnɛyi API dodoɔ no ara agye atom. IndexedDB sɛ outbox yɛ nhwɛsoɔ Google Drive wɛb de di dwuma ma offline nsakraeɛ. Vortex no dwumadie yɛ ~200 nkyerɛwdeɛ wɔ `static/js/lib/outbox.js` mu.
webclient.h3_a: 146-kasa bundle wɔ `static/locales/*.json`. Akwaaba screen kyinhyia nam native-din hints (`Выберите язык` / `Paw wo kasa` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Nea edi kan a wɔde fi ase: `lang-picker.js` kyerɛ typewriter-animated hint a ɛkyinkyini fa locales 97 mu wɔ 45 ms/char, ɛgyina 1.8 s, ɛpopa wɔ 30 ms/char, ɛkɔ n’anim. Ɔdefo paw kasa bi; kɔɔ so traa `localStorage.vortex_lang` mu. Mmirikatu biara a edi hɔ no kenkan nea wɔapaw a wɔakora so no. Runtime switch: `setLang(code)` de JSON no hyɛ mu, san kyerɛ `data-i18n` nneɛma no.
webclient.h3_c: Typewriter-hint nhwɛsoɔ no yɛ obuo ma terminal splash screens dedaw na wɔfaa no maa UX ɔhyew akyi v0.0.6 beta kyerɛɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no buu wɔn ani guu static dropdown so. Cycling hints ma sekan 1 mfɛnsere ma obiara a ɔde di dwuma no sɛ obehu ne kasa din na wahu no ntɛm ara.
webclient.h1_f:
shell: templates/base.html (wɔakyerɛ sɛ Jinja2 wɔ server so) .
nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu: static/js/main.js (ES module) .
nneɛma: static/js/{nkɔmmɔbɔ,dan,auth,frɛ,fael,bots}/...
SW: static/ɔsom-adwumayɛfo.js

offline akyerɛw nsuo:
  1. bu akontaa sɛ idempotency_key = rand (16).hex
