security.title: Ahobammɔ gyinabea
security.subtitle: Ahunahuna nhwɛso, ahobammɔ-a emu dɔ, WAF, akontaabu kwan, canary.
security.intro: Vortex de defence-in-depth di dwuma: layer biako a wobɛbubu no nnɔɔso, attacker a ɔyɛ ankasa hia nkonimdi ahorow pii a ɔde ne ho.
security.h1p1: **Passive network observer**: ohu TLS packet ahorow; yɛ kɛse/bere nhwehwɛmu. Wɔdii nkogu wɔ Level 1 sum ase.
security.h1p2: **Active network attacker**: betumi atɔ / akyɛ / inject. Wɔdii nkogu wɔ Level 2-4 sum ase.
security.h1p3: **Node dwumadiefoɔ a wɔagyae mu**: ɔhunu ciphertext + metadata. Nkrasɛm no mu nsɛm da so ara yɛ kokoamsɛm.
security.h1p4: **Akraman mfiri a wɔawia**: nkrasɛm a atwam a wɔada no adi no mu nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den. Double Ratchet anohyeto ma mprempren nhyiam; wipe-on-next-unlock no wɔ hɔ.
security.h1p5: **Quantum ɔtamfo a wɔakora so atwam traffic**: dii nkogu wɔ hybrid Kyber-768 session keys bere a atipɛnfo baanu no nyinaa bɔɔ dawuru PQ.
security.h2p1: Bisa nhwehwɛmufo: SQLi nhwɛsode, ɔkwan a wɔfa so twa, nsusuwso injection, LFI, NoSQLi. Drops ansa na app code aba.
security.h2p2: Rate anohyeto: wiase nyinaa 1000 req / s soft cap ne burst; ɔkwan biara so (kɔ mu 10/simma, kyerɛw wo din 5/simma); per-user 100 req / s akyi auth.
security.h2p3: Geo-blocking yɛ nea wopɛ denam `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN` so.
security.h3: Audit kwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma
security.h3p1: Nsɛm a ɛfa ahobanbɔ ho (admin adeyɛ, federation nsakrae, release upgrade, panic wipe) hash-chained via `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛpaapae ⇒ wɔahu sɛ wɔayɛ nsakrae. Kɔkɔbɔ ogya.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` da log no adi (admin auth nkutoo). Wɔde ka ho nkutoo.
security.h4p1: Canary fael a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ase da biara da a wɔde release key. Absence ⇒ compromise a wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ.
security.h4p2: Ntɛmntɛm a wɔtwa: admin bɔ `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` kɔma WebSocket biara. Clients popa cached keys.
security.h4p3: Rotation: safoa foforo a wɔayi no adi, san de wo nsa hyɛ ase manifest, san tintim. Clients san yɛ bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Atamfo anan akuw na ɛkanyan nhyehyɛe no: ɔhwɛfo a ɔnyɛ hwee, ɔtowhyɛfo a ɔyɛ nnam, nea ɔyɛ adwuma a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu, mfiri a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu. Wɔn mu biara dii nkogu denam ɔfa soronko bi so.
security.h1_b: Passive observer: ohu TLS-encrypted packets, ɔyɛ traffic nhwehwɛmu. Wɔdii nkogu wɔ Level 1-2 sum ase. Active attacker: betumi atow/akyɛ/ahyɛ packets mu. Wɔdii nkogu wɔ Level 3-4 sum ase. Operator a wɔabɔ no apete: ohu ciphertext + metadata. Wɔdii nkogu denam E2E crypto + metadata a wɔtew so. Compromised device: hu plaintext a ɛfa nkrasɛm a atwam ho. Ɔsɛe a wɔde anim kokoamsɛm (Double Ratchet) ne ehu popa na ɛto ano hye.
security.h1_c: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ adesuakuo anan no firi Schneier 1999 "Applied Cryptography" ahunahuna nhwɛsoɔ nkyekyɛmu, a wɔde Snowden akyi nsɛm a ɛfa ɔman-gyinabea ahwɛfoɔ ho atrɛw mu. Nnɛyi ahobammɔ-bɔfo nhyehyɛe biara fa biribi a ɛte saa ka ho asɛm. Vortex no twist ne sɛ ɔde adesuakuw a ɛto so anum rebɛka ho ama v0.4 kwankyerɛ no: ɔtamfo a quantum-atumi ayɛ no a ɔde kar a atwam a wɔakora so, a Kyber di ho dwuma.
security.h2_a: WAF no hwehwɛ abisade biara mu ansa na adu app code ho, ɛpow SQL-i, ɔkwan a wɔfa so twa, template injection, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` yɛ ~50 regex nhwehwɛmu tia URL, asɛmmisa, ne nipadua. Nhwɛsoɔ a wonim-a ɛyɛ bɔne (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Rate anohyeto: wiase nyinaa 1000 req/s soft cap a ɛwɔ burst tolerance; ɔkwan biara so `/kɔ mu` 10/simma, `/kyerɛw wo din` 5/simma; per-user 100 req / s akyi auth. Geo-blocking optional via `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` de di asotwe ahwehwɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔdi mmara no ho dwuma.
security.h2_c: WAFs sɛ mfimfini dwumadie yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde asi hɔ — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's yɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ketewaa bi efisɛ WAF a emu yɛ duru de atoro nneɛma pa a ɛmene ahunahuna ankasa ba. Wɔboaboaa regex list no ano fii OWASP Top 10 nsaano nkyerɛwee mu na wɔyɛɛ no ​​yiye wɔ v0.0.5 mu bere a beta WAF mmara bi siw ahama ankasa "DROP TABLE" ano wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nkrasɛm bi a ɛfa SQL ho no akyi.
security.h3_a: Nsɛm a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho no si fam wɔ hash-chained audit log mu. Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu a abubu kyerɛ sɛ wɔayɛ nsakrae.
security.h3_b: Wɔde admin adeyɛ biara, federation nsakrae, release upgrade, anaa panic wipe ahyɛ `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)` mu. Row biara kura `prev_hash = hash (prev_row)`. Wɔbu mprempren row no hash no ho akontaa wɔ `ts ∥ event ∥ prev_hash` so. Sɛ wɔpopa anaa wɔsesa row biara a, row a edi hɔ no `prev_hash` nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu paapae — wotumi hu denam nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no a wɔsan bɔ so.
security.h3_c: Hash-chained audit logs yɛ primitive dedaw (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd de wɔn di dwuma. Git commit DAG no titiriw yɛ nhyehyɛe koro no ara. Vortex de kaa ho wɔ v0.0.6 mu bere a ɔfotufo bi kyerɛe sɛ node a ayɛ basaa betumi apopa log rows komm akyi.
security.h4_a: Wɔadi kan ayɛ asɛm a esii ho mmuae ho nhyehyɛe: canary da no adi sɛ release key no yɛ nea wontumi nsɛe no; ntɛmpɛ revocation popa cached keys wɔ clients nyinaa so.
security.h4_b: Da biara da `canary.txt` a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase denam release key no so, a wɔatintim wɔ controller no nkyɛn. Clients optionally verify wɔ startup — absence ⇒ apam a wosusuw. Sɛ wɔsi apam bi so dua a: admin bɔ `{type:"n", event:"compromise", reason}` wɔ WebSocket biara so. Clients popa cached keys, hyɛ san kɔ mu. New release key minted, manifest re-signed, akraman san bootstrap fi ahwehwɛ mudi mudi awiei. Ciphertext dedaw a wɔakyerɛ ase sɛ wontumi nkenkan denam adwini so.
security.h4_c: Canary fael ahorow no hwehwɛ Apple 2013 warrant canary ne `canarywatch.org` adwuma no. Signal de wɔn di dwuma. Vortex's yɛ automated: cron bi de release key no hyɛ aseɛ `canary.txt` h 24 biara. Ntɛmntɛm a wɔtwa ho amanneɛbɔ yɛ nhwɛsoɔ korɔ no ara a Let's Encrypt de di dwuma ma adansedie krataa a wɔtwa mu dodoɔ.
security.h2_f:
hwɛ adesrɛ biara mu:
  SQL aduru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu : hu UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- ne nea ɛkeka ho.
  ɔkwan a wɔfa so twa : hwehwɛ ../, ..%2f, URL-encoded variants
  nsusuwso injection : hu {{, {% .
  XSS : hu <nkyerɛwde, javascript: .
  NoSQLi : hwehwɛ $ne, $hea, $regex
rate anohyeto: 1000/s wiase nyinaa, 10/min login, 5/min kyerɛw wo din
security.h3_f:
row: {ts, adeyɛ, odiyifo_id, botae_id, nsɛm_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash}
row_hash = SHA-256 (ts ∥ adeyɛ ∥ ɔyɛkyerɛfo_id ∥ ... ∥ kan_hash)
verify: nantew log, san bu row_hash biara, toto bo a wɔakora so ho
break ⇒ tampering a wɔahu wɔ saa row no so

privacy.title: Kokoam nsɛm ne nea wodi so
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, hokwan a wɔde popa, metadata a wɔtew so, data a wɔde fa so.
privacy.intro: Vortex po so ahyɛn GDPR ne CCPA nnwinnade fi adaka no mu. Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ tumidi a wɔahyɛ ho mmara no wɔ admin endpoint baako ma mmara kwan so abisadeɛ biara.
privacy.h1p1: IP logs biara nni hɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` gye sɛ nea ɔyɛ adwuma no paw sɛ ɔbɛkɔ.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` wɔ nkra rows hashes ankasa sender IDs — DB dump da per-room pseudonyms nkutoo adi.
privacy.h1p3: Hwehwɛ de encrypted-tokens di dwuma. Client de dan safoa de keywords sie; node sie token ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee; lookup yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ-match wɔ ciphertext tokens so.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen truncated to nea ɔde di dwuma no granularity a wapaw.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` mmɔ ɔdefoɔ row no din, ɛpopa wɔn nkrasɛm a wɔde amena (metadata a wɔakora so ama quorum), ɛpopa fael firi disk so.
privacy.h2p2: Federation: nsɛmmɔnedi a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase bɔ atipɛnfo amanneɛ; wɔpopa wɔ wɔn afã wɔ 72 h mu.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: wɔde timestamp ne (hashed) user id na ɛkyerɛw erasure sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a operator betumi akyerɛ sɛ odi mmara so.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` streams a zip: profile JSON, ciphertext a wɔde amena/wɔgye, fael nkyerɛkyerɛmu a fael biara ntini safoa wom, nkitahodi list.
privacy.h3p2: Awo ntoatoaso bere: ~5 min ma 10 k nkrasɛm, a IO na ɛto ano hye.
privacy.h3p3: Ɛsɛ sɛ nea ogye no decrypt ciphertext wɔ mpɔtam hɔ; wɔde nnwinnade a wɔde kɔ amannɔne no mena ka nkyɛn.
privacy.h4p1: Long-press logo 5 s → ntɛm ara local popa: nsafe, nkrasɛm a wɔakora so, attachments.
privacy.h4p2: Coupled wipe: `/api/privacy/panic` nso tombstones server-side akontaabu no.
privacy.h1_a: IP logs biara nni hɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. Metadata biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ nea ɔde di dwuma wɔ nkrasɛm row ahorow so. Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw nyinaa hwehwɛ wɔ token ahorow a wɔabɔ no kokoam so.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` ansa na node no ahu gye sɛ operator paw sɛ ɔbɛma rate-limiting. Nkrasɛm row ahorow no sie `sender_id` (ma ACL) ne `sender_pseudo` (ma fan-out); sender_pseudo yɛ HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) enti DB dump nkyerɛ nea ɔkaa nea ɔkae wɔ dan no atifi. Hwehwɛ: client de room key no de encrypt nsɛmfua titiriw; node sie token ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee; lookup yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ-match wɔ ciphertext tokens so, enni plaintext index.
privacy.h1_c: Metadata a wɔtew so no yɛ Snowden akyi adwene a ɛwɔ hɔ — Signal maa no gyee din wɔ afe 2014 mu, WhatsApp dii akyi de sender-pseudo wɔ afe 2019. Encrypted search wɔ ciphertext tokens so ne CryptDB (2011) ne ShadowCrypt (2014) nhwɛsoɔ. Vortex no dwumadie yɛ stripped-down version a ɛde asɛmmisa mu nsakraeɛ bi sesa ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` mmɔ ɔdefoɔ row no din, ɛpopa wɔn ciphertext a wɔde amena no, ɛpopa fael, na ɛbɔ federated peers amanneɛ.
privacy.h2_b: Server-side: `adwumayɛfo` row no mfuw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no zeroed (`ɔdefo din = "wɔapopa-<id>"`, `fon = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[wɔapopa]"`); `messages.ciphertext` hyehyɛ NULL ma row nyinaa a `sender_id = u.id`; fael ahorow a wɔde abɔ mu afi saa nkrasɛm a wɔapopa afi disk so no mu. Atipɛnfo a wɔayɛ biako no nya nsɛmmɔnedi a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase `{event: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}`; wɔtu mmirika purge koro no ara wɔ wɔn afã wɔ 72 h (SLA) mu.
privacy.h2_c: Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ wɔpopa no yɛ GDPR Ahyɛdeɛ 17 ahwehwɛdeɛ firi afe 2018. CCPA dii akyire wɔ afe 2020 mu; LGPD (Brazil) wɔ afe 2021. Vortex de primitive out-of-the-box no mena enti ɛho nhia sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ tumidi a wɔahyɛ ho mmara no si. 72 h federation SLA no ne GDPR nnafua 30 mmuae mfɛnsere a ɛwɔ ti a wɔde bɛtrɛw mu no hyia.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` streams a zip: profile JSON, ciphertext a wɔde amena/wɔgye, fael nkyerɛkyerɛmu a fael biara ntini safoa wom, nkitahodi list.
privacy.h3_b: Generation yɛ async efisɛ akontaabu akɛse gye simma. Client POSTs bisa → node enqueues adwuma → adwuma no tu mmirika wɔ akyi → client polls `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase URL bere a wɔasiesie. Zip mu nsɛm: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (baako wɔ dan biara mu), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + fael biara ntini safoa), `fael/` (wɔatwe-sɛnea ɛte blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Data portability yɛ twin ahwehwɛde a ɛwɔ erasure wɔ GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal nyinaa wɔ nnwinnade a wɔde kɔ. Vortex's de key material (file_root per file) ka ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi decrypt export no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ — anyɛ saa a export no ho nni mfaso. Sɛ saa nsɛm yi nni hɔ a, Apple / Google takeouts no yɛ nea etu mpɔn plaintext-only efisɛ wɔayɛ decrypted dedaw.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: mia Vortex ahyɛnsode no so bere tenten sikɔne 5 na woasɛe safoa ne data a wɔakora so wɔ mfiri no so nyinaa ntɛm ara. Nea wontumi nsakra no.
privacy.h4_b: Client-side: wɔ 5-second long-press, kyerɛ si so dua; wɔ si so dua no, frɛ `popaKeychainItems ()` / `popaKeystore ()` / `mpɔtam hɔStorage.pepa () + indexedDB.databases (). forEach (popaDatabase)`. Cached ciphertext ayera, keys ayera, JWTs ayera. Optional coupled wipe: `POST /api/privacy/panic` nso tombstones akontaabu server-side na federates an erasure nsɛmmɔnedi.
privacy.h4_c: Panic buttons / dead-man switches wɔ abakɔsɛm tenten wɔ nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom mu: Wickr 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat 2013 "Forget", Signal "Secure Deletion" nyansahyɛ (2016, wɔamfa ankɔ da). Vortex's 5-second long-press no ahyɛ da ayɛ den sɛ wobɛkanyan wɔ akwanhyia mu — yesuaa haptic feedback wɔ iPhone 15 ne Pixel 8 na yɛpaw 5 s sɛ sweet spot a ɛda "fast enough in an emergency" ne "can't fire by pocket-button" ntam.

debugging.title: Debugging ne diagnostics
debugging.subtitle: Nnwinnade a wɔde di nsɛm a ɛwɔ dev, staging, ne prod mu akyi.
debugging.intro: Subsystem biara wɔ logging a wɔahyehyɛ ne /metrics surface. Diagnosis playbook a wɔtaa yɛ no ni.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-wɔahyehyɛ no default so. `logger.info ("adeyɛ", extra={"ɔdefo_id": ...})` ma `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"adeyɛ", "ɔdefo_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Di akɔneaba wɔ 100 MB; kɔ so yɛ 14 gens gzipped.
debugging.h1p4: Correlation id: abisadeɛ biara nya `X-Abisadeɛ-Id`; RPC ahorow a ɛwɔ nsuo ase no san de di dwuma.
debugging.h2p1: Prometheus format wɔ `/metrics` (admin-a wɔagye atom wɔ prod mu).
debugging.h2p2: RED: rate / mfomso / bere tenten wɔ ɔkwan biara so.
debugging.h2p3: USE: dwumadie / saturation / mfomsoɔ wɔ DB pool biara mu, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Amanne: adan a ɛyɛ nnam, nkrasɛm/nkrasɛm, sum ase-gyinabea histogram.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` ma runtime nhwɛsoɔ. Fa bata node a ɛretu mmirika no ho PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` ma heap profiling. Simma 1 mfonini a wɔde twae no da nsu a ɛretu adi ntɛmntɛm.
debugging.h3p3: Rust ntrɛwmu `vortex_chat` de `--profile` frankaa a ɛkyerɛw trace a ɛne flamegraph hyia kɔ amannɔne.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` tu mmirika register/login/send/gye/logout tia mpɔtam hɔ node bi. Fi adi a ɛnyɛ zero wɔ huammɔdi biara so.
debugging.h4p2: CI tu mmirika wusiw wɔ PR biara so ne saa ara nso na wɔ merges to main so.
debugging.h4p3: Wusiw a wɔde yɛ nneɛma: abɔnten so nhwehwɛmu a ɛbɔ canary akontaabu pɛnkoro simma biara.
debugging.h1_a: Logs no yɛ JSON-nhyehyɛe default so. Log line biara wɔ ts, level, module, nkrasɛm, ne correlation id.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info ("ɔdefo_abɔ", extra={"ɔdefo_id": u.id})` ma `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"ɔdefo_abɔ", "ɔdefo_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}`. Nkitahodi id fi `X-Abisade-Id` ti; RPC biara a ɛwɔ fam no san de di dwuma bio. Nkyinkyin wɔ 100 MB; kɔ so yɛ awo ntoatoaso 14 gzipped. Level biara-module denam `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` so.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging yɛ mprempren adwene a ɛwɔ hɔ — Stripe, Datadog, nnɛyi observability vendor biara gye toom. Nkitahodi ID ahorow no hwehwɛ X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) na ɛbɛyɛɛ canonical wɔ microservices mu denam Jaeger / Zipkin (2015) so. Vortex de header-propagated correlation id a ɛnyɛ den di dwuma sen sɛ wɔde distributed traces bedi dwuma efisɛ distributed-trace tooling no de complexity a yenhia de besi nnɛ ka ho.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metrics wɔ `/metrics` (admin-a wɔagye atom wɔ adwumayɛ mu). Grafana dashboards a wɔde mena wɔ `deploy/grafana/` mu.
debugging.h2_b: RED metrics per-route: abisade dodow, mfomso dodow, bere tenten histogram. USE metrics wɔ adeɛ biara mu: DB pool dwumadie, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwidth. Amanne: adan a ɛyɛ nnam, nkrasɛm wɔ sekan biara mu, sum ase-gyinabea histogram. Admin dashboard a ɛwɔ `/admin/metrics` no kyerɛ nkyerɛwde a ɛwɔ soro no; Prometheus a ɔrehwehwɛ abakɔsɛm a edi mũ.
debugging.h2_c: RED (rate / mfomso / bere tenten) yɛ Weaveworks 2016 asɛmfua a wɔatwa no tiaa. USE (utilisation / saturation / errors) yɛ Brendan Gregg afe 2013 kwan a ɔfa so yɛɛ adwuma. Wɔbom kata ɔsom-gyinabea ne nneɛma-gyinabea nsɛnkyerɛnne so. Prometheus + Grafana yɛ open-source default firi afe 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` ma runtime nhwɛsode; `memray` ma heap mfonini ahorow; `vortex_chat` Rust ntrɛwmu wɔ `--profile` ma flamegraph traces.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` 60 s ma flamegraph SVG a ɛkyerɛ Python stacks a ɛyɛ hyew. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` di nkyekyɛmu akyi; `memray ogyaframa mem.bin` kyerɛ. Rust ntrɛwmu de emu nsɛm kɔ amannɔne sɛ Chrome-tracing JSON bere a wɔde `--profile` frɛ no. Fa eyinom mu biara ne adesoa-sɔhwɛ a ɛretu mmirika fa `scripts/smoke/all.sh` mu ma nsusuwii ahorow a ɛkɔ so daa.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) yɛ akontabuo profiler a ɛnyɛ nea ɛde ne ho hyɛ mu a ɛbata Python dwumadie a ɛretu mmirika a enni koodu nsakraeɛ ho — Go a ɛwɔ Python profilers. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) yɛ Python heap profiler a ɛyɛ papa nnɛ. Rust ankasa profiling ecosystem no ho akokwaw nanso ɛnyɛ nea wɔaka abom kɛse; yɛn ntrɛwmu no de Chrome-tracing kɔ amannɔne titiriw efisɛ browser biara wɔ viewer a wɔde ahyɛ mu.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ kyerɛw/kɔ/soma/gye/fi mu tia mpɔtam hɔ node bi. CI tu mmirika no wɔ PR biara so.
debugging.h4_b: Wusiw tu mmirika wɔ ~5 sikani mu. Yɛ akontaabu foforo abien, bue DM, de nkra mena, hwɛ sɛ wɔde ama, ɔtwe abien no nyinaa fi mu. Fi adi a ɛnyɛ zero wɔ huammɔdi biara so. CI frɛ no wɔ ɔdan akyi. Prod-wusiw canary a ɛyɛ soronko tu simma biara fi abɔnten nhwehwɛmu bi so tia sɔhwɛ akontaabu a wɔatu ho ama wɔ production node no so.
debugging.h4_c: Wusiw sɔhwɛ yɛ Toyota adwumayɛbea kasakoa (1950 mfe no) — tu mmirika hwɛ ntɛm de si so dua sɛ nhyehyɛe no nsɛee pefee. Wɔ software mu no wɔbɛyɛɛ gyinapɛn wɔ Michael Feathers "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (2004) akyi. Vortex wusiw nkyerɛwee no yɛ ~200 nkyerɛwde a ɛyɛ bash + curl.

testing.title: Sɔhwɛ ho nhyehyɛe
testing.subtitle: 29 k nkyerɛwde a wɔde sɔ hwɛ wɔ Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Layer biara wɔ n’ankasa sɔhwɛ suite. CI tu mmirika ne nyinaa wɔ nea ennu simma 10 mu.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` kata routers, ahobammɔ, akwantu, bots ho.
testing.h1p2: Hypothesis agyapade-gyina sɔhwɛ ahorow wɔ crypto: `assert decrypt (encrypt (m, k), k) == m` ma 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz on WAF: ɔpepem pii a ɛnteɛ inputs — si so dua sɛ 5xx leaks biara nni hɔ.
testing.h2p1: `swift test` wɔ `ios/Modules/` mu no tu mmirika unit sɔhwɛ ahorow tia RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 sɔhwɛ vectors.
testing.h2p2: XCUI sɔhwɛ ahorow no ma SwiftUI hwɛ wɔ simulator a enni ti mu; snapshot-a wɔde toto ho.
testing.h3p1: `./gradlew sɔhwɛ` tu mmirika JVM-nko sɔhwɛ ahorow (ntɛmntɛm).
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde nnwinnade ayɛ wɔ emulator a ɛretu mmirika so.
testing.h4p1: Playwright na ɔde wɛb client no di dwuma, Chrome a enni ti + Firefox a enni ti. Wɔde `--fake-ui-for-media-stream` na ɛyɛ frɛ.
testing.h4p2: Nsɛm tebea: kyerɛw akontaabu abien → DM → soma fael → popa → hwɛ sɛ sync → awiei.
testing.h1_a: Python sɔhwɛ ahorow no de pytest + coverage di dwuma. Router biara, security primitive biara, transport module biara wɔ sɔhwɛ ahorow. ~80 % a wɔde kata so.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` tu mmirika suite mũ no nyinaa wɔ nea ennu simma 2 mu wɔ core biako so. Hypothesis agyapade-gyina sɔhwɛ ahorow wɔ crypto primitives: `assert decrypt(encrypt (m, k), k) == m` ma 1000 random nkrasɛm. AFL-style fuzz tests wɔ WAF no so: inputs ɔpepem pii a wɔanhyehyɛ no yiye a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛma mmuae 4xx (ɛnyɛ 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` ma nea wɔde kata so.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ne de-facto Python sɔhwɛ mmirikatufoɔ. Hypothesis (2015) a wɔde yɛ sɔhwɛ a egyina agyapadeɛ so no de QuickCheck adwene no firii Haskell hɔ. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) ma fuzz ne fuzzer a wɔkyerɛ kwan wɔ canonical coverage mu. Vortex no stack no yɛ mainstream; dɛ nko ara ne sɛ yɛpɛ pytest parametrisation sen test-class agyapade.
testing.h2_a: Swift sɔhwɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ `ios/Modules/` mu no kata crypto primitives so tia RFC sɔhwɛ vectors a wɔde SwiftUI snapshot sɔhwɛ ahorow ka ho.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` a efi `ios/Modules/` no tu mmirika unit sɔhwɛ ahorow wɔ ase 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) mmoawa a wɔde nyarewa ba. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔde ɔyare mmoawa ba. RFC 5869 (HKDF) mmoawa a wɔde nyarewa ba. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) a wɔde hyɛ mu. SwiftUI preview snapshots a wɔde totoo ho via image diff atia git-tracked baseline no; regression wɔ pixel biara so no di nkogu wɔ ɔdan no mu.
testing.h2_c: Crypto a wobɛsɔ ahwɛ atia aban sɔhwɛ vectors no yɛ adeyɛ a ɛnyɛ bulletproof sen biara — sɛ wo code no ne RFC vectors no hyia a, ɛne nkyerɛase no hyia. Snapshot sɔhwɛ ma SwiftUI yɛ ~2022 tebea a ɛyɛ adwinni, agye din denam pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing so. Vortex de minimal in-house version di dwuma de kwati dependency no.
testing.h3_a: Kotlin sɔhwɛ ahorow: JVM-ɛnam `./gradlew sɔhwɛ` nkutoo so; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` wɔ emulator a ɛretu mmirika so.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` tu mmirika wɔ sikani kakraa bi mu — Android framework biara nhia, JUnit + Hilt-android-testing kɛkɛ. Unit-sɔhwɛ botae ahorow: crypto, akyerɛkyerɛfo, coroutine-gyina nsu a ɛsen. `./gradlew connectedCheck` twitwa emulator bi, instɔl app no, ɛyɛ UI sɔhwɛ ahorow denam Espresso so. E2E flows: login → soma nkra → hwɛ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu.
testing.h3_c: JVM-nko sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔbɛtetew mu afi sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔde nnwinnade ayɛ ho no yɛ Android 2019+ nhyiam no. JVM sɔhwɛ ahorow no yɛ ntɛmntɛm (sekan); sɔhwɛ ahorow a wɔde nnwinnade ayɛ no yɛ brɛoo (simma). Robolectric (2014) na ɛtaa siw nsonsonoeɛ no ano nanso wɔde saa mpaepaemu yi asi ananmu kɛseɛ wɔ nnɛyi Android nkɔsoɔ mu.
testing.h4_a: Playwright de wɛb akraman no di dwuma wɔ Chrome ne Firefox a enni ti mu, de di dwuma ankasa register → DM → frɛ a ɛsen.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` kura nsɛm tebea horow wɔ TypeScript mu. A throwaway node + Postgres no spun up wɔ sɔhwɛ nhyiam biara mu denam docker compose so. Sɔhwɛ ahorow ma wɛb no UI: kyerɛw akontaabu abien, bue DM, soma nkra, hwɛ sɛ wɔde ama, yɛ video frɛ a `--fa-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--fa-fake-device-for-media-stream` frankaa yɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Chrome ayɛ synthetic audio/video. Nsɛm tebea horow no tu mmirika di nsɛ denam Agorukyerɛwfo adwumayɛfo so.
testing.h4_c: Playwright (Microsoft, 2020) sii Selenium ananmu maa wɛb E2E sɔhwɛ dodow no ara efisɛ ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm, wotumi de ho to so, na ɛwɔ debugging a eye. WebRTC sɔhwɛ wɔ browser ahorow a enni ti mu no yɛ ɛyaw kosii sɛ Chrome 69 de atoro-mfiri frankaa kaa ho; efi saa bere no abɛyɛ adeyɛ a wɔtaa yɛ.

apiSurface.intro: Eyi ne ɔmanfo akwan a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛwɔ tumi. Endpoint card biara trɛw de kyerɛ atirimpɔw, auth tier, abisade / mmuae nhyehyɛe, mfomso pon, ne curl nhwɛso. Ofiehwɛ akwan a ɛwɔ `/internal/*` ase no, nhyehyɛe yi afi mu.

auth.title: Nokwaredi a wɔde ma
auth.subtitle: Kyerɛw wo din, login, refresh, revoke — ne akwan a wɔfa so san nya.
auth.intro: Akwan a ɛwɔ `/api/authentication/*` ase nyinaa. JWT a ɛfiri login a ɛdi mu ba no kura `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ HS256 wɔ node no ahintasɛm no so. Access di simma 15, refresh nnafua 30.

register.title: POST /api/nokwaredi/kyerɛw din
register.subtitle: Yɛ ɔdefoɔ foforɔ a ɔwɔ X25519 identity + Argon2id password.
register.h1_a: Yɛ ɔdefoɔ akonta foforɔ na ɔde JWT mmienu a ɛdi kan ma. Ɛkyekyere nea ɔde di dwuma no X25519 ɔmanfo safe a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ no kɔ akontaabu no so fi ɔfrɛ a edi kan koraa no so.
register.h1_b: Node nam Pydantic so di afuo nyinaa mu den, ɛhwɛ ɔdefoɔ din ne x25519_public_key soronkoyɛ, ɛtu mmirika Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) wɔ asɛmfua no so, de hyɛ `users`, `user_devices`, `push_subscriptions`, mints access + refresh JWTs mu.
register.h1_c: Wɔde kɔe wɔ v0.0.1 mu sɛ awiei a edi kan. Wɔde X25519 pubkey parameter no kaa ho wɔ v0.0.2 mu akyi a wohui sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ identity ne account wɔ atom kwan so — anyɛ saa a server no betumi MITM ɔdefo bi a ɛda register ne key upload a edi kan ntam.
register.h2_a: Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ: **obiara nni hɔ**. Mfinimfini `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` no pon saa kwan yi na ɛpow ne `401 unauthenticated` sɛ adansedi krataa a wɔhwehwɛ no nni hɔ anaasɛ enni mu a.
register.h2_b:
- `none` — a wonnye ntom (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ wɔ `Tumi krataa` ti no mu.
- `refresh` — Ɔsoafoɔ JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT a ne nsɛm a wɔka no kura `is_admin: nokware`.
- `peer-signed` — abisadeɛ nipadua a wɔde atipɛnfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di Ed25519 safoa ahyɛ aseɛ.
register.h2_c: Auth tier no da nnyinasosɛm a ɛwɔ hokwan a ɛba fam koraa adi: pre-login endpoints no anohyeto katee wɔ akontaabu a wɔbɔ ne sanba ho; biribiara a ɛwɔ JWT akyi no hu obi a ɔde di dwuma ankasa; admin endpoints kyerɛ badge wɔ UI no mu enti wotumi hu sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so.
register.h3_a: JSON nipadua a ɛwɔ ahyɛde sɛ ɔde di dwuma din + asɛmfua + x25519_public_key; telefon a wopɛ (E.164), imel (RFC 5322 lite), ɔyɛkyerɛ_din, avatar_emoji, nsato_kɔd, kyber_public_key.

login.title: POST /api/nokwaredi/kɔ mu
login.subtitle: Hwɛ sɛ edin a wode di dwuma + asɛmfua a wode di dwuma no yɛ nokware, san JWT baanu.
login.h1_a: Ɔsesa adansedi nkrataa ma JWT baanu. Wɔagye asɛmfua no atom tia Argon2id hash a ɛwɔ `users.password_hash` mu. Bere yɛ bere a ɛkɔ so daa mpo ma edin a wonnim a wɔde di dwuma no sɛ wɔbɛko atia akontaahyɛde.
login.h1_b: Hwɛ ɔdefoɔ no denam ɔdefoɔ din nketewa so, ɛyɛ `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(wɔde asie, wɔde akɔma)`. Sɛ ɔdefoɔ no nni hɔ a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware wɔ dummy hash a wɔadi kan abɔ ho akontaa no ho de ama berɛ ayɛ pɛ. Odi nkonim → asɛm JWT + `ɔdefo_mfiri` row.
login.h1_c: Wɔde register a ɛwɔ v0.0.1 mu no mena. Constant-time dummy hashing de kaa ho wɔ v0.0.2 mu bere a nhwehwɛmufo kyerɛɛ bere a wɔkan wɔ mfitiase nhyehyɛe no so akyi.
login.h2_a: Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ: **obiara nni hɔ**. Mfinimfini `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` no pon saa kwan yi na ɛpow ne `401 unauthenticated` sɛ adansedi krataa a wɔhwehwɛ no nni hɔ anaasɛ enni mu a.
login.h2_b:
- `none` — a wonnye ntom (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ wɔ `Tumi krataa` ti no mu.
- `refresh` — Ɔsoafoɔ JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT a ne nsɛm a wɔka no kura `is_admin: nokware`.
- `peer-signed` — abisadeɛ nipadua a wɔde atipɛnfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di Ed25519 safoa ahyɛ aseɛ.
login.h2_c: Auth tier no da nnyinasosɛm a ɛwɔ hokwan a ɛba fam koraa adi: pre-login endpoints no anohyeto katee wɔ akontaabu a wɔbɔ ne sanba ho; biribiara a ɛwɔ JWT akyi no hu obi a ɔde di dwuma ankasa; admin endpoints kyerɛ badge wɔ UI no mu enti wotumi hu sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so.
login.h4_f:
on nkonimdi: 201 + JWT envelope (nsusuwii koro no ara ne register) .
on 2FA hia: 200 { "hia_2fa": nokware } (no JWT de besi nnɛ)
on failure: 401 { "mfomso":"agyede_a ɛnyɛ adwuma" } .

login.h5_f:

401 account_suspended akontaabu no yɛ nea wɔagyae

429 rate_limited >10 mmɔdenbɔ/simma/IP .

totpSetup.title: POST /api/nokwaredi/2fa/nhyehyɛe

totpSetup.h1_a: Yɛ random 160-bit ahintasɛm, san de base32 ahama + otpauth URI ma QR scanning. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdefoɔ no fa /2fa/verify so di nhwɛsoɔ koodu bi ho adanseɛ na wawie.
totpSetup.h1_b: Handler ma saa kwan yi te module a ɛne no hyia no mu wɔ `app/` ase. Wɔde `@router.post('/api/authentication/2fa/setup')` abɔ ɔkwan nhyehyɛe `/api/authentication/2fa/setup` no ho dawuru.
totpSetup.h1_c: Wɔde akɔma wɔ Vortex a wɔayi no adi ntɛm mu sɛ `nhyehyɛe` tumi no fã.

- `jwt` — Bearer JWT kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ wɔ `Tumi krataa` ti no mu.

- `admin` — JWT a ne nsɛm a wɔka no kura `is_admin: nokware`.

- `jwt` — Bearer JWT kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ wɔ `Tumi krataa` ti no mu.

- `peer-signed` — abisadeɛ nipadua a wɔde atipɛnfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di Ed25519 safoa ahyɛ aseɛ.

roadmap.title: Ɔkwankyerɛfo
roadmap.subtitle: Nea wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne bere a wɔayɛ.
roadmap.intro: Adwene a ɛkorɔn. Date yɛ nea wɔpɛ; ahobammɔ ho nsɛm di feature adwuma anim.
roadmap.h1: v0.2 — nea ɛto so abien a wɔayi no adi wɔ baguam
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ wɔama ayɛ adwuma default wɔ instɔlehyɛn foforo so.
roadmap.h1p2: Akuw a ɛkɔ soro kodu 50 000 a wɔwɔ Variant-B key tintim.
roadmap.h1p3: Desktop (Tauri) nneɛma a wɔde kyekyere macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Bot gua no bue ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde bɛmena.
roadmap.h2p1: Kuw a wɔde ɔdio nkutoo na ɛyɛ frɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu bɛyɛ 100 denam SFU so.
roadmap.h2p2: Opus DTX + bere koro mu + bitrate a ɛsakra.
roadmap.h2p3: Per-participant mute / kick wɔ ɔfrɛ no mu UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Miro-style collaborative canvas over CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) nam nkrasɛm layer no so.
roadmap.h3p2: Bere ankasa mu cursor a ɛwɔ hɔ.
roadmap.h3p3: Fa kɔ amannɔne kɔ PNG / SVG / PDF.
roadmap.h4p1: On-chain escrow a wɔde tɔ bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Operator sika a wonya mu kyɛfa, 10 %% platform fee.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp denam Stripe nkitahodi so.
roadmap.h5p1: Above stabilised, formal ahobammɔ audit, reproducible adan, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5p2: Bug bounty nhyehyɛe no te ase.
roadmap.h5p3: Anyɛ yiye koraa no, ahobammɔ nhwehwɛmu biako a ɛde ne ho a ɔmanfo kyerɛw.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — nea ɛto so abien a wɔayi no adi wɔ baguam. Kyber PQ on by default, ɔmanfo adan akɛse via Variant-B, Tauri desktop packages, bot gua a wɔabue.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 defaults to enabled ma instɔlehyɛn foforo; clients a wonni mmoa gracefully downgrade. Pia a ɛkɔ 50 000 asɔremma via Variant-B safoa tintim — no biara envelope fanout wɔ rotation. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper around the web client) a wɔatintim ama macOS, Windows, Linux a ɛwɔ bundle koro no ara. Bot gua no bue ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde bɛba a wɔde 3-adwuma-da nhwehwɛmu SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 fa scaling out primitives a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ho sen sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ foforo. Ná Kyber wɔ ɔkwankyerɛ so bere nyinaa; nsakrae a ɛkɔ default no gyina pintinnyɛ wɔ adesoa ase. Wɔpaw Tauri sen Electron efisɛ bundle no yɛ ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Bot gua so ɔmanfo nsɛm a wɔde kɔe no na wɔasiw ano wɔ nhwehwɛmu infrastructure a ɛbaa fam wɔ v0.1 mu.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — kuw frɛ. SFU-gyina ɔdio akuw a ɛkɔ 100; video akuw a ɛkɔ soro kodu 32; adaptive simulcast a wɔde di dwuma.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ Rust mu ama adwumayɛ. Opus DTX + FEC + a wɔde bɔ bere koro mu ma ɔdio. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast ma video a SFU paw per-viewer layer a egyina amanneɛbɔ downlink so. Per-participant mute na kick fi UI. Ɔfrɛ a wɔakyere agu hama so (consent-gated, off by default) a wɔde asie wɔ encrypted ase wɔ frɛ biara ntini safoa a wɔkyɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no mu.
roadmap.h2_c: Kuw frɛ yɛ ade biako a wɔhwehwɛ kɛse fi v0.1 beta no mu. SFU nhyehyeɛ di Jitsi Videobridge + Janus nhwɛsoɔ akyi. Rust implementation mmom sen sɛ yɛbɛsan de mediasoup adi dwuma efisɛ mediasoup no Node.js runtime de latency a yɛmpɛ wɔ hot kwan no so ka ho.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — adwumayɛkuw canvas. Miro-style shared board a ɛboro CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) denam nkrasɛm layer a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no so.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT document sync piggybacks wɔ dan mu nkrasɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no so. Board edit biara yɛ CRDT dwumadie a wɔahyehyɛ no nnidiso nnidiso sɛ CBOR, a wɔde dan safoa no abɔ mu, wɔde ato hɔ sɛ nkrasɛm a ɛyɛ `kind:"board_op"`. Clients deserialise, wɔde di dwuma, wɔde ma. Bere ankasa mu cursor a ɛwɔ hɔ denam `kind:"board_cursor"` nkrasɛm su a ɛyɛ soronko so. Fa kɔ PNG / SVG / PDF denam client-side canvas rendering so.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro ne ne mfɛfoɔ 2011) bɛyɛɛ nea ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma agye din sɛ ɔde wɔn adwumayɛkuw no sii amanne kwan so CRDT-te sɛ nhyehyɛe so. Adwene a ɛne sɛ yɛbɛsan de yɛn nkrasɛm a wɔabɔ no kokoam no adi dwuma sen sɛ yɛbɛkyekye WebSocket akwan a ɛsono emu biara no fi nnyinasosɛm bi mu: akwantu akwan kakraa bi, mfomso kakraa bi.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — sikatua a wotua. On-nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn escrow (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/off ramp denam Stripe Connect so.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot tɔ kwan denam on-chain escrow apam so. Adetɔfo pene so; 24 h a wɔde siw kwan; afei sika a wɔde ma adetɔnfo a wɔayi 10 % platform fee afi mu. Akyinnyegye kɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnnibea asɛnnibea a wɔpaw wɔn denam staking so. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect akontaabu wɔ adwumayɛfo biara anaa bot tɔnfo biara; off-ramp: sikakorabea a wɔde sika bɛkɔ tẽẽ anaasɛ USDC sika a wɔde tua ho ka. Crypto mmoa: SOL, USDC, USDT wɔ Solana ne Ethereum nyinaa so.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart contracts yɛ dedaw (OpenBazaar 2016) nanso ɛda so ara yɛ rough twa anoano no ho hyia wɔ UX ho. Vortex nya nea ɛyɛ den no agyapade nanso ɛde ne fã kɛse no ara sie — adetɔfo hu "tɔ" bɔtn a wonim no yiye. 10 % platform fee no ne App Store nhyiamu hyia (ɛwom sɛ Apple gye 30 %); wɔhyɛɛ da twa nea ɛba fam no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtwetwe adetɔnfo.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — a egyina pintinn. Security audit, reproducible kyekye wɔ platforms nyinaa so, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5_b: Nnipa a wɔto so abiɛsa akontaabu nhyehyɛe ansa na 1.0 freeze — ɛbɛyɛ sɛ Trail of Bits anaa NCC Kuw a egyina aguadi mu nsɛm a wɔafa aka so. Reproducible builds kyerɛ sɛ fibea dua koro no ara ma bit-identical binaries wɔ build mfiri abien biara so; eyi hu sɛnea wɔsakra nneɛma a wɔde ma no. SemVer frozen kyerɛ sɛ waya protocols, storage schema, ne ɔmanfo SDK soro nya akyi-compat guarantees wɔ 1.x mu. Bug bounty nhyehyɛe no fi ase de $25k top tier ma akyirikyiri koodu kum wɔ node no so.
roadmap.h5_c: Stabilise-audit-freeze ntoatoasoɔ no yɛ nhwɛsoɔ Signal, Tor, I2P, ne WireGuard nyinaa di akyi. Reproducible builds bɛyɛɛ ade titiriw wɔ Reproducible Builds adwuma (2014) akyi. Vortex de Reproducible Builds adwinnade no di dwuma. Bug bounties yɛ gyinapɛn ma project biara a ɛdi ɔdefoɔ data ho dwuma; $25k yɛ mid-tier denam 2025 gyinapɛn ahorow so.

  PQ afrafra default : Kyber-768 wɔ default so
  adan akɛse : Variant-B tintim safoa, a ɛkɔ 50k asɔremma
  desktop : Tauri 2 ma macOS / Windows / Linux (~ 5 MB) na ɛyɛ nea ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ.
  bot gua so : ɔmanfoɔ nsɛm a wɔde kɔma, nnafua 3 nhwehwɛmu SLA .

aead.title: AEAD .
aead.subtitle: Encryption a Wɔagye atom a Wɔde Data a Ɛbata Ho.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) yɛ cryptographic primitive a ɛka kokoamsɛm ne nokwaredi bom wɔ ɔfrɛ biako mu. Sɛ wɔde safoa, nonce, plaintext, ne optional associated data (AAD) ma a, ɛma ciphertext + authentication tag ma sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nsakrae biara a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ plaintext, ciphertext, anaa AAD mu no rentumi nyɛ nokwaredi.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) yɛ cryptographic primitive a ɛka kokoamsɛm ne nokwaredi bom wɔ ɔfrɛ biako mu. Sɛ wɔde safoa, nonce, plaintext, ne optional associated data (AAD) ma a, ɛma ciphertext + authentication tag ma sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nsakrae biara a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ plaintext, ciphertext, anaa AAD mu no rentumi nyɛ nokwaredi.
aead.h1_b: Vortex AEAD yɛ AES-256-GCM bere nyinaa. AAD slot no kura nsɛm a ɛfa ho a ɛsɛ sɛ nea ogye no hu na ama watumi decrypt no yiye (room id, file id, offset). Binding AAD siw cross-context replay kwan — ciphertext a efi dan A mu no ntumi nkyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ dan B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD sɛ mfitiaseɛ a wɔato din no hwehwɛ Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) na wɔde NIST sii hɔ wɔ SP 800-38D (2007) mu. Ɛbɛyɛɛ default AEAD wɔ TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Nnɛyi protocol biara a ahobammɔ wom de AEAD di dwuma.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc (k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len (pt) baiti, tag = 16 baiti
AEAD.Dec (k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt anaa ⊥
aead.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

alembic.h1_a: Alembic yɛ canonical migration nhyehyeɛ ma SQLAlchemy. Tukɔ biara yɛ Python fael a `upgrade()` ne `downgrade()` dwumadie a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ schema nsakraeɛ mu sɛ SQL anaa ORM dwumadie.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex de Alembic a ɛwɔ linear revision abakɔsɛm (nkorabata biara nni mu) di dwuma. `alembic upgrade head` tu mmirika wɔ Docker container mfiase biara so. `alembic downgrade -1` san anammɔn baako ma rollback. Dev mode de `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` di dwuma enti local iteration nhia migrations wɔ rebase biara so.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic no, Mike Bayer (a ɔkyerɛw SQLAlchemy) na ɔkyerɛwee wɔ afe 2011 mu sɛ nea odii `sqlalchemy-migrate` akyi. Django a wɔasisi no atutra (2014) no fɛm nhwɛsoɔ titire no. Alembic traa n’anim wɔ nneɛma — rollback, autogenerate, branching — ɛwom sɛ Vortex mfa nkorabata nni dwuma de.

argon2id.title: Argon2id na ɔkyerɛwee
argon2id.subtitle: Memory-hard asɛmfua a wɔde hyɛ mu hash (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id yɛ memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing dwumadie. Parameters: memory kɛse (m), bere a wɔbɔ (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), ne hash tenten. 'id' variant no fra data-independent (Argon2i) ne data-dependent (Argon2d) passes.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id yɛ memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing dwumadie. Parameters: memory kɛse (m), bere a wɔbɔ (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), ne hash tenten. 'id' variant no fra data-independent (Argon2i) ne data-dependent (Argon2d) passes.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex de Argon2id di dwuma a m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32. Eyi gye ~0.5 s wɔ iPhone X (yɛn mfiri a wɔboa brɛoo sen biara) ne bɛyɛ 5 ms wɔ ASIC a ɛkorɔn so — 100× ahoɔhare no yɛ nea wontumi mmu ani ngu so sɛ wɔde toto SHA-256-gyina hashes a ASICs di nkonim ɔpepem pii ho a.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 dii nkonim wɔ afe 2015 Password Hashing Akansie a Dmitry Khovratovich ne Alex Biryukov hyehyɛeɛ no mu. Wɔahyɛ no gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 9106 wɔ afe 2021. Wɔde 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass na ɛde dii dwuma. Vortex no parameters no firi OWASP 2023 nyansahyɛ ahodoɔ mu.

Argon2id(asɛmfua, nkyene, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
default: m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32
ɛho ka yɛ ≈ 0.5s wɔ iPhone X so; ~5ms wɔ ASIC (100× ɔtowhyɛfo ahoɔhare)

blake3.title: BLAKE3 .
blake3.subtitle: Ntɛmntɛm cryptographic hash.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 yɛ cryptographic hash dwumadie a ɛfiri BLAKE2 ne BLAKE mu. Ɛyɛ arbitrary-length output fi arbitrary input mu; 10× ntɛmntɛm sen SHA-256 wɔ blobs akɛse so esiane dua mu hashing nti.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 yɛ cryptographic hash dwumadie a ɛfiri BLAKE2 ne BLAKE mu. Ɛyɛ arbitrary-length output fi arbitrary input mu; 10× ntɛmntɛm sen SHA-256 wɔ blobs akɛse so esiane dua mu hashing nti.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex de BLAKE3 di dwuma ma fael no mudi mu kura: fael biara a wɔde akɔ so no kura `plain_blake3` hash a ɛwɔ ne nsɛm a wɔabɔ no mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wogye no betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔatwe + awie akyi. DB kɔla no wɔ abakɔsɛm mu din `sha256` ama atutra a ɛne ne ho hyia nanso ɛwɔ BLAKE3 afiri.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 no, Jack O’Connor ne ne mfɛfo na woyii no adi. wɔ afe 2020. Ɔfirii BLAKE, a na ɛyɛ SHA-3 finalist wɔ afe 2012. Nnua-hashing nhyehyeɛ no ma BLAKE3 scale ne cores ma inputs akɛseɛ. SHA-256 da so ara yɛ ntɛmntɛm ma nsɛm nketewa a wɔde hyɛ mu; BLAKE3 di biribiara so > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(baiti) = 32 baiti // default output
BLAKE3(baiti, len) = len baiti (XOF) .
nea ɛkɔ: ~3 GB/s wɔ Apple Silicon so vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s

blake3.h3_a: SHA-256, fael no mudi mu kura, tag

bmp.title: BMP .
bmp.subtitle: Anifuraefo Nkrataa Adaka Protocol.
bmp.intro: BMP yɛ Vortex's anonymous store-ne-forward layer. Wɔn a wɔde nneɛma mena no de blobs a wɔabɔ no kokoam gu node biara a ɛma nsɛmmɔnedi tumi yɛ adwuma no so, na wɔde nea wɔde ma no pubkey no hash a ɛkɔ ɔkwan biako so na ɛyɛ keyed. Blobs tra nsɛmmɔnedi so kosi sɛ nea ogye no node no bɛtwe.
bmp.h1_a: BMP yɛ Vortex's anonymous store-ne-forward layer. Wɔn a wɔde nneɛma mena no de blobs a wɔabɔ no kokoam gu node biara a ɛma nsɛmmɔnedi tumi yɛ adwuma no so, na wɔde nea wɔde ma no pubkey no hash a ɛkɔ ɔkwan biako so na ɛyɛ keyed. Blobs tra nsɛmmɔnedi so kosi sɛ nea ogye no node no bɛtwe.
bmp.h1_b: BMP de kokoam nsɛm abiɛsa a ɛde ne ho ma: sender-hiding (TLS + optional onion), recipient-hiding (mailbox_id yɛ opaque to middle nodes), content-hiding (blob yɛ E2E-encrypted dedaw). Max blob 1 MB, node biara cap 500 MB, sika a wɔde sie dodow 10/simma/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP no, Vortex kuw no na wɔyɛɛ no ​​fi mfiase. Yɛkyekyeree no efisɛ na ɔbɔfo titiriw biara nni ɔpɛ sɛ obetua mfiridwuma ho ka a wɔbɔ wɔ metadata a wɔde sie awiei kosi awiei — wɔde encrypt nneɛma nanso wɔma social graph no pue. Ná yɛn gyinabea fi da a edi kan no ne sɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔwɔ ahobammɔ a ɔde nea-ɔkasa-ne-o-a-ɛbɔ-a-wɔ-de-ho-no-abɔ no mu no yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom fã pɛ. BMP to saa fã no mu denam nea ɔde kɔma, nea ogye, ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu a ɛma ɛyɛ nea ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee, wɔ Vortex ankasa nsɛmmɔnedi afiri so sen sɛ wɔde bolted-on infrastructure bɛto so.
bmp.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
bmp.h3_a: nsɛmmɔnedi, onion som, sealed sender, Ɔtare

cbor.title: CBOR .
cbor.subtitle: Nneɛma Binary Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛyɛ Tiawa.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) yɛ binary data format a wɔayɛ ama code kɛseɛ ne encoding ntɛmntɛm. Superset a JSON no data nhwɛso, binary-encoded, katee deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) yɛ binary data format a wɔayɛ ama code kɛseɛ ne encoding ntɛmntɛm. Superset a JSON no data nhwɛso, binary-encoded, katee deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex de CBOR di dwuma sɛ payload format wɔ AES-GCM envelopes mu. ~30 % sua sen JSON wɔ unicode-heavy chat so; strict parsing (no whitespace ambiguity) ko tia parser-nsonsonoe ntua; schema-free enti sɛ wode afuo bi bɛka ho a, enhia .proto recompilation.
cbor.h1_c: Wɔde CBOR yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 7049 wɔ afe 2013 mu, wɔyɛɛ no ​​foforɔ kɔɔ RFC 8949 wɔ afe 2020. Wɔde Signal (mfinimfini framing firi afe 2017), Matrix no state-resolution layer, WebAuthn (adansedie nneɛma) de dii dwuma. Wɔpaw no Vortex wɔ v0.0.2 mu bere a wɔde atoto JSON ne protobuf ho akyi.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encoding: {major_type (3 bits), akyinnyegye (5 bits), [data]}
map: type=5 mmienu mmienu
array: type=4 nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ
nkyerɛwee: type=3 baiti
baiti: type=2 raw
cbor.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet a Ɛyɛ Mmienu
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Signal no per-DM anim-kokoamsɛm protocol.
doubleRatchet.intro: Double Ratchet no de Diffie-Hellman ratchet ne symmetric-key chain bom. Nkrasɛm biara ma ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no kɔ anim; bere ne bere mu DH ratchets san-key ntini no. Ɛde kokoamsɛm a ɛkɔ anim (nkrasɛm a atwam a ahobammɔ wom wɔ apam akyi) ne ahobammɔ akyi ahobammɔ (daakye nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom bere a wɔasan ayɛ ratchet akyi) ma.
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Double Ratchet no de Diffie-Hellman ratchet ne symmetric-key chain bom. Nkrasɛm biara ma ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no kɔ anim; bere ne bere mu DH ratchets san-key ntini no. Ɛde kokoamsɛm a ɛkɔ anim (nkrasɛm a atwam a ahobammɔ wom wɔ apam akyi) ne ahobammɔ akyi ahobammɔ (daakye nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom bere a wɔasan ayɛ ratchet akyi) ma.
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex de Double Ratchet di dwuma ma nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛde nkrasɛm kɔ tẽẽ. Kuw adan mu de sender-key nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde keyed off the room root di dwuma. Chain tenten capped wɔ 1000 nkrasɛm ansa na wɔhyɛ re-ratchet; skipped-key cache a ɛkɔ soro kodu 1000 a ɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe; header encryption no wɔ default so.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Trevor Perrin ne Moxie Marlinspike na wɔyɛɛ no ​​wɔ afe 2013 mu; wɔde dii dwuma wɔ Signal 2014 mu; a WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Kokoam Nkɔmmɔbɔ, Skype Kokoam Nkɔmmɔbɔ gye toom. Public spec 2016. Vortex no dwumadie yɛ hyɛn gyinabea tẽẽ.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wɔde mena: CK_soma → HKDF(CK_soma, "anamɔn") → CK_soma'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_soma, "nkrasɛm")
nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wogye: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "anammɔn") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(yɛn_eph, wɔn_eph), RK_kan)

ech.h1_a: ECH de SNI (Server Name Indication) sie wɔ TLS 1.3 denam ClientHello a ɛwɔ mu no a ɔbɛkyekyere wɔ ClientHello a ɛwɔ akyi a wɔabɔ no kokoam wɔ ɔmanfo safoa a wɔatintim wɔ DNS HTTPS kyerɛwtohɔ no ase no so.

DPI ntumi nkyerɛ Vortex akraman bi mfi Cloudflare adetɔfo foforo biara hɔ.
ech.h1_c: ECH faa 5 IETF drafts ansa na standardization sɛ RFC 9460 wɔ afe 2024. Kan nsakraeɛ: ESNI (2018-2019, wɔagyae), ECH draft-00 kɔ draft-13 (2020-2024). Chrome maa ECH yɛɛ adwuma default wɔ afe 2023 mu; Firefox wɔ afe 2024. Vortex boa no firi v0.0.9.

ed25519.title: Ed25519 na ɛwɔ hɔ
ed25519.subtitle: EdDSA nsaano nkyerɛwee wɔ edwards25519 (RFC 8032) so.
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 yɛ elliptic-curve nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe. 32-byte ɔmanfo safe, 64-byte nsaano nkyerɛwee, deterministic nsaano nkyerɛwee default. Ntɛmntɛm a wogye tom (~200 μs wɔ nnɛyi CPU so), batch-verifiable.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 yɛ elliptic-curve nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe. 32-byte ɔmanfo safe, 64-byte nsaano nkyerɛwee, deterministic nsaano nkyerɛwee default. Ntɛmntɛm a wogye tom (~200 μs wɔ nnɛyi CPU so), batch-verifiable.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex de Ed25519 de ne nsa hyɛ federation envelope biara ase, integrity manifest biara, node adansedi biara, ne bot nkra biara ase. Apple CryptoKit a ɛwɔ iOS 17+ so no de RFC 8032bis a wɔanhyɛ da ayɛ no di dwuma; Vortex gye emu biara tom — verifier biara a ɛne mmara hyia no di abien no nyinaa ho dwuma.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 no, Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang na wotintimii wɔ afe 2011. Wɔde gyinaa so sɛ RFC 8032 wɔ afe 2017. OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol na ɛgye toom. Wɔpaw deterministic signing pefee sen ECDSA sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛkwati ECDSA RNG-reuse vulnerability class no.
ed25519.h1_f:
Nsɛnkyerɛnne(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              sanba (R, S) .
Hwɛ sɛ: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G na ɛwɔ hɔ

fanout.title: Fan-out na ɛwɔ hɔ
fanout.subtitle: Adeyɛ bi a wɔbɛbɔ ho amanneɛ afi baabi biako akɔma wɔn a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din pii.
fanout.intro: Fan-out yɛ architectural pattern a producer baako yi event bi na N consumers nya. Wɔ Vortex WebSocket layer mu no, nkra biako POST kanyan N socket sends — biako wɔ subscriber biara a ɔwɔ dan no mu.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out yɛ architectural pattern a producer baako yi event bi na N consumers nya. Wɔ Vortex WebSocket layer mu no, nkra biako POST kanyan N socket sends — biako wɔ subscriber biara a ɔwɔ dan no mu.
fanout.h1_b: Wɔde di dwuma sɛ dan biara mu WebSocket nsa a asyncio.Lock wɛn so. Twerɛ nya, kɔpi set no, gyae, afei iterates kɔpi a ɛretwɛn `ws.send_bytes(payload)` ne per-socket 1 s timeout. Adetɔfo a wɔyɛ brɛoo no wɔ 256-frame queue ansa na frame ahorow no akɔ fam.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out san kɔ tintim/subscribe nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ 1980 mfe no mu (POP, TIBCO). Nnɛyi mfonini ahorow (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) ma nhwɛso no yɛ kɛse ma nnipa ɔpepem pii a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din. Vortex no per-room in-memory fan-out yɛ ketewaa bi efisɛ enhia cross-node replication wɔ single-node mode mu; Redis pub/sub yɛ adwuma wɔ multi-node akuwakuw mu.
fanout.h1_f:
broadcast (dan_id, adesoa a mfaso wɔ so):
  subs = fanout [dan_id] # O (1) dict hwehwɛ
  ma ws wɔ snapshot(subs): # kɔpi kɔ iterate dwoodwoo
      twɛn ws.send_bytes (payload, bere a etwa to = 1s)
fanout.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, ɔkwan a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara ma nkra biara, adeyɛ, typing event, frɛ sɛnkyerɛnne.
fanout.h3_a: WebSocket, obi a ɔkyerɛw ne din, Redis pub/sub, ntonto

fcm.h1_a: FCM yɛ Google no push-notification dwumadie ma Android, iOS, wɛb. Wɔde Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) dedaw no sii ananmu wɔ afe 2016. Gye OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex de FCM di dwuma wɔ `data` mode mu (ɛnyɛ `notification` mode) enti app no ​​FirebaseMessagingService no tu mmirika bere a ɛba no na ɛdecrypt sealed-push payload no ansa na asi gyinae sɛ ebia ɔbɛkyerɛ banner. Silent-delivery wake-ups nso de FCM data nkrasɛm di dwuma.
fcm.h1_c: FCM a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 2016 mu de sii GCM ananmu. Wɔpoo agyapadeɛ HTTP awiei no wɔ afe 2024 mu; Vortex de HTTP v1 awiei no di dwuma ne OAuth2. Wɔnam service-account credentials a wɔaboaboa ano so na ɛyɛ token rotation dɔnhwerew biara automated.
