federation.title: Federation a ɛwɔ hɔ
federation.subtitle: Mutual-trust nkrasɛm a wɔde ma wɔ ahofadi Vortex nodes ntam.
federation.intro: Federation yɛ mutual-trust link a ɛda node operators mmienu ntam. Obiara de ɔfoforo no Ed25519 pubkey ka ne `federations` pon no ho. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node A so no betumi de nkra akɔma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node B so denam envelopes a wɔde fa `POST /federation/deliver` a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase so.
federation.h1_a: Federation yɛ mutual-trust link a ɛda node operators mmienu ntam. Obiara de ɔfoforo no Ed25519 pubkey ka ne `federations` pon no ho. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node A so no betumi de nkra akɔma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ node B so denam envelopes a wɔde fa `POST /federation/deliver` a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase so.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in per operator: "node biara betumi ayɛ federate" default biara nni hɔ. Peer a wode bɛka ho no hwehwɛ sɛ operator-signed admin action. Akwahosan ho nkontaahyɛde (AIMD ±1) ma federation no gyina mfɛfo a wɔnyɛ wɔn ade yiye so. Outbox retries adi nkogu deliveries a exponential backoff kɔsi nnafua 14.
federation.h1_c: Federation yɛ Matrix owudifoɔ afã (2014) na ansa na ɛno reba no XMPP/Jabber (1999). Vortex nhyehyeɛ no firi mmienu no nyinaa mu: envelopes a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ (Matrix), ahotosoɔ anchors a ɛda adi pefee (biara nni hɔ — yɛyɛ katee), akwahosan nkontabuo (AIMD firi TCP). Wɔde kaa ho wɔ v0.0.5 mu.
federation.h1_f:
envelope = {fibea_node, botae_ɔdefo, mu_ct, mu_nonce, asoma_wɔ}
sig = Ed25519-Nsɛnkyerɛnne (fibea_priv, CBOR (envelope))
POST /federation/de kɔma {envelope, sig} .
B di ho adanse: sig tia federations [source_node].pubkey
federation.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

fts5.title: FTS5 .
fts5.subtitle: SQLite no nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw nyinaa-hwehwɛ virtual pon.
fts5.intro: FTS5 yɛ SQLite awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so anum a ɛyɛ nsɛm nyinaa hwehwɛ ntrɛwmu. Yɛ virtual table a ɛkora tokenised indexes ma LIKE / MATCH nsɛmmisa ntɛmntɛm.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 yɛ SQLite awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so anum a ɛyɛ nsɛm nyinaa hwehwɛ ntrɛwmu. Yɛ virtual table a ɛkora tokenised indexes ma LIKE / MATCH nsɛmmisa ntɛmntɛm.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex kyerɛ plaintext tokens (client-encrypted sɛ opaque tags) kɔ FTS5 virtual table mu enti hwehwɛ no bɔ `O(log n)` mmom sen sɛ ɛbɛbɔ `O(n)` scans. Wɔ Android's Room so no, wɔde FTS4 di dwuma ne triggers a ɛma virtual table no kɔ so yɛ sync. Postgres deployments de `tsvector` / `tsquery` di dwuma ma atirimpɔw koro no ara.
fts5.h1_c: FTS san kɔ SQLite 3.7 (2010) so. FTS5 a wɔde kɔmaa wɔ SQLite 3.9 (2015) mu. Wɔagye atom kɛse; local-first messaging app biara a ɛwɔ iOS / Android so no de di dwuma. Postgres anya `tsvector` fi 8.3 (2008).
fts5.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

gossip.title: Gossip na ɛyɛ
gossip.subtitle: Peer-list nsakrae a ɛba bere ne bere mu wɔ Vortex nodes ntam.
gossip.intro: Gossip yɛ bandwidth-efficient protocol a node biara ne random peer sesa nimdeɛ a wɔaboaboa ano bere ne bere mu. Bere kɔ so no node biara hyia kɔ view koro no ara a enni central directory.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip yɛ bandwidth-efficient protocol a node biara ne random peer sesa nimdeɛ a wɔaboaboa ano bere ne bere mu. Bere kɔ so no node biara hyia kɔ view koro no ara a enni central directory.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes no bɔ nsɛmmɔne wɔ sikani 60 biara mu. Nsesa biara yɛ 256-bit Bloom filter a ɛbɔ atipɛnfo a wonim wɔn no mua; ɔfã foforo no de atipɛnfo a wɔyera wɔ filter no mu ne n’ankasa filter no bua. Bandwidth yɛ O(atipɛnfo foforo × 32 B), mpɛn pii no ɛba fam sen 1 KiB wɔ round biara mu.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter nsɛmmɔnedi fi ase wɔ Cornell 1998 bimodal multicast krataa. Apache Cassandra de di dwuma de yɛ asɔremma; Bitcoin ma nkitahodi relay; IPFS ma DHT nsiesie. O(log N) convergence no ne deɛ ɛma ɛyɛ adwuma ma network akɛseɛ.
gossip.h1_f:
nsesa(A, B): .
  A → B: filter_A = hyɛ_ne nyinaa (atipɛnfo_A, k = 5, m = 256)
  B → A: atipɛnfo_foforo_ma_A = {p ∈ atipɛnfo_B : p ∉ filter_A}, filter_B
  A yiyi fi mu saa ara
rate limit: 1 nsakrae wɔ atipɛnfo biara mu wɔ s 30 biara mu
gossip.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

gravitix.title: Gravitix .
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL a wɔde kyerɛw bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix yɛ kasa a ɛfa domain pɔtee bi ho a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛw Vortex bots. Event-driven handlers (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), tebea a wɔasisi, boilerplate a ɛba fam koraa. Wɔaboaboa ano akɔ bytecode mu na wɔayɛ no wɔ sandboxed interpreter mu.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix yɛ kasa a ɛfa domain pɔtee bi ho a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛw Vortex bots. Event-driven handlers (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), tebea a wɔasisi, boilerplate a ɛba fam koraa. Wɔaboaboa ano akɔ bytecode mu na wɔayɛ no wɔ sandboxed interpreter mu.
gravitix.h1_b: Ɔkwan foforo a wɔfa so yɛ Python SDK. Gravitix bots ntumi nkɔ faelsystem anaa ntwamutam a wɔpɛ — Vortex API soro nkutoo. Compiler no yɛ bytecode; Rust mmirikatu bere a ɛwɔ `Gravitix/` mu no kyerɛ ase. Nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ wɔ Gravitix docs ti no mu.
gravitix.h1_c: Wɔyɛɛ no ​​wɔ v0.0.6 bere mu akyi a wɔhwɛɛ sɛ bot code dodow no ara yɛ 80 % SDK boilerplate twa kernel ketewa bi a ɛyɛ nokware ntease ho hyia. A DSL ma nteaseɛ no hyerɛn na sandboxes de asiane ba. Ɛte sɛ Hubot (2011) wɔ honhom mu nanso ɛwɔ sandboxing a ɛyɛ katee ne native Vortex nkabom.
gravitix.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` repo ntini, bot koodu afuw wɔ `POST /api/bots` mu.
gravitix.h3_a: bot, gua so, anhwea adaka, Architex

hkdf.title: HKDF .
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-gyina Key Derivation Dwumadi (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF yɛ anammɔn mmienu safoa derivation dwumadie: Extract mia input key material no mu kɔ pseudo-random key (PRK); Expand trɛw PRK no mu kɔ output key material a ne tenten biara yɛ, a info labels na ɛtetew mu.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF yɛ anammɔn mmienu safoa derivation dwumadie: Extract mia input key material no mu kɔ pseudo-random key (PRK); Expand trɛw PRK no mu kɔ output key material a ne tenten biara yɛ, a info labels na ɛtetew mu.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex de HKDF-SHA256 di dwuma wɔ baabiara: ɔkyekyɛ X25519 ahintasɛm a wɔakyekyɛ mu ma ɛyɛ encryption + MAC + header keys, nya per-chunk fael keys, nya backup keys fi Argon2id output mu. Info nhama bere nyinaa kura version prefix (e.g. "v1:encryption") enti safoa nhyehyɛe no nyinaa betumi adi akɔneaba denam v1 → v2 a wobɛbɔ so.
hkdf.h1_c: Hugo Krawczyk na ɔtintim no wɔ EUROCRYPT 2010; standardized sɛ RFC 5869 afe koro no ara. TLS 1.3 de di dwuma ma ne nhyehyɛe, Signal ma Double Ratchet, WireGuard ma session keys.
hkdf.h1_f:
Nneɛma a wɔayi afi mu: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(nkyene, IKM) .
Trɛw mu: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, nsɛm ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ nsɛm ∥ i) .
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... wɔatwitwa mu ayɛ no len
hkdf.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
hkdf.h3_a: HMAC, X25519, AES-GCM, Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Nneɛma Mmienu

hmac.title: HMAC .
hmac.subtitle: Hash-based Nkrasɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma Mmara (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC yɛ adansi a ɛdane cryptographic hash biara (SHA-256, SHA-512) yɛ no MAC. Ɛma nokwaredi ne nokwaredi a wɔde ama ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC yɛ adansi a ɛdane cryptographic hash biara (SHA-256, SHA-512) yɛ no MAC. Ɛma nokwaredi ne nokwaredi a wɔde ama ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex de HMAC-SHA256 di dwuma wɔ HKDF mu, ma JWT nsaano nkyerɛwee (HS256), ma sender_pseudo derivation wɔ adan mu, ne coturn TURN credential signing. Daa-bere ntotoho hia wɔ nokwaredi fã — `hmac.compare_digest` wɔ Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC no, Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk na wɔde baeɛ wɔ afe 1996. Wɔde gyinapɛn sii hɔ sɛ RFC 2104 (1997) ne FIPS 198 (2002). Ɛbɛyɛɛ default MAC wɔ TLS, IPsec, SSH mu. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack nyinaa de HMAC-SHA256 di dwuma ma wɔn JWT ne session tokens.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(safoa, nkrasɛm) = H( (safoa ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (safoa ⊕ ipad) ∥ nkrasɛm ) )
  baabi a opad = 0x5c a wɔasan ayɛ, ipad = 0x36 a wɔasan ayɛ, block kɛse ne H hyia
hmac.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
hmac.h2_a: Baabiara wɔ crypto stack no mu. Grep ma `hmac_sha256` anaa `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, daa-bere toto ho

ice.title: ICE .
ice.subtitle: Nkitahodi a Wɔde Sisi Nkitahodi (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE yɛ WebRTC adwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nkitahodi kwan a ɛda atipɛnfo baanu a wɔwɔ NAT akyi ntam. Atipɛnfo kan wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn (host, server-reflexive, relay), sesa wɔn, na wɔsɔ wɔn baanu hwɛ kosi sɛ obiako bedi nkonim.
ice.h1_a: ICE yɛ WebRTC adwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nkitahodi kwan a ɛda atipɛnfo baanu a wɔwɔ NAT akyi ntam. Atipɛnfo kan wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn (host, server-reflexive, relay), sesa wɔn, na wɔsɔ wɔn baanu hwɛ kosi sɛ obiako bedi nkonim.
ice.h1_b: Vortex node brokers ICE kandifo sesa denam WebSocket sɛnkyerɛnne so. coturn de STUN (ma srflx a wobehu) ne TURN (ma relay bere a akwan tẽẽ di nkogu) ma. Wɔde HMAC adansedi nkrataa a ɛtra hɔ bere tiaa bi ma wɔ ɔfrɛ biara mu.
ice.h1_c: Wɔde ICE yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 5245 (2010) na wɔsan yɛɛ no ​​foforo sɛ RFC 8445 (2018). Wɔ carrier-grade NAT akyi no, akwan tẽẽ di nkogu ~15 % wɔ bere no mu — TURN relay yɛ nea wontumi nkwati. WebRTC maa ICE yɛɛ ade titiriw; video-frɛ biara de di dwuma.
ice.h1_f:
wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ dibea:
  ahɔhoyɛfo : rtp 192.168.1.5:49152 (ɛhɔnom IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-wɔahu ɔmanfoɔ kasa)
  relay : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-a wɔde ama relay)
pair check: STUN Adesrɛ a wɔde kyekyere; baanu a edi kan a wobedi nkonim = wɔapaw
ice.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, akyi kwan, NAT kwan a wɔfa so twa

jwt.title: JWT .
jwt.subtitle: JSON Wɛbsaet Token (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT yɛ compact token format a ɛwɔ base64-url-encoded afã abiɛsa: header, payload (claims), signature. Wɔde di dwuma ma stateless session nokwaredi.
jwt.h1_a: JWT yɛ compact token format a ɛwɔ base64-url-encoded afã abiɛsa: header, payload (claims), signature. Wɔde di dwuma ma stateless session nokwaredi.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex de HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWT ahorow di dwuma. Akwankyerɛ token kura `{sub: ɔdefo_id, jti: mfiri_id, typ: kwan, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Refresh token `typ: yɛ foforo`, 30 d TTL. Wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase wɔ 64-byte ahintasɛm a efi `.env` so. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ mmerɛw biara nni hɔ a ɛboro user_id so.
jwt.h1_c: Wɔde JWT ahorow no yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 na ama wɔagye din firi afe 2012. Mfeɛ du a wɔde kasa tia: alg-confusion ntua, a wɔannye antom. Vortex brɛ ase: HS256 nkutoo (RS/ES adwene mu naayɛ biara nni hɔ), device-keyed jti (wotumi san fa user_devices so).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE
asɛmti = base64url ({alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT"})
payload = base64url ({sub, jti, typ, nkyerɛkyerɛmu})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256 (ahintasɛm, ti + "." + adesoa a mfaso wɔ so))
jwt.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, token a wɔde yɛ foforo, token a wɔde kɔ hɔ

kyber.title: Kyber-768 na ɔkyerɛwee
kyber.subtitle: Akyi quantum safoa encapsulation (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (wɔ aban kwan so ML-KEM-768) yɛ NIST no standardized post-quantum key encapsulation afiri. 1184-byte ɔmanfo safe, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ. Ahobammɔ so tew kɔ Module-LWE, a wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (wɔ aban kwan so ML-KEM-768) yɛ NIST no standardized post-quantum key encapsulation afiri. 1184-byte ɔmanfo safe, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ. Ahobammɔ so tew kɔ Module-LWE, a wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex de Kyber di dwuma sɛnea ɔpɛ wɔ afrafra mu: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Sɛ fã biara kura mu a, nhyiam no yɛ nea asiane biara nni ho. Opt-in wɔ v0.1 mu, on-by-default a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe ama v0.2. Ɛka: ~2 KB foforo wɔ nhyiam biara nsa a wɔde bɔ; latency a wontumi mmu ani ngu so.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber yɛ ~70 a wɔde kɔmaa NIST PQ akansi (2016) no mu baako. Wɔpaw no sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ gyinapɛn wɔ July 2022 mu; wiee sɛ FIPS 203 wɔ August 2024. Chrome maa hybrid Kyber yɛɛ adwuma wɔ TLS 1.3 wɔ afe 2024. Signal de kaa wɔn protocol ho afe koro no ara.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio
Decaps (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so
hybrid = HKDF (x25519_fi ∥ kyber_fi, "nhyiam-v1")
kyber.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
kyber.h2_a: `app / ahobammɔ / akyi_quantum.py`, iOS `VortexCrypto.KyberKEM`, Android `crypto / pqc / KyberKEM`.
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, a ɛko tia quantum, ɛyɛ afrafra KEM .

mailbox.title: Nkrataa adaka
mailbox.subtitle: Ɔgyefoɔ-address akoraeɛ slot wɔ BMP.
mailbox.intro: Nkra adaka yɛ BMP abstraction a ɛkyerɛ "beae a nkrasɛm ma nea wɔde ama no twɛn". Wɔde 32-byte `mailbox_id` a wonya fi nea ogye no pubkey mu denam HKDF so na ɛkyerɛ.
mailbox.h1_a: Nkra adaka yɛ BMP abstraction a ɛkyerɛ "beae a nkrasɛm ma nea wɔde ama no twɛn". Wɔde 32-byte `mailbox_id` a wonya fi nea ogye no pubkey mu denam HKDF so na ɛkyerɛ.
mailbox.h1_b: Ɔdefoɔ (a ɔnim recipient_pubkey) ne deɛ ɔgye (a ɔnim wɔn ankasa pubkey) nko ara na wɔbɛtumi abɔ mailbox_id a wɔde ama no ho akontaa. Mfinimfini nodes hu opaque 32-byte identifier no nkutoo. Nkrataa adaka biara wɔ TTL 7200 s na adekorabea cap 500 MB wɔ node biara mu.
mailbox.h1_c: Asɛmfua no fi tete email mu. BMP fɛm kasakoa no nanso ɔma mailbox no yɛ nea efi nea ogye no mu mmom sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nea wɔde server ama — "mailbox creation" anammɔn biara nni hɔ, server biara nni hɔ a onim address ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (ogyefo_pubkey, nsɛm = "bmp-v1", len = 32)
nea ɔde kɔma (onim recipient_pk) ne nea ogye (onim n’ankasa pk) nkutoo na wobetumi ayɛ akontaabu
mailbox.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, nsɛmmɔnedi, HKDF, ɔsomafo a wɔasɔ no ano

nonce.title: Nonce a ɛnyɛ nokware
nonce.subtitle: Nnɔmba a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro — a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro botae.
nonce.intro: Nonce yɛ botae a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsan yɛ bio da wɔ safoa bi a wɔde ama ase. Wɔ Vortex mu no AES-GCM dwumadie biara de 96-bit random nonce foforɔ di dwuma. Sɛ wosan de nonce a ɛwɔ safoa koro no ara di dwuma a, ɛsɛe kokoamsɛm ne nokware — ɔtowhyɛfo a ɔwɔ ciphertext abien wɔ ade koro ase (safoa, nonce) betumi asan anya plaintext XORs.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce yɛ botae a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsan yɛ bio da wɔ safoa bi a wɔde ama ase. Wɔ Vortex mu no AES-GCM dwumadie biara de 96-bit random nonce foforɔ di dwuma. Sɛ wosan de nonce a ɛwɔ safoa koro no ara di dwuma a, ɛsɛe kokoamsɛm ne nokware — ɔtowhyɛfo a ɔwɔ ciphertext abien wɔ ade koro ase (safoa, nonce) betumi asan anya plaintext XORs.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex de OS CSPRNG (`ahintasɛm.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`) no yɛ nonces. Birthday bound with 96 bits: ~2^32 messages before collision becomes plausible, ɛboro nea dan safe biara hu wɔ ne nkwa nna mu koraa. Defensive duplicate-nonce tracking wɔ node no so sɛ abɔso-ne-suspenders.
nonce.h1_c: Nonce adwene no yɛ tete de wɔ cryptography mu; asɛmfua no ankasa fi Borɔfo Dedaw mu "for the once". GCM 96-bit nyansahyɛ no fi NIST SP 800-38D. Adobe 2013 mmara sobu no agye din sɛ ɛsan nyaa nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den fi nonces a wɔsan yɛe wɔ client-side RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(abɔne) wɔ 109 AES-GCM nonces = ~10−19
awoda bound: nea edi kan a wɔbɛbɔ kwan a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ bɛyɛ 248 nonces wɔ safe biara mu
GCM ahobammɔ: 232 random nonces wɔ safoa biara mu ansa na bound asɛe
nonce.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
nonce.h2_a: AES-GCM frɛ biara. Counter di akyi defensively wɔ `app / ahobammɔ / crypto.py`.
nonce.h3_a: AES-GCM, CSPRNG, awoda a wɔakyekyere, AEAD .

ohttp.title: OHTTP .
ohttp.subtitle: Wɔn a wɔn ani da hɔ HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP yɛ protocol ma relayed HTTP abisadeɛ a ɔfa baako biara nhunu abisadeɛ ne mmuaeɛ no nyinaa. Client no nam relay a ɛyi headers a ɛkyerɛ no so soma; relay no kɔ n’anim kɔ gateway a ɛdecrypt na ɛbua no.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP yɛ protocol ma relayed HTTP abisadeɛ a ɔfa baako biara nhunu abisadeɛ ne mmuaeɛ no nyinaa. Client no nam relay a ɛyi headers a ɛkyerɛ no so soma; relay no kɔ n’anim kɔ gateway a ɛdecrypt na ɛbua no.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex de OHTTP di dwuma sɛ Layer-5 sum ase fallback. Sɛ wɔde onion service ne BMP ka ho a, OHTTP ma ɔkwan a etwa to bere a TLS asiw koraa no. Relay no yɛ ahotoso a wɔatew mu (mpɛn pii no Cloudflare anaa Apple no kokoam-relay nhyehyɛe).
ohttp.h1_c: Wɔde OHTTP yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 9458 wɔ afe 2024 mu, Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla na wɔbom kyerɛw. Apple iCloud Private Relay (2021) yɛ ntɛm OHTTP-a ɛbɛn dwumadie. Vortex de OHTTP fallback mmoa kaa ho wɔ v0.0.9 mu.
ohttp.h1_f:
akraman → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub (abisade) + random-routing info
relay → gateway: kɔ anim, yi afɛfo-a ɛkyerɛ atiri
gateway → mmuae: decrypt, dwumadie, Encrypt_client_pub (mmuaeɛ) .
relay → client: mmuae a wɔde kɔ anim
ohttp.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

onion.title: Onion som adwuma
onion.subtitle: Tor som a wɔde asie.
onion.intro: Onion service yɛ TCP dwumadie a wotumi fa Tor rendezvous protocol so nya. Wɔde onion address (nkyerɛwde 56 base32 a ɛwɔ Ed25519 pubkey a ɛwɔ v3 so) na ɛkyerɛ. Ɔmanfoɔ IP biara nni hɔ, DNS biara nni hɔ, mfimfini nkyerɛwdeɛ biara nni hɔ.
onion.h1_a: Onion service yɛ TCP dwumadie a wotumi fa Tor rendezvous protocol so nya. Wɔde onion address (nkyerɛwde 56 base32 a ɛwɔ Ed25519 pubkey a ɛwɔ v3 so) na ɛkyerɛ. Ɔmanfoɔ IP biara nni hɔ, DNS biara nni hɔ, mfimfini nkyerɛwdeɛ biara nni hɔ.
onion.h1_b: Vortex node biara da ne ho adi sɛ `.onion` ne ne HTTPS awiei a ɛyɛ daa no nso. Clients a wɔwɔ Tor support no hwe ase kɔ onion so bere a biribiara a aka no di nkogu no. Bandwidth yɛ ~10× brɛoo nanso wotumi du ho wɔ networks a wɔabara koraa mu.
onion.h1_c: Onion som no fi Tor 2004 (v1) mu. Wɔsan sii sɛ v3 onion services wɔ afe 2017 mu a Ed25519 nsafe. SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, ahyehyɛde atitiriw a wonim crypto nyinaa na wɔde di dwuma. Signal de onion-service delivery kaa ho wɔ afe 2022 mu.
onion.h1_f:
address = base32 (Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ nkyerɛase_baiti) ∥ ".onion".
          = nkyerɛwde 56 wɔ v3 onion so
onion.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
onion.h2_a: `/etc/tor/torrc` wɔ `deploy/` mu, wɔatintim denam controller `/v1/mirrors` so.
onion.h3_a: Tor, Sukyerɛmma, BMP, akwantuo a wotumi de hyɛ mu

prekey.title: Prekey a wɔde di dwuma
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey tintimii ansa na bere ama bootstrap a DM foforo.
prekey.intro: Prekey yɛ X25519 keypair a wɔtintim kɔ node no so ansa na ɛho hia sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nkitahodifoɔ foforɔ bɛtumi ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a wɔabɔ no kokoam ase a wɔrenkɔ ne baabiara. Obiara a ɔde di dwuma no de batch bi gu so (prekeys 10 default); server som wɔn sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ; client uploads pii bere a ɛba fam.
prekey.h1_a: Prekey yɛ X25519 keypair a wɔtintim kɔ node no so ansa na ɛho hia sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nkitahodifoɔ foforɔ bɛtumi ahyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a wɔabɔ no kokoam ase a wɔrenkɔ ne baabiara. Obiara a ɔde di dwuma no de batch bi gu so (prekeys 10 default); server som wɔn sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ; client uploads pii bere a ɛba fam.
prekey.h1_b: Vortex no prekey bundle no, wɔde device no bere tenten identity key no de ne nsa ahyɛ ase sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a attacker ntumi nsakra forged prekeys mpo wɔ node-level access mu. DM foforo de Diffie-Hellman a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa biako di dwuma tia prekey foforo ansa na Double Ratchet no abɔ mu.
prekey.h1_c: Prekeys no firi Signal 2013 protocol nhyehyeɛ (X3DH) mu. Ansa na X3DH reba no, na encrypted bootstrap hwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ synchronous roundtrips — bɔne ma asynchronous nkrasɛm. Nnɛyi ɔbɔfo biara a ɔwɔ ahobammɔ de prekey-style bootstrap di dwuma.
prekey.h1_f:
bundle = { .
  identity_pk, .
  wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ_prekey_pk, .
  signed_prekey_sig = Ed25519-Sign (identity_priv, wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase_prekey_pk),
  bere_pɛnkoro_prekeys: [pk_0, pk_1, ..., pk_9].
} .
prekey.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Double Ratchet, X3DH, safoa a wɔsesa

reality.title: Nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ nokware
reality.subtitle: TLS-mu-TLS masquerade sum ase akwantu.
reality.intro: Nokwasɛm yɛ sum ase akwantu a ɛyɛ ne ho sɛ TLS kɔ mfiridwuma kɛse mfiase ankasa (mpɛn pii no www.microsoft.com). Abɔnten nsa a wɔde bɔ wɔn ani so Microsoft; nsa a wɔde bɔ mu no yɛ Vortex. Active probes a wɔde kyerɛ akyi no nya forwarded to the real origin enti probing da biribiara adi.
reality.h1_a: Nokwasɛm yɛ sum ase akwantu a ɛyɛ ne ho sɛ TLS kɔ mfiridwuma kɛse mfiase ankasa (mpɛn pii no www.microsoft.com). Abɔnten nsa a wɔde bɔ wɔn ani so Microsoft; nsa a wɔde bɔ mu no yɛ Vortex. Active probes a wɔde kyerɛ akyi no nya forwarded to the real origin enti probing da biribiara adi.
reality.h1_b: Vortex boa Reality sɛ Level-4 pluggable akwantuo. Config kyerɛ masquerade botaeɛ, ID ntiantiaa, ne Vortex X25519 ɔmanfoɔ safoa. Server di akraman a wɔba no ho adanse denam short-ID match so; nhwehwɛmu a ɛnyɛ pɛ nya mmuae a efi mfiase ankasa.
reality.h1_c: Wɔtintim nokwasɛm wɔ afe 2022 mu sɛ mmuaeɛ a wɔde maa China Great Firewall a ɛhunu akwantuo a atwam a ɛgyina TLS so (V2Ray VMess, Trojan). XrayCore gye toom wɔ afe 2023. Vortex de mmoa kaa ho wɔ v0.0.9 mu.
reality.h1_f:
akyi nsa a wɔde bɔ: TLS kosi Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
mu (sɛ auth ok): Vortex traffic wɔ data kwan bi so
probe mmuae: microsoft.com mmuae ankasa a wɔde kɔma ɔtowhyɛfo
                    ⇒ observer hu "yeah, ɛyɛ microsoft.com" nkutoo.
reality.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
reality.h3_a: sum ase, akwantu a wotumi de hyɛ mu, Trojan, VMess

rbac.title: RBAC .
rbac.subtitle: Dwumadie a Egyina Akwankyerɛ so.
rbac.intro: RBAC yɛ access-control model a wɔma kwan ma dwumadie ahodoɔ na wɔma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no dwumadie. Vortex de RBAC a ɛwɔ abansoro abiɛsa di dwuma wɔ dan biara mu: owura > admin > member.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC yɛ access-control model a wɔma kwan ma dwumadie ahodoɔ na wɔma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no dwumadie. Vortex de RBAC a ɛwɔ abansoro abiɛsa di dwuma wɔ dan biara mu: owura > admin > member.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: wuranom wɔ admin tumi biara a ɛka ho ne tumi soronko a wɔde popa dan no anaasɛ wɔde bɛdan wurayɛ. Admins to nsa frɛ, kick, mute, sesa dan nhyehyɛe. Asɔremma de nkra mena, wɔyɛ wɔn ade, sesa wɔn ankasa nkrasɛm. Wɔkyerɛw dwumadie nsakraeɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nkrasɛm sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a asɔremma biara bɛhunu.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC sɛ nhwɛsode a ɛyɛ mmara kwan so de no fi NIST krataa a Ferraiolo & Kuhn kyerɛwee wɔ 1992 mu no so. Ɔbɛyɛɛ adeɛ titire wɔ adwumayɛ mu IAM (AWS, Azure) wɔ afe 2010 mfeɛ no mu. Room-level RBAC yɛ gyinapɛn wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ nneɛma mu — IRC no ops/nne/ɔdefo (1988), Discord dwumadi ahorow (2015), Slack admin/member/ahɔho.
rbac.h1_f:
dwumadie: owura ⊃ admin ⊃ ɔmannifoɔ
transfer: owura no hyehyɛ new_owner_id → owura dedaw no demoted to admin
revoke: admin betumi abrɛ ɔmannifo bi ase; owura betumi demote admin bi ase
rbac.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, wɔahwɛ wɔ ɔkwan biara a wɔfa so kyerɛw mu denam `app/chats/permissions.py` so.

sfu.title: SFU .
sfu.subtitle: Selective Forwarding Unit a Wɔde Kɔma Nnipa.
sfu.intro: SFU yɛ mfinimfini adaka a ɛfrafra media wɔ kuw frɛ mu. Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no de asuten biako gu so; SFU no de kɔma afoforo no. Ɛsesa full-mesh topology (peer biara encodes N-1 streams) baabi a scaling yɛ O(N2).
sfu.h1_a: SFU yɛ mfinimfini adaka a ɛfrafra media wɔ kuw frɛ mu. Obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no de asuten biako gu so; SFU no de kɔma afoforo no. Ɛsesa full-mesh topology (peer biara encodes N-1 streams) baabi a scaling yɛ O(N2).
sfu.h1_b: Vortex's SFU no wɔde di dwuma wɔ Rust mu ma adwumayɛ. Simulcast-aware: obiara a ɔfrɛ no de encode resolutions abiɛsa bere koro mu; SFU no paw nea ɛfata wɔ ɔhwɛfo biara a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ downlink. Akuw a wɔde ɔdio nkutoo na ɛyɛ akuw a ɛkɔ soro kodu 100 a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu; video akuw a ɛkɔ soro kodu 32 (v0.3 kwankyerɛ).
sfu.h1_c: SFU adansiɛ no firi Jitsi Videobridge (2013) mu. Ansa na SFU reba no, na WebRTC kuw frɛ no yɛ full-mesh. Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi, Signal kuw frɛ nyinaa de di dwuma SFU. Vortex akuw a wɔde ɔdio nkutoo na wɔde mena wɔ v0.0.8 mu.
sfu.h1_f:
full mesh (N peers): emu biara de N-1 nsuten → O(N2) uplink kɔ
SFU (N atipɛnfo): obiara de asuten 1 → O(N) uplink kɔ atipɛnfo biara
simulcast: L1 (ba fam) + L2 (mfinimfini) + L3 (a ɛkorɔn) bere koro mu encodings
SFU paw layer biara a ɔhwɛ no gyina BWE-abɔ amanneɛ downlink so
sfu.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
sfu.h3_a: WebRTC, bere koro mu, ICE, TURN .

snowflake.title: Sukyerɛmma a ɛyɛ hu
snowflake.subtitle: Tor atuhoamafo-relay akwantu a ɛboro WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake yɛ Tor Project no pluggable transport a atuhoamafoɔ browsers yɛ adwuma sɛ WebRTC relays. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no install browser extension na wɔn browser no bɛyɛ relay bere a wɔwɔ tab a wɔabue.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake yɛ Tor Project no pluggable transport a atuhoamafoɔ browsers yɛ adwuma sɛ WebRTC relays. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no install browser extension na wɔn browser no bɛyɛ relay bere a wɔwɔ tab a wɔabue.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex gye Snowflake tom sɛ Layer-4 fallback bere a wɔasiw TLS ne primary transports ano. No infra required on our side — yehia Snowflake bridges a wɔatintim wɔ mmeae a wonim no yiye kɛkɛ. Atuhoamafo a wɔyɛ ntrɛwmu no de kataso ma.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake fii ase wɔ afe 2020 mu sɛ Tor Project a wɔde besi obfs4 ananmu (a na abɛyɛ nsateaa nkyerɛwee a wotumi de di dwuma). Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobesiw WebRTC akwantu no ano efisɛ sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɛbɛma video so frɛ pii a ɛfata asɛe. Vortex de mmoa aka ho wɔ v0.0.9 mu.
snowflake.h1_f:
client → Snowflake broker: "Mehia ananmusifoɔ".
broker ne atuhoamafo browser a ɛretu mmirika ntrɛwmu hyia
volunteer → Tor entry: ɔde akraman kar kɔ anim boro WebRTC .
mfasoɔ: WebRTC kar akwan wɔ baabiara; sɛ wosiw kwan a, ɛma wogyae video so frɛ ahorow
snowflake.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, akwantuo a wotumi de hyɛ mu, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Transport Layer Security, nkyerɛaseɛ 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 yɛ TLS protocol no mprempren de. Yi primitives a ahobammɔ nnim (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), ɛma nsa a wɔde bɛbɔ no yɛ mmerɛw kɔ akwantu biako a wɔde kɔ baabiara, ɛhyɛ kokoamsɛm a ɛkɔ anim.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 yɛ TLS protocol no mprempren de. Yi primitives a ahobammɔ nnim (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), ɛma nsa a wɔde bɛbɔ no yɛ mmerɛw kɔ akwantu biako a wɔde kɔ baabiara, ɛhyɛ kokoamsɛm a ɛkɔ anim.
tls13.h1_b: HTTPS + WSS + federation nkitahodi biara a ɛwɔ Vortex mu no de TLS 1.3 di dwuma. Yɛde Chrome 120 ClientHello byte-for-byte hyia enti DPI ntumi mfa nsateaa nkyerɛw yɛn sɛ wɔnyɛ browser. ECH (encrypted SNI) yɛ opt-in denam abɔnten-SNI nhyehyɛe no so.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 no yɛɛ gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 8446 wɔ August 2018 mu wɔ mfeɛ 4 ne 28 drafts akyi. Chrome, Firefox, Safari de mmoa kɔmaa wɔ afe 2018. Microsoft de kaa Windows ho wɔ afe 2020. Ɛduruu afe 2022 no na ɛyɛ wɛb akwantuo dodoɔ no ara.
tls13.h1_f:
nsa a wɔde bɔ (1-RTT): .
  Ɔdefoɔ → Ɔsomfoɔ: ƆdefoɔHello (safoa_kyɛ, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Server → Client: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Adansedi + CertifiedVerify + Wɔawie
  Client → Server: Wɔawie + Dwumadie Data
tls13.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
tls13.h2_a: TLS nkitahodi biara. Nsateaa nkyerɛwee a ɛne ne ho hyia wɔ `app/transport/stealth_level1.py` mu.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS nsateaa nkyerɛwee, JA4, anim kokoamsɛm

totp.title: TOTP .
totp.subtitle: Bere a Egyina Bere Baako Asɛmfua (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP yɛ asɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro a wonya fi ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ ne bere a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren mu. Default parameters: 30-second bere anammɔn, 6-digit koodu, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP yɛ asɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro a wonya fi ahintasɛm a wɔkyɛ ne bere a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren mu. Default parameters: 30-second bere anammɔn, 6-digit koodu, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex 2FA no de TOTP di dwuma a RFC defaults no ka ho. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no scan QR bere a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din no; koodu a wɔayɛ afi wɔn Authenticator app no ​​mu no ne server no koodu a wɔhwɛ kwan no hyia. Rate-limited to 5 mmɔdenbɔ wɔ simma 5 biara mu biara a ɔde di dwuma.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) a Mark Pei yɛeɛ a wɔsii wɔ HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Ansa na ɛno reba no, RSA SecurID de algorithm a ɛyɛ ne de di dwuma. Google Authenticator (2010) maa agye din TOTP; 2FA app biara mprempren de di dwuma.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) .
HOTP(k, c) = twa ( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
mfɛnsere: ±1 anammɔn a wɔma ho kwan ma dɔn skew
totp.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
totp.h3_a: HMAC, 2FA, adansedifo, mmara a wɔde sie

turn.title: TURN .
turn.subtitle: Traversal a Wɔde Relays Di dwuma bɛyɛ NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN yɛ protocol a wɔde fa UDP / TCP traffic fa public server so bere a peer-to-peer akwan tẽẽ no di nkogu. Wɔde di dwuma sɛ fallback kwan bere a ICE host ne server-reflexive candidates nyɛ adwuma.
turn.h1_a: TURN yɛ protocol a wɔde fa UDP / TCP traffic fa public server so bere a peer-to-peer akwan tẽẽ no di nkogu. Wɔde di dwuma sɛ fallback kwan bere a ICE host ne server-reflexive candidates nyɛ adwuma.
turn.h1_b: Vortex de coturn instance a ɛne node biara mena. Adansedi nkrataa no nkyɛ (24 h), HMAC-wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase, wɔde ma wɔ ɔfrɛ biara mu. Sɛ NAT traversal di nkogu — mpɛn pii no wɔ symmetric NAT anaa strict firewall akyi — frɛ media nyinaa sen fa TURN.
turn.h1_c: Wɔdii kan yɛɛ TURN gyinapɛn sɛ RFC 5766 (2010), wɔyɛɛ no ​​foforɔ kɔɔ RFC 8656 (2020). Wɔde di dwuma denam WebRTC deployment biara so ma ~15 % frɛ a akwan tẽẽ di nkogu. coturn ne reference open-source dwumadie.
turn.h1_f:
edin a ɔde di dwuma = "{expiry_unix}:{ɔdefo_id}".
password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_ahintasɛm, ɔdefo din))
TTL = 24 h
coturn si HMAC so dua wɔ AUTH biara so; pow bere a ne bere atwam akyi
turn.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
turn.h3_a: ICE, STUN, WebRTC, NAT twa kwan

vapid.title: VAPID .
vapid.subtitle: Aplikeshɔn Server a Wofi Wɔn Pɛ mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID yɛ Ed25519 safoa mmienu a application server de di dwuma de kyerɛ ne ho ma Web Push providers. Yi "hena na wɔma no kwan sɛ ɔsoma push" asɛmmisa no fi hɔ ma Web Push deployments.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID yɛ Ed25519 safoa mmienu a application server de di dwuma de kyerɛ ne ho ma Web Push providers. Yi "hena na wɔma no kwan sɛ ɔsoma push" asɛmmisa no fi hɔ ma Web Push deployments.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex no wɛb akraman no de node no VAPID ɔmanfo safoa no kyerɛw ne din wɔ Wɛb Push so. Wɔde sealed-push key a ɛyɛ soronko (p256dh) a ɛwɔ nkrataahyɛ biara mu no na ɛbɔ payloads. Rotation: VAPID safoa no tra ase kyɛ nanso payloads a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase no wɔ bere tiaa JWT-style expiry.
vapid.h1_c: Wɔde VAPID yɛɛ standardized sɛ RFC 8292 wɔ afe 2017. Ansa na VAPID reba no, na Web Push hwehwɛ sɛ FCM-brokered subscriptions anaasɛ auth mechanism a ɛyɛ soronko. VAPID ma self-hosted deployments yɛ mmerɛw — Firebase adwuma biara nhia.
vapid.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, wɔatintim denam controller `/v1/health` so ama wɔahu.
vapid.h3_a: Wɛb Pia, pia a wɔatoto ano, Ed25519, JWT .

waf.title: WAF .
waf.subtitle: Wɛb Dwumadie Firewall.
waf.intro: WAF yɛ mfimfini a ɛhwehwɛ HTTP abisadeɛ mu na ɛsiw nhwɛsoɔ a wonim-bɔne (SQL injection, path traversal, template injection) ansa na wɔadu application code ho.
waf.h1_a: WAF yɛ mfimfini a ɛhwehwɛ HTTP abisadeɛ mu na ɛsiw nhwɛsoɔ a wonim-bɔne (SQL injection, path traversal, template injection) ansa na wɔadu application code ho.
waf.h1_b: Vortex WAF no tu mmirika sɛ `app/ahobammɔ/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 regex nhwehwɛmu tia URL, asɛmmisa, nipadua. Blocks `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$beae`, nim XSS nhwɛso ahorow. Afei nso ɛhyɛ wiase nyinaa rate anohyeto (1000 req/s), ɔkwan biara anohyeto (login 10/min, register 5/min), obiara a ɔde di dwuma anohyeto.
waf.h1_c: WAFs no firi mod_security (2002) mu. Cloudflare's WAF (2014) de nhwɛsoɔ no yɛɛ aguadeɛ. Nnɛyi wɛb nhyehyɛe biara de nhwehwɛmu ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no mena. Wɔboaboaa Vortex regex list no ano fii OWASP Top 10 nsaano nkyerɛwee mu.
waf.h1_f:
wɔ adesrɛ biara so:
  ma nhwɛsoɔ wɔ SQLI_PATTERNS mu: sɛ nhwɛsoɔ.search (url + asɛmmisa + nipadua): po
  ma nhwɛsoɔ wɔ TRAVERSAL: sɛ nhwɛsoɔ.hwehwɛ(url): pow
  ma nhwɛsoɔ wɔ TEMPLATE: sɛ nhwɛsoɔ.hwehwɛ(nipadua): po
rate-limited keyed denam (IP, ɔkwan, ɔdefo_id) so.
waf.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .
waf.h3_a: rate anohyeto, akontaabu kyerɛwtohɔ, OWASP, SQL injection

x25519.title: X25519 .
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman wɔ Curve25519 (RFC 7748) so.
x25519.intro: X25519 yɛ elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman wɔ Curve25519 so wɔ ne Montgomery kwan so. 32-byte kokoam ne ɔmanfo safe, 32-byte a wɔkyɛ ahintasɛm. Wɔde di dwuma ma apam titiriw.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 yɛ elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman wɔ Curve25519 so wɔ ne Montgomery kwan so. 32-byte kokoam ne ɔmanfo safe, 32-byte a wɔkyɛ ahintasɛm. Wɔde di dwuma ma apam titiriw.
x25519.h1_b: Static device identity biara, ephemeral session key biara, sealed-push subscription biara a ɛwɔ Vortex mu no de X25519 di dwuma. Montgomery-antweri a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ bere nyinaa-bere na ahobammɔ wom wɔ kuw a ɛwɔ afã-kwan ntua a ɛhaw kan curves no ho.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 no, Bernstein (2005) na ɔtintim; standardized sɛ RFC 7748 (2016) a wɔde edin X25519 ma DH variant. Wɔde Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (quantum akyi afrafra) na ɛgye toom. Ɛwɔ baabiara wɔ nnɛyi cryptography a wɔde di dwuma mu.
x25519.h1_f:
kokoam safoa: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian, wɔakyekyere) .
ɔmanfo safoa: A = a · G (32-byte a wɔahyɛ no den) .
wɔkyɛ: s = a · B = b · A (baiti 32, → HKDF nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu)
adwumayɛ: ~100 μs wɔ DH biara so wɔ iPhone 11 so
x25519.h2: Baabi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Vortex .

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu
websocketFanout.subtitle: Sɛnea node biako de adeyɛ bi kɔma nnipa mpempem pii a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out no yɛ Python-native set a ɛyɛ subscriber handles wɔ dan biara mu. Sɛ wɔde nkra bi POST a, fan-out dispatcher no san yɛ set no na ɔde serialized frame bi gu subscriber biara send queue so.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out kwati N-copy ka a wɔbɔ wɔ broadcasting ho: decryption biako wɔ sender fã, serialized frame biako, N send-queue pushes. Pia biara yɛ O(1); wɔpia kɔpi ka no kɔ kernel no so wɔ `send()` bere mu denam zero-copy buffers so bere a OS no boa wɔn.
websocketFanout.where: Wɔde adi dwuma wɔ `app/chats/fanout.py` mu. Ɔsoro-gyinabea `FanoutRegistry` kura `dict [dan_id, set [WebSocket]]`. Registry nkyerɛwee no, `asyncio.Lock` na ɛwɛn; akenkan yɛ mfonini ahorow a wɔmfa lock-free.
websocketFanout.how: Wɔ nkra POST so no router no frɛ `twɛn fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)`. Ɔkwan no kɔpi set no wɔ lock no ase, gyae, afei ɛsan yɛ copy a ɛretwɛn `ws.send_bytes(payload)` a 1-second timeout wɔ socket biara mu. Wɔahyɛ socket ahorow a bere atwam no agyirae sɛ enye na wɔtew ho.
websocketFanout.when: Nkra biara, sɛnea wɔyɛ wɔn ade, akenkan-gye, typewritor, frɛ sɛnkyerɛnne, ne dan mu safe a wɔdannan no sen fa saa fan-out koro yi ara mu. Frame kɛse yɛ 64 KiB; wɔpow payload akɛse na wɔsan de kɔma nea ɔfrɛ no denam HTTP so.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — obiara a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu no de ntonto no mu dɔ mena. Overflow ma frame a akyɛ sen biara no hwe ase.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — ɔsoro anohyeto wɔ `send_bytes` so. Sɛ ɛboro so a, ɛkyerɛ socket no bɔne.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — pow fan-out wɔ adan a ɛsõ sen eyi so. Pia akɛse de channel mode ne pull pattern di dwuma mmom.
websocketFanout.fail1: Slow consumer — socket biara ntonto a ɛboro so. Frame a akyɛ sen biara no hwee ase. Client kyere via `efi` wɔ reconnect so.
websocketFanout.fail2: Socket a awu — `send_bytes` ma `NkitahodiAtoto` so. Dispatcher yi fi set na ɛkɔ so.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer — sɛ producer yɛ > 5× ntɛmntɛm sen aggregate consumer bandwidth, akyi-nhyɛso kicks in via `twɛn` suspending sender.
websocketFanout.fail4: Memory blow-up — obiara a ɔkra no ntonto a wɔatoto so wɔ 256 frames; wɔ 64 KiB biara a ɛyɛ 16 MiB max biara brɛoo consumer. Ɔdetɔfo a waguan no betwa ne nkitahodi mu denam liveness check no so ansa na wabɔ saa ceiling no.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{dan,ɔdefo}` — socket biara ntonto mu dɔ.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — wɔatow frame ahorow agu denam ntease so (overflow, bere a atwam, wɔato mu).
websocketFanout.tune1: Ma `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` so ma akraman a wɔwɔ ntwamutam a ɛyɛ brɛoo nanso ɛyɛ den.
websocketFanout.tune2: Fa `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` si fam wɔ akasakasa a ɛkorɔn akuwakuw a socket ahorow a ɛyɛ brɛoo ma afoforo kɔm de wɔn.
websocketFanout.tune3: Kyekyɛ adan akɛse mu yɛ no sub-rooms anaasɛ dan kɔ channel mode so denam pull-based updates so.
websocketFanout.edge1: Wɔde room rotation events (`type:"k"`) de 2 s timeout mena sen sɛ wɔde 1 s efisɛ ɛsɛ sɛ clients san de keys ba ansa na wɔagye nkra pii.
websocketFanout.edge2: Wɔnsan nsɔ nsɛm a esisi a wɔkyerɛw no nhwɛ — sɛ wobɛhwere "ɔdefo a ogyaee nkyerɛwee" a, asiane biara nni ho.
websocketFanout.edge3: Wɔayɛ presence updates batched: wɔaboaboa user presence flips pii a ɛwɔ 250 ms window koro no ara mu abom ayɛ no frame baako.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 a wɔde di dwuma wɔ dan biara mu `asyncio.Queue`s — wɔde lock-copy-iterate nhyehyɛe no asi ananmu wɔ v0.0.5 mu ama nkrasɛm biara a ɛba fam CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Daakye: sɛ Redis wɔ hɔ a, fan-out bɛpɛ pub/sub enti multi-node clusters no san yɛ nsɛm a esisi a mesh fan-out nni mu.
websocketFanout.ts1: High drop rate: hwɛ network to nea ɔde di dwuma brɛoo no; bump queue kɛse; hwehwɛ afɛfo nneyɛe mu.
websocketFanout.ts2: Bere tenten a ɛkorɔn a wɔde mena: ɛbɛyɛ sɛ TLS nkitahodi foforo a ɛrekɔ so anaasɛ NAT traversal timeout; hwɛ kernel logs sɛ TCP retransmissions anaa.
websocketFanout.ts3: Memory creep: hwehwɛ `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` biara a ɔde di dwuma; hyɛ obiara a ɔde di dwuma a ne bun a ɛkɔ so > 200 agyirae sɛ ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔyɛ akraman a ɔyɛ brɛoo anaasɛ ɔyɛ bɔne.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Sɛ client bi hwere frames bere a wɔatwa nkitahodi no mu a, dɛn na ɛba? A: Ɛsan ne `since=<last_seen_id>` di nkitaho na server no san bɔ fi DB no so. Fan-out no yɛ mmɔdenbɔ a eye sen biara bere ankasa; durability te DB no mu.
websocketFanout.faq2: Asɛmmisa: So obi a ɔyɛ adwemmɔne betumi ama fan-out ayɛ brɛoo? A: Wɔbrɛ wɔn ankasa ntonto a ɛhyɛ mu ma, ɛtow frame ahorow gu, na ɛtwa mu. Cross-subscriber ntwitwiridii biara nni hɔ.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi debug user pɔtee bi delivery? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` dumps wɔn queue bun, last send timestamp, ne nnansa yi drops.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce management
nonceManagement.subtitle: Sɛnea Vortex ma AES-GCM nonces yɛ soronko wɔ mfiri, adan, ne reboots nyinaa so.
nonceManagement.what: AES-GCM dwumadie biara gye 12-byte nonce a MUST yɛ soronko ma safoa a wɔde ama. Sɛ wosan de nonce a ɛwɔ safoa koro no ara di dwuma a, ɛsɛe kokoamsɛm ne nokware nyinaa — ɔtowhyɛfo a ɔwɔ ciphertext abien wɔ ade koro ase (safoa, nonce) betumi asan anya plaintext XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex ma dan safoa baako na ɛde di dwuma ma nkra mpempem pii. Nonce a wɔahyɛ no agyirae wɔ nkrasɛm abien so no bɛma nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den akɔ. Enti wɔde OS CSPRNG no na ɛyɛ nonces nyinaa wɔ 96 bits — awoda-bound-safe region no bɛyɛ 2^32 nkrasɛm wɔ safoa biara mu, ɛboro so koraa sen safoa biako biara a ɛbɛkora so.
nonceManagement.where: Client-fã nonce awo ntoatoaso te `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node) mu. Node no nso yɛ defensive duplicate-nonce check.
nonceManagement.how: Anamɔn-anamɔn: client yɛ random bytes 12, twa kɔ AES-GCM encrypt, frame ciphertext no sɛ `{ciphertext, nonce}` ne POSTs. Node kyerɛw `(room_id, nonce)` wɔ in-memory LRU cache a ne kɛse yɛ 10^6 nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw mu. Wɔ POST so no, node hwɛ cache no — duplicate ⇒ 400 `duplicate_nonce`. Wɔ sɛnea wɔde di dwuma daa ase no eyi ntow gya da (P(collision) wɔ 10 ^ 9 nkrasɛm yɛ ~ 10 ^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Wɔ biribiara a wɔde bɛmena so. Receiver-side: nonce check biara nni hɔ — AES-GCM no tag no di nokwaredi ho dwuma. Sɛ ɔkwan bi so no, wɔsan yɛ nonce bi a, anka decrypt a ɛto so abien no bɛda so ara adi nkonim nanso kokoamsɛm bɛsɛe.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — nnansa yi nonce dodow a wɔadi akyi wɔ node biara mu.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — nsɛm dedaw a wɔatu afi hɔ wɔ 24 h akyi (safoa dodow no ara di akɔneaba wɔ nnɔnhwerew mu ɔkwan biara so).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG huammɔdi wɔ client — ɛnyɛ nea ɛbɛyɛ yiye koraa ne OS-a wɔde ama CSPRNG. Yɛnsan nkɔ RNG ahorow a ɛnyɛ cryptographic so da.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss on node restart — wogye tom efisɛ cache yɛ defence-in-depth; clients nsan mfa nonces nni dwuma wɔ mmara kwan so da enti miss mmue ntua mfɛnsere.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ pintinn twa cache cap ho hyia.
nonceManagement.tune1: Pia akɛse: ma cache kɛse nkɔ soro na ama woakata mfɛnsere a ɛkyinkyini atenten so.
nonceManagement.tune2: Multi-node clusters: kyɛ cache no denam Redis so bere a ɛwɔ hɔ.
nonceManagement.edge1: Offline client re-connecting with queued messages: nkra biara a ɛwɔ ntonto mu no kura n’ankasa random nonce. Ɛho nhia sɛ wɔyɛ biako.
nonceManagement.edge2: Multi-device send: mfiri abien no nyinaa ma ahofadi random nonces. P(collision) wɔ 2 mfiri × 10 ^ 4 nkrasɛm = anibiannaso.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 de counter-based nonces seeded ne device id dii dwuma bere tiaa bi — wɔapow bere a krataa bi kyerɛɛ cross-device collisions wɔ clock-skew ase akyi. Mprempren Random-96 nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wɔahyira so.
nonceManagement.ts1: Hwɛ `duplicate_nonce` pow: hwehwɛ akraman no mu sɛ ɛyɛ bɔne RNG; hwɛ mfiri entropy fibea.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: hwɛ cache kɛse ne dan mu kyerɛw bo; anaasɛ ma ne kɛse so anaasɛ brɛ ase TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Asɛmmisa: Na sɛ adetɔfo baanu paw nonce koro no ara wɔ akwanhyia mu nso ɛ? A: Wɔ 96 bits a randomness, wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ kan a wɔbɛbɔ wɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa so no wɔ ~2 ^ 48 nkrasɛm — nkwa nna pii a Vortex dwumadie. Sɛ ɛba da bi a, na node no bɛpo nea ɛto so abien no.
nonceManagement.faq2: Asɛmmisa: Dɛn nti na 96 bits na ɛnyɛ 128? A: AES-GCM no gyinapɛn nonce tenten. 96 bits nso sie baiti 4 wɔ nkra biara mu.

keyRotation.title: Safoa a wɔkyinkyini
keyRotation.subtitle: Bere ne sɛnea dan, mfiri, ne nsafe a wɔde gyae nneɛma no bɛbɔ.
keyRotation.what: Safoa biara a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ wɔ Vortex mu no di akɔneaba wɔ nhyehyɛe bi so anaasɛ wɔ trigger so. Pia mu safe dannan bere a asɔremma sesa anaasɛ bere ne bere mu (dapɛn biara). Device keys di akɔneaba wɔ user paw biara mu. Release keys di akɔneaba bere a wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ apam bi no.
keyRotation.why: Rotation to blast radius a ɛwɔ compromise mu no ano hye. Pia mu safe bi a wowiae a efi nnɛra no gyae nnɛyi nkrasɛm no a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ mu. Safe a wɔawia a wɔayi no adi wɔ afe 2024 mu no gyae adansedie a ɛfa 2026 a wɔayi no adi ho.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` no wɔ server-side rotation logic. Adetɔfo fã: `ios/.../Nsafe/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../safe/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Room rotation: admin biara betumi akanyan; akwamma mu a wɔdannan no kwa no yɛ nea ɛba ara kwa. Rotator no nya ntini foforo a ɛyɛ baiti 32, san de envelopes kɔ asɔremma a wɔaka no so, de `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` ne envelopes foforo no to gua. Node de atom yɛ foforo `room_keys` na ɛbɔ `{type:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Room: wɔ akwamma mu, wɔ admin trigger so, nnafua 7 biara automatically. Device: nnafua 90 biara default (wobetumi asiesie). Release: ad-hoc wɔ nea wosusuw sɛ wɔayɛ no apam ho.
keyRotation.cfg1: `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS=7` — bere ne bere mu nsakrae a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ.
keyRotation.cfg2: `DEVICE_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS=90` — default a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mfiri biara mu.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=true` — dum na skip rotation wɔ akwamma (ɛbrɛ ahobanbɔ ase ma CPU a ɛba fam).
keyRotation.fail1: Client offline bere a rotation: kyere wɔ nkitahodi a edi hɔ no so. Node stores last 5 rotations enti reconnects bere nyinaa hwehwɛ wɔn envelope.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelope minting mmirikatu: admins baanu di akɔneaba bere koro mu. Node gye nea edi kan no tom na ɛsan de 409 Conflict kɔ nea ɛto so abien no so.
keyRotation.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rotation_duration_seconds` — ɔfasu- dɔn biara a ɛkyinkyini.
keyRotation.tune1: Ɔmanfoɔ adan a > 1000 asɔremma: dan kɔ Variant-B key publish. Rotation wɔ akwamma mu bɛyɛ no-op; asɔremma wɔ ahotoso wɔ pubkey nsaano nkyerɛwee a wɔde ato hɔ no so.
keyRotation.tune2: Pia a ɛfa bere ho (e.g. nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ fibea akwan): rotation cadence tiawa (da biara anaa dɔnhwerew biara).
keyRotation.edge1: Dan a emufo yɛ biako bere a afoforo nyinaa afi hɔ akyi: kyinhyia ho nhia nanso wɔda so ara kanyan no ma ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; lone member nya envelope foforo ma wɔn ho.
keyRotation.edge2: Owner leaves: ownership transfer kɔ admin a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu akyɛ sen biara no nkyɛn; wɔtwa owura no envelope dedaw no mu.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 a wɔdannan no wɔ akwamma nkutoo mu. v0.2 de bere ne bere mu kyinhyia a `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS` di so ka ho.
keyRotation.ts1: Clients stuck decrypting: hwɛ envelope pon so; hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde rotation event no too gua.
keyRotation.ts2: Rotation huammɔdi: mpɛn pii no network to a brɛoo member. San bɔ mmɔden count logged wɔ audit trail no mu.
keyRotation.faq1: Asɛmmisa: So rotation san de nkrasɛm dedaw no sie? A: Dabi, ciphertext dedaw no tra safoa dedaw no ase; akraman de safe dedaw sie wɔn mpɔtam hɔ cache mu ma abakɔsɛm mu decryption.
keyRotation.faq2: Asɛmmisa: Na sɛ obi a ɔde di dwuma de ne ho hyɛ mu na ofi hɔ ntɛmntɛm mpɛn 100 nso ɛ? A: Adeyɛ biara di akɔneaba. Wɔ adan akɛse mu no eyi bo yɛ den — yɛ rate-limited membership events to 1/min per user.

rateLimiting.title: Rate anohyeto
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, obiara a ɔde di dwuma, ɔkwan biara so token-bucket anohyeto.
rateLimiting.what: Rate anohyeto ne ade titiriw a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban fi bulk abuse ho: brute-force login, registration flood, message spam, file-upload ɔbrɛ.
rateLimiting.why: Sɛ anohyeto nni hɔ a, obiara a wɔagye atom sɛ ɔyɛ ayayade betumi asɛe disk, ahyɛ fan-out ma, anaasɛ brute-force a 4-digit 2FA. Anohyeto ahorow no bo yɛ mmerɛw (~10 ns wɔ check biara mu) na ɛdan ntua a anka ɛnyɛ hwee no yɛ nea ne bo yɛ den.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` kura anohyeto no. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` yɛ ntama a ɛyɛ tratraa ma auth akwan.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bokiti algorithm biara (scope, safoa). Bokiti refills wɔ rate R, capacity C. Abisade gye token 1. Bokiti a hwee nni mu ⇒ 429. Tracker storage: in-memory dict wɔ node biako so; Redis bere a `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Adesrɛ biara nam WAF mfinimfini. Skip list ma static agyapade ne akwahosan nhwehwɛmu.
rateLimiting.cfg1: `_AUTH_RATE_LOGIN=10` wɔ s 60 biara mu wɔ IP biara mu.
rateLimiting.cfg2: `_AUTH_RATE_REGISTER=5` wɔ s 60 biara mu wɔ IP biara mu.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` simma biara wɔ ɔdefo biara mu.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` simma biara wɔ ɔdefo biara mu.
rateLimiting.fail1: Mmara kwan so dwumayɛni akyi kyɛfa NAT (ɔfese, sukuu) hits per-IP anohyeto — ɔdefo-anim 429 ne animtew nkrasɛm.
rateLimiting.fail2: Memory blow-up wɔ kɛse pae — capped wɔ 100k soronko safe; LRU tu obi fi fie.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — ɛsɛ sɛ ɛtra 100 μs ase.
rateLimiting.tune1: Wɔ CDN a ɛreyi IP ankasa akyi: hyehyɛ `TRUSTED_PROXIES` sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yɛbɛkenkan `X-Forwarded-For`. Anyɛ saa a kar akwan nyinaa bɔ anohyeto a ɛwɔ CDN no egress IP ase.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bots a ɛwɔ dodoɔ a ɛkorɔn: ma API safoa a `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: yɛto /64 biara ano hye sen sɛ yɛbɛto address biara so de abu akontaa ama ISP nkyekyɛmu akɛse.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor exits: yɛde anohyeto a ɛyɛ mmerɛw (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) di dwuma de kwati sɛ yɛbɛtwe Tor dwumadiefoɔ aso wɔ exits a wɔakyekyɛ mu.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 de `slowapi` dii dwuma ne decorator-per-route — wɔayi afi mu wɔ v0.0.5 mu ama centralized middleware.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: hwɛ proxy config a wogye di, hwɛ shared-NAT nhyehyɛe ahorow, bump scope anohyeto sɛ mmara kwan so traffic rebɔ no a.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: hwehwɛ access logs mu sɛ IP a wɔyɛ basabasa no; fa ka `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var ma hard block.
rateLimiting.faq1: Asɛmmisa: So wɔakyekyɛ anohyeto ahorow mu wɔ node ahorow so? A: Wɔ single-node mode mu no, anohyeto ahorow yɛ per-node. Wɔ Redis mu no, anohyeto ahorow yɛ wiase nyinaa wɔ akuw no nyinaa mu.
rateLimiting.faq2: Asɛmmisa: Mɛyɛ dɛn ama pii ama me ho? A: Wɔn a wɔagye atom no betumi abisa quota a ɛkorɔn denam `/api/admin/quota` so. Admins pene asɛm biara so.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji nhoma ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ
emojiCatalog.subtitle: 1500-emoji dataset no kyɛe wɔ akraman nyinaa mu.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex de n’ankasa emoji set mena sen sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛto Unicode-version a ɛwɔ hɔ so. 1500 emojis a wɔahyehyɛ no akuw 9 (smileys, nnipa, mmoa, aduan, akwantu, dwumadi ahorow, nneɛma, sɛnkyerɛnnede, frankaa). Saa ara na JSON a wɔde di dwuma wɔ iOS (`Emoji / Nneɛma / emoji.json`), Android (`android / app / src / titiriw / agyapade / emoji.json`), ne wɛb afɛfo (`static / agyapade / emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Consistency: ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdefo a ɔde 🥹 remena wɔ iOS 17 so no kyerɛ sɛ 🥹 wɔ Android 9. Native system emoji diverge across OS versions by 1-3 years, enti yɛde yɛn ankasa de mena na ama mapping no akɔ so ayɛ pintinn.
emojiCatalog.where: `android / app / src / titiriw / agyapade / emoji.json`, `ios / Modules / Fibea / Emoji / Nneɛma / emoji.json`, `static / js / nkɔmmɔbɔ / emoji-picker.js`.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON nhyehyeɛ: `{ɔfã: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Clients load wɔ startup, flatten kɔ search index, na render denam LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid so.
emojiCatalog.when: Wɔ app start ne bere biara a ɔdefo no bebue picker no. MRU list no kɔ so wɔ UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage mu.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Nnansa yi cap: 30 wɔ iOS, 30 wɔ Android, 20 wɔ wɛb so.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Wɔasiesie akuw ahorow no nnidiso nnidiso — nhyehyɛe foforo a wɔsan hyehyɛ no bubu picker nhyehyɛe no.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Ɔdefoɔ OS ntumi nkyerɛ emoji: ɛsan hwe ase kɔ `?` glyph so. Yɛpaw codepoints fi Unicode ≤ 15.0 a nnɛyi OS biara boa.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Custom emoji packs: wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ahyɛ sticker packs a ɛyɛ wɔn ade saa ara nanso ɛkyerɛ raster mfonini ahorow.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Skin-tone variants: yɛn catalog no de base emojis nkutoo na ɛyɛ; variants no hyehyɛ client-side denam ZWJ ntoatoaso so.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Flag emojis: ɔmantam-kyerɛfo agyiraehyɛde abien; iOS kyerɛ frankaa no, Android nkyerɛase ahorow bi kyerɛ nkyerɛwde abien abien.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 de emoji.json dii dwuma fi emoji-mart a ɛwɔ soro. v0.0.5 forked de pin katalog no na trim kɔ 1500 esiane bundle-size ntease nti.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji a ɛyera: san kyekye agyapade; hwɛ sɛ JSON no yɛ nokware; mfiri binom cache dedaw versions aggressively — clear app cache.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Asɛmmisa: So metumi de emoji a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ aka ho? A: Ɛnyɛ denam katalog no so. Fa sticker packs di dwuma.
emojiCatalog.faq2: Asɛmmisa: Dɛn nti na womfa Twemoji nni dwuma? A: Tumi krataa + bundle kɛse. Twemoji yɛ CC-BY-4.0 nanso PNG set no de 20 MB ka ho wɔ client biara ho.

intro.p1: Architex yɛ mpaemuka UI kasa a wɔasi ama Vortex Mini Apps. Sɛ anka wobɛkyerɛw JavaScript a ɛsakra DOM no, wokyerɛkyerɛ screen a wopɛ no mu na runtime no ma pixels no kɔ so yɛ sync ne tebea no ankasa.
intro.p2: Kasa no sua: mpaemuka anan (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), prefix biako ma reactive variables (~), ne operator chain biako ma styling (::).
intro.p3: Sɛ woakyerɛw HTML + CSS + JS pɛn a, Architex bɛte nka sɛ wunim nanso ɛwɔ 10× less boilerplate. Sɛ woannyɛ saa a, Architex nso yɛ nnianim asɛm a ɛyɛ brɛoo wɔ reactive programming ho efisɛ kasa no sua araa ma wubetumi akura ne nyinaa wɔ wo tirim.
intro.p4: Saa nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi fã biara gyina nea atwam no so. Huruw kɔ baabiara a wopɛ sɛ wunim mpaemuka UI nhyehyɛe foforo dedaw a; kenkan fi soro kosi ase sɛ worefi ase foforo a.
intro.li1: Mpaemuka — kyerɛkyerɛ UI no nsusuwii mu, ɛnyɛ anammɔn a wɔfa so si no
intro.li2: Reactive — dwumadie baako yɛ label, class, anaa node biara a ɛgyina so no foforɔ
intro.li3: Portable — .arx koro no ara na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb, iOS, ne Android host ahorow so
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + renderer hyɛn a ɛwɔ ase 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex yɛ domain pɔtee bi. Ɛrensi kasa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so ananmu — nanso sɛ wode screen bɛmena wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu a, ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm sen nhyehyɛe biara a yɛsusuu.
intro.ct2: Construct biara a ɛwɔ kasa no mu no map kɔ runtime primitive biako so. Nkrabea biara nni hɔ a wuntumi nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.
intro.h1_a: Architex yɛ mpaemuka UI kasa a wɔasi ama Vortex Mini Apps. Sɛ anka wobɛkyerɛw JavaScript a ɛsakra DOM no, wokyerɛkyerɛ screen a wopɛ no mu na runtime no ma pixels no kɔ so yɛ sync ne tebea no ankasa.

syntax.p1: Wɔde mpaemuka anan a ɛwɔ soro na ɛkyekyee Architex nhyehyɛe biara: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, ne @for loop nipadua no. Biara fi ase wɔ ɔfa 0 mu; biribiara a wɔakyerɛw wɔ ase hɔ no yɛ saa block no dea.
syntax.p2: Wɔkyerɛw reactive variables ~name — tilde prefix no hyɛ wɔn agyirae sɛ tracked cells. Fa ~name kenkan, fa = ma, fa := bu akontaa.
syntax.p3: Nneɛma a ɛwom no yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda hɔ kwa wɔ wɔn ankasa nkyerɛwde so: text, button, image, col, row, ne nea ɛkeka ho. Wɔn gyinabea ho akyinnyegye no ba ntɛm ara wɔ: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Nsakraeɛfoɔ bata ho wɔ :: akyi. Wubetumi de nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abɔ dodow biara a wopɛ: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Nneyɛe te ase wɔ => akyi. Adeyɛ biako wɔ agyan biara mu; agyan pii nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

variables.h2: Nneɛma a ɛsakra a wɔabɔ ho akontaa
variables.p1: Reactive variable kura value bi na ɛbɔ obiara a ɔkenkan no amanneɛ bere a worekyerɛw value foforo no. Fa = pae mu ka, san fa = ma, fa += / -= / *= / /= yɛ foforo.
variables.p2: Nsakraeɛ a wɔabɔ ho akontaa no nya wɔn boɔ firi asɛmfua bi a ɛsan susuw ho bere biara a nsɛm biara a wɔde hyɛ mu bɛsesa. Fa := pae mu sen sɛ wode = bɛbɔ ho dawuru. Nkratafa a wɔde nsa yɛ biara nni hɔ, mfomso ahorow a ɛsom bo dedaw biara nni hɔ.
variables.p3: Fa : Type kyerɛw type no mu wɔ edin no akyi. Nneɛma ahorow a wɔboa: number, string, boolean, array, object. Annotations yɛ nea wobetumi apaw; wɔde type no fi mfitiaseɛ boɔ no mu.
variables.p4: Fa lowerCamelCase anaa ɔwɔ_nkyerɛwde di dwuma; Architex nso nhyɛ mmara. Ma edin nyɛ tiawa: screen a edin atenten du du pii wom sɛe indentation.
variables.p5: Scope: reactive variable a wɔabɔ ho dawuru wɔ @screen mu no, wotumi hu wɔ saa screen no nipadua no mu nkutoo. @theme tokens no yɛ nea wotumi hu wɔ wiase nyinaa.
variables.p6: Asetra mu kyinhyia: ɔman no tra ase bere tenten a wɔde screen no ahyɛ mu no. Sɛ wofa po so hyɛn kɔ akyirikyiri a, ɛsɛe no; navigating back san bɔ no wɔ mfitiaseɛ boɔ no so.
variables.p7: Nkɔso: sɛ wobɛtena ase akyɛ sen screen no a, frɛ send(action: "save", data: ~state) na ma bot host no ntra hɔ.

variables.cc5: ~nkyia := "Hello, {~din}!"  // wɔabu akontaa wɔ template string so

variables.li2: ~ akyi no, nkyerɛwde, nkyerɛwde, nkyerɛwde a ɛtwe adwene si so: ~user_count, ~page2.

state.p1: Nkwammoaa biara a ɛyɛ adwuma no tra ase bere tenten a wɔde ne @screen a ɛka ho no ahyɛ so no. Sɛ wobue screen bi a, ɛma ne mpaemuka ahorow no kɔ soro kosi ase; gyaw no via back() anaa goto() sɛe wɔn.
state.p2: Sɛ wo hia ɔman na ama woanya nkwa wɔ akwantuo mu a, nya no firi host no hɔ: POST kɔ bot no so a send() na san fa kɔ open, anaasɛ kɔ so wɔ mpɔtam hɔ denam store(key, value) frɛ so.
state.p3: Resetting: san fa ma mfitiaseɛ boɔ no. reset keyword biara nni hɔ efisɛ re-assignment yɛ adwuma no dedaw; runtime no diffs na ɛsan kyerɛ nea ɛsakrae nkutoo.
state.p4: Wɔnam := so na ɛbu tebea a wonya fi mu no ho akontaa. Architex di dependencies akyi ankasa, enti womfa nsa nkyerɛw. Dependency tracking yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ agyapade biara mu, ɛnyɛ ade biara mu.
state.p5: Wɔde arrays ne nneɛma toto ho denam reference so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ re-render a, fa array / ade foforo ma. Mutation a dedaw no yɛ nea wobu ani gu so — aguadi a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ma predictable update semantics.
state.cc1: ~list = [...~list, newItem] // hyɛ re-render ne array nkyerɛkyerɛmu foforo
state.cc2: ~obj = {...~obj, din: "x"}  // nhwɛso koro no ara ma nneɛma
state.li1: Scope: local to a ɛka ho @screen.
state.li2: Nkwa nna: efi @screen hyɛn mu kɔ fi mu.
state.li3: Concurrency: wɔde nhama biako na ɛyɛ screen biara. Wɔde updates no batched wɔ microtask biako mu.
state.li4: Pɛyɛ: katee (===) — sɛ wode botae koro no ara ma a, ɛsan kanyan biribiara.

types.h2: Nneɛma ahorow a wɔde gu mu
types.p1: Architex wɔ mfitiaseɛ ahodoɔ anum: number, string, boolean, null, ne object / array a wɔabom ayɛ. Wɔde nna no fa mu sɛ nhama (ISO 8601) anaa nɔma (unix ms).
types.p2: Nnɔmba yɛ 64-bit mmɔho abien (IEEE 754). Integer akontabuo a ɛkɔ 2^53 yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
types.p3: Nhama no yɛ UTF-8; tenten kan koodu nsɛntitiriw, ɛnyɛ baiti. Interpolation de curly braces di dwuma.
types.p4: Booleans yɛ true / false. Nsakrae a ɛda adi pefee biara nni hɔ a efi nhama mu.
types.p5: Wɔahyehyɛ arrays, 0-indexed. Fa ~arr[0] so kɔ hɔ; tenten via ~arr.length.
types.p6: Nneɛma yɛ key→value maps a wɔanhyehyɛ. Fa ~obj.name anaa ~obj["name"] so kɔ hɔ.
types.p7: Nhyɛsoɔ: akontabuo adwumayɛfoɔ hyɛ nhama ma ɛkɔ nɔma so sɛ ahama no te sɛ akontabuo a; anyɛ saa a, asɛmfua mfomso bi tow wɔ runtime mu.
types.p8: Nokware: atoro gyinapɛn ne false, 0, "", null, ne nhyehyɛe / nneɛma a hwee nni mu. Biribiara a aka no yɛ nokware.
types.td8: UTF-8 ahama a {...} a wɔde hyɛ mu
types.td12: agyiraehyɛde a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi nni hɔ; atoro

operators.p2: Ntotoho adwumayɛfo san boolean. == yɛ pɛyɛ a ɛyɛ katee (no type coercion).
operators.p3: Logical operators no twa benkum kɔ nifa.
operators.p4: Ternary cond ? a : b no yɛ adwuma wɔ baabiara a wogye asɛmfua bi tom; nest ma enum-te sɛ lookups.
operators.p5: Compound assignment operators (+=, -=, *=, /=, %=) yɛ adwuma wɔ nkwammoaa biara a ɛyɛ adwuma so.

layout.p1: Architex wɔ nsukorade abien pɛpɛɛpɛ a wotumi hyehyɛ: col (a ɛda hɔ) ne row (ɛda fam). Biribiara a aka no yɛ ahaban fã bi.
layout.p2: Indent mmofra level biako mu dɔ sen wɔn ade a wɔde gu mu no. Closing tag biara nni hɔ — parser no de indentation nkutoo na edi dwuma.
layout.p3: Nneɛma a wɔde gu mu gye gap(px) ma baabi a ɛda mmofra ntam, pad(px) ma emu padding, center to mfinimfini wɔ mmeamudua no akyi, grow de hyɛ baabi a aka wɔ afã titiriw no ma.
layout.p4: Alignment modifiers yɛ container-level: center wɔ col mfinimfini wɔ sorosoro; wɔ row mu no ɛwɔ mfinimfini tẽẽ. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) yɛ nsɛm a wɔabu so pefee.
layout.p5: Sizing: default so no, component biara twetwe ma ɛne nea ɛwɔ mu no hyia. Fa w(px), h(px), grow, anaa maxW(px) / maxH(px) a ɛda adi pefee no di dwuma de kyekyere.

modifiers.p1: Modifiers ba :: akyi na wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn gu mu bere nyinaa. Mpaemuka ahyɛde biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkae; ntawntawdi siesie ɔkyerɛwfo-nkonimdi a etwa to wɔ abusua bi mu.
modifiers.p2: Abusua a ɛda ntam: pad(n) (afã nyinaa), pad(x, y) (a ɛkɔ soro, ɛda fam), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS nhyehyɛe), gap(n) (mmofra ntam), margin(n) (akyi ano).
modifiers.p4: Kɔla abusua: color(#rrggbb) (anim), bg(#rrggbb) (akyi). Wɔn baanu nyinaa gye asɛmti token (color(~primary)) ne 8-digit hex ma alpha (#00000080).
modifiers.p6: Visibility family: hidden(~flag) yi node no fi mu bere a frankaa no yɛ nokware; visible(~flag) ne akyire no. Unmounted nodes hwie wɔn DOM — tebea UI yɛ cheap.
modifiers.p7: Subɔne abusua: debounce(ms) wɔ input throttles updates; placeholder("…") kyerɛ hint bi; format(kind, arg) wɔ text so no hyehyɛ nɔma bi ("currency", "percent", "compact").
modifiers.p8: Border / radius: radius(px) twa ntwea so kurukuruwa; border(#rrggbb) twetwe 1 px stroke; border(px, #rrggbb) de thickness nso si hɔ.
modifiers.li1: Nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so wɔ abusua mu no ho nhia.
modifiers.li2: Kɔla nsakraefo siesie nea etwa to-ɔkyerɛwfo-nkonimdi.
modifiers.li3: Spacing di dwuma ansa na kɛse, kɛse ansa na ɔhye.
modifiers.li4: Modifiers a wonnim yɛ parse error — a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ forward compatibility ho ban.

handlers.p3: Nneyɛe betumi de ama reactive cells, afrɛ host built-ins, navigate, anaa send() nkra bi asan akɔ bot no so.
handlers.p4: Host built-ins yɛ platform-a wɔde ama: copy(~text), share(~text), haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy"), vibrate(ms), alert("..."), confirm("...") => ~ok = it, goto("ScreenName", arg: val), back(), close().

control_flow.p1: Architex nni if asɛm biara wɔ syntax no atifi. Wɔnam hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) nsakraefo so na ɛda tebea UI adi anaasɛ ɛnam nsɛm abiɛsa a ɛwɔ afã horow botae ahorow mu so.
control_flow.p2: Ternary yɛ adwuma wɔ baabiara a wogye botae bi tom: component argument, modifier argument, computed value.
control_flow.p3: Sɛ wopɛ nkorabata bɛboro abien a, fa nkorabata abiɛsa no yɛ berebuw. Architex parses nifa-kɔ-benkum enti nesting kenkan sɛnea ɛte.
control_flow.p4: Sɛ wopɛ switch-te sɛ logic wɔ ade bi so a, fa kɔmputa so hwehwɛ di dwuma: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.li1: No if block — fa modifier anaa ternary di dwuma.
control_flow.li2: No else if nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn — fa nested ternary di dwuma.
control_flow.li3: No pattern matching — fa lookup tables di dwuma mmom.
control_flow.li4: No early return — conditional branches yɛ botaeɛ, ɛnyɛ nsɛm.

loops.p1: Tia block a ɛyɛ UI wɔ element biara mu ne @for item in ~list. Indent nipadua no mu; abofra biara kyerɛ ase pɛnkoro wɔ element biara mu.
loops.p2: Fa edin abien kwan no kyekyere index a egyina zero so no: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Runtime no di identity akyi denam element no ankasa so default so. Prepending to a 10 000-row list costs O(1) DOM adwuma — nea ɔkyerɛ ase no diffs denam nkyerɛkyerɛmu so, ɛnyɛ gyinabea so.
loops.p4: Nest @for wɔ ahofadi mu. Inner loops hu akyi loop bindings.
loops.p5: Iteration nhyehyɛe ne array nhyehyɛe. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wodan akyi a, san yɛ akontaabu a wɔde abɔ akyi: ~reversed := [...].reverse().
loops.li1: Iteration nipadua no yɛ indented level biako a emu dɔ sen @for line no.
loops.li2: Nipadua betumi akura ade biara mu, a @for foforo ka ho.
loops.li3: Sɛ wode ka ho / yi fi hɔ wɔ awiei no yɛ kwa; diffing yɛ nea egyina nipasu so.
loops.li4: Empty lists no nkyerɛ hwee — wɔmfa placeholder slot biara nsie.

reactivity.p1: Reactive akenkan biara a ɛwɔ computed expression anaa modifier argument mu no kyerɛw dependency. Sɛ dependency biara sesa a, asɛmfua no san susuw ho wɔ microtask a edi hɔ no mu.
reactivity.p2: Writes are batched: dwumadi ahorow pii wɔ event handler biako mu fire pɛpɛɛpɛ biako render pass wɔ awiei. Eyi nti na => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 bo yɛ mmerɛw mpo wɔ akenkanfo pii fam no.
reactivity.p3: Pɛyɛ yɛ katee (===). Sɛ wokyerɛw botae koro no ara a, ɛsan tu mmirika biara. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ updates a ɛwɔ reference types a, fa array anaa ade foforo ma.
reactivity.p4: Wɔhunu kyinhyia a ɛwɔ akontabuo dependencies (~a := ~b + 1 ne ~b := ~a - 1) mu wɔ mpaemuka berɛ mu na wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ mfomsoɔ.
reactivity.p5: Async updates: send() a ɛsan de value bi ba no update cell a wode aba no ama no, ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ma render pass bere a Bɔhyɛ no asiesie.
reactivity.cc3: ~info := "kan: {~kan}, mmɔho abien: {~mmɔho}"  // gyina abien no nyinaa so
reactivity.cc5: // tap biako ⇒ biako render pass updateing info
reactivity.li1: Fine-grained: nneɛma a ɛkenkan cell a wɔasesa no re-render nkutoo.
reactivity.li2: Batched: kyerɛw pii wɔ microtask biako mu ⇒ render biako.
reactivity.li3: Deterministic: inputs koro ⇒ output koro, ordering surprises biara nni hɔ.
reactivity.li4: Type-safe: wɔde type-checked modifier arguments de toto wɔn signatures a wɔabɔ ho dawuru no ho.

strings.p1: Nhama no yɛ nea wɔafa aka mprenu: "Hello". Wogye nsɛm a wɔafa aka biako nso tom ma symmetry ne JS.
strings.p2: Interpolation de curly braces di dwuma wɔ ahama bi mu: "Hello, {~name}!". Wɔma kwan ma nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara — cells, computed values, function calls.
strings.p3: Nkyerɛwde a wɔde guan: \n (nkyerɛwde foforo), \t (tab), \" (asɛm a wɔafa aka), \\ (akyi nkyerɛwde), \{ (asɛmfua a wɔde hyɛ mu ankasa).
strings.p4: Multi-line: bubu wɔ line foforo bi a ɛwɔ nsɛm a wɔafa aka no mu. Runtime no kora whitespace so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
strings.p5: Templating: ma text block a ɛwɔ interpolations pii no, computed string yɛ idiomatic. Fa sie wɔ cell mu na fa reference fi UI no mu.
strings.li1: Interpolation expressions yɛ reactive — akenkan biara di dependency bi akyi.
strings.li2: Braces a wɔaguan no kyerɛ ase sɛ braces ankasa.
strings.li3: Interpolation {} a ɛda mpan no nyɛ adwuma — parser no mfomso.
strings.li4: Concatenation de + (ahama a wɔde hyɛ obi) di dwuma ma nsɛm a ɛnyɛ den; interpolation kenkan yiye ma template atenten.

errors.h2: Mfomso ahorow a ɛba bere a wɔde tu mmirika
errors.p1: Parse mfomso ahorow no tow wɔ fael-load bere mu. Runtime no bɔ line, column, ne hint bi ho amanneɛ. Nea ɛtaa de ba: indent a ɛnhyia, = a enni hɔ, modifier a wonnim, ahama a wɔanto mu.
errors.p2: Runtime mfomso ahorow tow bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no. Dodow no ara yɛ reactive — asɛmfua bi kyerɛ cell a wɔmmɔ ho amanneɛ, anaasɛ type mismatch wɔ akontaabu mu. Runtime no logs, kyerɛ banner kɔkɔɔ wɔ preview no so, na ɛtwa saa frame no update no so.
errors.p3: Modifier mfomso (modifier a wonnim, akyinnyegye type a ɛnteɛ) gya wɔ parse bere mu. Architex yɛ katee wɔ modifiers a wonnim ho de bɔ forward compatibility ho ban.
errors.p4: Debugging: kyekyere asɛm bi a wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ debug(...). Runtime no kyerɛw nhwehwɛmu biara kɔ console no so a ɛnsesa botae no. Wo ne Architex inspector no bɔ mu na woatu anammɔn afa ɔman nsakrae mu.
errors.p5: Editor nkabom: Architex IDE a ɛwɔ Vortex bot studio no si mfomso so dua wɔ bere ankasa mu, ansa na wɔakora fael no so.
errors.cc2: nkyerɛwee "x" :: sunsuma // ERROR: "sunsuma" ɛnyɛ modifier a wɔboa
errors.cc3: // runtime mfomso: cell a wɔmmɔ ho amanneɛ
errors.cc4: text ~message // ERROR: wɔammɔ ~nkrasɛm ho dawuru wɔ saa screen yi mu
errors.cc5: // debug a wɔde kyekyere nneɛma ho

host_builtins.h4: Navigation a wɔde fa kwan so
host_builtins.p1: Host built-ins yɛ nneyɛe a platform-de ama. Wɔn ne gluu a ɛda DSL ne app a atwa ho ahyia no ntam.
host_builtins.p2: Clipboard: copy(~text) de akyinnyegye no to clipboard no so; paste() => ~x = it kenkan clipboard no kɔ cell bi mu. share(~text) bue nhyehyɛe no kyɛfa krataa no.

bestpractices.p1: Architex tua nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den so ka. Ebia screen biara a ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛkenkan no wɔ nesting levels biako dodo, inline ternaries biako dodo, anaasɛ component biako a ɛyɛ nnwuma abien.
bestpractices.p2: Sɛ w’adwene mu yɛ wo naa a, yi fi mu. @component a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde 5 no yɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛ grok sen @screen block a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde 30.
bestpractices.p3: Pɛ modifiers sen wrapping. text :: pad(16) ye sen sɛ wobɛkyekyere col :: pad(16).
bestpractices.p4: Ma runtime no nyɛ adwuma no. Manual hidden frankaa ma ade biara a ɛwɔ list bi mu no yɛ ɔsɛe — runtime no diffs dedaw.
bestpractices.p5: Bobɔ nneɛma din ma ɔkenkanfo no, na ɛnyɛ nea ɔboaboa ano no. ~isLoading > ~l na ɛyɛ.
bestpractices.li1: Ase 200 lines wɔ screen biara — mpaapaemu sɛ ɛware a
bestpractices.li2: Ɛnboro 3 nesting levels — refactor sɛ emu dɔ a
bestpractices.li3: Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛboro ternaries 2 wɔ asɛmfua biara mu — fa kɔmputa di dwuma
bestpractices.li4: Ɛnkɔ soro nsen 1 screen wɔ fael biara mu — gye sɛ wɔde abɔ mu denneennen

forms.p1: Inputs kyekyere akwan abien kɔ reactive cell so: input ~email. Sɛ wokyerɛw a, ɛma cell no yɛ foforo; cell no a wobɛma ayɛ foforo no ma afuw no yɛ foforo.
forms.p2: Validation yɛ boolean a wɔabɔ ho akontaa: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Fa hidden / visible nsakraeɛ di dwuma wɔ mfomsoɔ nkyerɛwdeɛ so.
forms.p3: Submit yɛ button a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa a wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abɔ nneyɛe. Block submission bere a validation di nkogu denam disabled(!~formOk) so.
forms.p4: Mfomsoɔ a wɔda no adi: yɛ text anaa label a visible(!~fieldOk) ka ho ma ɛkyerɛ berɛ a ɛnnyɛ adwuma nko ara. Fa color(~danger) di dwuma ma aniwa so si so dua.
forms.p5: Debouncing: fa :: debounce(300) ka ho de twentwɛn network-backed validation ase kosi sɛ ɔdefo no begyae typew 300 ms.
forms.p6: Beae a wɔde hyɛ mu: :: placeholder("...") kyerɛ hint bere a cell no mu da mpan. Hint yera wɔ keystroke a edi kan no so.
forms.p7: Input ahorow: plain input yɛ nkyerɛwee; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date siesie keyboard ne masking.
forms.cc3: label "Imel a ɛnyɛ adwuma" :: kɔla(~asiane) a wotumi hu (!~emailOk && ~email != "")

animations.p1: Architex animates implicitly bere a reactive value bi ma akontaahyɛde anaa kɔla sesafo. Nsakraeɛ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no yɛ 200 ms ease-out. Fa :: animate(ms, curve) hyɛ so.
animations.p2: Hyɛn / firi nsakraeɛ mu: nodes a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ wɔ tebea mu (hidden / visible) ma nkwa kɔ mu ne akyi. Fa :: animate.enter(...) ne :: animate.exit(...) so yɛ nea wopɛ.
animations.p3: Nkyerεkyerεmu: ease-out (default), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring gye stiffness ne damping akyinnyegye a wobetumi apaw.
animations.p4: Nsɛnkyerɛnne: :: draggable ne :: swipeable de nsaanodwuma a wohu a ɛfata asɛnka agua no bata ho. Fa bom ne reactive tebea no na ama woanya nkwa wɔ twetwe so.
animations.p5: Reduced motion: host no bu ɔdefo no accessibility nhyehyɛe. Sɛ reduced-motion no yɛ adwuma a, animations no so tew kɔ nea ennu 100 ms na spring curves bɛyɛ linear.

network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) yɛ bridge a ɛkɔ bot host no so. Ɔhɔho no nsa ka JSON RPC nkra, ɔyɛ ho adwuma, na ɔsan de nea efi mu ba ba.
network.p2: Wɔde nea efi mu ba no ma nkwammoaa bi denam => ~result = it so. it yɛ nkyerɛwde tiawa a ɛkyerɛ bo a wɔsan de ba.
network.p3: Di nkoguo pue sɛ ~result.error. Hwɛ ansa na woakenkan ~result.data. Fa nested ternaries di dwuma ma loading / nkonimdi / mfomso tebea.
network.p4: Loading states yɛ w’ankasa boolean: dannan ~loading cell ansa na woafrɛ, dannan san akyi. Kyerɛ spinner fã bi a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ ~loading so.
network.p5: Mmirikatu tebea: sɛ nea ɔde di dwuma no kanyan send mprenu ansa na nea edi kan no asiesie a, nea ɛto so abien no kyerɛw cell no so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosiw ano a, gate ne disabled(~loading).

network.li1: send() ne kwan baako pɛ a wobɛfa so adu abɔnten wiase.
network.li2: Wɔnam it nkyerɛwde tiawa so de nea efi mu ba no ma nkwammoaa bi.
network.li3: Mfomso tu kwan sɛ nea efi mu ba no fã, na ɛnyɛ sɛ nea ɛyɛ soronko.
network.li4: Bɔ wo ho ban fi mmɔho-amfa ~loading frankaa.

a11y.p1: Nkitahodi fã biara betumi akura accessibility label denam :: a11y("label") so. Screen akenkanfo de label no to gua wɔ focus so.
a11y.p2: Focus order di source order no akyi default so. Fa :: a11yOrder(n) bu so ma nhyehyɛe soronko.
a11y.p3: Dynamic Type: text modifiers scale a OS no accessibility font kɛseɛ kɔsi 200 %% a wɔantwitwa. Runtime no san de nsukorade ahorow no si hɔ wɔ nwansena no so.
a11y.p4: High-contrast mode: modifiers a ɛwɔ akyi a ɛda adi pefee no nya opaque fills; borders bump fi 1 px kosi 2 px. Automatic — code biara nhia a ɛboro obu a wɔde ma theme tokens.
a11y.p5: Kɔla nsonsonoe: Vortex asɛmti a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no hyia WCAG AA (4.5:1) wɔ hann ne sum tebea nyinaa mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛmti ahorow a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no de adwinnade biara a ɛkyerɛ kɔla ahorow sɔ nsonsonoe hwɛ ansa na wɔde amena.

a11y.li2: Ɛsɛ sɛ mfonini ahorow no nya alt nkyerɛwee (a11y label).

performance.h3: Kwati adwuma a wobɛyɛ wɔ keystroke biara mu
performance.p1: Reactivity yɛ fine-grained: components a ɛkenkan cell re-render a wɔasesa nkutoo. Biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛkyerɛw "for free" a ɛkanyan dua a edi mũ re-render.
performance.p2: Nneɛma mpempem pii a wɔahyehyɛ no ye. Runtime no diffs denam element identity so, enti prepending yɛ O(1). Kwati kɔmputa so nsɛmfua a ɛsan susuw list no nyinaa ho wɔ nsakrae biara so — bubu adwuma no mu ma ɛnyɛ ade biara akontaabu nkwammoaa.
performance.p3: High-frequency inputs: fa :: debounce(ms) di dwuma wɔ input biara a ɛkanyan network frɛ so. 300 ms taa yɛ nea ɛteɛ.
performance.p4: Bundle kɛse: Architex parser + renderer no wɔ ase 30 KB gzipped. Wo .arx fael no de n’ankasa kɛse ka ho — ma mfonini ahorow no nkɔ bundle no mu na fa URL gu mu.
performance.p5: Profile: Architex inspector no kyerɛ per-component render akontabuo ne computed-cell nhwehwɛmu akontabuo. Cell biara a ɛsɔ hwɛ bɛboro pɛnkoro wɔ ɔdefo nkitahodi biara mu no yɛ profiling botae.

runtime.p1: Architex runtime yɛ TypeScript paket a wɔatintim sɛ architex. Ɛwɔ module anan: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Lexer no kenkan source text na ɔde token ahorow ma. Ɛyɛ adeɛ baako pɛ a ɛdwene whitespace ho — downstream module biara yɛ adwuma wɔ tokens ne AST nodes so.
runtime.p3: Parser no si AST. AST nodes no yɛ typed na serialisable enti wobetumi de amena wɔ process hye so (ɛho wɔ mfaso ma hot-reload ne remote preview).
runtime.p4: Renderer no nantew AST no so a render context a host no de ama (web DOM / SwiftUI bridge / Compose bridge) na ɛma native views.
runtime.p5: Hosts de interface teateaa di dwuma: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, ne modifier application. Sɛ wode host foforo ka ho a, egye gluu code bɛyɛ 500.
runtime.li2: Parser: ɛma AST a wɔakyerɛw so.
runtime.li3: Renderer: nantew AST, ananmusifo kɔ ahɔhoyɛfo no nkyɛn.
runtime.li4: Reactive: automatic dependency tracking + batched nsɛm foforo.

migration.p1: Architex di semver akyi. Patches nsɛe biribiara. Mmofra nkumaa de nneɛma bi ka ho. Majors betumi de asram 12 deprecation window abubu nneɛma.
migration.p2: Nneɛma a wɔagyae no kɔ so yɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm nketenkete a ɛtoatoa so no nyinaa mu. Runtime no kyerɛw kɔkɔbɔ a ɛfa deprecation ho wɔ bere a edi kan a wɔde di dwuma no mu; IDE no si koodu a wɔagyae so dua.
migration.p3: Forward compat: fael ahorow a wɔakyerɛw atia kan nor version no kyerɛ sɛnea ɛte bere nyinaa wɔ akyiri yi runtime mu. Yɛnsesa nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛwɔ akyi da.
migration.p4: Wɔde nsakraeɛ a ɛbubuo ho amanneɛbɔ ma wɔ nsakraeɛ kyerɛwtohɔ no mu a ɛwɔ atutena akwankyerɛ. Nnwinnade a wɔde tu kwan a wɔde wɔn ankasa yɛ no kata mfiridwuma mu nsakrae dodow no ara so.
migration.p5: LTS: nkyerɛaseɛ kɛseɛ biara wɔ asram 24 mmoa mfɛnsere ma ahobanbɔ nsiesie a ɛho hia, mpo wɔ po so ahyɛn akɛseɛ a ɛdi hɔ no akyi.

migration.li3: Majors: nsakrae a ɛbubu, a asram 12 deprecation ka ho.

faq.p1: Asɛmmisa: So metumi akyerɛw app a edi mũ wɔ Architex mu? A: Wɔayɛ Architex ama Mini Apps — screens a ɛte nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Sɛ wopɛ native app a edi mũ a wopɛ SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: Asɛmmisa: Sɛ wɔde toto Flutter ho a, ɛte dɛn? A: Flutter trɛw kɛse nanso ɛwɔ runtime a ɛyɛ n’ankasa (Dart VM + Skia). Architex yɛ ketewaa bi na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ host primitives so. Sɛ wuhia platform lock-in a, Flutter; sɛ wuhia sɛ wo nsa ka a, Architex.
faq.p3: Asɛmmisa: Dɛn nti na if block biara nni hɔ? A: Efisɛ hidden / visible nsakraefo kata UI tebea horow no 95%% so yiye. Wɔ 5%% a aka no fam no, nsɛmfua abiɛsa yɛ adwuma.
faq.p4: Asɛmmisa: So Architex yɛ nea wɔabue ano? A: Yiw — hwɛ GitHub repo no. MIT-licensed runtime, tumi krataa nhama biara nni hɔ.
faq.p5: Asɛmmisa: So metumi afrɛ native code? A: Ɛnam host-exposed built-ins anaa bot send() nneyɛe so nkutoo. Direct native-bridge yɛ nea wɔahyɛ da anyɛ mmoa — ɛbɛbubu portability.
faq.p6: Asɛmmisa: Max screen a ɛyɛ den? A: Runtime no di 10 k reactive cells ne 100 k list nneɛma ho dwuma yiye. Nea ɛboro saa no, bubu kɔ screen ahorow pii mu.
faq.p7: Asɛmmisa: So metumi akɔ so ayɛ tebea? A: Yiw, ɛnam store(key, value) (per-Mini-App local) anaa send(action: "save") so kɔ bot no so (server-side).
faq.p8: Asɛmmisa: So ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ intanɛt so? A: Yiw ma pure-UI screens. Biribiara a ɛfrɛ send() hia network no.
faq.p9: Asɛmmisa: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi de custom component bi aka ho? A: @component wɔ Architex mu, anaasɛ (sɛ wuhia native primitives a) boa ma Architex host package no.
faq.p10: Q: Adwumayɛ so vs nsa-kyerɛw native? A: Mpɛn pii no 3-8 %% brɛoo sen nsa akyerɛw SwiftUI / Compose. Nnipa-a wontumi nhu ma screens a ɛyɛ daa.

faq.li2: Max fael: 1 MB .arx fibea ansa na kɔkɔbɔ aba.
faq.li4: Max component nesting: 32 a ɛwɔ soro.

gotchas.p1: Architex de spaces 2 di dwuma wɔ indent level biara mu. Wɔpow tabs wɔ parse bere mu. IDE dodow no ara dannan wɔn ho wɔn ho; sɛ wuhu indent mfomso a wonhwɛ kwan a, hwɛ sɛ afrafra whitespace.
gotchas.p2: Closures wɔ computed expressions mu kenkan reactive cells wɔ evaluation bere mu, na ɛnyɛ declaration bere mu. ~a := ~b + 1 de mprempren ~b no di dwuma bere nyinaa, ɛnyɛ bo a ɛsom wɔ mpaemuka mu.
gotchas.p3: Async send() de ma cell no bere a Bɔhyɛ no asiesie, a ebetumi ayɛ out-of-order sɛ sends pii wɔ wimhyɛn mu a. Awɛmfo a wɔde ~loading frankaa anaa nɔma a ɛtoatoa so.
gotchas.p4: Type nhyɛso: "5" + 1 susuw ho sɛ "51", ɛnyɛ 6. Fa Number("5") di dwuma anaa kyerɛw nkwammoaa no ho nsɛm sɛ : number.
gotchas.p5: Deeply nested reactive objects: sɛ wosakra agyapade bi (~obj.x = 5) a, ɛnkanyan updates wɔ akenkanfo a wɔwɔ ~obj no so. San fa ade no nyinaa ma mmom.
gotchas.p6: Modifier nhyehyɛe wɔ abusua bi mu: kɔla modifiers siesie last-writer-wins. Mfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn color(...) abien nhwɛ kwan sɛ wobɛfrafra.
gotchas.p7: @for nipadua no ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde indented level biako pɛpɛɛpɛ kɔ akyiri. Abofra a ɔwɔ level abien nyɛ parse mfomso na mmom semantic mis-nest — runtime no di no sɛ @for no nua.
